amazon.description: Amazon.com storefront system: white #ffffff canvas, near-black #0f1111 text, #131921 navigation bar, a yellow #ffd814 action button with 8px radius, Amazon Ember Modern Display 700 headlines over Arial 400 functional text, and dense bordered card grids where imagery carries all the colour.

amd-g.name: AMD
amd-g.description: AMD.com home: a black #000000 canvas lit by cyan light-trail imagery, Klavika 54.4px/600 headlines, Open Sans 16px/24px body in #f8f9fa, AMD cyan #00c2de for outlined 2px-radius buttons and accent words, #2899ff product links, and 12px-radius cards edged in translucent white.

american-airlines.name: American Airlines
american-airlines.description: aa.com, American Airlines' booking site: white #ffffff canvas, slate #36495a body copy, #0078d2 link blue, #00467f navy headings and a #0860c4 Log in button set in AmericanSans Var 16px/700 with 3.5px corners, plus a cool grey #d0dae0 footer. Type runs through the proprietary AmericanSans, AmericanSansLight and AmericanSans Var families.

amex.name: American Express
amex.description: American Express's site runs on its internal DLS (Design Language System): a white #ffffff canvas, Bright Blue #006fcf actions and links, Deep Blue #00175a for the darkest brand moments, and a six-step gray ramp from #f7f8f9 to #333333 (body ink). Type pairs BentonSans light (300) for 30px display lines with Helvetica Neue for UI and reading text (15px/22px, 16px/24px, 20px/26px). Buttons are 50px tall with 4px corners and 13px 30px padding (the header sign-in is 48px with 8px corners); cards are flat white with a 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.1) shadow, and focus is a 1px dashed #53565a outline offset by 3px.

amgen.name: Amgen
amgen.description: Amgen global home page: Amgen blue #0063c3 buttons and bands, pale #edf2f7 background, Poppins with 16px uppercase 700 buttons, 3px radius, photographic story tiles with blue gradient caption panels.

amity-solutions.name: Amity Solutions
amity-solutions.description: Amity Solutions (Thai enterprise AI software) design system: Euclid Circular B 48px headings with Inter body, white canvas, green #1dc497 8px-radius buttons, mint #e6f9f4 tints, 32px glass cards and a #121419 footer.

amplitude.name: Amplitude
amplitude.description: Amplitude's analytics site: a white #ffffff canvas with black #000000 headlines in Gellix 72px/600 tracked -1px, Gray 70 #50565b body copy at 18px/24px, black pill 'Start for free' buttons, Amplitude Blue #0052f2 reserved for CTAs, links and eyebrows, #f5f7fa product panels and 13.5px-radius cards.

amrit-palace.name: Amrit Palace
amrit-palace.description: Amrit Palace home page: sand #d8cbb8 background, charcoal #2c2c2c text, saffron amber #d49653 menu panel and icon tiles, Satoshi 11px copy with TT Ramillas serif display, 2-4px radii and dark candle-lit photography.

ana.name: ANA (All Nippon Airways) — US English site
ana.description: ANA's US English home page measured live — a #f1f1f1 grey page with white #ffffff panels, ANA navy #00146e for every action, #333333 text, a pale booking blue #ccd4ea, and a Myriad Pro stack (Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial fallbacks) set at 14px body with 600-weight headings; pill buttons at 18px and 100px radii, 15px and 20px card corners.

ananda-development.name: Ananda Development
ananda-development.description: Ananda Development English home page: cobalt blue #0032c8 pills and #0032c6 header, white canvas, Kanit and DB Helvethaica X Thai type, 8px cards, 20px See more button and per-project pastel card colors.

anantara.name: Anantara Hotels & Resorts
anantara.description: Anantara Hotels & Resorts: warm sand canvas #f9f5f3, taupe accent #a48e82, charcoal text #4a4a4a, Raleway ultra-light 100-weight display at 50px with Oswald letterspaced uppercase buttons, 2px corners, luxury resort portfolio.

anime-js.name: Anime.js
anime-js.description: Anime.js: warm near-black canvas #252423, stone text #b4b1af, DIN 800 display and 64px 700 hero, uppercase Mono labels, lime #b7ff54 accent, square-cornered buttons with 1px hairline borders; a JavaScript animation engine site.

ant.name: Ant Design
ant.description: Ant Design (antd) is Alibaba's enterprise React design system: a white canvas with one brand blue #1677ff, alpha-black text (#000000e0 down to #00000040), 14px/22px base type in the system stack with AlibabaSans on the marketing site, 32px controls with 6px radius (8px on large buttons and cards), and a faint 2px offset button shadow.

ant-group.name: Ant Group
ant-group.description: Ant Group (蚂蚁集团) corporate site: white canvas, #666666 body text, #333333 headings, Ant blue #1677ff for the active tab, deep navy #0c1f3a footer, AlibabaPuHuiTi display at 48px, full-bleed photography, 24px-radius ghost buttons.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.description: Anthropic home: ivory canvas #faf9f5 with oat page band #f0eee6, near-black ink #141413, Anthropic Sans 700 headlines at 57.7px, Anthropic Serif body and 71px display, oat #e3dacc cards with 24px radius, dark pill buttons.

ants.name: ANTS
ants.description: ANTS (Advance Network Technology and Services), a Thai SMS, LINE and MarTech platform company: white #ffffff canvas, deep navy #19164f ink and buttons, orange #f26622 kicker labels, Poppins with Kanit for Thai, 64px hero headings, pill buttons with a 0 2px 10px shadow and 16px to 54px rounded cards on a calm, photo-led layout.

anuc-home.name: Anuc Home
anuc-home.description: Anuc Home: Spanish-language interior design and Feng Shui studio; white canvas, #f0f0ef stone bands, ink #1a1a1e, Instrument Serif 68.5px display, Instrument Sans 17.5px body, five Feng Shui element accents, square-cornered stone-gray buttons.

anytype.name: Anytype
anytype.description: Anytype (anytype.io), "a safe haven for digital collaboration": a stark black-and-white grid site. Riccionets serif display type from 88px to 120px with tight negative tracking, Inter 300 18px/26px body, a #000000 6px-radius Download button, 1px #5b5b5b grid lines on black bands, and #ff6a7b coral and #3cd9b3 mint accents.

aot.name: Airports of Thailand PLC (AOT)
aot.description: Airports of Thailand PLC (AOT) English home: white canvas, navy #032d5d headings, royal-blue #2f4791 menu band and Search button, deep navy #182852 footer, Kanit and Noto Sans Thai type, navy news cards with 25px radius.

ap-property-perfect.name: Property Perfect
ap-property-perfect.description: Property Perfect (pf.co.th) residential developer site, Thai-language, set in aktiv-grotesk-thai 400/500/700 with navy #003767 / #004b8d headings and actions on a white #ffffff canvas, corner-cut radii (single rounded top-left corner of 10px to 14px) and a red #ee2e24 hotline pill.

ap-thailand.name: AP Thai
ap-thailand.description: AP Thai (AP Thailand) Thai-language home: white canvas with #f5f5f7 bands, AP typeface, brand red #921d1e pill buttons at 9999px radius, 36px-radius project cards, gray #6b6b70 body text, warm #f5f0ea section surfaces, real-estate listings.

apechain.name: ApeChain
apechain.description: ApeChain: electric blue #0054fa hero, pale sky canvas #e2f0ff, midnight #030a21 page band, manuka condensed uppercase display (120px hero), DM Sans body 16px, DM Mono 12px uppercase buttons with 16px radius and gradient outlines.

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.description: Apollo.io's apollo.io site: a white #ffffff content sheet with 24px corners set inside a warm grey #ccc9c6 frame, black #000000 seasonMix serif headlines (64px/550), abcDiatype body text, an acid yellow #ebf212 8px-radius 'Sign up for free' button (hover #fcffa8), black and outlined secondary buttons, warm #f7f5f2 image panels and 24px-radius cards with #e4e5d9 borders.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: apple.com is a cinematic product-tile gallery: alternating black #000000 and light #f5f5f7 tiles, SF Pro Display 56px/600 headlines with -0.28px tracking, SF Pro Text 17px buttons, a single blue #0071e3 on 44px full-pill (980px) CTAs, a 44px translucent nav #1d1d1fcc, and almost no shadow or border chrome.

apple-music.name: Apple Music
apple-music.description: Apple Music marketing page (apple.com/apple-music): Apple's light gallery system — #f5f5f7 sections, #ffffff cards with an 18px radius, #1d1d1f text — set in SF Pro Display (128px/600 hero, -0.256px tracking) and SF Pro Text (17px/25px body, -0.374px). The action color is Apple Music red #fa243c on 980px pill buttons (11px 21px, 44px tall); the hero sits on a magenta-to-red gradient and links are #0066cc. The music.apple.com web player uses #d60017.

application.name: Application
application.description: App dashboard with purple-themed aesthetic, top-bar navigation, card-based layouts, and developer-first workflows.

appwrite.name: Appwrite
appwrite.description: Appwrite's open-source cloud site: a white #ffffff canvas, zinc #71717b body text and #09090b headings, Appwrite Pink #fd366e buttons with 8px corners, light Aeonik Pro 76px/400 display headlines with a trailing underscore, system-UI body at 15px/24px, and frosted #ffffffcc product cards.

arc.name: Arc
arc.description: Arc's arc.net is a playful brand-blue site: #3139fb headings and full-bleed bands, an #fffcec off-white, Marlin Soft SQ 700 headlines with tight tracking (45.51px hero, 28px sections at -1.4px), ABC Oracle body, #2702c2 and white download buttons at 10px radius, and pastel browser screenshots as the main imagery.

arcadia.name: Arcadia
arcadia.description: Arcadia (arcadia.com), the energy intelligence platform: deep Evening Sea greens (#0b2c24 full-bleed bands, #104336 cards and buttons) over a warm Pampas #f3f1ec page top, with Arcadia Green #0fff87 reserved for the primary call to action. Everything is set in DM Sans (served as __DMSans_cff41e), light 300 for 56px/61.6px hero headlines with +0.56px tracking, 16-20px regular body in cream #f9f3e8 on the dark canvas and #535e5d on the light Pampas top. Buttons are 8px-radius rectangles 42-48px tall; product cards use 16px corners and 24px padding.

arco.name: ByteDance
arco.description: ByteDance corporate site: solid blue #3c8cff navigation, near-black #333333 text on white, DouyinSans-Bold display (52px, falls back to a serif in capture) with DM Sans 22px body, 22px card radius, circular portraits and soft gradient circles.

arco-design.name: Arco Design
arco-design.description: Arco Design is ByteDance's open-source enterprise design system: Inter with CJK fallbacks at 14px, one cobalt blue #165dff on a white canvas, a cool grey ramp (#1d2129, #4e5969, #86909c, #e5e6eb, #f7f8fa), 32px controls with 2px radii, flat 1px-bordered surfaces and faint cool shadows.

arcteryx.name: Arc'teryx
arcteryx.description: Arc'teryx Canada home page (arcteryx.com/ca/en), measured — white #ffffff canvas, #1a1a1a black for copy, input and footer, full-bleed outdoor photography with Elan ITC Pro 32px uppercase titles, Helvetica Now Display 16px/400 body with 0.32px tracking, ghost buttons with #b2b2b2 borders, #f5f5f5 41px search pill.

are-na.name: Are.na
are-na.description: Are.na's homepage is a quiet, document-like page: #ffffff canvas, #333333 ink, a single 568px text column set in Areal (Dinamo's custom Arial revival, served as areal, "areal Fallback", Arial) at 19.2px/400, and one deep navy #00075f used for the Sign up button and the footer. Buttons are 34px tall with a 3px radius and 700-weight 14.4px labels; surfaces are #f7f7f7 greys with #ededed hairlines and a soft 0 0 34px shadow.

area-17.name: AREA 17
area-17.description: AREA 17's site is a restrained white #ffffff page in Suisse Intl: 55px/500 statements with -0.825px tracking, 16px/400 body (+0.064px), #1a1a1a ink, #949494 grey lists, light-grey #f2f2f2 buttons with 8px radius and 16px 24px padding, #e6e6e6 hairlines, full-bleed black #000000 media sections and no shadows.

areeya.name: Areeya Property
areeya.description: Areeya Property (areeya.co.th) developer site: DB Gill Siam X Thai type with a 45px bold heading and 20px body, #101010 ink on a warm #f6f6f3 canvas, an olive #6e7c5d search button and footer band, square 0px controls, hairline-underlined form fields and calm architectural photography of Como, Aren and Nora homes.

ariakit.name: Ariakit
ariakit.description: ariakit.com, the docs and showcase for an unstyled React accessibility toolkit: near-white #fcfdfd canvas with cool gray #edf0f3 cards, black type in a Geist Sans variable face (72px/800 hero, 24px body), a single blue #007acc primary with 8px radius and soft shadow, and 4px to 16px radii on example surfaces.

arinsiri.name: Arinsiri Land
arinsiri.description: Arinsiri Land (arinsiri.com) Thai home developer site in Rethink Sans with Kanit Thai fallback: gold #ad8700 accents on deep navy #003b70, near-black #2c2c2c text on white #ffffff, 7px ghost links, 30px navy quote card and 15% rounded image frames.

arise-idc.name: Arise IDC
arise-idc.description: Arise IDC: Thailand's AI hyperscale data center provider; white canvas with #f8f8f8 bands, black buttons with 6px radius, gold-magenta-red gradient (#ffca00, #ff0099, #ff0000), brandFont 500-weight type at 50px display, 16px-radius white service cards.

ark-ui.name: Ark UI
ark-ui.description: Ark UI is Chakra Systems' headless component library (45+ components for React, Solid, Vue, Svelte on Zag.js). Its site uses Wix Madefor Text on a warm #fdfdfc canvas, warm greys (#21201c, #63635e, #e9e8e6), one coral accent #eb5e41 on 4px-radius buttons, 60px/700 hero type and a dark #191918 code panel.

arket.name: ARKET
arket.description: ARKET's web store as measured on arket.com: a white #ffffff canvas, pure black #000000 text and buttons, and full-bleed editorial photography, set entirely in the brand's own monospaced arketSansMono (one weight, 400) with an arketSCSansMono small-caps companion for chips and badges. Corners are almost square — 2px buttons, 1px badges, 4px search field — with 12px pill-ish category chips in #eaeae8, a cream #fff3db 'New' badge and sale red #d80404 as the only accents.

arqui9-visualisation.name: Arqui9 Visualisation
arqui9-visualisation.description: Arqui9 Visualisation: London 3D architectural visualisation studio; pure black canvas #000000, white text, PPNeueMontreal 400 at 41.6px display and 17.3px body, MartianMono uppercase micro-labels, no radii, full-bleed CGI imagery.

artefakt.name: Artefakt
artefakt.description: Artefakt (artefakt.mov): Frankfurt hybrid film production studio; pure black canvas #000000, white text, DrukWide 700 uppercase at 42.67px with -1.78px tracking, TronicaMono 10.67px uppercase body, square corners, ASCII-glyph hero.

artem-shcherbakov.name: Artem Shcherbakov
artem-shcherbakov.description: Artem Shcherbakov: director and creative lead portfolio; white canvas, near-black #0e0e0e ink, EaseDouble 900 display with -6.26px tracking at 78.2px, Arial Narrow body 21.3px, neon green #00fe40 accent, capsule-shaped media.

article.name: Article
article.description: Article's storefront (article.com) is a warm, photo-heavy modern-furniture shop set in Proxima Nova, served as separate files (proxima_nova_regular / proxima_nova_bold, all at computed weight 400): #2e2e2e ink on #ffffff, coral #ff6458 as the single accent for Add to cart pills (9999px radius, 1.6px uppercase tracking, hover #cc5046), white 100px-radius pills on photography, 32px bold headlines, 8px-radius cards with a 1px #c2c2c2 border, and a #2e2e2e footer.

artiom-yakushev.name: Artiom Yakushev
artiom-yakushev.description: Black-canvas portfolio of a Yerevan-based digital designer: pure white text on #000000, Suisse grotesk at 70.4px headings and 16.64px body with tight negative tracking, Apparel serif italic accents at 24.32px, grey #8a8a8a secondary text, and no buttons or filled controls.

artistic.name: Artistic
artistic.description: High-contrast, expressive style with creative typography and bold color choices for visually striking interfaces.

artsy.name: Artsy
artsy.description: Artsy's marketplace site and its open Palette system — a near-monochrome gallery wall in ll-unica77 (Helvetica Neue fallback) with black text on white, grey ramp #707070 to #f7f7f7, black 15px-radius pill buttons that turn Artsy blue #1023d7 on hover, and 3px-radius search inputs; the art supplies all the colour.

asana.name: Asana
asana.description: asana.com home: white canvas, near-black #0d0d0d ink and pill buttons (100px radius), TWK Lausanne in light 300 weight at 102px with -2.55px tracking for the hero, 54px section headings, 20px body, and animated product-graph illustrations with a coral-to-fuchsia gradient on one hero phrase.

ascend-group.name: Ascend Group
ascend-group.description: Ascend Group is the Bangkok-based Ascend corporate site: Anuyart type (48px bold uppercase headlines, 14px body), a brand red #ed1c24 header and buttons with 3px radius, white and light-grey #e5e5e7 bands, rounded 20px image cards, and a page-wide grayscale(1) CSS filter on the live site at measurement time, removed for the colour capture.

ascend-money.name: Ascend Money
ascend-money.description: Ascend Money is the regional fintech arm of Ascend Group: a white header with the ascend money wordmark and a red active-link underline, deep red #8b0304 bands with white anuyart_light type at 21px body and 36px headlines, light grey #ececec sections and full-bleed portrait photography.

ashley-brooke.name: Ashley Brooke Creative Studio
ashley-brooke.description: ABCS, the Ashley Brooke creative studio site: white #ffffff canvas, near-black #131410 ink, brand red #f63d18, pale blue-grey #d9e3e7 display words, Mosvita bold 36.6536px headlines with -1.09961px tracking, Universo 500 uppercase 94.5359px statements, 8px radius cards.

asia-biomass.name: Asia Biomass
asia-biomass.description: Thai-language corporate site of Asia Biomass Public Company Limited (ABM), a biomass-fuel supplier. Prompt typeface at weight 500 and 600, brand green #1e8b44 for headings and the top bar, chocolate-brown #6d3c18 buttons with 5px radius, white canvas and a pale #f8fcff section tint.

asia-books.name: Asia Books
asia-books.description: Asia Books (asiabooks.com) is a Thailand bookstore web shop set in DB Heavent at 16px to 24px, black on white with a Tailwind-style green brand (#00b54e fills, #22b25a links), a cream #fff8e7 New Releases band, red #da383f discount prices in pink-bordered pills, and 50px pill outline buttons around book-cover carousels.

asia-green-energy.name: Asia Green Energy
asia-green-energy.description: Asia Green Energy (AGE, age.co.th), a Thai clean-coal trader, logistics and sustainable-energy group, uses a white canvas #ffffff, charcoal ink #333333 and a single brand green #00a052 for buttons, headings and the top bar, with an #f5f6f7 footer, Prompt 500 at 16px/23.8px and TBold display headings.

asia-plus.name: Asia Plus Securities
asia-plus.description: Thai brokerage and research portal in DB Heavent: 86px weight-100 headings, navy #132a4b bands, teal #04a791 accents, white #ffffff research cards, 0px-radius navy submit button and 4px-radius cards with 50px pill outlines.

asian-marine-services.name: Asian Marine Services PCL. (Asimar)
asian-marine-services.description: Asimar, Thailand's listed shipyard (page title 'Asian Marine Service PCL. - Most Awarded Shipyard in Thailand'): navy #273b7b bars and buttons, white #ffffff body, black #000000 hero, Avenir LT light 17px body, Avenir heavy 32px and 60px headings, flat square buttons.

asiatique.name: Asiatique The Riverfront
asiatique.description: Asiatique The Riverfront (asiatiquethailand.com) is Bangkok's riverside night-market mall: a white canvas with Prompt at 16px for text and Taviraj 600 serif headlines at 32px to 48px, black ink, crimson #c60c46 as the single accent for the logo, active and hover navigation, and four tall cinematic photo columns at the top of the page.

asos.name: ASOS
asos.description: ASOS's home page is black-and-white fashion retail set entirely in futura-pt: white #ffffff page, #000000 header, tiles and footer, square-cornered (0px) white 'SHOP WOMENS' buttons in 16px Bold with 2px letter-spacing, a navy #051a6e app CTA, and a 19px-radius search field.

aspen-search.name: Aspen Search
aspen-search.description: Executive search for quantitative finance and tech: white #ffffff grid of hairline-divided cells, near-black #232323 ink and panels, mint #a1ffcb accent, SuisseIntl at weight 450 with -4% tracking (161.339px display), SuisseIntl Mono 12px uppercase labels, halftone-dithered imagery, square 0px corners.

asset-five.name: Asset Five Group
asset-five.description: Asset Five Group (A5, assetfive.co.th) Thai luxury-home developer site: burgundy #741032 ink and headings, gold #d39359 hover accent, black #000000 header and caption bars, Kanit Thai text with the arpona display face on a white #ffffff canvas, 5px and 100px radii.

asset-world.name: Asset World Corporation
asset-world.description: Asset World Corporation (AWC), Thailand's integrated lifestyle real-estate group: white #ffffff canvas, charcoal #1a1a1a ink, burgundy #a32035 for section labels and hover, Arial throughout with 6px-tracked 30px uppercase statements, full-bleed hotel photography and 3px to 4px radii.

associated-press.name: Associated Press (AP News)
associated-press.description: AP News home page: white #ffffff canvas, ink #191919, AP red #da1026, black #000000 header and footer, grey #f2f2f2 modules, the proprietary AP typeface at 13px body and 23px/700 headlines, uppercase 30px section titles, 3px radii and a dense multi-column news grid.

assumption-university.name: Assumption University of Thailand
assumption-university.description: Assumption University (AU) home page: white #ffffff canvas, black #000000 text, red #dd3333 buttons with 8px radius and drop shadow, crimson #aa1e23 and #a51818 headings, footer #e02826, Kanit 17.6px body with Monda 25px card titles, outlined pill header buttons.

aston-martin.name: Aston Martin
aston-martin.description: Aston Martin UK home page (astonmartin.com/en-gb): full-bleed car photography with near-black #161a11 hero fields, off-white #f4f4f2 news band, racing-green #00665e actions, AstonMartinFlare serif headlines at 54px and 32px, AstonMartinSans 14px body with 0.55px tracking, 2px-radius buttons.

astrazeneca.name: AstraZeneca
astrazeneca.description: AstraZeneca global home page: white #ffffff canvas, slate ink #3c4242, plum #830051 buttons with 2px radius, navy #003865 stat tile, dark #1b1b1b footer, lexia serif headlines (42px light, 28px, 23px) with positive tracking, Helvetica Neue navigation, science and people photography.

astro.name: Astro
astro.description: Astro's marketing site (astro.build) is a deep-night dark page: canvas #060913 with #0c0f19 panels, body copy in #bfc1c9 at weight 300, headlines in OH no Type's Obviously (48px/700 hero), a white #ffffff pill 'Get Started' CTA (9999px radius, 42px tall), 16px-radius cards with #23262d borders, and mint #4bf3c8 / amber #ffd493 eyebrow accents over purple-to-blue gradient art.

astro-uxds.name: Astro UXDS (Rocket Communications)
astro-uxds.description: Rocket Communications' site, creator of the Astro Space UX Design System, uses the Aglet Sans typeface in uppercase with wide tracking (80px display, 4px letter-spacing), a light #f4f4f4 canvas with #1f3345 ink, deep navy and #131313 bands, an orange #f6a10e accent, 30px-radius outlined buttons and curved section edges over space imagery.

astrodither.name: ASTRODITHER
astrodither.description: AstroDither by Robert Borghesi LAB, an audio-reactive Three.js and WebGPU dithering experiment: near-black #080808 canvas, off-white #f7f8f9 text, Azeret Mono at 11.9467px with -1.19467px tracking, and a 50%-black entry label over a pixel-glyph field in pink, violet and white.

asus.name: ASUS
asus.description: ASUS global home page: white #ffffff and light grey #f5f5f5 canvas with black #000000 product-campaign bands, slate ink #4d4d4d and #181818, ASUS blue #006ce1 for buttons and Learn more links, TT Norms Pro headings (52px condensed display, 42px/44px) over Roboto body, 8px button radius and 16px card radius.

atandt.name: AT&T
atandt.description: AT&T consumer home page: white #ffffff and cool grey #f3f4f6 surfaces with sky tint #f2fafd, ink #1d2329, brand cobalt #00388f pill buttons (28px radius, 48px tall), cyan #009fdb hero headline, bold sans at 48px with -1.44px tracking, card shadow 0 4px 20px 6px.

atelier-zero.name: Atelier Zero
atelier-zero.description: A magazine-grade, collage-driven visual system: warm paper canvas, surreal

atlanta-hotel-bangkok.name: The Atlanta Hotel Bangkok
atlanta-hotel-bangkok.description: Wix-built site of The Atlanta Hotel, Bangkok (est. 1952): a flat #910826 oxblood canvas, a cream #ffe991 art-deco wordmark set in an uploaded custom font, white 20px bold body copy in the Wix web font proxima-n-w01-reg, and square #edcc26 yellow link-buttons with 3px black borders and a soft 4px shadow.

atlas-energy.name: Atlas Energy
atlas-energy.description: Atlas Energy Public Company Limited (atlasenergy.co.th), the Thai LPG distributor behind the PT cooking-gas brand, uses a white canvas #ffffff, charcoal ink #333333, green #1eaf4d for its main button and #04c542 tiles, orange #ff7f28 for headings and tiles, set in Anuphan with 18px/28.8px body and rounded 40px tiles.

atlaskit.name: Atlaskit
atlaskit.description: Atlaskit docs site for Atlassian's UI library: white sidebar on a #f8f8f8 page, #292a2e text, Atlassian blue #1868db, Charlie Display 32px titles with Atlassian Sans 14px UI text, 4px and 6px radii and hairline card shadows built on --ds-* tokens.

atlassian-brand.name: Atlassian
atlassian-brand.description: Atlassian marketing home page (atlassian.com): a white canvas (#ffffff) with near-black ink (#292a2e, headings #101214), a single blue (#1868db) on pill CTAs and links, Atlassian's brand typefaces Charlie Display (54px at weight 500, tight negative tracking) and Charlie Text, 20px and 40px card radii, and a charcoal (#1e1f21) feature band, all expressed through --ds- design-token variables.

atlassian-design.name: Atlassian Design
atlassian-design.description: The Atlassian Design System site: Atlassian Sans (an Inter derivative) on white with ink #292a2e, one brand blue #1868db (hover #1558bc), a #f8f8f8 sunken band, 112px/700 hero type, 6px-radius 32px buttons and 40px text fields, pill secondary buttons, and playful illustration tiles over strictly token-driven (--ds-*) chrome.

attio.name: Attio
attio.description: Attio's CRM site is a near-white #ffffff / #fafafb product canvas in Inter and Inter Display (500 weight, tight -0.01em tracking), near-black #1c1d1f headlines with grey #6f7988 continuations, 10px-radius charcoal #202124 buttons with a #505967 border, layered hairline shadows and a dark #101010 'Universal Context' band and footer.

audemars-piguet.name: Audemars Piguet
audemars-piguet.description: Audemars Piguet's homepage is a black-canvas (#000000) cinematic site: Helvetica Neue Web at weight 100 uppercase 56px for display, white ink, a deep green accent #2b4f4f, square 0px buttons and italic serif Times Now accents over full-bleed watch and jewellery photography.

audi.name: Audi (audi.com corporate site)
audi.description: Audi's corporate site audi.com/en measured live — a near-black #101319 dark theme with #020203 header and footer, translucent off-white text #fcfcfdb2 and #fcfcfd, slate-grey #657081 pill buttons (999px) that darken to #2c343f on hover, 10px media corners and 20px outlined tiles, all set in the variable Audi Type at a single 400 weight from 36px down to 12px.

audible.name: Audible
audible.description: Audible's US storefront (audible.com): a near-black #000000 content field with white Audible Sans headlines at 700 weight, #ffb333 and #ffa000 pill buttons carrying #010e19 text, pale-blue #a3d4ff title links on dark, a white #ffffff header and footer, and floating rounded book-cover art as the only imagery.

australia-gov-au.name: myGov
australia-gov-au.description: myGov (my.gov.au), the Australian Government portal that australia.gov.au permanently redirects to: Roboto with a 62px weight-300 headline, a #66d3ee brand-blue header band, black #000000 buttons with 4px corners, white cards with a 1px #d9d9d6 border and a 6px soft shadow, and a full-width black footer.

auth0.name: Auth0
auth0.description: Auth0's marketing site: light-weight Aeonik 400 display at 64px/72px with -1px tracking on a deep violet #20003a canvas, a red-to-purple gradient hero, white #ffffff buttons with black text and a 4px radius, Aeonik Mono labels with 1.5px tracking, #120021 header and footer with lavender #ebd3ff uppercase footer headings.

autoguru.name: AutoGuru
autoguru.description: AutoGuru, the Australian online car-servicing marketplace: AvertaStandard at bold 700 (80px display, 16px body), one mint-green action color #01c68c on 8px-radius buttons, navy-slate ink #212338 and #484c5f, a white canvas washed with pale mint #dbfaf0 shapes, and 24px-radius cards. Built on AutoGuru's open Overdrive design system.

automattic.name: Automattic
automattic.description: Automattic's homepage is an editorial text page: Source Serif Pro in 400-700 on a white canvas (#ffffff), near-black ink (#222222) and black headlines (60px, weight 600, -1.2px tracking), with one accent, link blue (#3399cc), used for product names and links across a three-column list of products.

ava-srg.name: AVA SRG
ava-srg.description: AVA SRG, the 3.5-month web-design course by the AVA Digital studio: a warm-grey #dad9d3 / #e9e8e2 / #323232 three-surface page, giant uppercase Aeonik Pro Bold section titles at 76.7949px, IBM Plex Mono uppercase labels at 11.2614px, #211d1d ink, and a single red #d4202c that appears on hover.

avani.name: Avani Hotels & Resorts
avani.description: Avani Hotels & Resorts (avanihotels.com), the Minor Hotels brand: deep aubergine #350827 header, footer and buttons over pale #f1eff0 and #f7f6f3 surfaces, Gilroy at weight 100 for a 50px destination headline, letter-spaced Capitolium capitals for 2px-radius buttons, and full-bleed lifestyle photography.

avatr-vision-xpectra.name: AVATR Vision Xpectra
avatr-vision-xpectra.description: AVATR Vision Xpectra (vision.avatr.com), the concept-car microsite 'The Rise of Emotive Luxury': a black #010101 preloader and film hero that opens onto white #ffffff and deep-navy #001133 feature sections, one custom light-weight face named base at 300 and 400, 12px captions, 28px card titles, and 3.78px-radius black and outlined buttons.

avax-network-1.name: Avalanche
avax-network-1.description: Avalanche (avalanche.com, where avax.network now redirects): a #1d1d1d and #0a0a0a charcoal site with a heavy #e22b35 red, Aeonik at weight 900 in uppercase from 109.658px hero type down to 15.712px card heads, square 48px red buttons, 20.57px-radius panels, and a #c6cccd body ink.

aventura-dental-arts.name: Aventura Dental Arts
aventura-dental-arts.description: Aventura Dental Arts (ADA), a premium esthetic dental practice in South Florida: a #eae8e8 warm-grey and #14151d navy split palette, Instrument Serif headlines at 136px with -4.08036px tracking and an italic accent, Inter Tight body at weight 600 and 700 buttons, and pill-shaped Book A Call buttons.

aws-amplify.name: AWS Amplify
aws-amplify.description: The AWS Amplify product page sits inside the AWS marketing shell: Amazon Ember Display at weight 500, a dark navy utility bar, a white header, #161d26 pill buttons (40px radius, 44px tall) beside outlined twins, a lilac-to-pink gradient hero, and soft #f3f3f7 cards at 24px radius. Amplify UI, its React library, uses Inter and 4px teal buttons instead.

awwwards.name: Awwwards
awwwards.description: Awwwards' gallery-like, near-monochrome system — Inter Tight everywhere (600 for uppercase 112.31px display, 300 for 14px/28px body), #222222 ink and buttons on a #f8f8f8 canvas, 8px button radius, 14px card radius, a floating dark #222222cc dock, and a single #fa5d29 orange reserved for Academy offers and errors.

axa.name: AXA
axa.description: AXA's corporate website (axa.com): white #ffffff pages with #343c3d text and AXA blue #00008f navigation, Publico-Headline bold serif headlines at 48px over Source Sans Pro, square #f07662 coral READ MORE buttons, and full-bleed blue #4975ba, navy #274168 and gold #8a7333 content bands.

axiom.name: Axiom
axiom.description: Axiom's site is a near-black (#090909) observability page set in Geist with Berkeley Mono for data: Geist 64px/64px weight 500 headlines at -0.96px, 63%-white #ffffffa1 body text, an orange #da5c2b 'Start free' button at 6.08px radius, #1f1f1f-outlined secondary buttons, and #0c0c0c product panels with #222222 borders.

axios.name: Axios
axios.description: Axios is a white #ffffff / #f5f5f5 news site with #333335 ink: NB International Pro 400 sans headlines (40px/48px story heds, 26px hero, 48px article h1) over Atiza 18px/27px serif body with bold 600 'Why it matters:' lead-ins, a #1c3b7a navy top bar and footer, #104ac2 blue pill buttons that hover to #0b3997, 100px-radius pastel topic chips (#e1edfb, #e3f5fa, #edf6f2, #faf7f2) and 4px-radius #f5f5f5 tags.

axis-bank.name: Axis Bank
axis-bank.description: Axis Bank retail portal: deep burgundy #97144d on white and #f1f4f7, set in Lato (40px/54.4px headlines, 16px/24px body), 8px buttons, 12px cards with a wide soft shadow, and an italic burgundy open-to device repeated across rounded gradient sections.

b-grimm-power.name: B.Grimm Power
b-grimm-power.description: B.Grimm Power Public Company Limited English homepage (bgrimmpower.com/en/home): white canvas, Open Sans at 16px body and 80px weight-300 uppercase hero headline, #404040 text, orange #ff6727 brand accent with a 2px #ed713c header rule, outlined 4px-radius white buttons over dark photography and a #fafafa footer.

b2s.name: B2S
b2s.description: B2S Online (b2s.co.th), the Thai bookstore and stationery e-commerce site of Central Retail: dense white pages on a #ebf1f4 backdrop, Kanit at 12px with #2c2d4e navy-ink text, red #ff0000 ซื้อเลย buy buttons with 4px corners and 20px red prices, orange #f5822b links, and an olive #a6aa12 footer band.

baac.name: BAAC
baac.description: The English homepage of BAAC, Thailand's Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives: sage #e8e7dd bands, a #26770e farm-green header and pill buttons with #fdffe5 text, futura-100-thai headlines at 700 weight (64px hero, 48px titles), #043026 forest footer with 40px top corners, and full-bleed farmland photography.

babbel.name: Babbel
babbel.description: Babbel's language-learning home: warm cream #f6f4ef canvas, Babbel orange #fe4d01 Sign up pills and promo bands, sunshine #ffd966 sections, near-black #151515 text and pills, Feature Text LC serif headings at 32px over Graphik Babbel LCG body at 14px/20px, 4000px pills and 4px/12px/16px corners.

baidu.name: Baidu
baidu.description: Baidu's search homepage (baidu.com): a single white #ffffff screen with the red and blue Baidu logo, a wide rounded search box with a blue-to-violet 百度一下 button, #4e6ef2 login pill, #222222 Arial links at 13px, PingFang SC 16px AI banner, and a two-column hot-search list with red, orange and yellow rank numerals.

balance-4.name: Balance
balance-4.description: Balance is a one-person portfolio template site (demo persona John Taylor, Digital Designer) built as a monochrome editorial page — a #fcfcfc canvas, #141414 ink, one pill button, a 184.32px uppercase Inter hero name and Inter Tight 700 statement text, with grey #9d9d9d fine print.

balenciaga.name: Balenciaga
balenciaga.description: Balenciaga US online boutique (balenciaga.com/en-us): white #ffffff canvas, pure black #000000 type, a warm off-white #f6f5f3 'Discover the House' band and a flat grey #aaaaac footer. BB-CondBold uppercase headings at 22px with 1.1px tracking over BB-Regular 10–14px text; small 4px-radius outlined nav pills, 2px corners elsewhere, no shadows.

balmoral.name: Balmoral Running
balmoral.description: Balmoral Running is a Canadian running-apparel store built on a Shopify theme: a #ffffff canvas, #171614 ink, pale #eaeaec product tiles and black hero bands, ABCArizonaMix serif display at 40px over FTKunstGrotesk sans body at 15px, all corners square, no brand accent hue.

bam.name: Bangkok Commercial Asset Management (BAM)
bam.description: Thai debt-restructuring and repossessed-property site in IBM Plex Sans Thai: deep navy #044b80 bands, gold #edd311 buttons with #092c45 text at 8px radius, #444444 body ink, #f5f5f7 light sections, 32px-radius cards.

banana-it.name: BaNANA (Banana IT)
banana-it.description: BaNANA (bnn.in.th), Com7's Thai IT and gadget retailer: a dense promo-driven storefront on #ffffff with #f8f8f8 header strip, banana-yellow #ffdd00 CTAs and search accents, #252525 ink, red #f1574f prices, SukhumvitSet type at 12 to 16px, 4px buttons and 8px product cards.

banana-republic.name: Banana Republic
banana-republic.description: Banana Republic's US storefront (Gap Inc.): a quiet editorial retail site on #ffffff and #f2f1ee with #000000 ink, BananaSerif light 42.6667px headlines over photography, Lynstone v1 uppercase 12px navigation, square white 56px buttons, no accent hue and no radius.

bandai-namco.name: Bandai Namco Entertainment America
bandai-namco.description: Bandai Namco's Americas game-publisher site (bandainamcoent.com): a black header, hero and footer around white content bands, source-sans-pro at 60px/700 headlines and 16px body, white 40px pill buttons with 30px radius that turn #f6b700 on hover, and key-art tiles.

bandb-italia.name: B&B Italia
bandb-italia.description: B&B Italia's US site (bebitalia.com/en-us), an Italian luxury-furniture brand: a cool #f3f5f5 canvas, #505759 slate ink, one brick-red #b83c3c rectangular button at 50px high, Helvetica Neue LT in tracked 12px and 14px capitals, a translucent #000000cc header and full-bleed room photography.

bandcamp.name: Bandcamp
bandcamp.description: Bandcamp (bandcamp.com): a pale blue-grey #ecf3f4 canvas with #222222 text set in the system's Helvetica Neue (Arial fallback) — 32px/500 headline, 16px/24px body, dense 12px catalog text. Actions are near-black #222222 buttons with white labels and a 4px radius; genre pills are #333333 with a 16px radius; the logo blue is #0cacd7. Dark #222222 bands and a #333333 footer break the light page.

bang-olufsen.name: Bang & Olufsen
bang-olufsen.description: Bang & Olufsen's US storefront is a gallery-quiet system set in one self-hosted custom face, BeoSupreme (with Lexend Deca as the declared fallback), at weight 400 for every headline and 500 only for buttons: 24px/36px hero titles, 48px/64px page titles with -0.5px tracking, 16px/26px body with 0.2px tracking and 12px/20px product labels. Warm near-black #191817 ink and buttons on a #ffffff canvas, cream #fcfaee button text, #fafafa square product tiles, 40px-radius 44px-tall pill buttons, and a full-bleed ultramarine #060daa footer.

bangchak.name: Bangchak Corporation
bangchak.description: Bangchak Corporation (bangchak.co.th/en), a Thai energy group: a white page with BCP black #2d2926 ink, green #3aa537 to lime #91bd27 gradient pill links with 30px radius, DB Ozone X at 65px light hero titles and 700-weight 22 to 36px text, dark photographic heroes and translucent stat cards.

bangchak-green.name: Bangchak Sriracha
bangchak-green.description: Bangchak Sriracha (BSRC, bsrc.co.th), a Thai petroleum refiner and fuel marketer, uses a white canvas #ffffff, black ink #000000 and brand green #48a23f with a #84bd00 hover, a #131313 footer and red #ed1c24 eyebrows, set in DB Ozone X from 22px body to 100px statistics, with 4px buttons and leaf-shaped imagery.

bangkok-aviation-fuel-services-pcl.name: Bangkok Aviation Fuel Services (BAFS)
bangkok-aviation-fuel-services-pcl.description: Bangkok Aviation Fuel Services (bafsthai.com), Thailand's aviation refuelling operator: a navy #1a4683 and white corporate site with Urbanist headlines (a 440px uppercase BAFS masked-photo wordmark, 60px light titles), Roboto and Sarabun body text, 24px-radius navy pill buttons and pale #f3f8fd bands.

bangkok-bank.name: Bangkok Bank
bangkok-bank.description: Bangkok Bank's personal-banking site sets a full-bleed lifestyle photo hero with an 89.6px BangkokBank-Medium headline over a white canvas, uses one electric blue #0064ff (hover #0048b7) for 7px-radius buttons and links, deep navy #002850 for the footer and #233a58 for the currency converter, grey #4e4e4e body ink, 16px-radius light-blue #4890ff tag pills, and the self-hosted BangkokBank / BangkokBank_Text families (files named BBLSans).

bangkok-dock-company.name: Bangkok Dock Company
bangkok-dock-company.description: Bangkok Dock Company (1957) Limited, a Thai state-owned shipyard (bangkokdock.co.th): a WordPress site with a #334155 slate top bar, #1d4384 navy navigation, IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped body text, plus a Kanit tribute entry splash with a #111111 outlined pill button and 18px type.

bangkok-health-insurance.name: Bangkok Health Insurance (BHI)
bangkok-health-insurance.description: Bangkok Health Insurance (BHI) site at bhi.bdms.co.th: white canvas, Sarabun type, #3a6fba blue 4px-radius buttons, a #1b0692ce indigo navigation bar, #333333 ink and soft 12px cards with a 0 4px 15px shadow.

bangkok-hospital.name: Bangkok Hospital
bangkok-hospital.description: Bangkok Hospital (bangkokhospital.com/en), Thailand's private hospital network: a #fbfbfc and white page with navy #002d73 headings and icons, #363636 body text, Figtree 700 at 33.6px for section titles, satoshi sans for UI, 12 to 16px soft-radius cards, pill chips and red #b21e28 price and buy accents.

bangkok-insurance.name: Bangkok Insurance
bangkok-insurance.description: Bangkok Insurance (bangkokinsurance.com, กรุงเทพประกันภัย), a Thai non-life insurer: a Bootstrap 3 site on a #f2fafd pale-blue page with navy #063868 navigation, bands and text, DB Helvethaica X Thai type at 19.6px, white promo cards, square-cornered outlined buttons and colorful circular product icons.

bangkok-land.name: Bangkok Land
bangkok-land.description: Bangkok Land Public Company Limited (bangkokland.co.th, measured at /th/): Sukhumvitreg Thai type at 38px headings with 0.8px tracking and 18px body, navy #192346 buttons and footer with white text, #0d1b42 headings, a #cabb9a sand hover accent, pale #f9f9f9 and #f3f3f3 bands, 10px-radius buttons and soft 4px 10px shadows on cards.

bangkok-life.name: Bangkok Life Assurance
bangkok-life.description: Bangkok Life Assurance (กรุงเทพประกันชีวิต) Thai homepage: white canvas, DB Ozone X typeface at 19px body and 30px display, bright cyan #28b2ee action buttons, deep blue #0057a8 headings with #004a8e secondary buttons, #eaf4fa tint, and 2px-radius controls.

bangkok-post.name: Bangkok Post
bangkok-post.description: Bangkok Post (bangkokpost.com), Thailand's English-language newspaper: a Bootstrap-based news home page with a #050d81 navy masthead and footer, Charis SIL serif headlines in bold 30px and 24px, #0054c6 blue pill tabs and chips, 10px-radius thumbnails, and black rules under uppercase section titles.

bangkok-university.name: Bangkok University
bangkok-university.description: Bangkok University's English site (bu.ac.th/en) is a dark, photo-led university home page: near-black #1d1e20 canvas, off-white #f8f8f8 text, Noto Sans Thai at 48px/700 for headings, Karnvayla for buttons, and a pale #dfe1e3 pill 'Apply Now' button with a 22px radius, accented by orange #e56436, amber #fab751 and green #00a960.

bangmod-enterprise.name: Bangmod Enterprise (Bangmod.Cloud)
bangmod-enterprise.description: Bangmod.Cloud, the cloud and hosting brand of Bangmod Enterprise Co., Ltd. (bangmod.cloud): a Thai-language hosting storefront set in the custom Bangmod DB face, with an electric-blue #182eb8 hero, deep navy #000147 bands, white content sections, an amber #ffb000 call-to-action with 3px corners, and a white domain-search card.

bank-of-america.name: Bank of America
bank-of-america.description: Bank of America's consumer home page (bankofamerica.com): white and #f5f5f5 grey bands, a deep navy #012169 with pill-shaped 22px-radius buttons, red #e31837 and #a50e28 accents, a bright blue offers hero, the cnx display family for headings and Roboto for body and buttons.

bank-of-china-thai.name: Bank of China (Thai)
bank-of-china-thai.description: Bank of China (Thai) Public Company Limited homepage at bankofchina.co.th: white canvas with Helvetica Neue at 13.5px dense body and 16.5px bold headings, #333333 ink, Bank of China red #b6002a with #990000 headings and #d00024 card rules, pale blue-grey #d2dadd menu bands, and square corners.

banluesarn.name: Banlue Group
banluesarn.description: Banlue Group (banluegroup.com), the Thai publishing and content group behind Banluesarn: a white and #f7f7f7 page with a hazy full-bleed hero, extra-light Ostrich Sans headings at 64px with 8px letter-spacing, widely tracked Roboto Condensed labels, grey #777777 Roboto body text and a taupe #9f8b7f theme accent.

banpu-power.name: Banpu Power
banpu-power.description: Banpu Power Public Company Limited corporate site (banpupower.com): light-gray #f5f4f5 page, left sidebar navigation in teal #00b49c, HCo Gotham SSm at 11px to 13px, outlined 25px-radius teal pills, white news cards with soft 3px 6px shadows over photographic hero banners.

barclays.name: Barclays
barclays.description: The Barclays Group corporate site (home.barclays): a white and #f6f6f6 editorial layout in the proprietary Barclays Effra face with tight negative tracking on 48px and 32px headings, 99px-radius pill buttons filled with action blue #006de3, a deep navy #1a2142 hero panel and cards outlined with a 2px #e2e2e2 border.

barrys.name: Barry's
barrys.description: Barry's (barrys.com), the boutique HIIT fitness brand: an immersive dark red-black video hero over a #f7f7f7 page, uppercase Antenna headlines at 48px/700, Benton Sans Pro body at 14px, pill buttons with a 40px radius in #111111 and white, and the brand red #d6001a reserved for labels, chips and the word LIFT.

base-ui.name: Base UI
base-ui.description: Base UI documentation home: an unstyled React component library presented on a near-white canvas (#fcfcfc) in near-black ink (#2e2e2e) with muted gray (#767676), set in the "die grotesk" families at a single 400 weight (42px headline, 18px body), 8px radii, hairline-ruled lists and no filled buttons or brand color.

base-web.name: Base Web
base-web.description: Base Web is Uber's open-source React design system; its docs site is strictly monochrome: black #000000 ink and 48px black primary buttons with 8px radius on white, #f3f3f3 hairlines, UberMove 700 headings (28px/24px) over UberMoveText 16px/24px body, with accent blue #276ef1 and negative red #de1135 reserved for state.

basecamp.name: Basecamp
basecamp.description: Basecamp's home page by 37signals: white #ffffff and warm #fff9f5 canvas, slate ink #29353c, square-cornered #117af3 blue buttons (hover #0067de), #146dc7 underlined links, Graphik 800 headlines at 37.45px with tight tracking over Graphik 400 body at 17px, fluid percentage-based type, and soft layered card shadows.

bayer.name: Bayer
bayer.description: Bayer Global corporate site: Bayer Sans 400/500/700 throughout, 72px bold white headlines on #0f172b deep navy sections, #10384f dark-blue ink on #ffffff, square white 48px uppercase CTAs tracked 0.42px, #f1f5f9 elevated surfaces, #0075a6 link hover, Bayer bright blue #00bcff and green #66b512 accents and a pill-shaped floating navigation bar.

bbc.name: BBC
bbc.description: BBC.com news front: a white #ffffff page with #202224 ink, headlines and summaries set in the BBC's own BBC Reith Serif (28px/32px weight 500 lead headline with -0.56px tracking, 14px/18px summaries) and navigation, labels and buttons in BBC Reith Sans; square 0px corners everywhere, a solid black #000000 Register button that hovers to #3a3c3e, #e6e8ea nav-hover tiles, #545658 meta text and a #141618 dark video band.

bbdo.name: BBDO
bbdo.description: BBDO's agency site (bbdo.com): a loud pure red #ff0000 canvas with off-white #fafafa text, oversized 137px Outfit headlines at weight 600, a near-black #161616 work gallery with #212121 cards, outlined 51px-radius pill buttons and a video-led full-bleed hero.

bbtv-channel-7.name: CH7ON (BBTV Channel 7)
bbtv-channel-7.description: CH7ON, the online TV home of BBTV Channel 7 / Channel 7HD (ch7.com/en): a white streaming portal in Sukhumvit Set with #101828 text, brand-rose red #b12420 links and a Download pill, 12px-radius cards with soft rose borders, horizontal content rails and a dark-red Top 10 band.

bcg.name: Boston Consulting Group
bcg.description: BCG (bcg.com) pairs light-weight henderson-bcg-serif headlines in deep green #0c2b15 with henderson-bcg-sans text in #212427 on white, mint #e3fddb and warm #f1eeea bands, signature lime #96f878 15px-radius uppercase CTA buttons, 20px-radius translucent cards and full-bleed deep-green panels.

bcpg.name: BCPG
bcpg.description: BCPG Public Company Limited English homepage (bcpggroup.com/en/home): DB Ozone X typeface with 90px bold uppercase hero headlines and 22px body, a white canvas, orange #ea7600 and green #48a23f accents with teal #00b2a9 and lime #84bd00, a #2d2926 footer, and 50px-radius ghost pill buttons over photography.

beam-checkout.name: Beam
beam-checkout.description: Beam payments site at beamcheckout.com: Stolzl 80px headlines with italic serif accents, #265bea buttons (hover #1d46d7) on a navy and #101010 dark hero, white sections, 16px-radius cards with 1px #ffffff1a borders and Inter 600 labels.

bear.name: Bear
bear.description: Bear's bear.app is a light, illustrated note-app site: bearsansheadline 51.2px/400 headlines and bearsans 16px/25.6px body in #444444 on white, a single red accent #dd4c4f (--accent-color), section titles in blue #456aa3, green #2b6451 and purple #884aa8 over soft colour blobs, and white 16px-radius cards with a rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0px 13px 34px shadow.

beartai.name: Beartai
beartai.description: Beartai (BT, บีที แบไต๋), Thai tech and lifestyle media: midnight navy #050b1b canvas, electric cyan #14e7ff headings and outlined See All pills, white Contact pill, GraphikTH and Gotham type, 15px translucent cards and video-thumbnail-led layouts.

beats-by-dre.name: Beats by Dre
beats-by-dre.description: Beats by Dre (beatsbydre.com): a clean white and #f0f0f0 retail layout in Neuzeit Grotesk with -1px tracking on 70.769px display type, full-bleed celebrity photography, white pill buttons in Alternate Gothic with a 30px radius, rounded 18px product cards and red #e31837 price and offer labels.

becane-paris.name: Bécane Paris
becane-paris.description: Bécane Paris (becaneparis.com), a women's apparel label: an off-white #f6f6f6 canvas with near-black #0a0a0a type in the wide custom face Eurostile Becane, tiny 8px uppercase labels in 3px-radius white bars floating at the page edges, a 30px uppercase manifesto and a row of cut-out product figures.

beehiiv.name: beehiiv
beehiiv.description: beehiiv's newsletter-platform site: an inky #060419 canvas, white uppercase Clash Grotesk 60px/700 headlines, Satoshi 20px body copy in #f7f5ff and #d9dbdf, cobalt #2f39ba square-cornered sign-up buttons, a white 6px-radius header pill, hot-pink #ff5ec4 links and pink #f092dd product panels.

beings.name: Beings
beings.description: Beings (beings.co), the Aotearoa New Zealand directory of POC, Rainbow and Disabled talent: a white page with deep brown #1b0800 type, an oversized BEINGS wordmark, square-cornered photography, the Die Grotesk and Bonto faces at weight 400, and a skin-tone palette running from #fff4ec to #3d1801 with peach #f6c9a1 as the accent.

bell-canada.name: Bell Canada
bell-canada.description: Bell Canada's consumer site (bell.ca): a warm off-white #f9f8f6 and white page with Bell blue #0070ce pill buttons, deep navy #003778 footer, a #00549a header, Satoshi variable text at weights 450 and 550, the BellSlimRev Heavy display face with -1.5px tracking, and white 10px-radius offer cards outlined in #eeece5.

bem.name: Bangkok Expressway and Metro (BEM)
bem.description: Corporate transit-operator site for BEM, set entirely in two self-hosted Thai-capable faces, KitithadaRegular and KitithadaBold, at oversized pixel sizes (30px subheadings, 26px body) on a #f7f7f7 canvas with white cards, #666666 text and a single #0e4285 navy action color, square 0px corners, a #b7a676 gold accent for dates and pager marks, and no box shadows.

ben-and-jerrys.name: Ben & Jerry's
ben-and-jerrys.description: Ben & Jerry's US site (benjerry.com): white #ffffff canvas, near-black #141414 ink, sunflower-yellow #ffbc0e pill CTAs (80px radius, hover #fed831), a sky-blue #c4e7f3 values band, navy #201460 activism band, deep green #2a5729 footer and #002f87 links. Chunk ReThunk slab headings (48/36/24px) over Proxima Nova 20px/32px body.

benevity.name: Benevity
benevity.description: Benevity's homepage pairs a deep indigo canvas (#160e4c, the site's own moonshot-blue) with white Red Hat Display 700 headlines at 66.6px, a raspberry #d1305e pill CTA with 9999px radius, a pale #f0f7fc content band, violet #2c03b0 headings and aqua #61eff2 eyebrows — an enterprise purpose-software brand that speaks in confident, human photography.

bennett-clive.name: Bennett & Clive
bennett-clive.description: Monochrome production-company portfolio for Bennett & Clive: pure white #ffffff canvas with #000000 ink, full-bleed imagery under giant uppercase InterWeb type (133.333px display at -9.33334px tracking, 26.6666px body), a single outlined 500px-radius pill button, no shadows, and fluid vw-based sizing from a 4-column grid that starts at 1024px.

bentley.name: Bentley Motors
bentley.description: Bentley Motors' global site: near-black #040404 and charcoal surfaces under full-bleed car photography, white #ffffff text in the light (300) Bentley typeface at 14px/20px with 0.14px tracking, 30–36px light headlines, square 'Living Green' #394d45 buttons with uppercase 16px labels tracked 1.6px, and white 1px outlined secondary buttons.

bento.name: Bento DS
bento.description: Bento DS marketing site: white canvas, near-black ink #242424, Clash Display 600 headlines at 116px, Epilogue 18px body, a lavender gradient hero, 20px-radius dark buttons and 16px-radius pale violet secondary buttons.

berkshire-hathaway.name: Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
berkshire-hathaway.description: Bare HTML 4.0 corporate home page for Berkshire Hathaway Inc.: white #ffffff page, navy #000080 text, purple #800080 underlined links, Times at 16px with 13px and 10px notes and a 32px bold masthead initial, two-column bullet list in a 90%-wide table, grey #808080 horizontal rules, zero radius, no shadows and no stylesheet.

best-idc.name: Best Internet Service Solution (Best IDC)
best-idc.description: Thai web-hosting and data-center storefront built on stock Bootstrap 4.1.1: a black #000000 fixed navbar with lime #00ff00 brand text, a #f8f9fa content panel, Bootstrap system-font stack at 16px/24px with 32px and 28px weight-500 headings, Bootstrap blue #007bff links, teal #17a2b8 side panels, 3.2px to 4px corners and image-overlay cards.

bethesda.name: Bethesda.net
bethesda.description: Dark, game-publisher hub for Bethesda Softworks' franchises (Fallout, DOOM, The Elder Scrolls, QUAKE): #191919 background, white text, uppercase Trade Gothic Bold Condensed at 70px for hero headlines, Montserrat 16px body, fully rounded pill buttons in #303030 and #e7e7e7, 10px-radius feed cards with outlined franchise tag pills and a #00d0c840 teal hover glow.

better-world-green.name: Better World Green
better-world-green.description: Corporate site of Better World Green Public Company Limited (BWG), an industrial-waste management group. Sarabun 300 body and Kanit buttons, coral #f4524d Read-more buttons with 5px radius, deep forest-green sections #20311a and #3d5730 against white, translucent 10px-radius form inputs.

beyond-design-into-experience.name: Beyond Design Into Experience (Plus X 15th Anniversary)
beyond-design-into-experience.description: Black-and-white scroll-story microsite for Plus X Creative's 15th anniversary: neue-haas-grotesk at 204.8px bold for hero words (-6.144px tracking), 93.44px and 33.28px uppercase statements, 17.92px outlined pill labels (1px border, 14px radius, 27px high), #ffffff and #000000 sections with #4c4c4c and #808080 dimmed text, a 12-column 16px-gap grid and WebGL 3D scenes.

beyond-securities.name: Beyond Securities
beyond-securities.description: Thai brokerage site in Prompt: white #ffffff page, #212529 body ink, gold #e2b035 headings and buttons with #070707 text, dark translucent #000000b3 feature columns over photography, top-rounded 10px buttons and no shadows.

big-c.name: Big C Online
big-c.description: Big C Online (bigc.co.th, Thai hypermarket e-commerce home page): a white canvas with #262626 text in Noto Sans Thai, a lime-green #93d600 button with dark text and 6px radius, red #fb2a10 sale prices, blue #0066ff links, and a very dense grid of promotional banners and product cards.

bigcommerce.name: BigCommerce
bigcommerce.description: BigCommerce's marketing site sets AeonikPro at 64px/500 on a dark hero, then moves to white and pale-lavender bands. Buttons are black #000000 rectangles with 2px radius and white 16px labels, text is near-black #121118, with a navy #031033 footer-type surface and brand accents blue #2664ff and green #03eada.

biings.name: Biings
biings.description: Biings marketing site (biings.com, in French): a warm #faf7f5 canvas with aubergine #46285d text, a #8c50b9 violet pill primary button, Plush 76px display headlines over Averta body text, 28px rounded translucent cards and soft plum-tinted shadows.

binance.name: Binance
binance.description: Binance homepage system: near-black #181a20 canvas, #eaecef text, a single signal-yellow #fcd535 button with #202630 label and 8px radius, deeper #f0b90b yellow for numerals, BinanceNova at 72px/700 hero and 40px/600 headings, 20px-radius cool-grey cards.

bitbucket.name: Bitbucket
bitbucket.description: Bitbucket (Atlassian) sets Charlie Display 54px/500 headlines (-1.08px) and Charlie Text 16px body in #101214 on white, with #1868db blue pill buttons (48px, 10px 22px padding) that darken to #123263, a full-width #1868db band, #e9f2fe pale-blue sections, 20px-radius #b7b9be-bordered cards and Atlassian --ds-* tokens.

bitkub.name: Bitkub Exchange
bitkub.description: Thailand's crypto exchange site on a published --bk-* token system: Graphik TH at 14px body and 40px/600 hero, Bitkub green #00b359 buttons with #00994d hover, #0c0e0c ink and #6b7b70 secondary text on #ffffff and #f5f5f5, 4px button radius, 16px-radius white stat cards with soft layered shadows, red #f04542 for losses and a green stats band.

bitter-creek.name: Bitter Creek
bitter-creek.description: Monochrome production-studio portfolio for Bitter Creek (London): white #ffffff canvas with #000000 ink, two Unica 77 faces (Llsub sans at 112.083px for the mission line, Monollsub mono at 14px and 38.8096px for labels and project codes) with tight -0.03em tracking, a full-bleed film hero, a square 1px-outlined button, no shadows and no corner radius.

bitwarden.name: Bitwarden
bitwarden.description: Bitwarden's marketing site: Inter Variable headlines at 60px/69px weight 600 with -2.4px tracking, light 300-weight body at 18px/28px, Bitwarden Blue #175ddc pill buttons 52px tall that hover to Light Teal #a2f4fd, Deep Blue #0c3276 top bar, #0a171f dark logo band, Off White #f3f6f9 sections and 20px-radius cards.

bknix.name: BKNIX (Bangkok Neutral Internet eXchange)
bknix.description: Thailand's neutral Internet exchange site, built on Bootstrap 5.0.2 plus a reduced Flat UI stylesheet: Lato throughout (16px body, 29px bold section headings), a #34495e navy navbar, agenda panel and footer, #1abc9c turquoise date tiles and hover, #e74c3c red headlines, white stat cards with 20px radius and a 0 20px 40px shadow, and a live Chart.js traffic graph.

black-ivory-coffee.name: Black Ivory Coffee
black-ivory-coffee.description: Online store and brand site of Black Ivory Coffee, the elephant-refined coffee from Thailand, in trajan-sans-pro capitals and GeneralSans body on a warm #f1efe8 canvas with black ink, #ded9ca panels, white 1px outlined buttons over full-bleed cinematic photography and a black footer.

blackrock.name: BlackRock
blackrock.description: BlackRock's corporate home page on its published ONEDS design system (data-brand=blackrock): white #ffffff and black #000000 bands, BLK Fort Condensed bold headings at -1px tracking (58.6634px hero) over BLK Fort body at 19.7738px, signal yellow #ffce00 for the Local websites button, cream #f5f5eb cards with 12px radius, 4px-radius solid buttons and orange #ff4713 accents.

blcp.name: BLCP Power
blcp.description: BLCP Power (บริษัท บีแอลซีพี เพาเวอร์ จำกัด) Thai homepage, blcp.co.th: Noto Sans Thai with 34px/600 hero heading and 17.92px body, deep blue #0e3f64 with lime #a6ce39 pill buttons, pale #f4f7ec news panel, 16px-radius rounded photo cards and a left sidebar menu.

blender.name: Blender
blender.description: blender.org home: light grey #f2f2f3 canvas, #4c4d52 Inter text, 72px/800 Inter display heads in vivid feature colours (#46ebc2, #0066ff, #9300ff), blue-gradient #6183ff→#47aaf5 'Donate'/'Download' buttons with 6px radius and blue glow, 12px-radius cards with soft grey shadows, a white 64px navbar and the logo's PMS 716 orange #e87d0d.

blip.name: Blip
blip.description: Blip.ai (blip.ai/en) marketing site — a photo-led hero in white, deep-black type (#000000), cobalt blue (#1968f0) uppercase buttons with 6px to 16px corners, Carbona Blip at weight 800 for 44px headlines, pale grey (#f5f5f5) cards and a near-black (#1f1f1f) logo and industries band.

blizzard.name: Blizzard Entertainment
blizzard.description: Blizzard's portal is a dark navy (#131928) game showcase built from blz-* web components: a floating blurred nav bar, a full-bleed key-art carousel with 60px pill buttons (blue gradient #1888ef to #009fe9, or frosted rgba(208,217,251,.2)), and a 4-up grid of 4px-radius game cards. Headings are Poppins 600 (48px hero, 36px uppercase section titles), body and nav are Archivo at 20px/28px in 70% white.

bloom-appearhere.name: Appear Here
bloom-appearhere.description: Appear Here, the London-based marketplace for renting shops and pop-up retail space: Avenir Next W01 with an 800-weight, widely tracked uppercase hero (43.52px, 8.96px letter-spacing), a near-black #191919 header and footer, a single warm gold #baa082 (hover #dbbd9a) on 2px-radius buttons, white listing grids, and photography of shopfronts. Built on the Bloom React pattern library.

blue-bottle.name: Blue Bottle Coffee
blue-bottle.description: Blue Bottle Coffee's US store bluebottlecoffee.com measured live — white #ffffff and warm off-white #f6f6f3 bands, black #000000 text, square charcoal #333333 buttons that go black on hover, a #333333 footer, the logo's bottle blue #00a9e0, and two ABC faces: uppercase ABC Marfa headings (24px, +1.6px) over ABC Diatype body at 16px/22px, with 0px corners.

blueprint-js.name: Blueprint
blueprint-js.description: Blueprint is Palantir's open-source React UI toolkit for dense desktop apps: system font stack at 14px, #2d72d2 primary blue buttons 30px tall with 4px radius, #111418 dark and #f6f7f9 light canvases, 4px spacing grid, 600 headings, ring-style shadows.

bmw.name: BMW
bmw.description: BMW Thailand homepage: white #ffffff and black #000000 bands with cinematic car photography, #262626 ink, one BMW blue #1c69d4 button (52px tall, 3px radius, hover #0653b6), BMW Type Next at weights 300 and 500 with 48px hero and 35px light headings.

bmw-m.name: BMW M
bmw-m.description: BMW M international homepage: graphite #262626 canvas with white BMWTypeNextLatin Light 40px headings, BMW blue #1c69d4 square-cornered 50px buttons (hover #0653b6), pale-blue #9ecaff links, and a floating 24px-radius nav bar over offset motorsport photography.

boc-studio.name: Boc.Studio
boc-studio.description: Barcelona creative brand studio site: #181d21 near-black canvas with #f3f3f3 text and #adadad secondary lines, a #ff4421 orange marquee strip with black ppMori type, 28.259px display and 13px uppercase labels, a 3-column work index with 15px captions, square image corners, glass-sphere hero art and an enter-to-start intro.

boeing.name: Boeing
boeing.description: Boeing.com measured on 2026-10-09: white canvas (#ffffff) with deep navy (#0a2240) utility header, cobalt (#0033a1) cards and pill buttons (50px radius, uppercase 16px/500 with 1.3px tracking), and sky-blue (#82d4f6) nav links, all set in the Meso family at weights 300/400/500/700 with a 68px light display headline over full-bleed aerospace photography.

bold.name: Bold
bold.description: Strong visual presence with heavyweight typography, high-contrast colors, and commanding layouts.

bolt.name: Bolt
bolt.description: Bolt (bolt.eu), the European ride-hailing, scooter and delivery super-app, ships a calm off-white (#f7f9f8) marketing canvas set in Inter (served as __Inter_205b87) at variable weights 550/650/750, a single green action color (#2b8659, hover #18784c), 40px-radius CTAs 48px tall, near-black (#0e1010) 40px-radius service cards and a near-black footer, with tinted-alpha greys (#000a07a0) for body copy.

boltdesign.name: Bolt Design System
boltdesign.description: Bolt Design System's documentation landing page pairs a deep navy hero (#001f5f) with white sections, Open Sans at 800 weight (76px display) and 400 body at 16px, a golden primary button (#ffc836) with 3px corners, a #3e67bb action blue and a #10a5ac teal for the second implementation path.

booking.name: Booking.com
booking.description: Booking.com's traveller site pairs a deep brand-blue #003b95 header band with a white canvas, Avenir Next 700 headlines (48px hero, 24px section titles) over a system-ui body stack at 14–16px, action blue #006ce4 buttons (hover #0057b8) with 4px corners, a yellow #ffb700 frame around the search box, 8px cards with a 0px 2px 8px #1a1a1a29 shadow, #1a1a1a ink and 9999px pill tabs — all driven by --bui_* tokens on a data-bui-theme=traveller-light body.

boon-rawd.name: Boon Rawd Brewery
boon-rawd.description: Boon Rawd Brewery corporate site (home of the Singha brand): a full-bleed brewery photograph, a gold (#be9639) angular menu panel, white Galileo type at 31px and 70px, square corners, and a charcoal (#323637) page ground.

boots-thailand.name: Boots Thailand
boots-thailand.description: Boots Thailand storefront (store.boots.co.th) measured 2026-10-09: deep indigo-navy #161348 for the category bar and footer on a #fafafa page with white #ffffff cards edged in #bcc5d0, set entirely in the Thai-capable PSLDisplayPro and PSLDisplayProBold families at 18px body and a 38px page title, with 3 to 5px corners and circular carousel dots.

bootstrap.name: Bootstrap
bootstrap.description: Bootstrap 6 alpha homepage and docs: Geist type with 48px/600 headlines, white canvas with a pastel mesh hero, a #7740ff accent button at 12px radius, #0087fe blue docs buttons at 8px radius, #171a1d ink, and low-opacity layered shadows.

bosch.name: Bosch
bosch.description: Bosch Global (bosch.com) measured 2026-10-09: a white and cool-gray (#eff1f2, #e0e2e5) corporate page with Bosch blue #007bc0 links, near-square corners, black text, a charcoal #2e3033 footer, and one proprietary family, boschsans, at 400 and 700 with a 40px bold hero headline, 20px body and a token system of --g- color ramps and --sem__ semantic variables.

bose.name: Bose
bose.description: Bose home page (bose.com/home) measured 2026-10-15: a white and warm-gray (#f9f9f9, #f8f7f6) store with near-black #131317 ink and square 2px black uppercase buttons, a heavy condensed Bose Headline at weight 900 (96px display, 58px section titles) over Bose Text body at 16px with -0.36px tracking, and product photography on light tiles.

boston-gov.name: City of Boston (Boston.gov)
boston-gov.description: Boston.gov, built on the city's Fleet pattern library, sets 90px uppercase Montserrat bold headlines in white over a blue-tinted skyline, body copy and links in Lora serif, Optimistic Blue #1871bd links and square buttons that flip to red #fb4d42 on hover, navy #091f2f ink and footer, and white cards on a #f3f3f3 grey field with line icons.

bot.name: Bank of Thailand
bot.description: Bank of Thailand English home page (bot.or.th/en/home.html) measured 2026-10-15: deep navy #003366 on white with light-blue #e6f3ff bands, translucent navy data cards over a photographic hero, outlined 1000px-radius pill buttons, and the Thai-capable Conv_Kanit-Regular and Conv_Kanit-Medium faces at 18px body, 28px section titles and 24px card titles.

botanical-garden-organization.name: องค์การสวนพฤกษศาสตร์ (The Botanic Garden Organization, bgo.qsbg.org)
botanical-garden-organization.description: Main website of Thailand's Botanic Garden Organization, measured at bgo.qsbg.org: Mitr throughout, black #000000 text on a white #ffffff canvas, sky-blue #00a1ed for the wordmark, nav hover and 54px buttons with 8px radius, deep blue #0072a3 and amber #ffb020 brand variables, 2px-radius gradient stat cards and 48px section headings.

bottega-veneta.name: Bottega Veneta
bottega-veneta.description: Bottega Veneta's US store (bottegaveneta.com/en-us) is a white, square-cornered light table for photography: one proprietary face, bottegaveneta-regular-webfont, at weight 400 and mostly 14px/22px for everything from headings to CTAs, #000000 ink with #6d7882 slate secondary text, white outlined CTAs with 1px black borders and 8px 25px 5px padding, black #000000 primary buttons that hover to #31383e, a 36px black promo strip and #eeeff1 product image wells.

box-blueprint.name: Box
box-blueprint.description: Box's home page (box.com/home) uses Inter at 80px/600 for the hero, 20px grey #767676 body copy, a Box blue #0061d5 fully rounded 100px pill button, a near-white #fbfbfb card surface and a black #000000 footer, with a rainbow gradient on the headline and product-UI collage imagery.

bp.name: bp
bp.description: bp global home page (bp.com) measured 2026-10-09: warm off-white surfaces (#fbfcf8, #fcfcfc) with olive-dark text (#494736, #121000), bp green #007f00 pill buttons at 800px radius and 14px type, 16px-rounded image tiles, a floating rounded header, and a single-weight bpSans at 400 from 16px body up to a 48px headline.

brand-in-the-open.name: Base Brand Guidelines
brand-in-the-open.description: Base Brand Guidelines (brand.base.org, the open brand site behind Base's Brand in the Open campaign) measured 2026-10-09: white canvas with a left text sidebar, black coinbaseSans/Base Sans type at 24px with negative tracking, Base Blue #0000ff as the brand anchor (blue square logo and button hover), dark #323232 8px-radius buttons and #fafafa 12px-radius tiles.

brazil-gov.name: GOV.BR
brazil-gov.description: The Brazilian federal government portal gov.br (Serviços e Informações do Brasil), built on the Padrão Digital de Governo design system: Rawline type, government blue #1351b4 with navy #0c326f and #071d41, near-white canvas #fcfcfc, 4px to 25.2px radii and soft 0 3px 6px shadows on white service tiles.

breakthrough-energy.name: Breakthrough Energy
breakthrough-energy.description: Breakthrough Energy home page (breakthroughenergy.org) measured 2026-10-15: a cream #fafbf8 canvas with near-black #12110e ink, a full-bleed dark video hero carrying a 122.816px Saans 500 headline at -4.91264px tracking, a 12-column grid with 1rem gutters, and declared accents of yellow #dfff5c, warm grey #c3bdb8 and beige #ddd9d4.

breitling.name: Breitling
breitling.description: Breitling's homepage pairs a flat brand yellow #ffc72c (header and square 0px buttons with black text) with white and near-white surfaces, a navy-black #09091a footer, condensed uppercase italianPlate headlines at 50px bold and Open Sans 14px body.

brevo.name: Brevo
brevo.description: Brevo (brevo.com) pairs Tomato Grotesk semibold headlines (40px/48px) with Inter body text, a mint #c0ffa5 hero and header, #1b1b1b charcoal buttons with 16px radius and an inset-bevel shadow, forest-green #006a43 links and #004227 feature headings, and pale mint #e8fedf/#f9fff6 bands.

brex.name: Brex
brex.description: Brex home page (brex.com) measured 2026-10-09: Inter at weights 400 and 500 with about -2% tracking (72px/72px headline at -1.44px), white and cool-gray (#f3f3f7) bands with ink #15191e, a signature orange-red #ff3d00 for 10px-radius 36px buttons (hover #ff6a17), 12px-radius white cards, and a near-black #000710 footer.

bridge-ufsc.name: Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina (UFSC)
bridge-ufsc.description: UFSC institutional portal (ufsc.br): a white canvas with #333333 Open Sans text, a strong #1659bf blue header and footer band with pale #dcecff navigation text, compact 15px body type, 5px and 10px radii, no shadows and a dense three-column Portuguese-language news layout.

bright-biotech.name: Bright Biotech
bright-biotech.description: Bright Biotech home page (brightbiotech.co.uk) measured 2026-10-15: a deep green #03463b canvas with a lime #bbfd6a accent, #f5acff pink image cards, one family (Jeko at 500 to 700) with a 103.704px headline, lime pill buttons at a 74.0741px radius and viewport-scaled non-integer type sizes.

brilliant.name: Brilliant
brilliant.description: Brilliant (brilliant.org) as measured live — a white and warm-stone #f5f3f1 canvas, black headlines in the slab-serif CoFo Robert (76px/500, -1.4px tracking) over CoFo Brilliant sans body text in 60%-black #00000099, a single green #29cc57 pill CTA (9999px radius, 60px tall, hover #15b441), floating pill navigation with a 1px #e4e4e4 hairline, 44px-radius stat cards and 20px-radius course tiles with a 4px #e5e5e5 bottom lip — tokens shipped as Panda CSS variables (--panda-*).

bristol-myers-squibb.name: Bristol Myers Squibb
bristol-myers-squibb.description: Bristol Myers Squibb corporate home page (bms.com) measured 2026-10-15: white canvas with warm near-black ink #363131, square magenta #be2bbb 72px buttons in 14px uppercase (hover #ab27a8), violet #3312af tags, glowing 400px-radius section pills, and Basel Grotesk at weights 300 to 700 with a 56px light headline.

british-gas.name: British Gas
british-gas.description: British Gas's Nucleus-driven marketing site — a bright blue energy-and-services brand using the proprietary British Gas typeface in three cuts (Subhead, Medium, Body), a #004ecc action blue on white with #002f87 navy panels, #111518 slate ink, square 0px primary buttons 52px tall, 4px inputs 51px tall, 8px cards and rounded red sale pills.

british-museum.name: British Museum
british-museum.description: British Museum (britishmuseum.org): a black #000000 site with #1d1d1d content cards, white and #a5a5a5 grey text all in Helvetica Neue 400/500, square black-and-white buttons with a chevron (50px tall, 10px 60px 10px 20px padding), 50% round icon controls, and per-exhibition accent colours such as gold #bf955f, red #ec1616 and green #67ad25.

brokersthai.name: BrokersThai
brokersthai.description: BrokersThai (brokersthai.com), a Thai-language forex broker review site measured 2026-10-15: white and slate (#f8fafc) pages with ink #1f2937, a navy #0a2540 and dark-band hero, amber #f59e0b 8px-radius buttons with navy text, #1859d1 links, 12px bordered cards, Prompt headings (600 to 700) over Sarabun body at 16px/28px, and a published --bt-* token set.

brunello-cucinelli.name: Brunello Cucinelli
brunello-cucinelli.description: Brunello Cucinelli's homepage is a white (#ffffff), near-monochrome editorial gateway: light IvyPresto serif headlines at 40px, GTEesti sans at 18px, charcoal ink #262626, no filled buttons or radii, tiny tracked underlined links, and warm photography as the only colour.

brutalism.name: Brutalism
brutalism.description: Raw, anti-design aesthetic inspired by concrete architecture with unadorned elements, jarring layouts, and functional minimalism.

bt-group.name: BT
bt-group.description: BT (bt.com, the consumer site of BT Group) is a UK broadband, TV, sport and mobile retailer set in the proprietary BT Curve typeface, with one saturated indigo (#5514b4) for headlines, pill buttons and icon discs on white and #f0f0f0 surfaces, 48px-high pill CTAs, and very large 40px and 64px card radii.

bts-skytrain.name: BTS Skytrain
bts-skytrain.description: BTS Skytrain (bts.co.th/eng) is Bangkok's elevated-rail operator site, set entirely in Sarabun, with a royal-blue #2758aa header and footer, a signal-green #189008 action colour for Search buttons and hover states, white cards with 5px to 10px radii and a soft 0 2px 7px shadow, and full-bleed promotional posters.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.description: Bubble's no-code AI app builder site: deep cobalt #051043 bands and translucent white panels, Manrope set at 800 for 51px headlines with -1px tracking, #0c29ab pill CTAs (100px radius) that darken to #091e7c on hover, a #61caff sky-blue eyebrow and focus ring, and floating product screenshots.

buck.name: BUCK
buck.description: BUCK's portfolio site is pure black #000000 on white #ffffff with one typeface, Mabry Light Pro (Mabry) at weight 100 — a 27.4432px intro paragraph, 19.0578px project titles and captions — a staggered two-column image grid, a sage-grey #abb2aa footer with a 46.5201px city clock, no shadows and a single 9999px pill radius.

bucks-sauce.name: Bucks Sauce
bucks-sauce.description: Bucks Sauce (buckssauce.com) is a small-batch BBQ sauce brand on a near-black brown canvas (#100b06) with cream (#f5e4c7) type and buttons, a condensed custom display face (PeperoncinoSansCustom, uppercase, negative tracking) paired with Inter Tight, four flavour colours as product cards, and 10px radii plus round buttons.

buffer.name: Buffer
buffer.description: Buffer's social-media-management site: Stolzl 75.8px/400 display over Figtree 18px body, deep teal-black #213130 ink on an off-white #fefdfb canvas, a mint-green #b0ec9c pill CTA with dark text, pastel feature tiles, 20px soft-shadow cards and a dark #213130 footer with green links.

bugatti.name: Bugatti
bugatti.description: Bugatti homepage: pure black #000000 canvas with white ink, full-bleed car photography, three proprietary faces (Bugatti Display 60px, Bugatti Monospace 12px uppercase labels, Bugatti Text 16px), and outline controls: a 42px pill button and a 4px-radius compact button that invert to white on hover.

builderio.name: Builder.io
builderio.description: Builder.io's builder.io site and published brand system: warm near-black #0a0a0a page, off-white #faf9f5 primary text with #aeadac secondary copy, electric cyan #01c8f1 actions (hover #00dff6 with a cyan glow), Geist 56px/500 headings at -0.02em, uppercase Geist Mono 14px/600 button labels, 6px button radius and square 0px panels.

bulma.name: Bulma
bulma.description: Bulma is the CSS-only Flexbox framework whose own site is the product demo: white canvas (#ffffff), near-black blue-grey ink (#2e333d), a turquoise primary (#00d1b2) with dark teal label text (#001f1a), Inter at weights 400-800 (64px/800 hero), 6px button corners, 12px cards, and a dark 'code' band (#14161a) with syntax colors, all driven by --bulma-* CSS variables.

bumrungrad.name: Bumrungrad International Hospital
bumrungrad.description: Bumrungrad International Hospital (bumrungrad.com/en) is a Bangkok hospital portal set in Open Sans with Thai, CJK, Arabic, Burmese and Khmer fallbacks, a medical green (#0bb288) for buttons and headings on white and #f0f0f0, small 3.5px-radius uppercase buttons, a warm brown-gold secondary ramp, and four colour-blocked quick-action tiles.

bun.name: Bun
