bun.description: Bun's site is a dense white technical page: Archivo 800 headlines (64px, -1.28px, with the word fast in #ff1f8f pink), system ui-sans-serif 17.28px/28.08px body in #525252, Martian Mono code and uppercase labels, square 0px-radius buttons with a 7px clipped corner, #0a0a0a dark buttons, #f6f6f6 code cards with 4px radius and #e2e2e2 hairlines.

burberry.name: Burberry
burberry.description: Burberry's homepage measured at int.burberry.com: a white canvas (#ffffff) with a light-grey product band (#f6f6f6), black text (#000000), BurberrySerif at 20px and 24px for editorial copy, BurberrySansSerif for interface text, square corners with no measured radii, and an electric blue (#0000ff) used only for underlined text links.

burger-king.name: Burger King
burger-king.description: Burger King (bk.com) is a US ordering app-on-the-web: a warm cream canvas (#f8f1e7) with chocolate-brown type (#502314) in the rounded Flame typefaces, a flame-red (#d62300) pill CTA 50px tall, outlined brown pill buttons, white 16px-radius promo cards with a faint shadow, and a mobile-app tab bar.

burrow.name: Burrow
burrow.description: Burrow (modular furniture, New York) sets a white #ffffff storefront with #262626 ink in Swiss Typefaces' Suisse Intl at weight 500 for display (40px/42.4px h1, 55–68px promo headlines) and 400 for 14–18px body, DM Mono uppercase eyebrows tracked 2px, small-radius rectangular buttons (3px sand #eaddc5 and white CTAs, a 2px #262626 Add to cart), coral #e46950 sale prices, and a warm charcoal #383633 footer with cream #f7eee3 text.

butter.name: Butter
butter.description: Butter (butter.video) is an online video editor whose marketing page is a near-white #fafafa canvas with #0f0f0f type at 40% and 50% opacity tiers, set in DieGrotesk at up to 99.8px with slightly positive tracking, rounded 20px to 32px cards in #ededed and near-black #0a0909, a 3D keychain hero, and monospaced eyebrow labels.

butterfly-book-house.name: Butterfly Book House (สำนักพิมพ์ผีเสื้อ)
butterfly-book-house.description: Butterfly Book House (bflybook.com), a Thai publisher and bookshop built on WordPress, WooCommerce and the Flatsome theme: white canvas, black Thai text in the Srivichai typeface at 19.2px with 0.96px tracking, a soft pink #fcbdc0 for pill buttons, a deeper rose #cd6090 for section titles, pale pink #fdf3f2 footer, and 99px-radius SIGN UP and JOIN pills.

buzzvil.name: Buzzvil
buzzvil.description: Buzzvil's marketing site is a Korean-language, Pretendard-set ad-tech page: a near-black slate hero (#0e171f) under a white navigation bar, an 800-weight 78px headline filled with a salmon-to-white gradient, a single red (#f44336) inquiry button with 4px corners, glass-effect stat cards at 32px radius and pill-shaped filter chips on a mostly dark canvas.

byd.name: BYD USA
byd.description: BYD USA (byd.com/us, the US page that byd.com redirects to) is an EV marketing site in Montserrat 400 to 700 with a #252728 charcoal header and footer, a black #000000 utility bar, white content bands, full-bleed car photography, 4px-radius black and outlined buttons 44px to 47px tall, and underline-style form fields.

byredo.name: Byredo
byredo.description: Byredo's Next.js storefront is a near-silent black-and-white luxury system: full-bleed video and photography, a stencil BYREDO wordmark, and a single custom face, byredoSans, at weight 400 only — 24px/32px uppercase product titles with 0.6px tracking, 14px/20px body with 0.35px tracking, 12px/16px uppercase labels — over a #ffffff canvas with #000000 ink, #f5f5f5 product surfaces, square 0px black ADD TO CART buttons 44px tall and 4px-radius floating product cards.

byteark.name: ByteArk
byteark.description: ByteArk (byteark.com), a Thai CDN and video-streaming platform: a deep navy hero (#090a25) over light #f9f9f9 sections, a condensed bold Thai and Latin face (AnantasonReno-Condensed) at 60px/700, a #2563eb pill login button, a blue-to-violet (#2d83db to #6957c5) trial button, and white 20px-radius cards with an indigo-tinted shadow.

c-design-by-dylan.name: Design by Dylan
c-design-by-dylan.description: ©Design by Dylan (dylanbrouwer.design) is the Webflow portfolio of Dutch designer Dylan Brouwer: a near-black to grey scrolling backdrop, a 243px uppercase ABC Gravity Variable headline, Die Grotesk B at 53px/500 with -0.03em tracking, IBM Plex Mono 12px uppercase labels, an #ff6436 orange accent and 12.8px-radius project imagery.

ca-gov.name: State of California (CA.gov)
ca-gov.description: The State of California's portal at www.ca.gov: Public Sans in bold white-on-blue headlines, a single civic blue (#046b99) for buttons, links and the hero, dark slate-ink body text (#3b3a48) on white, 5px-radius buttons and sharp 3px-radius topic cards with a blue bottom rule, built on Bootstrap 5 variables plus a custom cagov stylesheet.

ca-mineral.name: Broadcom
ca-mineral.description: The Broadcom corporate site (broadcom.com): Inter at 44px/700 and 22px/800 headings with 0.25px tracking, 15px slate body #494a5e, link blue #005c8a, brand red #cc092f in the logo and gradient rule, white cards with 1px light borders, square buttons and 2px to 5px radii.

cableconnect.name: Cable Connect (CConnect)
cableconnect.description: Cable Connect (CConnect, cableconnect.co.th), a Thai internet and ICT service provider on a WordPress build with the The7 theme: white pages with red #dd3333 uppercase Kanit headings, a #d12525 hero slider, a #d73b37 square-cornered button, gold #ffb536 outlined button, 220px circular service photos and Thai-first copy.

cadbury.name: Cadbury
cadbury.description: Cadbury UK (cadbury.co.uk) is a chocolate brand site built on Gatsby and Tailwind: Cadbury purple #4b0983 with a deeper #3b0073, gold gradient pill buttons, Gibson SemiBold uppercase headlines with wide +0.08em tracking at 64px, Gibson Regular body at 16px, 16px-radius lilac #e4daec recipe cards and full-bleed product-pack photography.

caeli-energie.name: Caeli Energie
caeli-energie.description: Caeli Energie (caeli-energie.com) sells the Caeli One cooling module with a poster-like French site. Warm cream canvas #faf7f0, deep green ink #053725, bright headline green #005d3b, Altform at 400/700/900, a 124.444px uppercase 900 hero at -2px tracking and 4.44px-radius buttons.

cafe.name: Cafe
cafe.description: Cozy cafe-inspired interface with warm tones, soft typography, and clean layouts for a relaxed browsing experience.

cafe-amazon.name: Café Amazon
cafe-amazon.description: Café Amazon (cafe-amazon.com) is the coffee-shop brand of PTT Oil and Retail Business, with a calm forest-green Thai site. FC Iconic at 400/700, primary green #436152, footer green #2b4635, near-black ink #181d27, white page, a 110px hero headline, 0px-radius buttons and cards with soft Tailwind-style shadows.

caffe-design.name: Caffè Design
caffe-design.description: Caffè Design (caffe.design) is a playful 3D office tour by Design Kills S.R.L. of Milan: one full-viewport rendered room, white page background #ffffff, black ink #000000, coral accent #ff545a, GT Haptik at 400/500/700 with Argent Pixel CF for inputs, and a hand-lettered speech bubble.

cal.name: Cal.com
cal.description: Cal.com is a grayscale scheduling brand: a #f4f4f4 page with white (#ffffff) rounded cards, near-black #242424 ink and CTA fills, #898989 secondary text, the open-source Cal Sans display face (64px/600, tight 1.1 leading) over Cal Sans UI Variable Light body, 12px card corners and a single #0099ff accent used sparingly.

calendly.name: Calendly
calendly.description: Calendly's marketing home: warm magnolia #fcfbf8 canvas and #f5f3ee sand panels, midnight-navy #071a31 headlines and buttons (hover #0e396a), slate #5f6d77 body copy, a #84c1ff announcement bar and #c3dffe sky cards, Calendly Sans 500 headlines at 72px/-2px over Geist 18px/25.2px body, 16-24px rounded corners.

caltex-thailand.name: Caltex Thailand
caltex-thailand.description: Caltex Thailand (caltex.com/th): white canvas #ffffff, Caltex red #e62f46 pill buttons with 25px radius, deep teal #01526d headings and footer, ITC Franklin Gothic Book, Medium and Demi type, 5px-radius promo cards with #e5e5e5 borders.

cambridge-university.name: University of Cambridge
cambridge-university.description: University of Cambridge (cam.ac.uk) home page: Bootstrap-based, Lato 400/500/700 on a #f8f9fa and #ffffff page, stylesheet primary teal #6bbbae, secondary magenta #e5007d, pink and teal-tint buttons with 0px radius, a black caption-bar style, a navy #010a14 footer and a 56px bold h1 on a white panel over a photograph.

canada-ca.name: Canada.ca
canada-ca.description: Canada.ca, the Government of Canada's main website, following the Canada.ca design system: Lato headings (41px/500 white hero title, 29px/700 #333333 section heads) over Noto Sans body at 17-20px, #333333 text on #ffffff with #f5f5f5 bands, underlined #284162 links that hover to #0535d2, square #26374a navy buttons that hover to #444444, a 4px-radius 2px outlined 'All services' button and a #26374a footer.

canon.name: Canon Global
canon.description: Canon Global (global.canon/en) is a white #ffffff and pale grey #f5f5f5 corporate site set entirely in Roboto 400/700, with #333333 text, a Canon red #be000b accent bar under 46px bold section headings, square 0px corners everywhere and #c8c8c8 hairline borders.

canva.name: Canva
canva.description: Canva (canva.com) marketing home page: Canva Sans at 400/500/600 with -0.01em tracking on large type, brand purple #8b3dff, near-black ink #0f1015, a white page under a purple-to-aqua gradient hero, 12px-radius buttons with layered inset shadows and 9999px-radius tab pills.

capacities.name: Capacities
capacities.description: Capacities (capacities.io), "a studio for your mind": a warm-neutral note-taking landing page. Inter 700 headline at 64px/67.2px with -1.92px tracking, system ui-sans-serif 16px/27.2px body in #5c5959, #454447 charcoal 8px-radius Start Free buttons, white 12px–16px cards with #ecebea borders, and #fbfaf9 alternate sections.

capcom.name: Capcom USA
capcom.description: Capcom USA (capcomusa.com), the site of Capcom U.S.A., Inc. linked from the capcom.com region splash: Roboto 300/400/500 on a #f0f2f5 and #ffffff page, Capcom blue #1059a4 for section titles and the social bar, black ink #000000, a full-width hero carousel, 4px-radius cards and a Bootstrap grid.

capital-one.name: Capital One
capital-one.description: Capital One (capitalone.com) home page: Optimist at 300/400/600 with Helvetica Neue fallbacks, interactive blue #0276b1, near-black ink #141414, #f4f4f4 and #ffffff surfaces, 40px light headlines, pill and 4px-radius buttons, a sign-in strip above a photographic hero and light illustrations.

capitolium.name: Capitolium
capitolium.description: Capitolium (collabcapitolium.fr) is the capsule-collection site of TéFéCé x Stade Toulousain: a cinematic chaptered story in warm cream #f0e3cf and slate #58595b with gold #c3a677 accents, a condensed all-caps display face called gin at 93.1315px, Times body copy, square 0px-radius buttons and a gold script tagline.

cappen-4.name: Cappen
cappen-4.description: Cappen (cappen.com) is a digital design and development studio's portfolio: a monochrome #fcfcfc and #000000 page, HelveticaNowDisplay 900 uppercase at 124.444px with -4.97778px tracking, PP Editorial New 200 serif text, Martian Mono 8.88889px uppercase labels, 3.56px-radius work tiles and no chromatic accent.

carabao.name: Carabao Group
carabao.description: Carabao Group (carabaogroup.com), the global corporate site of the Thai energy-drink maker: white page with textured grey bands, Carabao green #009560, red accent #e60501, DB Adman X body at 16px and DBImpactoX 700 display at 44px with 1px tracking, a 60px-radius outlined pill button and a dotted green world map.

carasti-thailand.name: Carasti Thailand
carasti-thailand.description: Carasti Thailand (carasti.com/THL/en), a monthly new-car subscription site: white page with #f6f6f6 and #f9fafb panels, Carasti blue #347dc9 buttons with 6px radius, slate ink #434343, a Gilroy-named family at 400/600/700 with a 53.376px bold hero heading, a translucent header and grey car tiles with baht prices.

carhartt.name: Carhartt
carhartt.description: Carhartt (carhartt.com, measured on the EU edition en-eu): workwear storefront in Carhartt gold #feb913, black and charcoal #3a3a3a on white, Tungsten condensed uppercase headlines at 52px/700 with TradeGothicNextLTPro text, 5px-radius gold buttons, hairline-bordered 10px-radius product cards and full-bleed workwear photography.

carnegie-mellon.name: Carnegie Mellon University
carnegie-mellon.description: Carnegie Mellon University (cmu.edu): white canvas with black utility bar and Carnegie Red #c41230 wordmark plate, Source Serif Pro 600 headlines at 56px and Open Sans 16px/27px body, square 0px corners, flat surfaces with no card shadows.

carrd.name: Carrd
carrd.description: Carrd's carrd.com is a dark one-page site: #24252d charcoal canvas, a purple-to-blue gradient hero, Arial throughout (56px/700 headlines at -1.4px tracking, 16px/28px body in 75% white #ffffffbf), teal #33ada9 6px-radius buttons that hover to #39c1bc, and ghost buttons drawn with a 2px inset white ring.

cartier.name: Cartier
cartier.description: Cartier's US site (cartier.com/en-us) pairs two bespoke Yorgo&Co typefaces — Brilliant Cut, a wide uppercase sans (21.049px/600 titles, 12px/400 nav at 0.8px tracking), and Fancy Cut, a serif for prose (16px/400/24px at 0.5px) — on a white #ffffff canvas with warm-black #1d1c1c ink, square #1d1c1c buttons that invert to white on hover, white-outlined CTAs over full-bleed video, #f9f9f9 product wells and a 3px Cartier red #d50032 underline that slides in under menu items.

casper.name: Casper
casper.description: Casper (casper.com) mattress store: white canvas, navy #012169 / #1e306e text and pill buttons with 32px radius, a red #cb372a sale accent, NewKansas serif headlines and Calibre 20px/300 body, soft blue-tinted card sections with 0 18px 50px shadows.

cat-motors-motorbike-scooter-rentals.name: Cat Motors Motorbike & Scooter Rentals
cat-motors-motorbike-scooter-rentals.description: Cat Motors (catmotors.net), Chiang Mai motorbike rental: #f7fafc canvas with #edf2f7 panels, slate #4a5568 / #2d3748 / #1a202c text, Source Sans Pro 20px/32px body with 700 headlines, a full-width #377e99 teal CTA bar, 3px card radius.

cathay-pacific-g.name: Cathay Pacific
cathay-pacific-g.description: Cathay's US site (cathaypacific.com/cx/en_US): white #ffffff and #f9f9f9 canvases, #2d2d2d ink, deep Cathay green #2c4036 buttons and footer (hover #042728), jade #367878 links, GT Walsheim 28px/36px headlines over Cathay Sans EN 16px/24px body, 8px button corners and 16px cards with a soft #bcbeb0 glow.

cathy-dolle-portfolio-1.name: Cathy Dolle
cathy-dolle-portfolio-1.description: Cathy Dolle (cathydolle.com), interactive designer portfolio: pure #ffffff canvas with #000000 text, a single neuemontreal typeface at 11px in 400 and 500 uppercase, a 12-project list and slider over grayscale 3D imagery, square corners, no shadows.

cbre.name: CBRE
cbre.description: CBRE (cbre.com): corporate real-estate site on white with dark slate #435254 hero panels, CBRE green #003f2d headlines in Financier Display (48px, 64px), Calibre 16px/22px body, a bright #17e88f accent dash, square corners and no shadows.

cd-projekt-red.name: CD PROJEKT RED
cd-projekt-red.description: CD PROJEKT RED (cdprojektred.com/en): near-black #110b06 canvas, cream #f5eae8 text and CD PROJEKT red #f40024 header and headlines, Proxima Nova extra-condensed 800 uppercase at 80px, 99px pill buttons with 2px red outlines, no shadows.

cdg-group.name: CDG Group
cdg-group.description: CDG Group (cdg.co.th/website), Thai technology group site: white canvas, deep green #16351a text and footer, light cyan #bbe9f9 labels over photography, Aktiv Grotesk Ex uppercase headings (72px, 40px) with Anantason Reno Expanded Thai body, 8px-radius photo tiles.

cdiscount-jumping-max.name: Cdiscount
cdiscount-jumping-max.description: Cdiscount (cdiscount.com): French marketplace on white with a #3732ff blue header, #ff1e3c red accent, #293847 text, Hind Madurai 14px/21px body and 21px/600 section titles, 8px-radius product cards and pill chips, dense product carousels.

cea.name: Creative Economy Agency
cea.description: Creative Economy Agency (cea.or.th), Thailand: white header with CEA orange #ff5100 uppercase nav, near-black #1d1d1b feature section, #575756 body text, Poppins and Kanit at 16px/23.2px with 700 uppercase headings (39.0625px), square buttons, 12px-radius tabs.

centara.name: Centara Hotels & Resorts
centara.description: Centara Hotels & Resorts (centarahotelsresorts.com): white canvas with black text, Centara red #b5121b buttons and accent words, Cardo serif headings (42px) with Karla body at 16px/24.48px and -0.4px tracking, cream #f8f6f3 bands and square-cornered buttons.

centara-the1.name: Centara The 1
centara-the1.description: Centara The 1 (centara1card.com), Centara Hotels & Resorts loyalty portal: #f7f7f7 canvas with black footer and white header, black Open Sans text at 14px to 15px, Centara red #b5121b and #a12a23 square buttons (44px to 58px tall), 4px radii, flat surfaces.

central.name: Central Online
central.description: Central Online (central.co.th, Central Department Store's e-commerce site): white #ffffff canvas with blush #fbeeee sale bands, #333333 cpnFont body text (16px/24px, 14px UI), 30px/700 section heads, condensed Bebas Neue for square black #000000 'EXPLORE MORE' buttons (26px, 16px padding, 0px radius), brand names and -% badges, centralSangBleuFont 48px serif promo headlines, red #ff0036 prices and #f50a3c 'Sale', pill filter chips.

central-embassy.name: Central Embassy
central-embassy.description: Central Embassy, Central Group's Bangkok luxury retail flagship, uses a pure black canvas (#000000) with off-white text (#f0f0f0), Raleway in uppercase with 1px tracking (900 weight at 24px for headings, 600 at 10px for navigation), square corners and campaign imagery as its only colour.

central-food-retail.name: Tops
central-food-retail.description: Tops is the corporate site of the Thai supermarket chain TOPS, part of Central Retail. It pairs a pure white canvas and black ink with the brand's signature red #ff1301, a CPN typeface used at 16px/700 for body and 32px/700 for headlines, full-bleed store photography under a dark scrim, and almost no rounding (1.75px) apart from circular carousel dots.

central-group.name: Central Group
central-group.description: Central Group (centralgroup.com/en/home): monochrome conglomerate site on white and #f1f1f1 with black and #474747 text, the CPN typeface (32px/700 statement, 16px/24px body), full-bleed photography with white labels, 10px frosted cards and no brand accent color.

central-pattana.name: Central Pattana
central-pattana.description: Corporate site of Central Pattana (CPN), Thai retail-property developer. White canvas, black ink, a single muted gold #b39656 for buttons and section titles, one custom sans (CPN, 300/400/700), 3px square-ish buttons, uppercase navigation and headings.

central-tham.name: Central Tham
central-tham.description: Central Tham (centraltham.com) is Central Group's sustainability and community project site: white canvas, near-black #1c1916 bands and buttons, a leaf green #60a031 accent, the CPN typeface at 110px bold for the hero, 5px buttons and 20px photo cards.

centralworld.name: centralwOrld
centralworld.description: centralwOrld, Bangkok's large lifestyle shopping complex, is a black-and-white editorial site in the custom cpn typeface (700 weight, 48.0004px section headings, 126px display words) with a white DISCOVER button, uppercase 12.25px tracked labels, and three rootVar accents: red #ed2939, lime #dfff0d and blue #0f4dbc.

century-21.name: Century 21
century-21.description: CENTURY 21 Real Estate US homepage: near-white #fdfcfc canvas, charcoal #262627 buttons with square corners, #121212 header, a full-bleed kitchen photo hero with a 56px Bold headline, and listing cards with 4px/6px radii and soft two-layer shadows.

cerave.name: CeraVe
cerave.description: CeraVe US homepage: white canvas, navy #003057 and #0e3353 text and footer, CeraVe blue #0772ba actions, square 0px buttons in DIN-Bold uppercase with 1px letter-spacing, Open Sans body, and a rainbow of nine category-tab fills under product carousels.

cerebrium.name: Cerebrium
cerebrium.description: Cerebrium serverless GPU homepage: dark #101421 hero with a magenta ribbon, white rounded content sheet, navy #172b76 text, pink #ff488b buttons with 7px radius in 13px Suisse Int'l Mono caps, ABC Favorit Trial light headlines at 79.8px.

ch3-thailand.name: Channel 3 Thailand (3Plus)
ch3-thailand.description: ch3thailand.com redirects to 3Plus (ch3plus.com), Channel 3's streaming site: near-black #00040d canvas, #f2f6fd ink and a white-fill 'play' button with dark text and 4px radius, Thai type in the DB Heavent family at 20px and 28px.

chakra-ui.name: Chakra UI
chakra-ui.description: Chakra UI is the accessible React component system: a white canvas, #52525b body copy and #09090b headings in Wix Madefor Text on the site (Inter in the library), a teal primary (#0d9488), 4px component radii with 6px cards, 1px #e4e4e7 outlines, 40px-tall 14px/500 buttons, and recipe-driven tokens built on Panda-style createSystem.

champions-for-good.name: Champions for Good Club
champions-for-good.description: Champions for Good Club homepage: a dark purple #23002b hero with giant Druk Condensed lettering in light purple #e894ff, a #fbfbfb canvas, brown #291900 and green #002629 bands with yellow #ffac47 and mint #94ffe4 text, and Neue Montreal 15px to 16px interface type.

chanel.name: CHANEL
chanel.description: CHANEL's US home page: a white #ffffff header over a stack of full-bleed campaign images, #1d1d1d ink, uppercase abchanel-2022 captions at 30px/600 with 1.8px tracking, 11px/600 'SEE MORE' buttons 48px tall with square 0px corners (hover #f1f1f1), Helvetica 14px/300 body text in #767676, and no color beyond black, white and greys.

channel-8.name: Channel 8 (thaich8.com)
channel-8.description: Thai news and entertainment portal of Channel 8 (RS Public Company Limited): light #f2f3f5 and white pages, #333333 text, slate #525b6e section titles, a #0484cf blue menu bar, Prompt type at 13px to 19px, and white cards with 1px #e6e6e8 borders.

channel-9-mcot-hd.name: MCOT TV (9 MCOT HD)
channel-9-mcot-hd.description: tv.mcot.net/tv/th, the MCOT operator portal for 9 MCOT HD: deep violet #190a22 canvas, #8b36bc purple pill buttons, a #5d0e8b sub-nav band, black #000000 top bar, white Kanit text at 16px and 48px, 8px and 16px card radii.

channel-g.name: Channel G Company Limited
channel-g.description: cng.co.th, Channel G's Thai IT-services site: a full-screen slide deck with white Prompt type at 72px/700 and 18px/300, 0.5px tracking, slides filled #71911b, #9a004c, #ca9800, #11769e and #790707, a white side rail and 2px white outline pill buttons.

chao-phraya-express-boat.name: Chao Phraya Express Boat
chao-phraya-express-boat.description: Chao Phraya Express Boat Co. (เรือด่วนเจ้าพระยา) site, built on Wix: white canvas, navy #0b4280 full-width sections with white Kanit-based text at 40px and 18px, square 1px-outline buttons, a 177px header with black menu links that fade to #959595.

character-ai.name: Character.AI
character-ai.description: Character.AI logged-out landing page: #f4f4f5 canvas, near-black #131316 buttons with 12px and 30px radii, atHauss type at 36px/600 with -0.72px tracking, a 24px-radius sign-in card over a 32px-radius illustrated hero image, and grey G-scale tokens.

charan.name: Charan Insurance
charan.description: Charan Insurance (บมจ.จรัญประกันภัย) Thai homepage: Mitr headings at 30.4px and Noto Sans Thai text, royal-blue ink (#4054b2) on white over a #ecebe9 page, cyan (#22b5ce) accent on the submit button and active menu, flat boxes with 2-3px radii, a striped contact table and a row of vertical product banners.

chargepoint.name: ChargePoint
chargepoint.description: ChargePoint's EV-charging marketing site: a white canvas with charcoal-plum ink (#413d46), a deep ocean-blue pill CTA (#0f588a, 50px radius), orange (#ff7a14) pattern heroes and plus-sign bullets, set entirely in Gotham Narrow SSm at light weight 300, with 16px soft-shadowed cards.

charity-water.name: charity: water
charity-water.description: charity: water's donation-first site: full-bleed documentary photography, Kazimir Text serif headlines at 46px/52px, Proxima Nova UI with widely tracked uppercase labels, a single Jerry Can yellow (#ffca0a, hover #ffd53b) on 4px-radius buttons with #222520 text, warm cream bands (#f8eed3 fading to #faf7f0) on a white (#ffffff) page, and a white donation card with 48px amount buttons.

charles-schwab.name: Charles Schwab
charles-schwab.description: Charles Schwab (schwab.com, measured at https://www.schwab.com/): a white canvas with near-black #111111 text, the proprietary Charles Modern family at 17px body and 42px light headings, a burnt-orange #b05e0d call-to-action with 24px radius and a teal-blue #037dae secondary button, on a slate #33424c header bar.

charlotte-tilbury.name: Charlotte Tilbury
charlotte-tilbury.description: Charlotte Tilbury's US storefront: a white canvas with Night Crimson ink (#3a080a), a blush promo strip (#fde8e0), outlined square-cornered uppercase buttons, red sale prices (#e41929), Vanitas display headings over Helvetica Neue LT Condensed and Helvetica Neue LT, and full-bleed campaign photography.

chatramue.name: ChaTraMue
chatramue.description: ChaTraMue (Original Thai Tea Since 1945): a white, near-flat storefront set entirely in Nunito at weight 300, with charcoal #3a3a3a actions, #333232 body text, near-square 0px and 2px corners and no shadows, letting red and green tea packaging supply all the color.

chatuchak.name: Chatuchak Market
chatuchak.description: Chatuchak Market (chatuchakmarket.org), a visitor guide and tour-booking site for Bangkok's weekend market: Lato uppercase headings, signal red #f44337 top bar, pill BOOK A TOUR button at 99px radius, 12px gray cards and full-bleed market photography.

chegg.name: Chegg
chegg.description: Chegg.com home: white #ffffff canvas, #222222 ink, Aspira Webfont throughout (48px/900 hero, 40px/700 claims), Chegg orange #eb7100 with a #e65700→#eb7100 gradient on 32px-radius 'Join now' buttons, a peach #fff6f0 steps strip, a shadowed ask-a-question card and a #fbfafb footer in #302c41.

chew-productions.name: CHEW
chew-productions.description: CHEW (chew.productions), a London creative studio for gaming and esports film: a pure black canvas (#000000) with white Messina Sans type in uppercase, 14px captions, 108.8px bold hero titles at -5.44px tracking, a #171616 menu panel, and full-bleed project video instead of buttons, cards or shadows.

chin-huay.name: Chin Huay
chin-huay.description: Corporate site of Chin Huay Public Company Limited, a Thai canned fish, dried fruit and snack maker, in Poppins 400/600 with an 85px uppercase hero, brand magenta #ec008c, forest green #558257 outlined pill buttons, pale lime #e9f2d0 bands and heavily rounded organic shapes (15px to 97px).

china-mobile.name: China Mobile Limited
china-mobile.description: China Mobile Limited's English investor and corporate site: a white page with #f9f9f9 bands, #333333 and #666666 Roboto Light text, a three-color accent system of blue (#008ed4), magenta (#dc1779) and green (#8dc642) with pastel tint cards at 8px radius, and a header menu whose links fill blue on hover.

chipotle.name: Chipotle
chipotle.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill's web system as measured on chipotle.com — a pure white #ffffff canvas, burnt-brown #451400 ink used for nearly all text and headings, a chili-red #ad2118 ORDER NOW button and a mustard-gold #b68207 catering button, uppercase "Trade Gothic LT Bold" headlines (33.6px/500 h1, 48px section titles, 24px nav) over Nunito 18px body copy, 4px button corners, 14px reward cards, and a signature left-to-right color-wipe hover on every filled button.

chipsa.name: Chipsa
chipsa.description: Chipsa (chipsa.design), a WebGL and 3D design studio's site: black text on white (#ffffff) and light grey (#f4f4f4), all-caps PPRightGroteskText at weight 800 for the h1 (40px) and h2 (60px) with PPNeueMontreal 500 body at 28px, square-cornered buttons, 6px-radius cards, 1px black underlines and -0.12px tracking throughout.

chopard.name: Chopard
chopard.description: Chopard's US e-commerce site: a near-black (#010307) and off-white (#fefefe) luxury palette with light-grey (#f2f2f3) product tiles, uppercase Engravers labels at 1.6px tracking, Walbaum serif headings at 36px, Helvetica Chopard body text, 2px-radius black DISCOVER buttons and a full-black Services band.

christian-louboutin.name: Christian Louboutin
christian-louboutin.description: Christian Louboutin's US homepage is a black-and-white shell around campaign photography: NB Akademie 12px body with 0.7px tracking, serif Loubi capital titles, square 36px outlined white buttons with 1px borders, a measured red #ce0a2c panel, and a #ffffff canvas.

christies-international-real-estate.name: Christie's International Real Estate
christies-international-real-estate.description: Christie's International Real Estate's home page: white and pale blue-grey (#f2f5f7) panels with near-black ink (#171a1c), a champagne-gold (#c9ac77) square Gilroy button, Playfair Display serif headings at 32px and 46px, Gilroy body text tracked at 1.6px, full-bleed property photography and a dark footer.

chromatic.name: Chromatic
chromatic.description: Chromatic's chromatic.com marketing site, built with its own Tetra style guide: dark slate #141c24 canvas, white and #eef2f6 Nunito Sans text (48px/600 headlines), blue #006deb pill CTAs with 42px radius, outlined white pills, an uppercase tracked DEVELOP / TEST / DELIVER band in yellow #ffae00, cyan #37d5d3 and purple, and colored 8px-radius stat cards.

chubb.name: Chubb
chubb.description: Chubb's US home page: a white canvas with black text, a violet accent (#6e27c5) used on emphasis, rules and card underlines, PublicoHeadline serif for the 62px hero and 40px headings, Lato 16px body at 26px line-height, square outlined buttons, and 0.2-alpha card shadows over documentary people photography.

chulabook.name: Chulabook
chulabook.description: Chulabook (ศูนย์หนังสือจุฬาฯ), Thailand's university bookstore online: white canvas, hot-pink #ee5294 headings and outlined buttons, Montserrat with Kanit for Thai, 6px outlined buttons, 8px cards and book-cover-led product grids.

chulalongkorn-university.name: Chulalongkorn University
chulalongkorn-university.description: Chulalongkorn University's English home page (chula.ac.th/en): white canvas with black and #333333 text, Chula pink (#da5f8e) gradient cards and accents, a custom CHULALONGKORN typeface at 100px and 80px with Anuphan 18px body, 12px to 20px card radii, pill buttons and a #141414 footer.

ciao-energy-launch-website.name: Ciao Energy
ciao-energy-launch-website.description: Ciao Energy's French launch site for a low-sugar energy drink: a pure black canvas with white Geist Light text at 15.75px, Franklin Gothic ATF uppercase headings at 96px, white 3.5px-radius buttons with a white glow, hairline white borders and WebGL cans and gradient orbs, with raspberry (#800035) and pink (#ff659d) taste colors.

cigna.name: Cigna Healthcare
cigna.description: Cigna Healthcare's US site pairs a confident cobalt blue (#0033ff) with deep indigo (#110081) headlines, leaf green (#00874d) and peach (#fad6bd) accents on a white and #f4f4f4 canvas. Value Serif Pro 700 carries display and feature headlines (64px hero), Value Sans Pro carries body (14px/16px), with fully round 9999px pill buttons and 30px leaf-cut cards.

cimb-thai.name: CIMB Thai
cimb-thai.description: CIMB Thai Bank's personal-banking home page uses signal red (#ff0000) for primary buttons on a white canvas, deep maroon (#780000) headlines and hero scrim, a charcoal #272727 footer, Noto Sans in 400, 700 and 900 weights (48px hero, 18px body) and 8px-radius buttons and cards with a soft 0 3px 6px shadow.

cipher.name: CIPHER
cipher.description: CIPHER is a Paris creative production company whose site is a near-monochrome stage: warm black #060403 and bone #e9eae4, ABC Arizona Mix at weight 200 in uppercase for 40px statements, ABC Favorit 12px medium uppercase for navigation, no radii, no shadows, and staggered image grids captioned with index numbers.

ciridae.name: Ciridae
ciridae.description: Ciridae's site pairs cream and bone grounds (#fcfbf8, #eae1ce) with ink #14110d and a single copper accent #cc6437, set in Pragmatica Cond uppercase at 102.4px for the hero, Pragmatica 18px body and Roboto Mono and ABC Monument Grotesk Mono labels, with square 52px buttons, one pill-outline nav CTA and no shadows.

cisco.name: Cisco
cisco.description: Cisco.com homepage: a black canvas (#000000) with white Inter type (48px/500 display, 16px/24px body), a white 48px pill primary button, outlined link tiles, and a single electric blue accent (#0a60ff) used for links and glowing promo-card edges.

citi.name: Citi (Citigroup corporate site)
citi.description: The Citigroup corporate site (citigroup.com) uses Citi Sans Text at 400 weight on a pale #f6f8fa page with a deep navy #0f1632 band, a cobalt #255be3 button with 6px radius that darkens to #163788, 20px-radius cards in #f0f5f7, 36px headlines, and no drop shadows beyond a single soft blue lift.

cj-more.name: CJ MORE
cj-more.description: CJ MORE (ซีเจ มอร์), the C.J. Express Group supermarket chain, runs a green-and-yellow Thai site in the condensed db_helvethaica_x_cond face (34px body, 26px nav) with 80px db_helvethaica_x_med headings, a #00a150 green header and footer, #ffc934 and #fedb21 yellow buttons and a #f5f5f5 canvas.

ck-power.name: CKPower
ck-power.description: CKPower (CKP) Public Company Limited English homepage (ckpower.co.th/en/home): photography-led sections with white Lato 900 headlines at 65px and 40px uppercase, Montserrat 15px body, charcoal #292929 text, #4b4744 footer, 4px-radius ghost buttons, and orange #ee7822, blue #1f51a0 and green #26a24c icon rings.

claude.name: Claude
claude.description: Claude's site is warm paper and ink: a #faf9f5 canvas, #30302e text, near-black #141413 buttons with 9.6px corners, Anthropic's custom serif (330-weight 67.7px hero) over Anthropic Sans body, clay orange (#d97757) used only as a spark accent, 1px #d1cfc5 outlines, and 24-32px rounded cards with almost invisible shadows.

clay.name: Clay
clay.description: Clay is a playful GTM-data brand set in Roobert (88px/575 hero, -3.52px tracking): lime (#cbd810) and black pill-less 12px buttons, a deep forest-green hero (#035d44), warm oat neutrals (#f4f3f0, #fffdf9) and candy swatches (dragonfruit, tangerine, slushie, ube) behind rounded 18px tiles and 3D clay-style illustrations.

clay-boan-25.name: Clay Boan
clay-boan-25.description: Clay Boan's portfolio is an almost black stage (#0e0e0e) with white type, set entirely in Aeonik Pro 500 uppercase: 11.2px parenthetical labels and navigation against 144px to 160px project titles with -5.76px tracking, plus a blackletter Emeritus Display hero mark, a 3D clay render, no radii, no shadows and no buttons.

claymorphism.name: Claymorphism
claymorphism.description: Soft, rounded 3D-like shapes mimicking malleable clay with playful, puffy elements and colorful surfaces.

clean.name: Clean
clean.description: Simplicity-focused design with ample whitespace, legible typography, and a limited color palette to reduce visual clutter.

clerk.name: Clerk
clerk.description: Clerk's authentication site: a cool off-white #f7f7f8 canvas alternating with #131316 near-black bands, #131316 ink, violet #6c47ff section eyebrows, suisse 56px/700 headlines tracked -1.96px, 13px/20px body copy, pill buttons and 2.4%-opacity layered hairline shadows on product-UI cards.

cleveland-clinic.name: Cleveland Clinic
cleveland-clinic.description: Cleveland Clinic's patient site uses Roboto throughout (900-weight 48px hero, 700-weight 32px service titles, 18px medium buttons) with a clinical blue #007bc2 for the Appointments button, a deeper #0076ba for headings and links, #1b477b hover, a green #1d8553 accent, 5px button radii and a 24px alert pill on a white canvas.

clickhouse.name: ClickHouse
clickhouse.description: ClickHouse's marketing site is a warm near-black canvas (#131312) with off-white Inter text, Basier 600/700 headlines at up to 96px, and a single neon yellow accent (#faff69) on 4px-radius buttons, 8px cards, arrow links and testimonial panels.

clickup.name: ClickUp
clickup.description: ClickUp's marketing home: white #ffffff and #f8f9fa canvas with a black #000000 Brain AI section, #202020 Get started buttons with 15px corners, #646464 grey copy, Plus Jakarta Sans 700 headlines at 60px with -2.1px tracking, Inter UI text, Sometype Mono uppercase labels, and the pink-orange-purple-blue brand gradient (#ff02f0, #fc6d2d, #6647f0, #0091ff).

climeworks.name: Climeworks
climeworks.description: Climeworks (climeworks.com), the Swiss direct-air-capture carbon removal company: white #ffffff pages with neutral #f0f1f1 bands and a black #000000 footer, Climeworks dark blue #008fe8 for the primary 'Remove CO2' button (hover #007fca) and light blue #78c5e5 for banners. Headlines are the serif Reckless Neue (served as WebRecklessNeue) at 71.9661px/400 with -1.49996px tracking; everything else is Haffer (served as WebHaffer) at 18px/26.1px. Buttons are 8px-radius, 44px tall with 12px 24px padding; media cards round to 16px.

clinique.name: Clinique
clinique.description: Clinique's US storefront is a clean white and #fafafa product catalogue in Cliniques Helvetica Neue (200-weight 48px headlines, 16px body, 800-weight product titles), with black pill buttons (1000px radius), mint #adddb7 badges, a red #dd0000 holiday nav link and square, unframed product imagery.

clou-agency-portfolio.name: Clou Werbeagentur Luzern
clou-agency-portfolio.description: Clou, a Lucerne branding and web agency, sets a 256px Athletics wordmark at weight 500 on white, then drops into a near-black #101114 panel and full-bleed colour case cards (orange #eb693c, teal #005d69, coral #ec554a), with grey #e8ebe9 and graphite #1f2126 pill buttons at 48px radius and 16px to 64px card radii.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.description: Cloudflare's homepage sets FT Kunst Grotesk at weight 500 with tight negative tracking, floods the hero with a rounded Cloudflare-orange (#ff5e1f) panel carrying a white pill CTA, then drops to a near-white canvas of hairline-divided feature cells. It is built on Kumo, Cloudflare's open-source design system, whose docs run on Inter with 8px controls.

cloudforest.name: CloudForest
cloudforest.description: CloudForest (cloudforest.co.th), a Thai cloud hosting provider, pairs a deep brand blue #016fb9 and bright action blue #0496ff on white with Line Seed headlines (45px, weight 500) and Prompt uppercase navigation, 10px-radius buttons, a 15px-radius white feature panel with a soft shadow, and isometric cloud illustrations.

clover-power.name: Clover Power
clover-power.description: Clover Power (cloverpower.co.th), a Thai renewable-electricity producer, uses a white canvas #ffffff, blue #4378bc and #3e78bc, deeper blue #305993, clover green #72bb44 and orange #f7941d accents, Mitr type from 16px/300 body to an 80px/500 hero word, 25px pill buttons and leaf-shaped image masks.

club-med.name: Club Med
club-med.description: Club Med Thailand home page (clubmed.co.th), measured — warm sand #f5f0e8 and white #ffffff surfaces, ultramarine navy #1e2a4a pill buttons (120px radius), saffron #ffcc00 search button, sage #a8b8b3 sustainability band, Newsreader 64px/700 serif headlines over Inter 16px/400 body, 16px-radius image cards.

cnn.name: CNN
cnn.description: CNN's edition home page is a dense newsroom grid in near-black #0c0c0c on white, set in cnn_sans_display (36px bold lead headline, 20px medium story headlines, 16px links), with the brand red #cc0000 reserved for conversion actions and live markers, #e6e6e6 hairlines, 4px thumbnails and 8px controls.

coachella.name: Coachella
coachella.description: Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival (coachella.com): warm beige surfaces (#f5ebdb header, #fefbf6 cards, #efddbe), forest-green #294e2c text and desert-blue #336d8e headings, Perfectly Nineties serif display at 75.3927px, Sweet Sans Pro tracked caps, Funnel Sans body at 20px, and 20px-radius cream cards over festival photography.

coca-cola.name: Coca-Cola
coca-cola.description: Coca-Cola US site system: a #eeeeee canvas with white #ffffff cards, black #000000 pill buttons (40px high, full radius, 12px bold label), TCCC-UnityText at 700 with -1.5px tracking for 38px headlines, 16px image-and-card radius, and campaign photography carrying all colour.

cockroach-labs.name: Cockroach Labs
cockroach-labs.description: Cockroach Labs (CockroachDB and the Continuum database cloud): a pure black #000000 page with a deep-green #101913 footer, data-purple #9059ff pill CTAs (35px radius) that hover to bio-green #aede54, sci-fi blue #60ecff accents, Geist at weight 200 from 71.11px display to 16px/27px body, Geist Mono buttons and 2-3.2px tracked uppercase eyebrows.

code-and-theory.name: Code and Theory
code-and-theory.description: Code and Theory's site is a pure black (#000000) stage with white type in akademie (53.33px headlines, 46.29px project names at weight 400), a light koor serif for the hero's second line, Fragment Mono 12px notes in #a9a9a9, one white 56px pill button, no cards, and full-width case-study imagery.

codecademy.name: Codecademy
codecademy.description: Codecademy's marketing site runs its open-source Gamut design system in dark color mode — a pure #000000 canvas, white Apercu body type at 16px/24px, a 76px Apercu hero headline with a Suisse Int'l Mono accent line in lime #aee938, and Codecademy-yellow #ffd300 fill buttons with navy #10162f labels, 4px corners and a 2px border. Light pages flip to beige #fff0e5 with hyper-violet #3a10e5 actions. Cards are #0a0d1c with 16px radius and translucent #ffffff33 hairlines.

codesandbox.name: CodeSandbox
codesandbox.description: CodeSandbox's home page is near-black #0e0e0e with #161616 bands, a 120px/500 display headline (-6px tracking) in electric lime #d6fb41, Inter body text in #a3a3a3 and #f0f0f0, pale-lime #eaff96 buttons with #343434 text at 6px radius, and full-bleed lime sections with 10px-radius testimonial cards.

coffee-world.name: Coffee World
coffee-world.description: Coffee World (coffeeworld.com), the Thai coffee-shop chain now part of PTG. Royal blue #273c84 text and accents on a white #ffffff canvas with a yellow #fad943 bean-and-drop mark, set entirely in Nunito Sans (32px/900 hero heading, 14px/400 body) with 100px pill navigation and 10px cards.

coffeetech-r.name: CoffeeTech®
coffeetech-r.description: CoffeeTech® (coffee-tech.com), an Israeli maker of commercial coffee roasters. A near-black #0d0e13 canvas with cream #f3ede3 type and a terracotta #c8603d Products button, set in Inter with a 192px/500 hero headline, square 0px buttons and 11.11px beige cards on #e5e2dd bands.

cohere.name: Cohere
cohere.description: Cohere's marketing site pairs a white canvas (#ffffff) and volcanic ink (#212121) with warm stone bands (#f0eee9), forest-green panels and photography; CohereText headlines at 96px/400 with -1.92px tracking, Unica77 Cohere Web body, and near-black pill buttons (#17171c).

coinbase.name: Coinbase
coinbase.description: Coinbase's homepage uses a white canvas (#ffffff), a cool grey band (#eef0f3), near-black rounded panels (#0a0b0d), and one accent, Coinbase Blue (#0052ff), on 56px-radius pill buttons with CoinbaseDisplay headlines at 80px/400 and grey 13px CoinbaseText body.

coldwell-banker.name: Coldwell Banker
coldwell-banker.description: Coldwell Banker (coldwellbanker.com), the US residential real-estate brokerage. White #ffffff canvas under full-bleed home photography, royal blue #1f69ff actions, navy #012169 and #00003e bands, ColdwellSans 56px/500 headline with Roboto text, 8px buttons and 20px search card.

collins.name: COLLINS
collins.description: COLLINS (wearecollins.com), the brand-and-design agency site. Warm off-white #f8f8f7 canvas with espresso-black #140700 ink, Portrait Text serif at 72px/400 for headlines and Graphik for interface text, pill buttons at 96px radius and 16px image cards.

colodee-digital-network.name: COLODEE DIGITAL NETWORK
colodee-digital-network.description: COLODEE DIGITAL NETWORK (colodee.com), a Thai co-location, dedicated-server and VPS host. Dark navy #07142b hero bands and light #f5f7fb sections, electric teal #19e0cf actions with navy #040a16 labels, Chakra Petch 700 headlines, IBM Plex Sans Thai text and IBM Plex Mono labels, 8px buttons and 16px cards.

colonia-zacamil.name: Colonia Zacamil
colonia-zacamil.description: Colonia Zacamil (coloniazacamil.com), an interactive neighbourhood experience. Warm stone #ebe6e0 canvas with pure black #000000 type, Heathergreen condensed capitals at 166.4px, Reckless Neue serif at 24px, Roboto Mono labels and a 30px-radius black Discover pill with a gold #b48e46 accent.

colorful.name: Colorful
colorful.description: Vibrant, high-contrast palettes and gradients for engaging, memorable, and modern user experiences.

com7.name: Comseven
com7.description: Comseven (comseven.com/th), the corporate site of Com7 Public Company Limited, a Thai IT retailer. White #ffffff and #faf9fa pages, black #000000 type and footer, a fresh green #44c767 View-more button and a #3fb02c share-price panel, Noto Sans Thai at 16px with Sukhumvit Set controls and 2px-radius buttons.

cominvi.name: CoMinVi
cominvi.description: CoMinVi (cominvi.com.mx), an underground mining contractor in Guanajuato, Mexico. Near-black #151515 hero over mine footage, pale #ebf0ed and white sections, orange #f47920 accent, Helvetica Now Display 700 headlines with PP Supply Mono 300 uppercase labels and 7.11px clipped buttons.

commonwealth-fusion-systems.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
commonwealth-fusion-systems.description: Commonwealth Fusion Systems (cfs.energy), a commercial fusion energy company. Warm tan #ccc8c3 canvas with graphite #333333 type, deep navy #152536 footer, terracotta #cf6d46 circle-arrow accents, nbInternational Light 300 at 58.526px for headlines and a mono face for navigation and links.

compass.name: Compass
compass.description: Compass (compass.com), the US real-estate brokerage, ships a monochrome system — black (#000000) pill CTAs and white (#ffffff) pages, full-bleed home photography, a self-hosted "Compass Serif" for hero display lines (48px/600 hero, 50px/400 section titles) over a self-hosted "Compass Sans" UI face (16px/400 body, 500 for buttons), Open Sans 12px for listing-card metadata, 9999px pill buttons, square 0px search tabs and 8px listing cards, all driven by --cx-* and --colorIntent-* CSS custom properties on an 8px base unit.

composio.name: Composio
composio.description: Composio's homepage alternates a warm near-black DEV surface (#0f0f0f) and an off-white FOR YOU surface (#f6f6f6) with square-cornered white-fill mono buttons (JetBrains Mono 14px), Geist headlines at 64px/400 with -1.6px tracking, and a single electric blue accent.

compsych-brand-hub.name: ComPsych Brand Hub
compsych-brand-hub.description: ComPsych Brand Hub (compsych.konpo.co), the ComPsych Design Guidelines microsite made by Konpo Studio. Sky blue #8dc9f4 with deep sea #070f36 type, sienna #9c4e23 and forest #164c3b section themes over soft gradients, Beatrice at 103.385px/500 with Bright Clones and Inter, and 14.77px cards.

confluent.name: Confluent
confluent.description: Confluent, the data streaming platform from the original creators of Apache Kafka: black #000000 hero and demo bands against a white #ffffff canvas, #1e1e1e ink, electric blue #0056f9 buttons at 6px radius (hover #5a91f9), a #0e68bc announcement strip, and Poppins throughout from 53.332px/600 display to 16.732px body with uppercase tracked nav.

conicle.name: Conicle
conicle.description: Conicle (Thai online learning platform) design system: dbHeaventRounded type with a 52px hero, white canvas, red #ff2e38 pill buttons, #fff1ef tint, #ebecf0 hairlines and 20px-radius course cards with a soft shadow.

conocophillips.name: ConocoPhillips
conocophillips.description: ConocoPhillips (conocophillips.com), the global oil and gas exploration and production company. White #ffffff canvas with near-black #111111 type, electric blue #0b2cd9 actions and highlights, red #b00024 hover states, Sora 300 headlines at 64px, Public Sans text and square 0px buttons.

contemporary.name: Contemporary
contemporary.description: Current-era minimalist design with bento grids, dark mode support, and high-performance accessible layouts.

contentful.name: Contentful
contentful.description: Contentful's homepage pairs a deep navy hero panel (#0c2659) and a bright blue announcement bar (#1770e5) with white and charcoal (#2b2d31) pill buttons, set in a self-hosted face registered as avenirNextFont at weight 600 with tight tracking, 48px-radius pills and 20-48px rounded media. Its Forma 36 docs use Geist Sans and 6px blue buttons.

continental.name: Continental
continental.description: Continental (continental.com), the German tire and industrial-technology group. White canvas with black type, light-gray #f0f0f0 bands and a warm yellow-orange #ffa500 for pill buttons, set in ContinentalStagSansW at 52.5px/600 headlines and 20px body, with 24px-radius buttons and a 48px pill search field.

convertkit.name: Kit
convertkit.description: Kit (formerly ConvertKit) email-marketing site: custom KitSansFont headlines at 80px/500 over Libre Franklin 16px body, soft black #1e1e1e ink on white and warm-white #f2efe9 bands, Kit bright blue #44b1ff pill-free buttons with 14px corners, 16px dark creator cards and a #1e1e1e footer.

convex.name: Convex
convex.description: Convex's backend-platform site: warm near-black bands (#221f1d, #281d1d, #191919) with an antique-white #f6eedb section, the official yellow #f3b01c pill, red #ee342f and purple #8d2676 stripes, uppercase neue-haas-grotesk-display 60px/900 headlines, gtAmerica body, vcr pixel labels and IBM Plex Mono commands.

coolors.name: Coolors
coolors.description: Coolors palette-generator site: Inter everywhere with a 102.4px/800 hero at -3.584px tracking, #0a0a0a ink on white, blue #2563eb buttons with 10px and 8px corners, grey #f5f5f5 resource cards, and eight pastel tool tiles that pair Tailwind-style 100 tints with matching 600 text colours.

cooperative-promotion-department.name: Cooperative Promotion Department (CPD)
cooperative-promotion-department.description: Thai Cooperative Promotion Department portal at cpd.go.th: Noto Sans Thai with 38px bold titles, deep and light blue #1186b8 bands, white 10px-radius icon cards with a 10px 30px 0.08 shadow, white pill buttons with #0058aa text.

copilot-money.name: Copilot Money
copilot-money.description: Copilot Money's site: a near-black navy #000814 page with 90%-white text, Jokker Semibold headlines (112px, -2.24px) over hairline-thin Matter Variable Thin body copy at weight 100, electric blue #1c6cff actions, #597caa nav hover, 24px-radius glass cards, and glossy 40px-radius category tags in pink #ff33aa, orange and purple.

corentin-bernadou-portfolio.name: Corentin Bernadou Portfolio
corentin-bernadou-portfolio.description: Near-black portfolio (#070304) of a freelance developer, set entirely in one variable grotesque named H at tiny 11.85px / 600 grey (#767676) with a #ff4401 orange accent that appears as a measured link hover colour, a WebGL image cube, and zero border radius.

corporate.name: Corporate
corporate.description: Professional, brand-aligned design with structured grids, minimalist layouts, and consistent enterprise patterns.

corsair.name: CORSAIR
corsair.description: CORSAIR's global storefront is a Pitch Black (#000000) catalogue with Bright Yellow #ece81a used only for square-cornered (0px) CTAs; Saira Expanded Light headlines at 64px/300, Saira 14px body, Anthracite #191919 hairlines and 2px-radius form fields.

cos.name: COS
cos.description: COS US womenswear landing page: SuisseIntl (400/500/600/700) set in uppercase, a white 48px header over full-bleed two-column fashion photography, a #080808 near-black footer with #ffffff 13px text, #757575 inactive links, 32px bold uppercase headlines, and square 0px corners on every element.

cosmic.name: Cosmic
cosmic.description: Futuristic sci-fi aesthetic with dark themes, vibrant neon accents, and immersive spatial elements.

cosmos.name: Cosmos
cosmos.description: Cosmos visual-discovery site: a single custom family, cosmosOracle, with 72px/700 headlines at -2.88px and 20px/500 text at -2% tracking, near-black #0d0d0d ink and pill buttons on white and warm #f7f5f3 bands, warm greys #6e6a69 and #9a9796, 12px–16px cards and soft 5% shadows.

costco.name: Costco
costco.description: Costco Wholesale US storefront: white canvas (#ffffff), body ink #333333, Costco blue #005dab buttons with 3px radius, Costco red #e51937 accents, green #008000 savings text, set in Costco Sans Web with a Material UI token layer and dense promo tiles.

coursera.name: Coursera
coursera.description: Coursera as measured on coursera.org — a white canvas with near-black #0d0f12 ink and slate #48546e secondary text, Coursera Blue #0056d2 (the brand guide's primary blue, PMS 2728) on 36px buttons with 8px radius and a 1px inset ring, hover #0b408b; Source Sans Pro at 400/600 with slight negative tracking; soft blue-grey #f2f5fa bands, 24px-radius promo cards, pill chips and a CDS (Coursera Design System) token layer exposed as --cds-* CSS variables.

cp-all.name: CP ALL
cp-all.description: CP ALL Public Company Limited corporate site (7-Eleven-centred imagery): white page, black ink, CP blue #1c4ca0 footer and headings, #01a7df cyan hover pills with 30px radius, set in the self-hosted Thai/Latin face DB Heavent at 500 weight.

cp-axtra.name: CP Axtra
cp-axtra.description: CP Axtra (cpaxtra.com/en/home) measured at 1280px: Prompt in 400/500/700, uppercase bold headings, CP yellow #ffc01f pill buttons (15px radius), blue #0171cc for the stock ticker and links, #edf7ff light-blue bands, translucent #ffffffcc cards with 15px radius, and a 120px white header.

cp-foods.name: CPF (Charoen Pokphand Foods)
cp-foods.description: CPF (Charoen Pokphand Foods, cpfworldwide.com/th/home) measured at 1280px: Thai DB Heavent faces in light/regular/medium, green #008b43 section bars and headings, white pill outline buttons with 50px radius, a #f2f2f2 canvas with #f9f9f9 cards, and 30px/45px body copy.

cp-meiji.name: CP-Meiji
cp-meiji.description: CP-Meiji (ซีพี-เมจิ), Thai dairy brand site: light gray #eeeeee canvas with white panels, Meiji red #ed1c24, PSL Omyim Pro at 46px display and 30px body, 4px inputs, full-bleed product and campaign banners with red read-more tags.

cp-tower-reit.name: ซี.พี.ทาวเวอร์ (C.P. Tower)
cp-tower-reit.description: Office-for-rent site of C.P. Tower buildings managed by C.P. Land, set in db_helvethaica at 25.12px body and 80px display on white, with brand green #006838, lime green #8ec63f accents, slate ink #58595b and 50px-radius pill links.

cpn-retail.name: CPN Retail Growth Leasehold REIT
cpn-retail.description: Investor site of CPN Retail Growth Leasehold REIT (CPNREIT, SET: CPNREIT), the Central Pattana retail real-estate trust. Proprietary CPN typeface at 400 and 700 with a 130px wordmark headline, near-black #231f20 ink and buttons, brick-red #b33019 tiles, grey #595959 tiles and square corners on white.

craft.name: Craft
craft.description: Craft's marketing home: warm paper #fcf9f7 canvas, near-black #030302 pill buttons fading to 75% on hover, Untitled Serif 400 headlines at 66px with -1.98px tracking over Untitled Sans UI text, large 24px-rounded pastel panels in periwinkle #b8caf5, mint #9bd8a9 and butter #fde99b, and deep soft multi-layer shadows.

crate-and-barrel.name: Crate & Barrel
crate-and-barrel.description: Crate & Barrel's US storefront: a white #ffffff canvas with #222222 ink, square #222222 'Shop' buttons with #ffffff 600-weight 16px labels, everything set in the proprietary Crate Helvetica (400/600), 0px-radius fields and buttons, lowercase 33.783px editorial headlines over full-bleed lifestyle photography, and a #f7f7f7 footer.

crav-burgers.name: Crav Burgers
crav-burgers.description: CRAV artisan smashed-burger brand site: beige page #f5e3cd, ink #1b1b1b, ketchup red #f91814 and mustard #ffd750 full-bleed sections, oversized uppercase Mouse Memoirs headlines (384px and 192px), Modak wordmark, pill-shaped buttons.

crea.name: CREA
crea.description: CREA (Thai e-commerce enabler) design system: proxima-nova with a 100px weight-900 uppercase hero, off-white #fdfcfc canvas, teal #36b3a8 pill buttons with 300px radius, purple #750c92e0 section headings and a charcoal #1f1f1f footer.

creative.name: Creative
creative.description: Playful, character-driven design with expressive typography and bold graphics for landing pages and creative projects.

creative-giants.name: Creative Giants
creative-giants.description: Creative Giants (Brighton, UK) immersive-activation and public-art studio site: warm off-white #fffef7, black #000000 sections, grey #666666 body, Switzer at light 300 weight with tight negative tracking (-2.06379px at 51.59px) and fully round black Menu pill.

credit-agricole.name: Crédit Agricole
credit-agricole.description: Groupe Crédit Agricole corporate site (credit-agricole.com): grey page #ebebeb, ink #404040, Crédit Agricole green #82b600 buttons and side menu, teal #60bba1 press cards, Barlow Semi Condensed headlines with Open Sans body at 14px and 4px/10px radii.

cron.name: Cron
cron.description: Cron's cron.com is a single dark screen: #161412 warm near-black canvas with a #0f0d0a footer, Helvetica Neue throughout (a 140px/700 'It's about time.' headline at -3px tracking, 22px/37.4px body in #cccccc), and one #ff4700 orange pill 'Sign up' button wrapped in a 100px orange glow.

crossfit.name: CrossFit
crossfit.description: CrossFit.com home: light grey #f2f2f2 page with black #000000 header and #1a1a1a ink, CrossFit blue #075dc6 pill CTAs at 100px radius, uppercase PF DIN headlines (96px, 56px, 36px) over Inter body at 16px, with full-bleed gym photography.

crowdstrike.name: CrowdStrike
crowdstrike.description: CrowdStrike's site: crowdstrikeSharpSans bold headlines at 56px/62px and Neue Haas Grotesk Display for UI and body, CrowdStrike red #ec0000 buttons with 6–8px radii that hover to #d30000, black #000000 hero and platform bands with white type, light #f8f8f8 pricing sections and white 22px-radius cards with a soft 50px shadow.

cuberto.name: Cuberto
cuberto.description: Cuberto's agency site alternates white #ffffff and black #000000 sections, all set in Suisse Intl (72px/500 headline with -0.72px tracking, 14.4px/400 body), with black and white 46px pill buttons (9999px), 16px-radius service rows on #eeeeee, mint #e3f5f3 and pale #f1f3fa testimonial cards, 64px top-rounded section edges and 70%-white #ffffffb3 copy on black.

culture-amp.name: Culture Amp
culture-amp.description: Culture Amp pairs a warm off-white canvas (#fefbf9) and near-black ink (#171a1b) with Tiempos serif headlines at 56px/500, Inter body at 20px/400, black pill buttons (9999px radius, 54px tall) and soft 24px-radius cards on a #f6efea cream band. Its public Kaizen design system uses a separate Inter-led product palette with a #0168b3 action blue and 7px-radius buttons.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.description: Cursor's homepage uses warm cream grounds (#f7f7f4, #f2f1ed), olive-black ink (#26251e) with alpha-mixed greys, a custom CursorGothic sans at weight 400 (26px hero), pill buttons, and an orange accent (#f54e00) for links, with large product screenshots as the visuals.

cushman-and-wakefield.name: Cushman & Wakefield
cushman-and-wakefield.description: Cushman & Wakefield global home (cushmanwakefield.com/en) measured at 1280px: Gotham with ChronicleTextG2 accents, uppercase 40px/500 display, deep indigo #1d1740 square-cornered buttons with 12px/700 uppercase labels, grey #686b6b body text on a white canvas, and a 0px radius everywhere.

customerio.name: Customer.io
customerio.description: Customer.io (customer.io) sets everything in Saans (saansFont, variable weight 475) on white, with Spruce #0b363b pill buttons ringed by a 4px Verdant #abffae flare, deep-teal #00262b ink, dark Spruce #00191c bands and footer, 96px/40px headlines with +0.2px tracking, and pastel case-study tints.

cvs-health.name: CVS Health
cvs-health.description: CVS Health corporate site: white canvas, black ink, CVS red #cc0000 buttons (10px radius) and hover links, black #000000 footer and #262626 utility bar, CVS Sans Regular and Medium at 48px and 36px headlines, 16px cards with a soft 8px shadow.

cyphr.name: Cyphr
cyphr.description: Cyphr (London brand-experience studio) site: warm grey canvas #ecece9, black #000000 ink and footer, one electric blue #212dd2 accent, Bandit Condensed uppercase display at 123.733px and 318.737px, Messina Sans Mono 13px body with -0.39px tracking.

d2c-life-science.name: D2C Life Science
d2c-life-science.description: D2C Life Science (d2c-lifescience.com) is a one-page GMP consultancy site built as a dark olive field (#717f71) with pale mint text (#e6f6ed), Atipla ND 700 uppercase headlines at 40px/41.6px, PP Fraktion Mono 12px uppercase body copy, 4px-radius mint buttons and a rotating 3D cube hero.

daily-news.name: Daily News (เดลินิวส์)
daily-news.description: Dailynews Online (dailynews.co.th), the web edition of the Thai daily Dailynews: a white page with magenta #ec008c section titles and rules, Kanit for headlines and navigation (400-700), Sarabun 16px/25.6px for Thai body copy, 8px-radius cards with a 10px soft shadow, and a very dense multi-section news home.

daisyui.name: daisyUI
daisyui.description: daisyUI is the Tailwind CSS component library: a white canvas (#ffffff), zinc ink (#18181b), a neutral black pill CTA (#09090b), indigo theme primary (#422ad5), 4px field and 8px box radii, Outfit headlines (44.8px/72px) and a system-UI stack for components.

damn-good-brands-2.name: Damn Good Brands
damn-good-brands-2.description: Damn Good Brands (damngoodbrands.com), a Charlotte, NC (Ad)venture fund and creative agency site: pure black #000000 canvas, white #ffffff type, NeueMontreal 900 display at 32px, Chomsky blackletter initials, Nord 14px UI labels with 0.28px tracking, #131313 cards at 6.4px radius, and floating 3D props around an oversized DAMN GOOD wordmark.

damso.name: Damso
damso.description: Damso.com is the artist Damso's site built as a retro media-player interface: a white (#ffffff) product browser with a dark #212121 click wheel, a Finder-style /world page with a #074edd selection label, and a black /billetterie event list, all in tiny uppercase grotesk (700, 10.6666px) with 1.59px-7.11px corners.

danone.name: Danone
danone.description: Danone's corporate site (danone.com): a saturated #005eb8 blue hero over white pages, DanoneOne Regular 16px body, DanoneOne CondensedBold uppercase headlines (28px hero, 52px and 120px statistics), pale blue #ccdff1 and #cceefb stat cards at 12px radius, and 100px-radius outlined buttons with a 1px black border.

dapper.name: Dapper
dapper.description: Dapper (dapper.agency) is a European B2B demand-generation agency site: a warm light-gray #f3f3f3 canvas with near-black #212121 type, a mint-green #74f5a1 action accent, Helvetica Now Display 700 headlines at 85.3333px with -2.56px tracking, italic serif accent words, white cards, and 5.33px-radius buttons with a small arrow chip.

darknode.name: Darknode
darknode.description: Darknode (darknode.army/en), the site of an anti-Shahed drone unit of Ukraine's 412th Nemesis Brigade: a near-black navy HUD interface (#14181e, #0f1318) with pale #eef2f9 text, signal red #f90000 accents, Uafsans Cond 600 uppercase headlines at 99.5584px with -5.6px tracking, Geist Mono 14px labels and square 0px-radius controls.

darkroom-engineering.name: darkroom.engineering
darkroom-engineering.description: darkroom.engineering is a black #000000 terminal-like site printed entirely in one red, #e71419: uppercase Therma condensed display at 177.778px ('WHERE THINGS GET DEVELOPED', -8.88888px tracking), a 12.4444px/200 uppercase mono for everything else, burnt-red #390205 chips and rules, red-filled 'LET'S TALK →' buttons with black text, 0px corners and no shadows.

darkstar-fury-evo-i.name: Darkstar Fury: Evo I
darkstar-fury-evo-i.description: Darkstar Fury: Evo I (darkstarfury.com), a browser synthwave space shooter by Patrick Heintzmann: a pure #000000 canvas, terminal-green #25ab6f Orbitron copy at 16px/32px with 1.6px tracking, red #ff3838 button labels inside mint #43ffc0 chamfered frames, a photosensitivity notice and a 40px-tall ENTER button.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Dark-themed cloud-platform aesthetic with modular grids, glass-like panels, and strong data hierarchy for productivity dashboards.

data-zone.name: Data Zone Thailand
data-zone.description: Data Zone Thailand (datazonedc.com), a Tier III carrier-neutral data center: a white page under a charcoal #3a3b3d header, red #d71921 links and CONTACT button with 5px radius, Century Gothic Bold 48px/51.2px headlines, Open Sans 18px/28px body, a full-width night photograph slider, and a metal-tile textured footer.

databricks.name: Databricks
databricks.description: Databricks (databricks.com), the data and AI platform company: DM Sans 500 headlines at 48px/60px in deep teal-navy #1b3139, a hot red #eb1600 square-cornered CTA, alternating white, warm #eeede9 and dark #0b2026 bands, DM Mono uppercase eyebrows, and product cards with layered soft shadows at 16px-20px radius.

datadog.name: Datadog
datadog.description: Datadog (datadoghq.com), the observability and security platform: NationalWeb type at 68px/600 on white, brand purple #632ca6 (official Datadog Purple) with an #8000ff accent, 4px-radius uppercase CTAs, a #110617 dark-purple footer, black product sections, and a 3D tilted product dashboard under a centered hero.

datamossa.name: DataMossa Co., Ltd
datamossa.description: DataMossa (datamossa.co.th), a Thailand technology consultancy site in dark mode: #1a1a1a and #000000 alternating sections, Inter 400-700 text in light gray #b0b0b0, a purple #881a8a hero gradient and buttons with 5px radius, 10px-radius bordered cards with a soft 0 2px 10px shadow, and a 48px/57.6px bold headline.

david-alaba.name: David Alaba
david-alaba.description: Official site of footballer David Alaba: a white #ffffff canvas with near-black #0a0a0c type set entirely in TWK Lausanne 400, from 176px negative-tracked display headlines down to 12px uppercase navigation, with sharp 0px corners and photography as the only color.

david-whyte-experience.name: David Whyte Experience
david-whyte-experience.description: Companion-membership page of poet David Whyte's site: a warm grey #e7e7e2 canvas, black #000000 type in thin Canela Text (weight 100, 52px headings) paired with 18px Roobert body, white #ffffff 4px-radius subscribe buttons, and a painted WebGL landscape as the only color.

davincii.name: DaVincii
davincii.description: DaVincii, a self-described living intelligence system: a charcoal #1d1d1d canvas with light-grey #c3c3c3 type, a custom DaVinci serif at weight 300 (56px, -3.92px tracking) with italic emphasis, Kessler 17.7778px body, Inter 500 labels, circular 50% shapes and sand-toned stone textures.

daydream-player.name: Daydream Player
daydream-player.description: Marketing site for Daydream, a social music player: near-black #080808 and #161616 surfaces, white and #d9d9d9 type in Archivo (48.8px headline) and Manrope (25px body), an ember red #ee4137 loader and footer, pill shapes and a frosted nav pill.

db-schenker.name: DSV
db-schenker.description: DSV global transport and logistics site, which now serves dbschenker.com after the Schenker merger: white #ffffff canvas, #181818 text in FoundrySterling (800-weight headlines at 48px and 36px, 15px body), sharp 0px corners, DSV blue #0a34a1 buttons and a #002664 navy footer.

dbs.name: DBS
dbs.description: DBS Group home page: a white #ffffff canvas with #2e2e2e text in Open Sans (700-weight 36px and 32px headlines, 16px to 24px copy), DBS red #ff3333 buttons with a 4px radius, an 80px red Login block, #f3f3f3 photo tiles and amber #ffaa22 'View all' tiles.

decathlon.name: Decathlon
decathlon.description: Decathlon America's storefront is a white (#ffffff) Inter-only retail layout with 56px/700 hero headlines, near-black ink (#000000cf), an indigo store action colour (#3643ba) for announcement bar and cart buttons, a yellow (#ffcd4e) "Shop" pill, and 12px-radius buttons, over full-bleed outdoor lifestyle photography.

decathlon-yestalgia.name: Decathlon Yestalgia
decathlon-yestalgia.description: Campaign microsite for the Decathlon Yestalgia retro-sportswear collection (since 1976): a #f4f4f4 canvas with #e9dae6 lilac and #eaa0cd pink sections, black Roboto Flex uppercase type at weight 535 up to 179.2px, and lime #d7dd44 buttons with 2px black borders and 10px radius.

decentraland.name: Decentraland
decentraland.description: Decentraland.org home page — a near-black (#161518) body under saturated purple bands (#570f88, #39055c), white Inter headlines at 60px/600, and uppercase Inter buttons in a hot pink-red (#ff2d55) with 16px corners, built on the MUI-based decentraland-ui2 theme with a 6px base radius.

deel.name: Deel
deel.description: Deel's homepage pairs Bagoss Condensed headlines (60px/500) and Inter body text on white, cream #fffbf4 and warm #f7f5f2 surfaces with a deep purple #201547 hero card, near-black #1b1b1b and #141414 bands, fully rounded 200px pill buttons in indigo #201148, black and white, and 16px-rounded product cards.

deestone-group.name: Deestone Group
deestone-group.description: Thai tyre maker Deestone's website (ดีสโตน): a white #ffffff page with #ebebeb panels and footer, dark #252525 text in the dokchamp Thai display face (19px navigation) and Sarabun 15px, an orange-red #f15a22 and orange #ff6700 brand accent, and 20px and 4px radii.

deezer.name: Deezer
deezer.description: Deezer (deezer.com): a near-black #0f0d13 page with an off-white #fdfcfe hero, Deezer purple #a238ff actions (12px-radius buttons, hover #9333e8) and #fdfcfe / #a9a6aa text. Headlines are the custom Deezer Brand face — 140px/800 uppercase hero, 56px/700 section titles — with Inter for UI and body (16px, 14px/500/25px). Purple sound-wave rings and a curved section edge carry the 2023 purple-heart identity.

default.name: Neutral Modern
default.description: A clean, product-oriented default. Use when the brief doesn't call for a

dell.name: Dell
dell.description: Dell's homepage is a dark-navy retail canvas (#0a0e14) with white Roboto text, Dell blue (#0672cb) buttons with a 2px radius, near-square 2px white cards with a faint shadow, and a #f0f0f0 footer. The public Dell Design System (DDS v3) documents the same Roboto/blue/slate language as --dds-* tokens.

deloitte.name: Deloitte Southeast Asia
deloitte.description: Deloitte Southeast Asia (deloitte.com/southeast-asia/en.html) measured at 1280px: a black header and hero over a white page, Open Sans in weights 300/400/600, a 40px light h1, #007cb0 blue action pills with 100px radius, 8px-radius white cards with a rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 0px 3px 6px 0px shadow, and full-width section label bars in green #26890d, blue #007cb0 and teal #0d8390.

delta.name: Delta Air Lines
delta.description: Delta Air Lines (delta.com): a navy-and-red airline booking site. Whitney Condensed 300 hero headlines at 48px/44px, Whitney 14px–18px UI text in #3e414f, #e01933 red 4px-radius Find Flights buttons 64px tall (hover #ad1834), a #001122 navy gradient header and footer, and white 8px-radius cards with #dfe0e6 borders.

demco.name: DEMCO
demco.description: Thai investor and corporate site of DEMCO Public Company Limited (power and infrastructure engineering), set entirely in Prompt (42px bold uppercase display with 2px tracking, 16px body), with gold #bb9f4b links, deep purple #5f2c6b panels and footer, near-black #1d1d1d ink on white and #f8f8f8 bands.

denmark-gov.name: Danish Government (Digitaliseringsstyrelsen)
denmark-gov.description: Digitaliseringsstyrelsen's site (digst.dk) is a warm, editorial public-sector design: a cream canvas (#f5f1e6), deep aubergine ink and primary (#3f1a2b), white cards, and a single light-weight humanist sans loaded as headings-font and body-font at 30px display and 16px body with wide letter-spacing. Controls are round, with a pill-radius search field (9999px), and burgundy panels carry white-on-dark link lists.

deno.name: Deno
deno.description: Deno uses bold Inter 700 headlines (70.4px, -1.76px) in #000000 on white with #56575a body text, a #70ffaf runtime-green announcement bar and pill CTAs, dark #25272b pills, a #66c2ff Moranga-serif Deploy button with a hard #0077cc offset shadow, 8px-radius code cards in Menlo and a #121417 footer.

department-of-medical-sciences.name: Department of Medical Sciences (DMSc)
department-of-medical-sciences.description: Thai Ministry of Public Health science department portal at dmsc.moph.go.th: Noto Sans Thai 14px body and 34-36px weight 600 headings, navy #01377d with green #209972 fills, square buttons with an 18px cut corner, 10.8px cards with a 30px 60px soft shadow.

depo-luxe.name: Depo Luxe
depo-luxe.description: Depo Luxe, a film production company for luxury brands: a pure black #000000 canvas with white #ffffff EB Garamond type (36px capitalized titles, 13px and 16px serif labels at slightly negative tracking), roman-numeral work index, 0px corners and video imagery as the only color.

deque.name: Deque
deque.description: Deque's marketing site sets Graphik at weight 500 with tight negative tracking on a warm cream canvas (#f6f3ed), with 9999px pill buttons in terracotta (#cc463b) and charcoal (#282a26), a #ffbc64 highlighter behind the key headline phrase, and pale blue (#c5dde9) bands. Its Cauldron library uses Roboto and 3px charcoal-blue buttons instead.

der-baukasten.name: Der Baukasten
der-baukasten.description: Der Baukasten, a 3D character concept site by tubik: a #000000 canvas with off-white #effcfc futura-pt type (500-weight wordmark at 255.701px with -20.4561px tracking), three saturated panels in blue #0581fe, red #f54d25 and yellow #efc11b, and 11.25px outlined download buttons.

der-spiegel.name: DER SPIEGEL
der-spiegel.description: DER SPIEGEL, Germany's news site: an orange-red #e64415 header on a warm grey #f1efed page with white #ffffff cards, black #000000 headlines in SpiegelSlabCdUI 800 at 36px, SpiegelSansUI 16px body, 1.5px corners and a 44px orange register button.

descript.name: Descript
descript.description: Descript, the text-based AI video and audio editor: deep maroon #390a1a page with a #fff7fa blush canvas, coral-red #f73b3b primary buttons at 12px radius, gamuthDisplay serif headlines at 88px over booton sans body at 18px/25.2px, near-black #190308 testimonial cards and a #110a0d footer.

detroit-paris.name: Detroit (Detroit Paris)
detroit-paris.description: AI production house in Paris for luxury brands: a stark black-on-white page with a 184px Mangogrotesque 700 uppercase headline, tiny 9.6px uppercase Barlow chrome, square-edged campaign imagery, hairline #0b0b0b1a borders and a difference-blended fixed nav. Built in Webflow.

deutsche-bahn.name: Deutsche Bahn
deutsche-bahn.description: Deutsche Bahn international booking site (int.bahn.de/en): DB red #ec0016 buttons with 4px corners on white and #f0f3f5 grey bands, slate #282d37 text, DBScreenHead 900 headings (32px/40px desktop) over DBScreenSans 400/700 at 16px, one 8px-blur nav shadow, built on the DB UX Design System's --db-* variables.

deutsche-bank.name: Deutsche Bank
deutsche-bank.description: Deutsche Bank's group home page (db.com): white canvas with black text, navy #1e2a78 and #16184e accents, a bright blue #0550d1 for buttons and links, a #e7f4fe light-blue band, 2px-radius buttons and soft 24px-blur card shadows, set entirely in the proprietary Deutsche Bank Text face at weight 400.

deutsche-bank-thailand.name: Deutsche Bank
deutsche-bank-thailand.description: Deutsche Bank Thailand country page on country.db.com: white canvas, black ink, action blue #0550d1 on outlined 2px-radius buttons and expand icons, deep navy #1e2a78 info cards and links, #16184e headline, the Deutsche Bank Text typeface at 16px body and 44px display.

dexcom.name: Dexcom
dexcom.description: Dexcom US home page (dexcom.com): Gilroy 700 headlines with negative tracking (52px/56px hero), fully pill-shaped 56px green #137d00 buttons with white 16px/700 labels, #161a1d ink on white and #f5f5f5 bands, a plum #412636 Stelo section, and a Chakra UI theme underneath.

dga.name: Digital Government Development Agency (DGA)
dga.description: DGA's English home page (dga.or.th/en): Prompt typeface at weights 400 to 700, orange #da3c0c headings and links with 100px-radius outlined pill buttons, grey #707070 paragraphs on white, a deep navy #1e154c footer, soft 8px-blur header shadow, built in WordPress with Elementor.

dhipaya.name: Dhipaya Insurance (ทิพยประกันภัย)
dhipaya.description: Dhipaya Insurance's English home page (dhipaya.co.th/en): a saturated blue #21479a and navy #063291 page with white text, Superspace display type at 36px, Tahoma body, square-cornered 48px buttons with a white 2px border (red #e41a23 or periwinkle #7b9ce4), pill 50px inputs and flat, shadow-free Bootstrap-based layout.

dhk-architects.name: dhk Architects
dhk-architects.description: dhk architects' home page (dhk.co.za): an all-black, white-type studio site in Helveticanowdisplay at weights 400 to 700, with 60.544px section headings, 16px/22.4px body, bracketed text buttons, a dark/light switch, square-edged architectural photography and no shadows, borders or filled buttons.

dhl.name: DHL
dhl.description: DHL's US homepage on dhl.com: a white #ffffff canvas with black #000000 text set entirely in the corporate typeface Delivery (800 for 36px/46.8px headlines, 300 for 28px and 20px intros, 400 for 16px/20.8px body), a 63px Postyellow #ffcc00 top bar with the red logo, and DHL Red #d40511 buttons with 12px corners (Track: 52px tall, 7px 15.4px padding; CTAs: 14px 32px) that darken to #9a0000 / #95040c on hover. Cards are white with a 0 1px 4px shadow, grey #f5f5f5 panels, 7px spacing steps.

dichtm-fashion.name: DICH™ Fashion
dichtm-fashion.description: DICH Fashion concept site (dich-fashion.webflow.io): a black #070707 intro with a pink-violet-peach gradient ring, then a peach #ffdfc4 page, ultra-large uppercase T 012 display type (253.293px), tiny 10.0928px Nbarchitektstd terminal-style labels, hairline grid lines, no shadows and no filled buttons.

didi.name: DiDi Global
didi.description: DiDi Global's official home page (didiglobal.com): light #f8f8f8 and white screens with grey #666666 text, DiDi orange #ff7f41 for links and a circular outlined 'Learn More' button, Aspira Regular type with generous tracking (47px/54px at 2.6px), a circular hero image mask, flat and shadow-free.

digilab.name: Digilab
