digilab.description: Digilab (digilab.co), a New Zealand bioacoustics AI company: cream #f2eee5 canvas, dark purple #160e20 headlines in denimInk 500 at 75.5555px with -2.27px tracking, lilac #cda6ff pill buttons (26.67px radius) with 10.67px uppercase groteskMono labels, flat with ghosted tree illustrations.

digital-agency-jp.name: デジタル庁 (Digital Agency, Japan)
digital-agency-jp.description: The Digital Agency of Japan home page (digital.go.jp) is a plain government news portal: Noto Sans JP at 28px/700 headings and 17px body, #333333 text on white, a single deep-blue #00118f used for underlined links, black 1px outlines on 16px and 24px rounded cards, and a translucent white #ffffffe0 header.

digital-design-days-x.name: Digital Design Days Palermo (DDDx)
digital-design-days-x.description: Digital Design Days Palermo (palermo.ddd.live), the Sicily edition of DDD: a magenta-to-purple gradient hero with 111.224px neue-haas-grotesk-display 600 uppercase titles at -1.67px tracking, midnight-purple #201a39 ink, 13.7143px DM Mono uppercase labels, 100px pill buttons and 10px frosted cards.

digital-economy-promotion-agency.name: depa (Digital Economy Promotion Agency)
digital-economy-promotion-agency.description: depa Thailand's English home page (depa.or.th/en/home): a bright yellow #fff200 and white portal with sukhumwit type in very light weights (100 to 200) at 16px, navy #173b6b section titles, slate #586667 text, a #333333 footer, 4px-radius yellow buttons, 45px-radius tiles and soft 18px-blur card shadows.

digital-gov.name: U.S. Web Design System
digital-gov.description: USWDS, the U.S. Web Design System, gives federal sites a plain, accessible look: Source Sans Pro Web type (16px body, 700 buttons), federal blue #005ea2 with hover #1a4480, near-black ink #1b1b1b, slate #3d4551 and #565c65 bands, and 4px-radius rectangular buttons; GSA.gov is the live implementation measured here.

digitalists-1.name: digitalists
digitalists-1.description: digitalists is a Vienna and Eisenstadt WordPress agency whose German site pairs a saturated lemon-yellow canvas (#f1e500) with pure black type, PP Neue Montreal 400/700, PP Fraktion Mono uppercase labels, 7px-radius black and yellow buttons and flat, shadow-free color fields.

digitalocean.name: DigitalOcean
digitalocean.description: DigitalOcean's AI-Native Cloud site is dark: #000000 canvas with #000f0f cards (16px radius, #f4f5f51a hairline), Plus Jakarta Sans 800 headlines (48px, -1.5px), Inter 16px/24px body in #e5eceb, #6fe0ed aqua pill buttons (999px radius, 40px tall) hovering to #1aafbf and a #104b55 teal announcement bar.

dime-mtl.name: Dime MTL
dime-mtl.description: Dime MTL is a Shopify apparel and skate storefront: white #ffffff canvas, black #000000 ink, Instrument Serif 80px titles in white over full-bleed photography, Habitus weight 300 at 12px and 10px with negative tracking, 0px-radius square geometry and no chromatic accent.

disaya.name: DISAYA
disaya.description: DISAYA is a Bangkok fashion label whose Shopify storefront (Shella theme) uses a white #ffffff canvas, black #000000 ink, a single Questrial face, a blush #f9dcd6 and deep-teal #224d51 pair for 30px-radius pill buttons, flat shadow-free surfaces and full-bleed editorial photography.

discord.name: Discord
discord.description: Discord's home page puts white text on a deep indigo (#1a2081) illustrated night sky, with Blurple #5865f2 and white 12px-radius 56px buttons, ABC Ginto Discord Nord uppercase headlines at 44px/700, ABC Ginto Discord body copy, and big 88px-radius translucent feature panels.

disney.name: Disney Thailand
disney.description: Disney Thailand (disney.co.th), a Thai-language poster-wall storefront: neutral #f8f9fa canvas with white, #f1f2f3 and #054553 teal bands, Noto Sans Thai type at 16px/28px body and 30px section headings, and one cyan #02d6e8 pill button (24px radius, 48px tall) with black label.

dithered.name: Dithered
dithered.description: Dot-pattern rendering technique that simulates shades with a limited palette for nostalgic, retro, high-contrast visuals.

dji.name: DJI
dji.description: DJI's Thailand English storefront pairs a white #ffffff canvas and #ededed product tiles with a #272727 footer, DJI blue #0070d5 pill buttons, Open Sans at 32px/16px with negative tracking, 64px capsule outlines and studio product photography.

docker.name: Docker
docker.description: Docker's site pairs ABC Repro 64px/500 headlines (-1.92px) with Inter 16px/22.4px body in #2c333f on a #f9fafb canvas, #2560ff blue buttons (8px radius hero, 4px header) with #003db5 borders, 18px-radius product cards, a #00084d announcement bar, #0e1217 dark hero and terminal panels in ui-monospace.

documenso.name: Documenso
documenso.description: Documenso.com home: white #ffffff canvas, Inter 44px/600 headlines (-0.88px) in #171717 over #4d4d4d body text, lime #a2e771 6px-radius buttons with dark-green #1f3d0a labels (hover #6bbd36), deep forest #101f05 bands with mint #c9f1ac headings, PT Mono code panels, #fbfbfb 18px-radius feature cards and a near-black #0f0f0f footer.

docusign.name: Docusign
docusign.description: Docusign's home page pairs a deep violet hero gradient with white and sand content bands, set entirely in the proprietary DSIndigo typeface: an 80px/300 display headline, 24px/36px lead copy in #130032, uppercase 14px/600 'TRY FOR FREE' buttons in electric violet #4c00ff (hover #4000cc) with 8px radius, and lavender #ede5ff product cards.

dogstudio.name: Dogstudio
dogstudio.description: Dogstudio (Dogstudio / DEPT.) is a dark, cinematic studio site: near-black #131419 canvas, white #ffffff and periwinkle-tinted translucent greys (#a0a8dcb3, #bbc2e54d) for text, thin red #e43333 accent lines, GT Sectra Display Bold at 120px/700 for the hero, Heebo 200–400 for lists and body (80px project names, 14px/24px copy) and Gilroy 9px tracked uppercase labels.

dohome.name: DoHome
dohome.description: DoHome is a Thai home-improvement retailer whose Tailwind v4 storefront uses Prompt, a #f26529 orange primary with a #f15a24 promo panel, #343a40 ink on #f8f9fa and white surfaces, 10px-radius cards and add-to-cart buttons, and one soft 0 4px 12px shadow.

doi-chaang.name: Doi Chaang Coffee Co.
doi-chaang.description: Doi Chaang Coffee Co. (Thai Mountain Coffee) is a WordPress storefront in navy #14324e, burnt orange #df5929, yellow #f6ce3d and cyan #00a7e1, with Metropolis body at 21px, a Vestige Harmony serif display at 38px, square 2px-ring outline buttons and a triangle pattern motif.

dolsten-co.name: Dolsten & Co.
dolsten-co.description: Dolsten & Co. is an AI-first creative studio whose site uses a lavender #e3deea canvas, warm near-black #27231f ink, white 32px-tall square buttons, all-caps PP Neue Montreal headings and IBM Plex Mono 500 text, hairlines with plus-sign crosshairs and no shadows.

dominos.name: Domino's Pizza Thailand
dominos.description: Domino's Pizza Thailand (queued dominos.com resolves to dominospizza.co.th) is a Thai-language ordering site in DB Heavent at 24px and 30px, white and #f4f4f4 surfaces, #898989 secondary text, #006491 blue controls, 12px tiles and a #53565a footer with a 5px #9d2235 border.

don-molinico.name: Don Molinico
don-molinico.description: Don Molinico is a Navarra piquillo-pepper brand whose site uses a cream #fbf5e7 canvas, signal red #d70321 type, gold #cba058 button labels, one uppercase condensed face (super-med) with 192px and 166.4px headlines, 64px square buttons and no shadows.

don-mueang-international-airport.name: Don Mueang International Airport
don-mueang-international-airport.description: The Don Mueang International Airport (DMK) site in the Airports of Thailand network uses Kanit throughout, a #03a9f4 airport bar, #00aff4 sky-blue accents, #4b4b4b ink on white and #f1f1f1 bands, 7px-8px cards with soft grey shadows and a pill-shaped flight search.

dont-board-me.name: Don't Board Me
dont-board-me.description: Don't Board Me is a San Diego pet-sitting site with a candy-pink #f4ced3 canvas, signal-red #e33529 type in uppercase Bayon at 165px to 260px, #693413 brown ink, a #2b6786 blue counterpoint, Neue Montreal labels, square red buttons and round overlapping discs.

doodle.name: Doodle
doodle.description: Hand-drawn, sketch-like style with doodles, handwritten fonts, and imperfect lines for a playful, informal feel.

dot-property.name: Dot Property
dot-property.description: Dot Property (dotproperty.co.th), a Thai-language property portal for buying, renting and listing homes, condos and land. Noto Sans Thai at weights 200 to 500, white and #f3f4f6 surfaces, near-black ink, #2a6b2a green accent text, a declared #4FB84F brand variable, pill-shaped search bar and 8px-radius cards over photography.

double-play.name: Double Play
double-play.description: Double Play GmbH is a German web and brand studio whose Webflow site uses one chroma, ultramarine #002bba, on an off-white #fbfbfb canvas, Perfectly Nineties serif at 120px and 64px, Neue Montreal at 32px, tennis-themed copy, full-width blue bands, square corners and no shadows.

dove.name: Dove
dove.description: Dove (dove.com, US English home page): a navy-and-white personal-care storefront. Navy #001f5f buttons with square 0px corners and white SHOP NOW labels, #3b3b3b body copy in Sofia Pro Regular, a Helvetica 40px light h1, a Century Old Style Italic 64px accent word, and #f6f6f6 grey bands between full-bleed navy promo blocks.

dragonfly-redux.name: Dragonfly Redux
dragonfly-redux.description: Dragonfly Redux (dragonfly2.studiofreight.dev): an all-black #000000 crypto-fund site with a huge orange #fa4c14 DRAGONFLY wordmark, #7d7d7d grey body copy in FK Roman Standard 300, uppercase NON Natural Grotesk section titles at 16px, NON Natural Mono 10px labels, and #f2f2f21a hairline rules on an 8-column grid.

dramatic.name: Dramatic
dramatic.description: High-contrast, theatrical design with bold layouts, immersive visuals, and unconventional compositions that command attention.

drawbotics.name: Drawbotics
drawbotics.description: Marketing site of Drawbotics, a Brussels-linked real-estate sales and marketing software company. Rubik at regular weight throughout (60px display, 16px body), a single cyan action color #3db5d0 that deepens to #247488 on hover, deep navy headings #0a083b, slate body copy #57586e, and small 4-5px radii on rectangular buttons over a near-white canvas with pale blue-grey section bands.

dribbble.name: Dribbble
dribbble.description: Dribbble's live design language — a white (#ffffff) gallery canvas with near-black indigo ink #0d0c22, pill-shaped (9999px) ink buttons that lift to #3d3d4e on hover, and the signature Dribbble pink #ea4c89 reserved for search, Pro upsells and badges. Every word is set in GitHub's open-source Mona Sans (hero 52px/600, UI 14px/500), shots sit in a three-column grid of 12px-radius thumbnails, and the component layer is Shoelace web components re-themed with --sl-color-primary set to pink.

drizzle.name: Drizzle ORM
drizzle.description: Drizzle ORM (orm.drizzle.team) is a white #ffffff, system-font page: #444444 12–14px text, a 40px/700 hero with a handwritten ship-ship-ship joke, square #f6f6f7 tile buttons hovering to #eff0f3, a navy #282b3b 4px-radius action button (16px 32px, 48px tall), 8px-radius cards with #e8e8e8 hairlines and hand-drawn raindrop mascots.

droga5.name: Droga5
droga5.description: Droga5 (droga5.com, Part of Accenture Song): a white agency home page with a 100px DroteskNo5-Bold black headline at -3px tracking, 35px DroteskNo5-Regular statements, a black rectangular 'See what we do' button, short #0000d5 blue rules above section labels, square corners, and cool-grey #949799 secondary text.

dropbox.name: Dropbox
dropbox.description: Dropbox (www.dropbox.com): warm off-white #f7f5f2 and white pages with graphite #1e1919 headings, a #0061fe blue call to action with 16px rounded corners, Sharp Grotesk 500 at 40px for the h1, Atlas Grotesk Web for body at 16px/24px, and a full-width graphite band for the AI-integrations section.

dropbox-brand.name: Dropbox Brand Guidelines
dropbox-brand.description: Dropbox Brand Guidelines (brand.dropbox.com): a white page with a #0061fe blue 36px bold headline in the Dbsharpgroteskvariable Vf variable face, #736c64 body copy in Atlas Grotesk Web 14px/22px, and a stack of full-bleed colour tiles (yellow #fad24b, cyan #3dd3ee, tangerine #ff8c19, navy #283750, lilac #c8aff0) with 8px corners that turn #1a1918 on hover.

drunk-elephant.name: Drunk Elephant
drunk-elephant.description: Drunk Elephant's Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront pairs a white #ffffff canvas and warm charcoal #45474a ink with BrownRegular display type at 66px/400 and -1.98px tracking (often lowercase), BrownBold 12px/700 uppercase buttons with 0.6px tracking in square 1px charcoal outlines (11px 40px, 38px tall), SentinelMedium serif product titles, #fafafa product tiles with 5px corners, and pop accent fills — electric lime #e6fe52, lavender #f6dcff and aqua #bffcf3.

dtac.name: dtac
dtac.description: dtac (www.dtac.co.th/en, 'dtac True Better Together'): a light Thai telecom storefront on white #ffffff and grey #f5f5f5 with dtacEvolution headings at 40px weight 500, Kanit Light body, #007ad0 blue text links that turn #e00000 on hover, 16px-rounded promo banners, and outlined 10px cards with #d6d6d6 borders.

dub.name: Dub
dub.description: Dub.co home: white #ffffff / #fafafa neutral canvas, #171717 ink with a #737373 grey scale, Satoshi 48px/500 headlines over Inter 14-16px UI text and GeistMono numerals, black #000000 8px-radius buttons (hover #262626), #e5e5e5 hairline borders and small purple/green/orange product accents.

ducati.name: Ducati
ducati.description: Ducati's Thailand-market home page (ducati.com/th/th, English content): off-white #fafafa canvas, #0f0f0f ink and footer, Ducati red #cc0000/#cb1517 for actions and links, and three custom families — ducati-extended 48px/700 headlines, ducati-condensed 14px uppercase links tracked 1px, ducati 12px/18px body — with 2px corners.

duet.name: Duet Design System
duet.description: Duet is the design system of Finnish insurers LocalTapiola and Turva: the localtapiola-sans typeface at 800 weight (58px display, 24px lead text), a #0077b3 blue header and primary action, #082a4d navy ink on white #ffffff with #f5f8fa panels, 4px component radii, pill (320px) controls and soft #00294d-tinted shadows.

dulcedo.name: Dulcedo
dulcedo.description: Dulcedo (dulcedo.com), a Montreal talent agency: near-black #0a0a0a pages with champagne-gold #c5ae79 text, light #f4f4f4 sections with black type, Helvetica Now Display in uppercase weight 800 at 100px with -3px tracking, Saol Display serif for the wordmark, black pill buttons 34px high and 2px-cornered cards.

duolingo.name: Duolingo
duolingo.description: Duolingo's web identity as measured on duolingo.com — a white Snow canvas, Feather Green #58cc02 3D "lip" buttons (12px radius, 50px tall, 4px Tree Frog #58a700 bottom shadow), Macaw blue #1cb0f6 secondary actions, Wolf #777777 body copy set in the served duolingo-sans family at 17px/500, and the bespoke Feather Bold display face (served as `feather`) at 48–64px in lowercase green. Flat surfaces, 2px Swan #e5e5e5 borders, 16px card radii and a full-bleed green footer.

duroc-1.name: Duroc
duroc-1.description: Duroc (duroc.ma), Moroccan cherry-tomato grower: a saturated tomato-red #d23b37 site with white Okomito type in weight 900 uppercase (42px intro, 80px page titles), #d64119 orange-red CONTINUER and CTA buttons, darker #ae2521 pill chips with 26px radius, and a blue #2d78b2 impact section.

dusit-international-corporate.name: Dusit International
dusit-international-corporate.description: Dusit International corporate site (Dusit Thani Public Company Limited) - a calm blue-grey palette (#32323f ink, #5f7380 link blue, #eff1f2 page ground) with gold accents in the root variables, set in the proprietary Dusit Display serif and Dusit Text sans at 51px and 14px.

dusit-shop.name: Dusit Hotels & Resorts
dusit-shop.description: Dusit Hotels & Resorts (dusit.com), measured because dusitshop.com redirects to it: a white luxury-hospitality site with a light serif display face at 48px, a bronze #bc8547 Check rates button with square corners, #31313f navy panels, and photography-led hero and offer cards.

dutch-gov-rijkshuisstijl.name: Rijksoverheid
dutch-gov-rijkshuisstijl.description: The Dutch national government portal rijksoverheid.nl sets RijksSans (600 headings, 400 body at 17.2739px) in #0f172a ink on white, with #007bc7 sky-blue links, a #154273 logo-blue header and card blocks, #f1f5f9 tint panels and #01689b dark-blue outlined buttons 56px high.

dutch-mill.name: Dutch Mill
dutch-mill.description: Dutch Mill (ดัชมิลล์) Thai dairy site: a black top bar over a sky-blue hero with milk-splash photography, Prompt typeface at 15px, blues #076aad and #0fa1f2, an orange (#f17b1f) pill outline, and generous 14 to 60px rounding.

dwr.name: Design Within Reach
dwr.description: Design Within Reach (DWR) sells modern furniture on a pale grey #f8f8f8 canvas with warm-black #242222 ink, a single in-house family served as "DWR Sans" at only two weights (400 and 700 — 34px/700 page titles, 15px/24px body), fully rounded pill buttons (36–53px radii: a #242222 Add to Cart pill, white and outlined 39px pills), seasonal colour bands such as burgundy #643335 and sand #d1ccbd, a #242222 footer, and #ce2a22 reserved for sale.

dyson.name: Dyson
dyson.description: Dyson's US storefront (Adobe Experience Manager) is a monochrome engineering catalogue: one proprietary face, DysonFutura (Light 300 / Book 400 / Medium 500), set light at 32px/40px for section headings and 14px/20px for #555555 body copy, on a #ffffff canvas with a #000000 header, #fbfbfb product stages, #ebebeb hairlines and 4px-radius cards. Action colour is a transactional green #79b928 with black text (66px tall, 4px radius, darkening to #65a01b through a circular ripple), backed by a #ececec 'linking' button and a #333333 'interactive' button.

eastern-power.name: Eastern Polymer Group (EPG)
eastern-power.description: Eastern Polymer Group (EPG) Thai homepage (epg.co.th/th/home/): Noto Sans Thai at 14px body and 600-weight headings, royal blue #1e51a4 on white with #f8f8f8 menu bars, orange #f29400 accents, 5px and 18px radii and soft 0 0 10px shadows on news cards.

easy-tomorrow-brand-website.name: EASY TOMORROW
easy-tomorrow-brand-website.description: EASY TOMORROW (easytomorrow.com/en), a Samyang hangover-relief brand: a white page of bento cards with 33.73px to 66px rounded corners on #f5f5f5, Pretendard type at 34px weight 600 with -0.68px tracking, cyan #00a5e7 title accents, a navy #21439c About tile, 70%-black #000000b3 body text and round white arrow buttons.

easypost.name: EasyPost
easypost.description: EasyPost (easypost.com), the shipping API company, presents a white-canvas marketing site set entirely in Poppins (700 hero at 48px, 600 display at 56px, 500 section titles at 38px), deep navy text (#061340) with slate body copy (#47547f), mint filled CTAs (#99f5df with navy labels, 8px radius, 15px 20px padding) beside electric-blue (#4671fe) outlined buttons, and 12px-radius white cards with a 1px #e2e7f0 border — values that track its open-source Easy UI token palette.

ebay.name: eBay
ebay.description: eBay's homepage runs on the Evo design system: Market Sans (Regular 400, Bold 700) on a white #ffffff page with #191919 ink, an accent blue #0968f6 Search button with a 44px radius, near-black #191919 pill 'Shop now' buttons, 16px-radius image tiles and a #f7f7f7 footer band.

ecobee.name: ecobee
ecobee.description: ecobee (www.ecobee.com/en-us): a white smart-home store with Tiempos serif headlines (66px/80px weight 500), Bastion sans body, white 39px-rounded pill buttons outlined in warm charcoal #2d2926 that fill #2d2926 on hover, mint #deede8 bands, #1169c8 inline links, and full-bleed teal and navy product photography.

eddie.name: Eddie
eddie.description: Eddie (eddie.eco), a Québec EV-charging assistant: warm #f7f4f2 pages with black Founders Grotesk type (107.462px display, 61.3889px bold headings), lavender #d8d1ff cards with 40px corners, black 25px-rounded pill buttons 60px high that turn #b7b2ff on hover, a lime #d2e534 promo card and soft lavender shadows.

editorial.name: Editorial
editorial.description: Magazine-inspired editorial layout with refined serif typography, structured grids, and elegant reading experiences.

edoardo-lunardi.name: Edoardo Lunardi
edoardo-lunardi.description: Portfolio of Edoardo Lunardi, a Creative Web Engineer, built as a desktop-OS interface: #232323 ground, white Inter 13.4776px text, Ubuntu Mono window titles, 2px radius windows with 1px #ffffff4c rings and a dithered wallpaper.

edolus.name: EDOLUS
edolus.description: EDOLUS, an AI company site: black canvas, #c4c7c7 ink, General Sans 300 at 96px uppercase for the headline, JetBrains Mono for technical text, a square white #ffffff 'INITIATE SYSTEM' button with black 12px mono text, 0px radius everywhere, over WebGL 3D artwork with a gold light ribbon.

eduard-bodak-portfolio.name: Eduard Bodak — Portfolio
eduard-bodak-portfolio.description: Portfolio of Eduard Bodak, designer and developer from Cologne: beige #f9f4ec and black grounds, one hot-pink #ff47e7 accent, a heavy compressed sans at 84.8095px with -6.78476px tracking, 20px-radius cards.

edx.name: edX
edx.description: edX's learning-marketplace language — deep "elm" teal-black #00262b for headings, dark bands and the footer, a single burnt-orange action color #d64000 on 94px pill buttons, warm "putty" neutrals (#f9f8f6, #edebe3, #e7e3da, #e1ddd1) for section bands, and Inter everywhere with heavy 900-weight italic display headlines at 72px and 56px. Course cards are white 12px-radius tiles with a #cccccc hairline; body copy runs #333333 at 16–18px. Learner apps are built on Open edX's Paragon design system (--pgn-* CSS variables).

effortel.name: Effortel
effortel.description: Effortel, an MVNE telecom platform: dark slate #22282a ground, cyan #66e8fa buttons with #22282a text, Satoshi Variable 800 at 58.368px for headlines, Et Mono uppercase buttons, 9.19px button radius.

eflowsys.name: Eflowsys
eflowsys.description: Eflowsys, Thai ERP and e-Tax software vendor: white canvas, blue #046bd2 buttons with 5px radius, Sarabun 16px body, Arial 700 48px hero headline, 20px-radius translucent cards over photography.

egco.name: EGCO Group
egco.description: EGCO Group, a Thai power producer: white canvas, ink #313131, orange #f58220 headings and green #409a3c accents, Prompt 300/500 type, 8px-radius white buttons with #bebebe border and soft card shadows.

el-pais.name: EL PAÍS
el-pais.description: EL PAÍS, Spanish daily newspaper: white canvas, #111111 ink, MajritTx serif headlines at 30px with -1.15px tracking, MajritTxRoman 15px body, 11px uppercase MarcinAntB navigation, one yellow #f7cf3c subscribe accent.

elastic.name: Elastic
elastic.description: Elastic's site sets display headlines in Geist Mono (64px, weight 500, -1.28px tracking) over Inter body text at 16px, on a white canvas with a single action blue (#0b64dd), 4px-radius buttons, a near-black #1c1e23 footer, and an isometric product illustration. Its EUI framework uses the same blue with 8px controls.

electra-filmworks.name: Electra Filmworks
electra-filmworks.description: Electra Filmworks, a film and commercial production company: full-bleed film still over a #15110f base, white PP Pangram Sans 16px credits, Monument Extended 12px uppercase navigation, one orange #f16920 spark accent.

electrify-america.name: Electrify America
electrify-america.description: Electrify America, a US EV fast-charging network: white and #f5f5f5 bands, navy #0b0f4d header, royal navy #122771 accent, Ubuntu 800 italic 44.8px headlines, 16px/300 body, 4px-radius buttons and 8px photo cards.

electronic-arts.name: Electronic Arts
electronic-arts.description: Electronic Arts official site (ea.com): deep navy #00071f canvas with off-white #eaeaec text, electric blue #255af6 8px-radius CTAs (hover #1e4aca), slate #2b3044 game cards with #404557 borders and 12px corners, #151c32 footer. electronicartsdisplay 700 at 44px for headlines, electronicartstext 14–20px for everything else, no letter-spacing.

electronics-extreme.name: Electronics Extreme
electronics-extreme.description: Electronics Extreme, a Thai online-gaming company: charcoal #252525 bars, orange #f79533 accents and outlined Readmore buttons, white Kanit text at 16px to 20px, 10px-radius selector, warm hero photography.

elegant.name: Elegant
elegant.description: Graceful, refined aesthetic with delicate typography, minimal palettes, and polished layouts that exude sophistication.

element-plus.name: Element Plus
element-plus.description: Element Plus is the Vue 3 component library whose docs site pairs Inter (with a Helvetica Neue / PingFang SC fallback stack) on a white #ffffff canvas, a bright #409eff primary, grey text ramps #303133 and #606266, 1px #dcdfe6 hairlines, and a 4px default radius (20px for round buttons).

elementary.name: elementary OS
elementary.description: The elementary OS website: Inter in 48px bold and 32px light headings, charcoal ink (#333333) on white and #fafafa, a light-blue (#64b9f1) gradient purchase button with 3px corners and a faint inset highlight, link blue #0088cc, and a saturated grape-purple band (#7239b3) for the AppCenter section, with desktop screenshots as the main imagery.

elevance-health.name: Elevance Health
elevance-health.description: Elevance Health, a US health company: white canvas, #231e33 ink, navy #1a3673 bands, blue #2861bb links and 24px-radius pill buttons, ElevanceSans regular 42px headings with Lato navigation.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.description: ElevenLabs' marketing site is a warm-neutral, near-monochrome canvas (#fdfcfc page, #f5f3f1 panels, pure #000000 ink and CTAs) that sets light 300-weight Waldenburg display type over Inter UI text, with pill buttons and large 24px panel radii.

eli-lilly.name: Eli Lilly and Company
eli-lilly.description: Lilly.com home page: black-and-white film hero with a 100px Ringside Sans Extra Wide 900 headline, a condensed Garamond Narrow serif for statements, blush #f9eeed sections, ink #191919 text and Lilly red #d31710 pill buttons at 32px radius.

elisa.name: Elisa
elisa.description: Elisa (Finnish telecom) consumer web design as built on the Elisa Design System (EDS): Jost headings and buttons with Open Sans body copy, a #005fed action blue and #00239d brand blue on a #fdfdfd canvas, #171c43 navy ink, 4px-radius uppercase buttons, 8px photo cards with a soft 4px 13px shadow, and saturated blue hero fields with arc-cut photography.

elliott-mangham.name: Elliott Mangham
elliott-mangham.description: Single-screen dark portfolio of freelance WordPress developer Elliott Mangham: #121212 canvas, white text at 100, 80 and 40 percent, Neue Montreal 30px/36px weight 500 with Roobert Mono 11px detail, 30px-radius capsule toggle and 6px-radius thumbnails.

elva.name: Elva
elva.description: Elva (elvalabs.ai), an AI video agent for phones: #131313 canvas, white and #b3b3b3 text, Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro at 108px display and 42px headings, frosted #ffffff0d buttons with 16px radius and 48px height.

emberjs.name: Ember.js
emberjs.description: Ember.js (emberjs.com) is built from the official ember-styleguide: brand orange #E04E39 (PMS 7417C) buttons with 5px radius that hover to #cf2d20, a #1c1e24 charcoal hero and header, cool grey #f4f6f8 / #ebeef2 page bands, #42474f body text, and Inter var throughout — a weight-200 48px hero headline over 16px/27px body copy.

emdistrict.name: The EM District
emdistrict.description: The EM District, The Mall Group's Bangkok district site: pure black #000000 canvas, white #ffffff ink, Prompt 700 headings at 53.3333px, Helvetica Neue LT Std 14px body, translucent white #ffffffcc pill buttons and hashtag chips, with saturated fashion and street photography doing all the colour.

emele-collab.name: Emele Collab
emele-collab.description: Emele Collab (emelecollab.com), a creative studio home page that is a typographic index: names in a heavy condensed uppercase face at 92.8px over 74.24px line-height, black #000000 on white #ffffff, with 15px edge navigation and no shapes.

emilie-aubry.name: Emilie Aubry
emilie-aubry.description: Emilie Aubry (emilieaubry.com), a minimal personal site whose entry screen is a white title card with a light Riccione-Serial name lockup and italic Emi, PP Neue Montreal 500 uppercase micro-labels, black ink #000000 and 29.97px capsule link chips.

emirates.name: Emirates
emirates.description: Emirates' booking site is a light-grey (#f6f6f6) canvas of white 3px-radius cards under a charcoal #333333 nav bar, with full-bleed cabin and destination photography carrying white display type in the condensed Heroic-Medium (120px, -5px tracking, uppercase) and the proprietary Emirates-Bold serif-like display face. UI copy runs in HelveticaNeue / HelveticaNeue-Light at 200-700 weights, and the only saturated colour is Emirates red #d71921 on the filled CTA, active-tab underline and text links.

emirates-nbd.name: Emirates NBD
emirates-nbd.description: Emirates NBD English home page: deep navy #072447 buttons with 10.8px radius, white and pale blue-grey #eef2f8 grounds, UAEDirham with Plus Jakarta Sans at 37.8px headlines and 12.6px body, dense banking modules with a loan calculator and FX strip.

emotion.name: Emotion
emotion.description: Emotion's docs site (emotion.sh) is a Bootstrap-style white page with #212529 text in a system-ui stack, a pink brand (#d26ac2 wordmark, #c43bad links), #282936 dark code blocks in SFMono and hotpink #ff69b4 live-preview panels.

emporium.name: Emporium
emporium.description: Design language of the Emporium Bangkok luxury shopping complex site: a white page with black Cormorant serif display capitals at 88.8889px, light-weight GTWalsheimPro text in warm grey #8c8c8c, a muted gold #b5a06b theme accent, black bands, and frosted white pill controls at 42px height with fully rounded corners.

emquartier.name: The EmQuartier
emquartier.description: The EmQuartier (emquartier.co.th), a Bangkok fashion and lifestyle destination: black, white and silver #8e8f97 with editorial photography, termina wide uppercase at 80px/76px plus DB Adman X Thai body at 24px/28px, and 50px-radius outlined pill buttons.

emsphere.name: EmSphere
emsphere.description: EmSphere, the Bangkok shopping centre from The Mall Group, on a light #f5f5f5 canvas with black #000000 ink, a white #ffffff button that carries a pink-and-violet glow shadow, Helvetica Neue LT Std at weight 300 for body and nav, aktiv-grotesk-extended 700 at 84px for section headings, and 20px, 24px and 40px corner radii over full-bleed photography.

enel.name: Enel Group
enel.description: Enel Group corporate home page: white canvas, ink #0e141a text, Roobert bold 58px/68px headlines and 22px body, magenta #d3135a links, ocean #0047cc secondary, snow #eff2f7 sections and square-cornered components with round carousel arrows.

enel-x.name: Enel X
enel-x.description: Design language of the Enel X Italia web presence as captured in October 2026: the Roobert ENEL typeface at weights 300 to 900 (70px/900 display headline, 20px body), a deep purple #461e7d hero wash over night photography, a #3a16ff electric-blue action color declared as the site's --primary, and near-white #f7f7f7 and #fbfbfb chrome with hairline 1px shadows. Radii are small (4px to 16px) with a 50px pill.

enerblock.name: Enerblock
enerblock.description: Enerblock (enerblock.net), industrialized digital construction: signal orange #ff5949 ground, paper #f0efeb and ink #0c0b11 planes divided by hairline grid rules, Neue Corp at 72px/64.8px display and 16px/20px body, square black buttons with arrows.

energetic.name: Energetic
energetic.description: Dynamic, vibrant style with thick borders, geometric shapes, high-contrast colors, and expressive typography conveying motion and vitality.

engie.name: ENGIE
engie.description: ENGIE's web identity is built on Lato in bold at very large sizes (72px display, 48px statements), white canvas #ffffff with near-black ink #171d21, an action blue near #007acd with a 0px-radius outlined button, deep ultramarine #182663 footers, full-bleed industrial photography in the hero, and the brand's #00aaff to #23d2b5 gradient ray, all documented by ENGIE's own Fluid design system.

enphase.name: Enphase
enphase.description: Enphase Energy's web system: warm off-white #faf6ef pages with white #ffffff panels and black #000000 header and media bands, Enphase orange #ea6100 (hover #ff8b49) reserved for the 'Get started' pill, black and white pill buttons (36px and 56px radius) in enphase-visuelt-medium, enphase-visuelt-regular 400 headlines at 64px/-1.28px and 42px, 20px/32px body, and T-Star Pro uppercase 20px labels tracked 1.6px.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Clean, high-contrast enterprise design for data-driven workflows with intuitive drag-and-drop patterns and structured layouts.

envato.name: Envato
envato.description: Envato (www.envato.com redirects to Envato Elements): PolySans 600 headlines at 48px with 16px/400 body, near-black #191919 ink on a peach-cream #fff5ed canvas with white #ffffff cards, lime #87e64b buttons with dark-green #1a4200 labels and 4px corners, and 16px-radius bordered tiles.

epic-games.name: Epic Games Store
epic-games.description: The Epic Games Store web storefront (store.epicgames.com) — a near-black #101014 canvas stepped through #18181c, #202024, #28282c and #404044 surfaces, white #ffffff headings over 65%-white #ffffffa6 body copy, and a single cyan accent #26bbff reserved for the Download button, Get / Add To Cart purchase buttons and discount pills. Type is Inter (body, buttons, prices) paired with Inter Tight 700/900 for game titles and section headings; promo CTAs are white 10px-radius 48px buttons, cards use 12px corners with a 1px #ffffff1a hairline, and game key art carries all colour.

equinor.name: Equinor
equinor.description: Equinor corporate home page: white canvas, #3d3d3d text, Equinor typeface at 65.3px/81.7px with -3.27px tracking and 17.7px body, Energy Red #ff1443 arrows and links, slate #243847 footer, soft layered card shadows and 6px/13px card radii.

equinox.name: Equinox
equinox.description: Equinox's equinox.com as measured — an all-black canvas (#000000) with white uppercase display type in the proprietary Equinox Sans at weight 400 and tight negative tracking (72px/-1.44px, 104px/-2.08px), grey reading copy (#aaaaaa), Messina Sans Mono 11px eyebrows, square 0px-radius buttons (solid white #ffffff with black text, hover #ededed; or 1px translucent-white outline), and a white, hairline-bordered sign-up form.

era-residence.name: ERA Residence
era-residence.description: ERA Residence (era-residence.com), Contemporary Mediterranean residences in Estepona: velvet plum #340c24 planes, cream #f3f3ec and navy #17233b, uppercase ambroise-francois-std display serif at 153.6px, Maison Neue Extended body and arch-shaped panels with 307.2px top radius.

esa.name: ESA
esa.description: The European Space Agency home page: photography-first editorial layout, NotesESAbold headlines at 48px and 75px over Arial 14px body, petrol ink #003247 on an off-white #e8e8e4 canvas, white 2px-radius READ buttons.

espn.name: ESPN
espn.description: ESPN's web front page (international edition, global.espn.com) — a dense three-column news board on a cool grey #edeef0 canvas with white 10px-rounded story cards, a #2b2c2d top bar, the red #dd0000 skewed logo slash, system-font text in #48494a/#1d1e1f, BentonSans 14px/700 uppercase section headers, PublicoBannerExtrabold 28px feature titles and 40px-radius pill buttons.

estonia-e-residency.name: e-Residency of Estonia
estonia-e-residency.description: The official e-Residency of Estonia site: Aino and Aino Headline type with a 72px light-weight blue headline (#005eeb), ink #0f172a on white, #0062f5 pill buttons with #0030de hover, 16px-rounded photography and pale #f1f5f9 cards.

estrela.name: Estrela Studio
estrela.description: Estrela Studio home page: near-black #020202 ground under a luminous glass-prism render, PP Migra serif display (48px and 110.222px) with PP Neue Montreal 16px body, off-white #fbfbf4 text and translucent glass buttons with 1.78px corners.

etda.name: ETDA (Electronic Transactions Development Agency)
etda.description: ETDA English home page: DBHeavent condensed type (23px to 70px), navy ink #102a52 on white and grey, amber #f89b08 accents, 20px-radius teal-outlined nav pills, blue gradient wave bands with white service cards.

eth-zurich.name: ETH Zurich
eth-zurich.description: ETH Zurich German home page: DINPro in a single family (16px body, 32px lead heading), black ink on white with pale cyan #e7f4f7 washes, teal #007894 labels, a red #b7352d callout, ETH blue #215caf theme and square 2px corners.

ethan-tom.name: Ethan & Tom
ethan-tom.description: Ethan & Tom film-director portfolio: near-black #010101 stage, white #ffffff 8px to 9.6px type in Switzer and Geist Mono, a five-column grid of film stills with bracketed index captions, no radii, shadows or accent colors.

ethical-life.name: Ethical Life
ethical-life.description: Ethical Life vegan multivitamin gummies product page: Sora 600 headings (62.5px, 46px) over Inter 18px body, charcoal #2d2d2d on off-white #fbfbfd, lime #dcf343 pill buttons that hover to #4145c8, 3D product renders.

etienne-planeix.name: Etienne Planeix
etienne-planeix.description: Etienne Planeix designer portfolio: a Framer build in one family, Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro 65 Medium at 12px (weights 400 and 600), black on white with 40% and 50% black greys, a 3D arc carousel of projects and no radii or shadows.

european-union.name: European Union
european-union.description: European Union portal home page built on the Europa Component Library: Arial 16px body with 42px and 36px regular headings, EU blue #0e47cb on white and #f3f6fc bands, yellow #ffcc00 card bars, 4px and 8px radii and blue-tinted shadows.

eurostar.name: Eurostar
eurostar.description: Eurostar booking site (Rwanda market, English): La Pontaise headlines and ABC Social 16px body, navy #00286a chrome, brand blue #106dff with #0a4199 hover, yellow #ffc305 search button, plum #7d0552 and teal #086264 promo blocks, 4px and 8px radii.

eventpop.name: Eventpop
eventpop.description: Eventpop (Thai event ticketing platform) design system: proprietary Eventpop typeface with 28px bold headings, white canvas, deep violet #260176 login button with 3px radius, red #ee3124 date lines and poster-led rows.

evergreen-ui.name: Evergreen
evergreen-ui.description: Evergreen is Segment's React UI framework: white and #fafbff surfaces, a #3366ff blue primary, a navy-grey text ramp (#101840, #474d66, #696f8c), SF UI Text/Display type at 12-14px, 4px control radii and 32px controls.

everland.name: Everland
everland.description: Everland (everland.co.th) Thai residential developer site in DBHeavent 300 to 700: deep green #006341 headings and links, gold #c6893f price and rule accents, slate #545859 body text, near-black #1e1e1e header and hero on a white #ffffff canvas, 3px radius.

everlane.name: Everlane
everlane.description: Everlane's Shopify storefront (Dawn 15.3.0 theme, customised) is a quiet, photography-led apparel system set entirely in Maison Neue Book at weight 400: a 32px letter-spaced EVERLANE wordmark, 12px/0.24px uppercase nav and CTA labels, 14px/0.28px body, #ffffff canvas with #000000 ink and #121212 graphite, a #f4edd9 cream announcement band, square 0px corners everywhere, and a #262626 ADD TO BAG bar 47px tall with 15px/1px type.

evernote.name: Evernote
evernote.description: Evernote's marketing home: warm paper #f9f6f2 canvas with sand #f4eee5 panels, near-black #141414 buttons that turn Evernote green #00a82d on hover, a lime #94e130 AI button on a #262626 band, Figtree 600 headlines at 72px with -3.6px tracking, Inter/Figtree body, 5px button and 10px card corners.

everswap.name: EverSwap
everswap.description: EverSwap DeFi home page: a painterly mountain hero, Feature Display light serif and Britti Sans, off-white #fbfff4 text, a forest-green #203727 palette from root variables, a translucent pill Launch App button and a fluid type scale on a 16-column grid.

evolve-2.name: Made in Evolve
evolve-2.description: Made in Evolve ecommerce agency home page: near-black #111111 ground, white neue-haas-grotesk 500 type with a 166.4px uppercase H1 and negative tracking, a lettered case-study table in Bull 5 Typewriter, lime #c3ff00 accent and 7px to 14px radii.

example.name: Example
example.description: Example (weareexample.com), a Sydney and Dubai brand strategy, design and PR agency for hospitality and consumer brands. A warm off-white canvas #f3f3f0, near-black navy ink #0e1623, American Grotesk Compressed at weight 900 in uppercase up to 182.4px, American Grotesk for body, a 6.4px radius on imagery.

excalidraw.name: Excalidraw
excalidraw.description: Excalidraw (excalidraw.com), the open-source hand-drawn whiteboard: a white #ffffff canvas with floating #ececf4-on-white UI islands, Assistant 14px UI text in #1b1b1f, Excalifont 18px hand-lettered hints in #b8b8b8, the #6965db violet brand, a #f0efff 8px-radius Try Excalidraw+ button with a #d7d5ff border, and 6px–8px radii.

exim-thailand.name: EXIM Thailand
exim-thailand.description: Export-Import Bank of Thailand (exim.go.th/en), a state banking site in a navy #034ea2 and signal red #ed1c24 palette on white, with DB Heavent for headings and buttons, IBM Plex Sans Var for body, a red 6px-radius button and a blue-to-red gradient service band.

expedia.name: Expedia
expedia.description: Expedia US home page: Reckless XPD serif headlines (44px hero, 36px and 28px) over Centra No2 400/500/700 UI text, #191e3b navy ink on #ffffff, #1668e3 blue for filled search buttons, links and outlined pill buttons (hover #0d4eaf on #ecf4fd), #fddb32 brand yellow, #0c0e1c and #191e3b dark panels, 40px-radius search fields and 16px-radius cards.

explore-primland.name: Primland Residences
explore-primland.description: Explore Primland (explore.ownprimland.com), the Blue Ridge Mountains real estate microsite of Primland Residences. Full-bleed aerial imagery, wide-tracked uppercase PetitSerif (46.8px, 9.36px tracking), Centra sans buttons, a cream #fffbe7 square button with forest green #456a4b text.

expo.name: Expo
expo.description: Expo's site is a white and cool-grey canvas (#ffffff, #f9f9fb) with near-black #1c2024 text set in Inter 600 at -2px tracking, pure #000000 pill buttons, 40px-radius cards and a JetBrains Mono eyebrow.

expressive.name: Expressive
expressive.description: Vibrant, personality-driven design with bold colors, playful graphics, and dynamic layouts that balance creativity with structure.

exxonmobil.name: ExxonMobil
exxonmobil.description: ExxonMobil corporate site (corporate.exxonmobil.com): white and light grey #f1f2f2 pages, signal red #fe000c square buttons (hover #d5000a), charcoal #333333 text, the EMprint family in Light 300 for 60px headlines, a deep navy statement band and photo-led story cards.

ey.name: EY
ey.description: EY US home page (ey.com/en_us): EY Yellow #ffe600 on dark #2e2e38, #1a1a24 and black bands over a #f6f6fa and white canvas, EYInterstate in 300 and 700 weights (40px headlines on 48px), square buttons, yellow-topped dark insight cards.

ezy-airlines.name: Ezy Airlines
ezy-airlines.description: Ezy Airlines (ezyairlines.com), a Thai regional airline site: Kanit type at 52px/600 headlines, navy primary #213a56 buttons with 8px radius and hover #142334, a deep navy #06203b destinations band, a yellow #f9c017 booking accent and soft blue-grey layered shadows.

faint-film.name: Faint Film
faint-film.description: Faint Film (faint-film.com), a developer's personal black-and-white photography site: white #ffffff and #f2f2f2 split screen, charcoal #222222 text, PP Neue Montreal Medium only, a 32px year display, a 4 by 5 thumbnail grid and a dark pill Grid and Slider toggle.

fairphone.name: Fairphone
fairphone.description: Fairphone shop (fairphone.com): forest green #00433d brand ink on white and sand #f0f0ee surfaces, Bricolage Grotesque 600 headlines at 64px, DM Sans body at 14px, uppercase 14px buttons with 0px radius, 24px-radius product cards and a published sand and forest token scale.

fantasy.name: Fantasy
fantasy.description: Fantasy (fantasy.co), an AI-native digital product design agency: a black #000000 stage with white #ffffff text, one custom sans at weight 400 in 18px and 40px with negative tracking, a 10px radius on media frames and a Menu pill, dark device renders and client logos as the only colour.

farm-minerals.name: Farm Minerals
farm-minerals.description: Farm Minerals CropTab promo page (farmminerals.com/promo): deep moss #404f1d ink, olive #636f3d buttons and headings, warm beige #f4ede6 sections, Aeonik at 122.88px with -2.4576px tracking, tiny 11.06px uppercase pill buttons, a blurred foliage hero around a 3D carbon tablet.

farmhouse.name: Farmhouse
farmhouse.description: Farmhouse (ฟาร์มเฮ้าส์) bread brand site: a solid red #d90000 header and campaign carousel over a cream paper world of illustrated bakery props, with Thai FC_Lamoon display type at 50px, 20px rounded form fields and round red carousel arrows.

fashion-island.name: Fashion Island
fashion-island.description: Design language of the Fashion Island mall website: Helvetica with Kanit as Thai companion, black text on white, a hot magenta #ec098d for the active tab, 10px-radius tab buttons with a soft 13% black gradient overlay, a #5f6062 grey quick-link bar, and a four-colour (orange, green, red, blue) letter-block motif for large display words.

fastly.name: Fastly
fastly.description: Fastly alternates #f8f5f4 beige and #000000 black full-width bands, sets everything in TT Hoves Pro (72px/400 headlines at -2.88px, 16px/22.4px body in #4a4a49), uses #0067d1 blue 4px-radius buttons (#0073eb on black, hover #165099), white #dfdcdc-bordered cards and red #ff282d line-art accents.

fastwork.name: Fastwork
fastwork.description: Thai freelancer marketplace at fastwork.co: Fastwork and Noto Sans Thai type, #1d6ce2 buttons with 3px radius, deep blue #08439b headings, white 8px-radius cards with a blue layered shadow, a pill search field with Ask AI, soft blue gradient canvas #fafcfe.

fathom-analytics.name: Fathom Analytics
fathom-analytics.description: Fathom Analytics' site: white and green-tinted grey #f4f6f5 surfaces, system sans text in green-grey inks (#242925 headings, #4e5551 body at 18px/27px), a 56px bold headline with -1.4px tracking, violet #6a51ec CTAs (6px, or 24px pills in the header) darkening to #3d22c3, and a monospace founders' letter.

fauna-robotics.name: Fauna Robotics
fauna-robotics.description: Fauna Robotics (faunarobotics.com), a New York humanoid robot company: warm cream #f8f0e3 canvas, near-black plum #180102 ink, orange #f16b46 buttons with a 32px and 8px mixed radius, Matter at weight 500 with 64px/-2px headlines, rounded 100px logo tiles.

fc-porto-memorial.name: FC Porto Memorial
fc-porto-memorial.description: FC Porto Memorial (memorial.fcporto.pt), a Portuguese-language tribute microsite for Jorge Nuno Pinto da Costa: a midnight navy #01060e canvas, warm cream #e8e1d2f2 type, GT Super Display serif at 111.424px with -5.5712px tracking, system sans body at 16px, an EN/PT switch and a scrolling timeline.

fedex.name: FedEx
fedex.description: FedEx US home (fedex.com/en-us/home.html) measured at 1280px: FedExSans in 300/400/500/700, FedEx purple #4d148c header and secondary pills, orange #ff6200 square TRACK button with 19px uppercase label, blue #007ab7 text links, #fafafa page ground and mostly 0px radius.

fender.name: Fender
fender.description: Fender international store: a black (#000000) canvas with white text, TheFuture uppercase headlines at weight 900 (48px section heading), dark #191a1f pill buttons (100px radius, 32px high) and white 44px pill CTAs, over full-bleed music photography and video.

fenty-beauty.name: Fenty Beauty
fenty-beauty.description: Fenty Beauty by Rihanna's Shopify storefront is a stark black-and-white system set entirely in Lineto's Brown — uppercase 700-weight fluid headings (71.1112px wordmark h1, 42.6666px/28.4444px/21.3334px at 1280px), 14px/400 body, 12px/700 uppercase buttons with 0.3px tracking — on a #ffffff canvas with warm-black #2d2929 ink, square 0px black (#000000) buttons 40px tall that invert to white on hover, #bd0100 sale prices, and full-bleed campaign colour such as magenta #cc2d75.

ferrari.name: Ferrari
ferrari.description: Ferrari's site is a cinematic black-and-white editorial grid: #181818 bar and footer, white #ffffff content bands, full-bleed photography with uppercase Title-Font headlines, a Ferrari red #da291c accent and FerrariSans / Body-Font at 12-16px.

ferrero.name: Ferrero Group
ferrero.description: Ferrero Group global site: chocolate-brown (#59200a) text on white and cream (#fffaf0), Merriweather serif uppercase headlines at 50.08px over Rubik 16px body, light-orange (#ffa646) CTA, square-cornered outlined buttons and full-bleed heritage photography.

fifa.name: FIFA
fifa.description: FIFA (fifa.com/en) is a pale blue-grey #eef2fb news-and-tournaments portal set in FIFASans with Poppins and Noto Sans fallbacks, deep navy #03122b text, a #045694 FIFA-blue header, a navy #020f2a hero and footer, white 100px-radius 'Read more' pills and 5px-radius story cards.

figma.name: Figma
figma.description: Figma's marketing site is a strict black-and-white frame (#ffffff canvas, #000000 ink and primary) set entirely in the custom figmaSans variable grotesque by Grilli Type at regular weight with tight negative tracking, with 8px-radius buttons, 24px cards and a 9999px pill, and all colour supplied by product imagery rather than chrome.

financial-times.name: Financial Times
financial-times.description: The FT's site sits on its signature paper background #fff1e5 with #33302e body ink and #000000 headlines: financier display VF serif headlines (48px/48px lead at variable weight 397), metric 2 VF sans for standfirsts, nav and labels (16px/24px), claret #990f3d topic kickers, teal #0d7680 links, a slate #262a33 Subscribe button and footer with 2px radius, and FT Pink #fcd0b1 accents — all defined by the Origami o3 token system.

fine-thought-site.name: Fine Thought
fine-thought-site.description: Fine Thought portfolio: a code-editor interface on a charcoal #282828 canvas, with a fine-thought.js tab, a monospaced line-number gutter in code-saver, ASCII-art grid lines in grey #898989, and giant neue-haas-grotesk-display 600 headlines in #bababa (281.4px).

finland-gov.name: Suomi.fi
finland-gov.description: Suomi.fi (suomi.fi/etusivu), Finland's public-services portal, is set in Source Sans 3 with a #235a9a blue for buttons, #2a6ebb link blue, a blue hero band, #f0f6ff and #d5e4f6 section tints, 2px-cornered buttons and white 4px cards with a soft shadow.

finland-toolbox.name: Finland Toolbox
finland-toolbox.description: Finland Toolbox is a materials library by the Finland Promotion Board, set in Finlandica with uppercase bold headings, a single deep blue #002ea2 for buttons, links and underlined fields, near-black #060a14 text, a #f0f1f2 grey filter panel on white, and square (0px radius) controls throughout.

finnair.name: Finnair
finnair.description: Finnair's web system — Nordic Blue #0c0243 as the single ink and outline colour on white, an accent blue #3772de (hover #2f62c0) reserved for filled primary buttons, proprietary FinnairHeadlinePro (variable 300–900, headings at 400/450/500) over FinnairText (400/500/700), 40px-radius pill buttons, 8px cards with whisper-soft 3% layered shadows, warm beige #edebe6 and pale blue #e1eafa surfaces, all expressed as semantic CSS variables like --surface-accent and --text-icon-primary.

finnomena.name: Finnomena
finnomena.description: Finnomena (Thai mutual fund investing platform) design system: aktiv-grotesk-thai type at 17px, white canvas, dark navy #01172c banners, acid yellow #f2f93c button with 4px radius, navy 200px sign-up pill and pale-yellow #fbfdbf cards.

firefox-acorn.name: Firefox
firefox-acorn.description: Firefox's marketing site in a deep violet #210340 canvas with white text, a #7543e3 pill download button (128px radius, #6132bc on hover), Mozilla Headline VF at 80px/600 for the hero and Mozilla Text VF at 16px for body copy, and near-white lilac #f1e7f8 cards with 48px radii floating on the dark page.

first-frame-2.name: First Frame
first-frame-2.description: First Frame (Paris creative and post-production studio): a pure black (#000000) canvas with white (#ffffff) uppercase text, IBM Plex Mono 10.6667px for interface labels, HKRequisite 42.6667px uppercase for project titles, hairline rules and a slideshow of work with a 01/06 counter.

first-solar.name: First Solar
first-solar.description: First Solar corporate site: deep navy #00355f buttons and panels, charcoal #212529 text on white and warm #f1edea bands, Franklin Gothic (URW) condensed headings at 48px with 300-weight body at 16px, HelveticaNowDisplay 68px hero headline, 5px-radius buttons and plant-floor photography.

flabbergast-agency.name: Flabbergast Agency
flabbergast-agency.description: Flabbergast Agency: a near-black #151515 canvas with off-white #fafafa text, Aeonik Regular at 83.264px with -1.66528px tracking for the hero line, Aeonik Fono uppercase mono labels at 12.96px, a red #e62200 footer, and a white 10px-radius service card over team photography.

flash-express.name: Flash Express
flash-express.description: Flash Express Thailand (English site): signature yellow #ffea33 header, buttons and promo cards with charcoal #303133 text, Prompt typeface (14px body, 32px section headings, 57px bold promo display), white 8px-radius cards with soft shadow, and a tracking search bar.

flashlights.name: Flashlights - Our Roots (history of jailhouse lawyers)
flashlights.description: Flashlights, the Our Roots history site on history.jailhouselawyers.org: buttery cream #f1eada canvas, near-black #101010 ink, saturated pink-red #e8465e and green #10935b chapter panels, ultra-condensed Fkscreamertrial 900 headlines at 124.444px, FK Grotesk body and mono labels.

flat.name: Flat
flat.description: Two-dimensional minimalist style with vibrant colors, clean typography, and no 3D effects for fast, user-friendly interfaces.

flexport.name: Flexport
flexport.description: Flexport's 2026 site on flexport.com: a white #ffffff canvas with black #000000 headings, light Zalando Sans (ExtraLight 200 for the 58px/63.8px hero and 52px section heads, Light 300 for 20px/24px body in grey #595959), Roboto Mono uppercase for every button, nav link and eyebrow, and square-cornered (0px) Indigo #3048df buttons 48px tall with 12px 16px padding that darken to #182a9c on hover. Dark video hero (#000304), midnight #020e16 utility bar and a footer that fades from periwinkle to Midnight Blue #052439.

flim.name: Flim
flim.description: Flim, an AI search engine for film stills: white and #f5f5f5 canvas on a visible grid, near-black #141414 ink and buttons, Swizzy sans at 19.6px, PP Neue Montreal Mono 12px uppercase labels, a 113.569px wordmark, rounded image tiles and a pill search bar.

flipkart.name: Flipkart
flipkart.description: Flipkart India: white marketplace canvas with #f1f3f6 backgrounds, Flipkart blue #2874f0 for links and the search outline, midnight blue #2a55e5 Login button (2px radius), golden-yellow #ffc200 chips, Inter 14px body and 12px captions, 12px-radius white cards over saturated sale-banner panels.

floema.name: Floema
floema.description: Floema (sustainable urban signage and equipment): warm ivory #f2efea canvas, stone-brown #241f21 ink and buttons, flour-yellow #e9e778 footer, Zimula typeface with tight negative tracking (53.36px display, 14.67px body), white pill navigation, and floating product thumbnails.

flowaccount.name: FlowAccount
flowaccount.description: FlowAccount Thai online accounting site at flowaccount.com: Prompt 38px h1 and Chat Thai UI body, #66bd00 sign-up button with 5px radius, #2898cb brand blue outlines and numerals, #f8f9fb canvas with white and #e9f5fa bands, 20px cards with a 10px soft shadow.

flowbite.name: Flowbite
flowbite.description: Flowbite, the open-source Tailwind CSS component library, presents a white marketing page set in Inter with 800-weight 60px headlines, gray-900 ink (#111827) over gray-500 body (#6b7280), a royal-blue #1a56db primary with 8px-radius buttons, and docs demos whose brand blue is #1447e6 with 12px radii.

floyd.name: Floyd
floyd.description: Floyd (Detroit modular furniture) runs on a warm vintage-cream canvas (#f8f6ed, the site's --color-vintage) with brand-black #231e1e ink and buttons, large tightly-tracked sans headlines served from a face named "Regular" (40px/44px at -1.6px, 36px at -1.44px), body at 18–20px, monospaced uppercase eyebrows in "Mono" / GT America Mono, the custom Floyd Gothic in nav and product headings, and near-square corners (1px modal button, 5px Add To Cart, 3px chips).

fluent-design.name: Fluent UI React
fluent-design.description: Microsoft's Fluent 2 as shipped in Fluent UI React v9: Segoe UI at 14px/20px body and a 10-step semibold ramp up to 68px, neutral #242424 ink on white, a #0f6cbd brand-80 primary with 4px-radius, 32px-high buttons, #d1d1d1 strokes and a documented 2-to-40px radius and 2-to-32px spacing scale.

fluent-web-components.name: Microsoft Learn
fluent-web-components.description: Microsoft Learn home page: Segoe UI at 16px/28px body with 40px headings, action blue #0f6cbd, near-black #161616 ink, warm beige #e8e6df bands, 4px-radius controls, 8px cards with a soft two-layer shadow and a navy Ignite banner.

fluid-glass.name: Fluid Glass
fluid-glass.description: Fluid Glass (fluid.glass) is a UK bespoke architectural glazing site built on a graphite canvas #212325 with cream #f3f0ec panels, white type, Aeonik Pro for reading text and Aeonik Mono for uppercase micro-labels, square 0px buttons filled #0b1012 and one 16px radius.

flyio.name: Fly.io
flyio.description: Fly.io pairs a Mackinac serif display (72px/500, -1.44px tracking, #2e2e2e) with Fricolage Grotesque body text in muted violet-grey #686082 on white, #7c3aed violet 8px-radius buttons that darken to #6d28d9, 10px-radius #f4f3fb cards with #d5cfef hairlines, pastel watercolor gradient bands and a #191034 night-violet footer.

follow-art.name: FOLLOW.ART
follow-art.description: FOLLOW.ART (follow.art) is a creative-practice card platform for artists and curators: full-bleed flat color fields in orange #f4793a, green #8e9487, pink #c5939d and blue #8498ac, white type, a giant uppercase Hardbop wordmark at 199.89px and HeadingNow for all reading text, with no rounded corners measured.

fontshare.name: Fontshare
fontshare.description: Fontshare, the Indian Type Foundry's free-font library: a cream #ffffe3 canvas, near-black #10100e ink, Passenger-Sans 12px/16px UI, 120px live specimens in each typeface (Satoshi, Clash Display, General Sans), hairline #c0c0ab rules, a black active tab and 9999px pill toggles — no shadows.

foodworld.name: Food World
foodworld.description: Food World (foodworld.in.th) is CPF's Thai food-court and catering service site: white canvas, warm brown #665c53 text, lime #d5e03c headings, orange #ff9d24 pill buttons, Kanit and Prompt type with a 96px hero, and soft 32px and 50px rounded brown cards.

ford.name: Ford
ford.description: Ford.com's US home page: black #000000 hero and spotlight bands alternating with white #ffffff, #333333 body ink, Ford blue #066fef pill buttons (hover #044ea7) with 400px radius at 40px tall, #0562d2 links and promo bars, 8px media corners, and FordFont throughout from 54px/600 headlines to 14px/700 button labels.

form-energy.name: Form Energy
form-energy.description: Form Energy (formenergy.com) is an American iron-air battery company whose site pairs full-bleed factory photography with uppercase Roboto Condensed headlines (86px hero), Roboto Mono labels, light-grey #f4f4f4 and white bands, black footer and a single amber #faaf40 outline accent with 3px square-ish corners.

form-fun-studio.name: Form&Fun Studio
form-fun-studio.description: Form&Fun Studio (formandfun.co) is a global creative technology studio site: white #ffffff canvas with warm grey #f5f4f2 tiles, near-black #1d1d1d ink, Aeonik at 12.8px for UI and up to 89.6px for section words, one pill-shaped #1d1d1d "Learn more" button with 25.6px radius, and 8px-radius media cards.

formula1.name: Formula 1
formula1.description: Formula 1's formula1.com — a news-and-video sports surface built on a carbon #15151e hero band, a white #ffffff content canvas with warm #f7f4f1 story cards, and one racing red #e10600 for pill CTAs (1000px radius). Headlines use the proprietary Formula1 face at 900 in uppercase (32px desktop / 24px mobile); everything else is Titillium Web 400/600/700 at 16–17px with #1c1c25 ink and #606066 meta text; cards are 8px-rounded.

foudre-human-social-club.name: Agence Foudre (Human Social Club)
foudre-human-social-club.description: Agence Foudre (agencefoudre.com, wordmark Human Social Club) is a French social-media agency site in pink #f29ebd and deep pink #db3c8a on white and forest green #00522d, with Beni 900 poster headlines (94px), Clash Grotesk 500 body, 10px-radius buttons and 20px-radius cards.

foundation.name: Foundation
foundation.description: Foundation for Sites by ZURB, a responsive front-end framework: its docs and marketing use #fefefe and #0a0a0a with the default $foundation-palette (primary #1779ba, secondary #767676, success #3adb76, warning #ffae00, alert #cc4b37), square 0-radius framework buttons, Helvetica Neue docs type, and a 200-weight Proxima Nova homepage.

four-seasons.name: Four Seasons
four-seasons.description: Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts (fourseasons.com): a black-and-white luxury hospitality site. Saol Display 300 uppercase headlines at 60px, Monotype Garamond 18px/27px body copy, Neue Helvetica 10px bold uppercase labels with 3px tracking, square 0px buttons with a 1px #000000 border on #ffffff, and full-bleed photography on a #000000 page.

fourmula-ai.name: Fourmula AI
fourmula-ai.description: Fourmula AI (fourmula.ai) is an AI product-imagery platform site in near-black #020108 on white #ffffff and grey #f7f7f7 panels, set in SF Pro Display with -2.66px tracking at 88.5981px, a black pill "Get started" button that turns orange #ff6b02 on hover, and large 17.72px to 35.44px rounded media cards.

foyer.name: Foyer
foyer.description: Foyer is a Luxembourg insurer whose website sets Barlow (400 to 700) on a white canvas with slate ink #3b4856, a single electric blue #2957c8 for actions and the footer, a deep navy #041d58 for card text, and pale feather-grey #f8f9fc bands. Buttons are 50px and 200px pills, cards use an 8px radius with a soft blue-tinted shadow, and photography of smiling households sits beside flat blue illustration.

framer.name: Framer
framer.description: Framer's homepage is a pure black stage (#000000 canvas, #ffffff ink) set in GT Walsheim Medium at 54px/-2.16px for headlines and Inter Variable for text, with white 8px-radius buttons, #111111 and #171717 panels with 15-25px radii, and Framer Blue #0099FF appearing only as a glow, link and focus accent.

framer-motion.name: Motion
framer-motion.description: Motion (motion.dev, previously Framer Motion) is a near-black #080808 developer site set in TASA Orbiter 700 headlines with grey-green #979d97 body text and #edebe5 highlights, square-cornered uppercase Geist Mono buttons in yellow #fbd509 and green #52cd86, 6px-rounded code cards and a light #f8f8f6 footer.

framework7.name: Framework7
framework7.description: Framework7 homepage: warm brown-black #201a19 canvas, off-white #ede0dd text, peach #ffb4a4 pill buttons with 44px radius, Inter 700 headings at 44px and 48px with 18px body, and a red-orange logo, plus an iPhone demo of the framework.

freee.name: freee
freee.description: freee marketing site: Japanese cloud accounting brand in Noto Sans JP (34px/51px headline, 16px body), saturated blue #2864f0 with navy #1e46aa on white and #f7f5f5, 8px primary buttons 48px high, white cards with a soft 2px shadow and pale-blue illustration tiles.

fremtind.name: Fremtind
fremtind.description: Fremtind Forsikring (fremtind.no) is a calm, editorial insurance site built on its Jøkul design system: a warm sand canvas (#f4f2ef), granite ink and action colour (#1b1917), a near-black footer (#000000), light-weight Fremtind Grotesk at 30px/40px, outlined pill buttons (9999px radius) and an 8px-radius dark navigation card laid over a full-bleed street photograph.

freshket.name: Freshket (เฟรชเก็ต)
freshket.description: Freshket (freshket.co, เฟรชเก็ต) is a Thai B2B fresh-food ordering marketplace for restaurants: white canvas, brand green #008065, sale red #de1b1b, Noto Sans Thai at 10px to 16px, 8px-radius cards and a 32px green "สมัครสมาชิก" button with a soft blue-grey shadow.

freshman.name: Freshman
freshman.description: Freshman (freshman.tv) is an award-winning production company site: a full-viewport dark reel on #101010 and #000000 with a giant white italic "freshman" wordmark, Editorial New at weight 200 for statements, Altform bold uppercase for client names, the handwritten Wasted Year face for tags, and red #ff2936.

freshworks-g.name: Freshworks
freshworks-g.description: Freshworks.com home: warm off-white #f7f7f4 canvas with full-black #000000 bands, Lora serif headlines (72px/80px, with bold-italic emphasis words), Inter and Roboto UI text in #1d2026 and #6c6c6a, black 9999px pill 'Get a demo' buttons, 12px-radius media cards and saturated testimonial panels in #ffb42d, #ff574a, #eb3da7 and #73bc29.

friendly.name: Friendly
friendly.description: Approachable, intuitive design with rounded elements, ample whitespace, and soft pastel color palettes.

fritz-hansen.name: Fritz Hansen
fritz-hansen.description: Fritz Hansen (fritzhansen.com) is the Danish furniture, lighting and accessory design house: white #ffffff and beige #efeeeb pages, black #000000 text, HansenGrotesque in uppercase at 43.75px and 27.5px for headings, 15px body, square 0px corners, and full-bleed room photography with product tiles.

frog.name: frog
frog.description: frog (part of Capgemini Invent) runs a near-monochrome, cinematic system — pure #000000 canvas with #ffffff type, the self-hosted frogSerif at weight 300 for 60–180px editorial headlines, GT America (400/500/700) for everything else, square 0px buttons with a 3px border that invert on hover, a single 16px-radius region chip, and five Bootstrap-era highlight colors (--hl-green #4ee601 etc.) kept in reserve.

fromanother-love.name: fromanother
fromanother-love.description: fromanother (fromanother.love) is an artist-led creative studio site on deep navy #051236 with cream-yellow #fffde2 text, twkFont uppercase headlines at 73.3333px and -2.2px tracking, herbikFont italic captions, a glowing teal hero shape and one brand blue #1740a9 declared in the stylesheet.

fromsoftware.name: FromSoftware
fromsoftware.description: FromSoftware (fromsoftware.jp, フロム・ソフトウェア) is the Japanese game developer's corporate site: near-black #0f0f0f with #151515 and #222222 panels, white and grey #a6a6a6 text, Archivo for Latin labels and a Noto Sans JP system stack for Japanese, edge-to-edge key art, 4px corners and grey #838382 date chips.

frontier-familysearch.name: FamilySearch
frontier-familysearch.description: FamilySearch's global homepage (www.familysearch.org/en/global) is a warm, humanist genealogy site: HeritageHeadings and HeritageBody sans faces, near-black #202121 text on a #fefefe canvas, one deep teal #057091 (hover #0383a4) for 4px-radius uppercase buttons, full-bleed documentary photography and soft flat illustrations.

fujifilm.name: Fujifilm [Global]
fujifilm.description: Fujifilm [Global] (global.fujifilm.com/en) is the group's region-selector and corporate home page: white canvas with #f1f2f1 panels, charcoal #333333 square-cornered buttons (2px radius), Clarimo UD PE in light and narrow cuts with 0.96px tracking, green #018463 line icons and a declared red #fb0020.

fullstory.name: Fullstory
fullstory.description: Fullstory's fullstory.com site: deep teal #0a2828 / #0e3c3c / #135050 bands with white text, neulis-neue display type (62px regular hero) over neulis-sans body (20px/30px), green #11ab85 uppercase 4px-radius 'GET A DEMO' buttons (hover #059573), and a three-color product code: green #07c799, pink #ff6f94 and purple #9e36f1 on 10px-radius outlined cards.

function.name: FUNCTION
function.description: FUNCTION (function10.ca) is a Ballroom culture platform for stories, audio, events and portraits, set entirely in TWK Everett 400 uppercase with negative tracking (71.1168px hero, 22px headings, 12px body), black #000000 ink on a white #ffffff canvas, full-bleed event photography, and lilac #9389c5 and cyan #24ceea portrait cards with 2px corners.

function-health.name: Function Health
function-health.description: Function Health's lab-testing membership site — a warm beige canvas #fef9ef with cream #f5eee1 cards and footer, midnight #2a2b2f ink and gray #515151 secondary text, light Financier Display serif headlines (76.5418px/300) with one orange italic phrase, FT Base sans at weight 300 for body (16px/24px), Fragment Mono uppercase tags, and burnt-orange #b05a36 fully rounded pill CTAs (12px 25px, 50px tall) that flip to midnight on hover.

future-park.name: Future Park Rangsit
future-park.description: Future Park Rangsit and ZPELL (futurepark.co.th) is a Thai mall site on a warm off-white #fafafa canvas set in LINE Seed Sans TH, with 32px bold uppercase headlines in charcoal #44424a, fresh teal #2dd4cd section eyebrows, a deeper #13afab for links and outlined buttons, soft lime-to-mint gradient bands, and generous 15px to 32px rounded cards.

futuristic.name: Futuristic
futuristic.description: Forward-looking design with tech-inspired typography, modern layouts, and a sleek, innovation-driven aesthetic.

fwd-thailand.name: FWD Thailand
fwd-thailand.description: FWD Thailand (fwd.co.th/en) is a life insurance site built on the FWDCircularWeb typeface (300 body, 700 headings, 48px hero) with FWD orange #e87722 buttons and 2px outlines, cream #fef9f4 product cards with 16px radius and soft shadows, peach #fae4d3 promo bands, mint #6eceb2 discount badges and lifestyle photography.

g-capital.name: G Capital
g-capital.description: G Capital (gcapital.co.th), Thai personal and agricultural lender whose Sabai-jai loan brand uses Prompt type, a royal-blue #324695 action and footer color, light grey #dddcdc and #e5e5e5 bars, 50px-radius pill buttons and an uppercase 34px bold Thai heading.

gap.name: Gap
gap.description: Gap (gap.com) is a US apparel storefront set in Gap Sans v1 weight 400 (55.7333px hero, 14px body), with black #000000 and white #ffffff controls, 0px-radius rectangular buttons, a black 46px brand bar, full-bleed lifestyle photography with white headlines, and neutral greys #757575 and #ededed.

garmin.name: Garmin
garmin.description: Garmin's US site is a black-and-white retail system exactly as its Consumer Brand Style Guide prescribes: Oswald (the web stand-in for Knockout) at weight 400 with 0.8px tracking for every headline — 40px/50px h1, 32px/40px section and card titles — over Roboto 16px/24px body, #ffffff canvas, #000000 ink and footer, square 0px buttons (8px 24px outlined, 16px 32px contained), 2px-radius product cards with a soft 0 2px 4px 1px shadow, and Candy Blue #6dcff6 reserved for ADD TO CART.

gary-and-the-endless-forest.name: Gary et la forêt infinie (Garance)
gary-and-the-endless-forest.description: Gary et la forêt infinie (play.garance.com) is a French-language game page by Garance: a full-viewport illustrated forest scene with cream #fbffdc UI text in Kilimanjaro 400 (14.6286px), a 65px nav bar, chunky 29.2573px-radius controls, a green #006468 palette and orange #f47f46 action buttons.

gavin-schneider-productions.name: Gavin Schneider Productions
gavin-schneider-productions.description: Gavin Schneider Productions (gsproductions.co.za) is a photography and film portfolio in SuisseMedium 500 at 8.88889px, black #000000 text and grey #979797 labels on a #fbfbfb page, a 28px navigation bar, no radii or shadows and tall full-colour portrait photographs in a narrow column.

gdh-559.name: GDH 559
gdh-559.description: GDH 559 (gdh559.co.th) is a Thai film company site set in Kanit (45px weight 800 uppercase news heading, 15px body) with GDH blue #009be4 links and 3px outlined square buttons, grey #868e96 body text, a #f2f2f2 article band, 25px pill tags and a #262b2f footer with orange #fd590f accents.

ge.name: GE
ge.description: GE.com (General Electric) is a short corporate hub on a #f0f3f7 grey canvas set in GE Sans (gesans-regular/bold), with a #1e2f46 dark blue-grey header and footer, #0870d8 GE primary-blue links, a 69px light-weight hero headline with tight tracking, and three square company cards in navy #00003d, teal #005e60 and purple #6022a6.

ge-healthcare.name: GE HealthCare
ge-healthcare.description: GE HealthCare (gehealthcare.com, US) is a medical technology site in Source Sans Pro 400 (48px headlines, 18px body), with GE purple #6022a6 links and top bar, lavender #f4f1f8 category bands with 16px-radius cards, dark #222222 headings, 8px-radius 44px buttons and clinical photography.

ge-vernova.name: GE Vernova
ge-vernova.description: GE Vernova (gevernova.com), the energy-equipment company spun off from GE: white #ffffff pages, deep evergreen #012d2f video hero and #212121 footer, Evergreen #005e60 as the dominant text and link colour, and Urgency Green #c8ff08 for pill-shaped CTAs (30px radius, 56px tall, 16px/600 ge-inter-semibold label in #005e60; hover fills #05625e with #f9fbfb text). Display type is the condensed ge-sons-condensed-extrabold, uppercase at 92px/74.52px; body is ge-inter-regular 18px/28px with -0.54px tracking. Story cards are white with 8px corners on an #e4f1f1 band.

geico.name: GEICO
geico.description: GEICO (geico.com) is an insurance storefront set in GEICO Roobert (72.8px weight 600 hero, 17.6px body) with action blue #026df1 100px-radius pill buttons, navy #062342 text, cream #f6f5ee bands with 15.2px-radius cards, a deep-blue #004894 panel and a lime #c8f547 accent.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.description: Google Gemini (gemini.google.com/app) is the signed-out chat app in Google Sans Flex (36px weight 320 heading, 13px legal text) on a #faf9f9 canvas with white pill surfaces, a light-blue #c2e7ff Sign in button with #004a77 text, 9999px radii and a soft blue radial glow behind the prompt field.

generali.name: Generali Group
generali.description: Generali Group (generali.com) is an insurer's corporate portal in Roboto (38.7981px weight 300 headings, 15.008px bold uppercase buttons), with Generali red #c21b17 5px-radius buttons, #f6f6f6 cards with 8px radius, #20252b text on white, and red feature panels behind photography.

generali-life-thailand.name: Generali Thailand
generali-life-thailand.description: Generali Thailand homepage (generali.co.th): white canvas with #ebeaea grey bands, Noto Sans TH at 16px body and 30px headings, Generali red #c21b17 on 3px-radius buttons (45px tall, 15px 35px padding), #7a7a7a secondary text, 10px-radius cards with soft grey shadows.

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.description: Genesis (genesis.com/worldwide/en) is a luxury automotive site in GenesisSansHeadKr weight 300 (48px) and GenesisSansTextKr (14px body), with near-black #111111 2px-radius buttons, a translucent black header, white-on-photography captions, #535356 body text, copper #af6249 press labels and 4px-radius model cards.

get-hyped.name: Get Hyped
get-hyped.description: Get Hyped (gethyped.nl) is a Dutch social-first content agency site in Inter 600 (85.3333px headline with -4.26667px tracking), on a cream #faf4ec canvas with #161616 text, orange #fa5424 actions, flat pink #fcb8fa, blue #0d8dff and green #33c791 tilted cards with 32px radii.

getyourguide.name: GetYourGuide
getyourguide.description: GetYourGuide's website pairs a midnight-blue ink #1a2b49 on white with a vivid interactive blue #0071eb, a coral #ff5533 brand mark colour and critical red #c72a3d for discounts; GT Eesti bold at 36px for the hero, 80px pill buttons, 12px photo cards and a published semantic CSS token layer.

ghb.name: ธนาคารอาคารสงเคราะห์ (Government Housing Bank, GH Bank)
ghb.description: Thai state housing bank site on a white #ffffff canvas with #333333 body ink, orange #e64500 and #fe5000 as the brand colors, Google Sans at 13px to 18px for Latin and Thai text, DB Heaventbold at 24px for the Thai menu, 6px card radius and a #f0f0f0 grey footer band under an orange rule.

gibson.name: Gibson
gibson.description: Gibson guitar retail site: white #ffffff canvas with #000000 ink, full-bleed black photographic hero, Inter Tight at 16px to 48px in weights 500 and 600, pill buttons at 25px radius, a gold #86764b secondary button and #f7f7f7 product cards with a 10px radius and soft shadow.

gil-huybrecht.name: Gil Huybrecht — Freelance designer & art director
gil-huybrecht.description: Black portfolio page for freelance designer and art director Gil Huybrecht: #000000 canvas, #ffffff text, a single sans typeface at 14.5067px weight 500, a six-column header row, project rows of numbered thumbnails and a 4.27px radius on tags, with no buttons, shadows or accent colors.

gilead.name: Gilead Sciences
gilead.description: Gilead Sciences corporate site: white and #f4f5f4 canvas, #222222 text, crimson #c5203f square-cornered buttons 50px to 60px tall, proxima-nova from 18px to 40px at weights 400 and 500, pale pink, teal and blue stat panels with a 5px radius and soft grey shadow, and a #e2eaf4 blue footer.

gitbook.name: GitBook
gitbook.description: GitBook's home page sets General Sans Bold headlines (45px/700, -0.9px) in warm near-black #1c1917 on white, with General Sans 18px body in stone grey #57534d, a single flame-orange accent #fe551b, black 99px pill CTAs and 8px/16px-radius white product panels on a #fafaf9 warm-grey band.

github.name: GitHub

helsinki.name: City of Helsinki
helsinki.description: The City of Helsinki homepage (hel.fi) uses HelsinkiGrotesk at weights 400 to 500, a white #ffffff canvas with #1a1a1a ink, square black buttons, a #c2a251 gold hero band with a wave edge and a 64px display headline at -1.2px tracking, plus #f2f2f2 service panels and a pale blue #e8f3fc news box.

heng-leasing.name: Heng Leasing and Capital
heng-leasing.description: Heng Leasing and Capital (hengleasing.com), a Thai vehicle-loan company on WordPress: brand green #016938 header and headings, red #b20000 call-to-action buttons, white canvas, Prompt at 400 and 16px body, 30px display heading, square 0px buttons.

heptabase.name: Heptabase
heptabase.description: Heptabase (heptabase.com): a quiet eggshell-white landing page for a visual knowledge base. Instrument Sans 500 headlines at 48px/62.4px with -1.584px tracking, Inter 16px/24px body in #2e2e2e, a #2e2e2e charcoal 10px-radius Start your 7-day trial button, 6px-radius cards with rgba(0,0,0,.08) hairlines, and large pastel-sky product screenshots.

herman-miller.name: Herman Miller
