herman-miller.description: Herman Miller's site (hermanmiller.com) is a bright, photo-led corporate system set entirely in FF Meta (served as 'Meta' at 400/500/700) with slight negative tracking: #252525 ink on #ffffff, a #ebebeb footer, the #e62b00 red circle-M logo as the only brand colour, 40px/52px bold white headlines over full-bleed photography, white 5px-radius 'Discover Now' buttons with a 4px white border that turn #ebebeb on hover, and a 1px #cccccc 5px-radius search field.

hermes.name: Hermès
hermes.description: Hermès' US online store (hermes.com/us/en) is a quiet cream-paper system: #fcf7f1 canvas with #fffcf7 media wells and a white footer, pure #000000 ink, three free typefaces in strict roles — EBGaramond italic for editorial (34px/440 titles, 20px paragraphs), Overpass Mono uppercase for labels and buttons (12px/300 category labels, 12px/500 buttons), Manrope for UI (12px/400, 10px/700 tracked nav) — 0px photo corners and a single 4px-radius outlined black button.

heroku.name: Heroku
heroku.description: Heroku's marketing site pairs a deep-purple gradient hero (Purple 15 #300b60 to Purple 30 #5a1ba9) with white content bands, Avant Garde 600 headlines (40px/48px), Salesforce Sans body at 16px, Salesforce Blue (#0176d3) buttons with a 4px radius, and flat line-art icons.

heroui.name: HeroUI
heroui.description: HeroUI (formerly NextUI) v3 marketing site: a light #f5f5f5 canvas with white #ffffff surfaces, Inter 700 headlines at 48px with -1.2px tracking, a single azure #0485f7 accent on fully rounded 24px buttons, 12px fields and 24px cards on faint layered shadows.

hersheys.name: Hersheyland
hersheys.description: hersheyland.com (Hersheyland, the Hershey Company's recipes, products and inspiration site, reached from hersheys.com): chocolate-brown #3f000b ink on #f6f6f6 and white, Gazpacho 900 headlines (48px hero) with TT Norms Pro body at 17px, #007bbd pill buttons with 35 to 50px radii, 8px-radius cards with navy #003594 bottom bars and plum #460e3d hero bands.

hgc-global-communications-thailand.name: HGC International Business
hgc-global-communications-thailand.description: hgc-intl.com, HGC International Business (the parent group's international telecom and ICT site that the Thailand entry points to): white canvas with #212529 ink, signal-red #e02926 square buttons and panels, Montserrat 700 headlines (50px hero, 40px section) over Nunito 12px copy, and a 0px radius on every element.

hhhusher.name: HHHusher
hhhusher.description: hhhusher.com, product site for HHHusher, a hi-hat sound enclosure for drum recording: #212121 near-black pages with #f3f1e0 cream text, a tan #ad9069 section field, a single #ffcc00 yellow BUY and feature card, UniversalSans Display at weight 100 (60.4444px) with Aeonik Fono uppercase 10.6667px labels and 4.44px to 5px radii.

hilden-kaira.name: Hildén & Kaira
hilden-kaira.description: hildenkaira.fi, the Finnish-domain social media agency Hildén & Kaira: a #181818 black and #eae9e6 off-white page with lime #ecfdad accents, PP Editorial New serif headlines (55.8545px hero, tight -1.11709px tracking) over PP Neue Montreal 9.30909px copy, chrome 3D-rendered logo and icons, and 9.30909px rounded lime and black buttons.

hino-motors-sales-thailand.name: Hino Motors Sales Thailand
hino-motors-sales-thailand.description: hinothailand.com, the Thai site of Hino Motors Sales (Thailand) Co., Ltd.: a white canvas of full-bleed truck photography in Poppins and Prompt (14px weight 300 labels, 27px bold uppercase headings), #727272 grey copy, signal-red #ed1c24 buttons and nav hover, 4px-radius controls with one 70px pill, and a dealer-search card.

hobro-digital.name: HOBRO
hobro-digital.description: hobro.digital, the site of HOBRO, a design-first full-cycle digital agency: alternating #ffffff and #000000 bands, PPNeueMontreal text at 18px, AkkuratMono uppercase 14px labels, giant Kamerik205 and FreigBigProLigIta italic display (193.333px), pill buttons with a 33px radius, and a mint #00fb96 brand variable used for the cursor dot.

homepro.name: HomePro
homepro.description: HomePro (โฮมโปร) Thai home-improvement retail site measured live: Prompt typeface throughout, brand blue #0065b2 header, footer and CTAs with white text, #112332 body ink, #da3731 sale red, 10px button radius, 44px buttons, 48px search input, dense promo-tile grid on a white canvas.

homerun.name: HOMERUN Creative Things
homerun.description: HOMERUN Creative Things (homerun.today), formerly ROSBEEF!, is a creative agency site measured live: near-black #181817 hero with cream #f8f7ec ink, oversized lilac #edd4f8 wordmark, orange #e56138, green #2d5a36 and sky #cdf0ff blocks, Space Grotesk headings, Figtree body, pill-shaped controls.

honda.name: Honda Global Corporate Website
honda.description: Honda Motor Co.'s global corporate site global.honda/en measured live — white #ffffff and #f6f6f6 bands, charcoal #35363b text and outlined CTAs, black #000000 hero and legal strip, #cc0000 Honda red in the CSS, the custom HondaGlobalFontEN Regular/Light at weight 400 (32px tracked section titles, 16px body) and square 0px corners everywhere.

honda-automobile-thailand.name: Honda Automobile Thailand
honda-automobile-thailand.description: Honda Automobile Thailand (honda.co.th/en) measured live: dbHeaventFont throughout, Honda red #cc0100 GET DEAL button with square corners, #303030 headings on a #f0f0f0 and white canvas, #373f4e slate footer, 42.6667px display text, outlined Discover More buttons and photographic car heroes.

honda-motorcycle-thailand.name: Honda Motorcycle Thailand
honda-motorcycle-thailand.description: Honda Motorcycle Thailand (Thai Honda, thaihonda.co.th/honda) measured live: ap_honda custom Thai typeface, Honda red #ec1b2e and #ed1a29 on white and #f2f2f2, #222222 ink, 40px bold section headings, 3px-radius red register button, red FIND DEALER side tab and motorcycle product carousels.

hootsuite.name: Hootsuite
hootsuite.description: Hootsuite's social-media-management site: Montserrat throughout (35.84px/600 hero, 36px/700 section heads, 16px/500 body), Nocturn #012b3a ink on white and #f2f4f5 bands, hyperlink-blue #1f60c9 buttons with 4.736px and 8px corners, Saffron #e03035 accents and soft navy-tinted shadows.

hopper.name: Hopper
hopper.description: Hopper's consumer travel-booking site is a white (#ffffff) canvas set in Proxima Nova, a full-bleed destination photograph with a pill search bar, a single saturated blue (#1878ec) for action and links, near-black (#111111) headlines, grey (#606060) body copy, and shapes stepping from 4px through 12px and 32px to full pills.

hotjar.name: Contentsquare
hotjar.description: Contentsquare's Hotjar landing page (where hotjar.com now redirects): white #ffffff and sage-white #f7f8f6 bands, near-black #0d0d0d ink, raspberry #cd3246 'Sign up free' buttons, wine #7c0033 and deep plum #440220 brand tones, NewEdgeRounded 48px/400 headlines over Inter 16px body, 8px cards.

house-of-corto.name: House of Corto
house-of-corto.description: House of Corto (houseofcorto.com), furniture by Jessica Mille, measured live: warm #f2efe7 canvas, forest green #2b3e0d ink, olive #63692b, lilac #c7b1da menu, canada-type-gibson 900 uppercase micro-labels at 9.6px, square corners and a borderless photo grid of chairs and tables.

house-of-honey-1.name: House of Honey
house-of-honey-1.description: House of Honey (houseofhoney.com), a female-led interior design studio in South Pasadena, measured live: peach #edccbe and deep brown #331917 sections, hot pink #fc72c4 script wordmark, noeText serif uppercase display, neueHaasGrotesk body, square corners and a 32px Get in Touch button.

hp.name: HP
hp.description: HP (hp.com/us-en) measured live: forma-djr-micro typeface, electric blue #024ad8 Shop buttons with 8px radius and white text, #1a1a1a ink, white and #f5f5f5 surfaces, 56px display headings at weight 500, 16px card radius and product-photography tiles under an hpi- token system.

hsbc.name: HSBC Group
hsbc.description: HSBC Group corporate website (hsbc.com) measured live: UniversNext typeface in light 200 at 65px for hero display, black #000000 ink on white and #f5f6f7 surfaces, HSBC red #da0011 accents, 3px-radius outlined white hero button over photography, and white content cards in an offset two-column grid.

hsbc-thailand.name: HSBC Thailand
hsbc-thailand.description: HSBC Thailand homepage: square-cornered, white-canvas corporate banking site in the licensed univers-hsbc face (weights 100 to 700), 60px weight-100 display headline, #333333 ink, HSBC red #db0011 on a 41px Log on button, light grey #ededed notice panels and hairline #d7d8d6.

huawei.name: Huawei
huawei.description: Huawei corporate site (huawei.com/en) measured live: HuaweiSans Regular and Bold, Huawei red #c7000b for links, underline accents and chevrons, #191919 ink on white and #f3f3f3 surfaces, 16px-radius white cards, 6px 48px search input, built on an hwp- design token system with red 60 brand colour.

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.description: HubSpot home page (hubspot.com) measured live: HubSpot Serif light 65px display headlines, HubSpot Sans body, orange #ff4800 filled and outlined 8px-radius buttons (68px tall), #1f1f1f ink on white and #fcfcfa, peach #fcded2 and dark teal #061c1d sections, 16px-radius hub cards under the cl- Canvas-style token system.

hubtown.name: Hubtown
hubtown.description: Hubtown Limited (hubtown.co.in), an Indian real estate developer, measured live: near-black navy #020a18 canvas with pale periwinkle #d5e0ff ink, Commit Mono uppercase micro-labels at 9px with 1.44px tracking, Grotesk Bold buttons, 5 percent tinted #d5e0ff0d button fills and a glowing blue 3D cube hero.

huge.name: Huge
huge.description: Huge (hugeinc.com), a digital experience agency, measured live: matter typeface at weight 600 with -0.05em tracking from a 284.8px "Hello." hero to 42px copy, magenta #ff0090 accents, #0d0b0a ink on white and warm #faf8f4 tiles, a white 999px pill Let's talk button and 16px client-logo tiles.

huggingface.name: Hugging Face
huggingface.description: Hugging Face (huggingface.co) measured home page: white canvas with a near-black #0b0f19 hero panel, Source Sans Pro 400/600/700 with IBM Plex Mono for repo names, a #101828 pill Sign Up button, 8px and 12px radii, and a Tailwind v4 token layer. Brand marks are yellow #ffd21e and orange #ff9d00.

hugo-boss.name: HUGO BOSS
hugo-boss.description: HUGO BOSS US online shop (hugoboss.com/us/home) measured: full-bleed campaign photography under a translucent #edededcc pill-cornered nav bar, AvertaPE sans in uppercase 800-weight headlines (54px HIGHLIGHTS, 24px hero), 15px weight-100 body text, a near-black #1c1c1c footer, and no shadows.

huneety.name: Huneety
huneety.description: Thai career platform for interns and young graduates (Huneety, Thailand at Work): turquoise #50ccc0 accents, pastel mint, cream and cyan cards, Noto Sans Thai at 16px with 900-weight 48px display, 4px buttons and 8px cards, grey #737373 footer.

hungry-tiger.name: Hungry Tiger
hungry-tiger.description: Hungry Tiger (eathungrytiger.com) measured: a fire-roasted Indian sauce brand on a #823513 brown canvas with #faae33 saffron text and pill buttons, a #402011 dark-brown label color, Salmond 700 uppercase display type up to 189.44px with negative tracking, Graphikx 500 nav, and no shadows.

hut-8.name: Hut 8
hut-8.description: Hut 8 (hut8.com) measured: a #080808 off-black canvas over full-bleed industrial footage, ITC Franklin Gothic Std 400/500 with negative tracking (60px/-1.8px headings, 14px body), off-white #f8f8f8 text, a #b3ff00 bright-green accent, square corners and no shadows or borders.

hyundai.name: Hyundai Mobility Thailand
hyundai.description: Hyundai Mobility Thailand (hyundai.com/th/th, the Thai-language Hyundai site) measured: white and warm #f6f3f2 surfaces, Hyundai navy #002c5f square-cornered buttons (50px high), HyundaiRegular/HyundaiMedium with KanitRegular Thai fallback, 58px/71px headings, a #1c1b1b footer and a navy dealer-locator panel.

ibank.name: Islamic Bank of Thailand
ibank.description: Islamic Bank of Thailand (ไอแบงก์) homepage: white canvas with Islamic-bank green #018749 pill buttons (50px radius, 45px tall), a deep green #164614 audience bar, gold #e4b963 and #ffb300 sections, teal #0ec1ac band, and the self-hosted Sukhumvit Tadmai Thai faces at 16px body and 50px display.

ibm.name: Carbon Design System
ibm.description: Carbon is IBM's open-source design system: square-cornered (0px) controls, IBM Plex Sans and Plex Serif, a #f4f4f4 and #ffffff layered canvas, near-black #161616 ink, a single IBM Blue 60 (#0f62fe) action color, #393939 secondary and #da1e28 danger buttons 48px tall, built on an 8px mini-unit 2x grid and role-based color tokens.

icbc.name: 中国工商银行 (ICBC Ltd corporate site)
icbc.description: ICBC Ltd corporate site (icbc-ltd.com) measured: a 1280px white page of Arial 12px/22px text, ICBC red #bc0021 links and bullets, #666666 body copy, #f2f2f2 panels, a #d1d1d1 hairline on the 宋体 search field, a red navigation bar and 0px computed radii everywhere.

icbc-thai.name: ICBC (Thai)
icbc-thai.description: ICBC (Thai) public company site: a dense, legacy portal on a white canvas with Arial 12px text, #333333 body ink, ICBC red #bc0021 as the dominant stylesheet colour (red navigation bar, red login buttons), 3px and 30px radii, and bilingual Thai, English and Chinese navigation.

ichitan.name: Ichitan Group
ichitan.description: Ichitan Group (ichitangroup.com/en) measured: investor-and-brand site with Poppins and Noto Sans Thai, a 57px/500 white hero headline, #e30613 red pill buttons (40px radius, 8px 32px padding), 20px-radius news cards on a #f2efe8 band, a #3b996d green accent and a black footer.

icomat.name: ICOMAT
icomat.description: ICOMAT (icomat.co.uk) measured: 'Engineer Without Limits' composites manufacturer on a #f8f8f8 canvas with a #080808 dark hero, LayGrotesk-Semibold headlines (69.3px, -1.04px tracking), AkkuratMono 11.24px uppercase labels, translucent #ffffff1c buttons with 7.49px radius, #cfd9e0 pale steel text and a 1px inset shadow.

iconsiam.name: ICONSIAM
iconsiam.description: ICONSIAM (iconsiam.com/en) measured: a Bangkok riverside mall site in Gotham with Thai (DBAdmanX) and Chinese (NotoSansSC) companions, antique gold #8c7225 bars and footer, cream #f4edd7 bands, #475467 body copy, a #f7e907 yellow Register Now button, square 0px buttons 48px high and no shadows.

ideo.name: IDEO
ideo.description: IDEO's 2025 Webflow site is a dark-ink editorial system — near-black slate #151f27 page wrapper, a single acid-lime "Alchemy" accent #d9ff00 for headlines, links and the Say hello button, white #ffffff copy, and slate blues #7b92a5 / #536575 for the footer, menu and hairline card borders. Type is FH Oscar (served as "Fhoscar") at Light 300 for 80px display and 40px section heads, Medium 500 at 20px for UI and lede copy, with Manrope 18px for long-form case-study prose. Every corner is square (0px radius), cards are 1px outlined boxes, and there are no shadows.

iheartradio.name: iHeartRadio
iheartradio.description: iHeartRadio web player home (iheart.com) measured: a light app shell in Open Sans Variable with a #f6f8f9 page, white sidebar, #cc032e iHeart red pill buttons (990px radius, 32px high), #27292d ink, 6px radius tiles, 0.15-alpha elevation shadows and an internal 'accomplice' token set.

ikea.name: IKEA
ikea.description: IKEA's US storefront (ikea.com/us/en) is a white-canvas, photo-first retail system set entirely in Noto IKEA at 400 and 700: #111111 ink with #484848 secondary text, #f5f5f5 light-grey pills and footer, a #111111 utility bar, #0058a3 IKEA-blue 'Add to bag' pills (56px tall, 64px radius, hover #004f93), #007cc1 IKEA Family tiles and badges, #ffdb00 brand yellow, square 0px photo tiles in a 12px-gap bento grid, and tight negative tracking on bold headings (40px/-1.39286px).

il-capo-production.name: IL CAPO PRODUCTION
il-capo-production.description: Il Capo Production (ilcapoproduction.com, 'Industrial Cinema 2.0') measured: a #000000 canvas with one brand red #d60001 for text and a full-bleed red footer, IvarDisplay serif in uppercase (120px titles, 30px nav) paired with HelveticaNeue 21px, a giant red ILCAPO wordmark over film footage and 0px radii.

illoca.name: illoca
illoca.description: illoca is an architectural design tool whose marketing site pairs a graph-paper cream page (#eadfc9) and charcoal ink (#373737) with a single cobalt blue (#283f7d, the site's own --color-primary), setting headlines in F37 Analog, body in Graphik Web at 13.3333px, and UI labels in Geist Mono, with radii held to 1.33px and 2.67px.

illumina.name: Illumina
illumina.description: Illumina's home page is a clean white and warm-grey (#f4f2f0) science-marketing page set entirely in Inter (light 300 headlines at 49.024px, 17.536px body), with pill buttons of 100px radius in periwinkle #4e60ee and dark #1f1d1a spotlight bands carrying orange and violet gradients.

immersive-garden-website.name: Immersive Garden
immersive-garden-website.description: Immersive Garden, a digital experiences studio, shows a monochrome plaster-relief hero on a light grey canvas (#e8e8e8) with near-black ink (#030303), setting statements in the serif PSTimes at 28px and 32px and its single Menu control in HelveticaNeueRegular at 14px, with no rounded corners, shadows or colored buttons.

impact-growth-reit.name: IMPACT Arena, Exhibition and Convention Center
impact-growth-reit.description: Event-venue site for IMPACT Muang Thong Thani, set in Helvetica Neue on a light grey #ededed canvas with a #1c3fa3 pill call-to-action (9999px radius, 15px type, 1px tracking), black #000000 body ink, 44px display headings and 8px-radius white event cards.

imperial-college-london.name: Imperial College London
imperial-college-london.description: Imperial College London pairs a white page and charcoal ink (#161a1d) with a bright spring green (#00ff7f) used for links on dark panels and the course-finder band, setting everything in its own variable font ImperialText at 19.447px body and 700-weight headlines from 26.8243px to 60.1061px, with square corners (0px) throughout.

impronta.name: Impronta
impronta.description: Impronta (improntahome.com), Italian maker of designer windows and doors: white #ffffff canvas, charcoal #2a2a2a ink and button blocks, SuisseBPIntl Medium at 37.5px for headlines and 9px uppercase labels, square corners, split dark title bars and full-bleed architectural photography.

inclusive-components.name: Inclusive Components
inclusive-components.description: Inclusive Components by Heydon Pickering: a blog-as-pattern-library in two values, off-white #fefefe and charcoal #222222, Miriam Libre 700 headings at 89.6px, Asap 19.04px body, #80b3ff focus ring, dashed rules and white plug illustrations.

indara.name: Indara Insurance
indara.description: Indara Insurance (อินทรประกันภัย) Thai homepage: IBM Plex Sans Thai in four file-weights, near-black ink (#111111) with forest green (#257e65) accents and navy (#123663) detail, light #f1f5f8 and #fafafa bands, 12px-radius photo tiles with white captions, soft 1px 5px shadows and a green announcement hero.

index-living-mall.name: Index Living Mall
index-living-mall.description: Index Living Mall (อินเด็กซ์ ลิฟวิ่งมอลล์), a Thai furniture and home-goods retailer, runs a dense white storefront (#ffffff, #f6f6f6 bands) with body text #515151 and price-red #e00000, set in its own Index typeface at 16px weight 200, uppercase 32px bold section headings and 4px card corners.

indigo-laboratory.name: Indigo
indigo-laboratory.description: Indigo (indigo-laboratory.it, '5 tales of being'), a contemporary jewelry house, builds an editorial experience on a warm paper canvas (#f4f3eb) and near-black ink (#030303) with violet (#6a15ff), in Hanken Grotesk 900 at 100px with -6px tracking, IBM Plex Mono labels, the display face Palette Mosaic at 240px, and square 0px corners.

indorama-ventures.name: Indorama Ventures
indorama-ventures.description: Indorama Ventures, a global PET, fibers and packaging chemicals producer, uses a white page with navy ink and panels (#002e61), signal red (#cc0033) and green (#009933) pill buttons, pale teal bands (#d6ebeb), and Noto Sans at weight 300 for 16px body with 36px light headlines and 24px bold uppercase business titles.

infor.name: Infor
infor.description: Infor is an industry-cloud enterprise software company whose homepage pairs Montserrat headlines (500, 40px) with Source Sans 3 body text (18px) on white and light grey #f2f3f4, deep slate ink #15262e, a single violet primary #460daf for 8px-radius buttons, and a signature red #d5000e for the logo, eyebrows and active navigation.

ing.name: ING
ing.description: ING (ing.com), the Dutch banking group, pairs its signature orange (#ff6200) with white, near-black ink (#151515) and indigo links (#525199), set in the proprietary INGMe and INGDisplay families (64px hero, 16px body), with pill outlines at 50px, 8px buttons and a floating rounded navigation.

ini3.name: Ini3 Digital
ini3.description: Ini3 Digital PLC, a Thai online-games publisher, on a #353535 charcoal canvas with white ink, a single #ff7a00 orange accent, PT Sans Narrow 700 at 120px for headings, Hind Siliguri body at 21.6px, square-cornered outlined buttons with a translucent black fill, and black label chips over staff photography.

ink-games.name: INK Games
ink-games.description: INK Games, a game studio and publisher, runs a near-black page (#0a0e11) with off-white text (#fafbfd), a full-bleed electric purple section (#c74fff) with deep violet type (#4c0070), huge uppercase RuderPlakatLL headlines up to 211.905px and PP Neue Montreal and Montreal Mono for 17px body and 15px buttons.

inkfish.name: Inkfish
inkfish.description: Inkfish, a New York commercial production company, uses a white page (#ffffff) and pure black (#000000) with a near-black stage (#010101), setting 142.222px uppercase NT Dapper display words with -5.68889px tracking and 10.6667px uppercase Martian Mono labels, with square corners and no color accents.

inngest.name: Inngest
inngest.description: Inngest's durable-execution site: a #1c1c1c charcoal canvas, white ink with #b3b3b3 secondary text, a salmon #f65c4f primary button with 6px corners and uppercase WhyteMono 12px labels, uppercase Whyte 72px display type, CircularXX 18px body copy and an electric-blue #013cf6 feature band.

insta360.name: Insta360
insta360.description: Insta360 (insta360.com), the 360-camera maker, uses a pale cloud-white canvas (#f8f9fc) with graphite ink (#262629), a single signature yellow (#ffe100) for the Store button, dark #1d1d1f Buy/Compare buttons, 24px-radius product cards, and Poppins Num with MiSans VF fallback at 56px/600 headlines and 14px body.

instacart.name: Instacart
instacart.description: Instacart's US grocery marketplace: a white #ffffff canvas under a warm #f7f5f0 header, a deep-kale #003d29 hero band, Instacart Green #108910 pill buttons (hover #007200) with 20px/28px radii, #343538 and #242529 grey ink, #e8e9eb filter chips at 999px, 8px-radius retailer cards with a #0000001f hairline, #ffdc23 deal badges, all set in the custom Instacart Sans (400/600/700).

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.description: Instagram's logged-out web entry page: white #ffffff canvas, #111112 headline in Instagram Sans Regular at 35.84px, #737373 footer text at 12px, a #0064e0 blue for the login button and outlined create-account pill, Optimistic for form text, and 16px to 40px radii around a login panel next to a collage illustration.

instantly.name: Instantly
instantly.description: Instantly (instantly.ai) is a sales-engagement SaaS site set entirely in Avertastd (600 Title-Case headlines at 40px, -1.5 to -2px tracking), black #000000 pill buttons (100px radius) on a near-white #fbfbfc canvas, grey #6d727e copy, blue-gradient product panels with #4580f7 accents and very deep layered card shadows.

instructure.name: Instructure
instructure.description: Instructure's site is a Drupal-built marketing page in deep navy ink #061c30 on near-white #fefefe, with Circular-style 'circularxx' type at 48px bold with -3px tracking, cobalt #0e35b3 pill buttons (25px radius, 2px border), navy rounded stat cards, and a white mega-menu panel.

instrument.name: Instrument
instrument.description: Instrument (Portland digital agency) runs a monochrome editorial system — near-black #070708 on white #ffffff, a giant black masthead wordmark, the agency's own open-source Instrument Sans (variable, wdth 80–100) and condensed Instrument Serif at 60–285px, 999px pill buttons with 12% shade fills, 24px-rounded square media cards and fluid type that scales with the viewport (22.5px body at 1280px).

integratedbio.name: Integrated Biosciences
integratedbio.description: Integrated Biosciences, an aging-medicine biotech site: warm off-white canvas #f7f7f5, deep teal-ink #222f30, Aspekta light-weight sans at 18.52px body with negative tracking, Roboto Mono uppercase 13.68px for nav and buttons, 8px button radius, large rounded cinematic hero image.

intel.name: Intel
intel.description: Intel homepage: a navy #000f28 hero and header over a white #ffffff body, intel-one-display-medium type at 218px with tight tracking, 20px/30px intel-one-body-text, Intel blue #0046c8 accent with cyan #00c7fd brand highlight, and small outlined 100px pill buttons.

intercom.name: Intercom
intercom.description: Intercom's marketing site: warm off-white #faf9f6 canvas with white and chalk #f1eee9 panels, near-black #111111 buttons with 4px corners turning cobalt #0007cb on hover, Saans display at 80px with -2.4px tracking, Serrif light body, mono caps labels, and one Fin orange #ff5600 accent.

interlink-telecom.name: Interlink Telecom
interlink-telecom.description: Interlink Telecom (ITEL), a Thai fiber-optic and data-center network operator: Prompt typeface in light weight 300 at 16px body, 45px display, brand orange #ff7b23 pill buttons at 36px radius, white canvas, grey #707070 text and dark #292929 footer over dark network photography.

internalities.name: Internalities
internalities.description: Internalities, the Pavilion of Spain site for the 2025 Venice Architecture Biennale: flat grey canvas #ebebeb, charcoal ink #393939, a gigantic wordmark, ShinkaMono monospace and ABC Camera Plain at 14px / 16px weight 400, zero borders or shadows, with a faint vertical column grid.

international-gateway.name: International Gateway
international-gateway.description: International Gateway Co., Ltd. (IGC), a Thai neutral gateway and submarine-cable carrier: Noto Sans Thai headings at 700 / 40px uppercase in indigo #303188, Calibri 17.33px body, teal #00a8a2 hover accent, lime #4fd946, white canvas, rounded 20px to 50px green cards and pills.

intouch.name: Intouch Holdings
intouch.description: Intouch Holdings PCL, a Thai telecom and technology holding company: Inter with Noto Sans Thai at weight 300 and 16px body, brand green #69a72a with lime #ccdc04 pill buttons at 99px radius, white canvas, black footer, 20px to 30px rounded cards with a 0 30px 40px soft shadow.

intuit.name: Intuit
intuit.description: Intuit.com home page — white and pale-grey (#f4f5f8) canvas, deep indigo ink (#0d0031), a single saturated action blue (#236cff) on 60px-radius 52px-tall pill buttons, Tally and Tally Display typefaces with 40px/500 headings, and rounded gradient product cards (green, navy, yellow) holding rounded photographs.

intuitive-surgical.name: Intuitive
intuitive-surgical.description: Intuitive, maker of da Vinci and Ion robotic surgical systems: white canvas with #f3f3f3 and #dcdce0 panels, near-black #1c1c1f pill buttons at 24px radius turning cobalt #0f25d2 on hover, BrownPro headings at 72px and 36px, InterUI body at 15px, 16px rounded cards.

ionity.name: IONITY
ionity.description: IONITY, the European high-power EV charging network: deep navy canvas #000032, white text, magenta #ff0074 and purple #702283 gradient cards, Foco W Rg and Foco W Bd type with a 97.9px display, pill-shaped white and outline buttons at 999px radius, full-bleed photography.

ironhill.name: Ironhill
ironhill.description: Ironhill (ironhill.au), an Australian drinks brand site themed as a place the maps don't show: warm cream #f4eddd canvas, forest green #344128 text and bands, yellow #fec820 menu toggle, PP Woodland Light at 260px, 70px and 16px, 4px radius and thin contour-line illustration.

isuzu-motors-thailand.name: ISUZU Group Thailand
isuzu-motors-thailand.description: ISUZU Group Thailand corporate entry page (isuzu.co.th), operated by ISUZU Motors Asia (Thailand) Co., Ltd.: white canvas, grey #707070 DB Helvethaica X menu at 26px, ISUZU red #ed1b2f and #ff0000 accents, black #000000 footer bar, all corners square (0px), full-bleed sky photograph.

isuzu-thailand-tri-petch-isuzu.name: Isuzu Thailand
isuzu-thailand-tri-petch-isuzu.description: Isuzu Thailand Official (isuzu-tis.com), the Thai consumer site for Isuzu vehicles: white canvas, near-black #1d1d1d ink, Isuzu red #ed1c24 buttons turning #a11116 on hover, NotoSansThai Regular and Bold at 18px body, EurothaiDemiExt 64px headings, 4px button radius and 12px cards.

italy-gov.name: Governo Italiano
italy-gov.description: Governo Italiano (www.governo.it), the Italian government's institutional site, is set entirely in Titillium Web with #0066cc institutional blue for links and navigation, a #444e57 slate Focus band, #eeeeee and #ffffff content areas, 4px-cornered cards, and a green-white-red stripe under the header.

itch-io.name: itch.io
itch-io.description: itch.io is an open indie-game marketplace with a utilitarian, catalog-dense interface — a white #ffffff main column beside a #f4f4f4 sidebar, near-black #222222 Lato text at 12–20px, hot red #ff2449 actions with a deeper #da2c49 for tags and links, the official 'itchy carnation' #fa5c5c brand color, and tiny 2–4px radii on outline buttons, price tags and thumbnails. Cover art does all the color work; the chrome stays flat, bordered and quiet.

iventions.name: Iventions
iventions.description: Iventions, an international event, exhibit and sports agency: electric lime #e0ff98 sections and warm off-white #f3efeb, near-black #1e1e1e ink, Soehne at 500 with a 106.667px wordmark-scale display and tight negative tracking, ABC Arizona Mix 24px nav, lavender #9c93e8 and purple #8072ff accents.

ivress-spin-a-tale.name: SPIN A TALE (IVRESS Brand Site)
ivress-spin-a-tale.description: Dark, story-driven brand microsite for the Japanese company IVRESS: near-black canvas #000203, warm off-white ink #faf5f0, amber highlight #f9b639, Basilia Compress D condensed display, Josefin Sans UI labels, A-OTF Ryumin serif for Japanese narrative text, and 48px pill outline buttons.

iwc-schaffhausen.name: IWC Schaffhausen
iwc-schaffhausen.description: Swiss luxury watchmaker's worldwide home page (iwc.com/ww-en): pure white canvas #ffffff, black #000000 ink, a single HelveticaNeue family at 400 and 500, 32px display with 0.32px tracking, 12px uppercase buttons with 0.6px tracking, a round 73px black PLAY control, and no shadows.

iyo.name: iyO
iyo.description: Dark, near-black (#101010) home page for iyO, a maker of agentic voice computers: pearl-grey #dddee3 type, a three-face stack of Magnetik 33.6px display, Roobert Regular and Nbarchitekproneue 9.6px body, a floating pill nav, 12.8px to 42px radii and no shadows.

izanami.name: Izanami
izanami.description: Japanese-harmony brand site (Dubai and Tokyo) set on a near-black warm field #0a0801 with soft stone-grey #d9d7d4 text, a Cinzel, Playfair Display and Shippori Mincho serif trio at 12.8px to 16px, 30.72px reading line-height, a full-bleed fog-forest hero and every corner square (0px).

jacques-cie.name: Jacques + Cie
jacques-cie.description: French-Canadian dental clinic site (Quebec City, Sainte-Foy) in warm cream #f7f3eb with deep indigo #333347 text, a periwinkle #84b0e8 button fill, Aeonik at weight 400 from 14px to a 104px hero, and 20px rounded 50px-high buttons with no shadows.

jaeger-lecoultre.name: Jaeger-LeCoultre
jaeger-lecoultre.description: Swiss watch maison's US English home page: full-bleed dark campaign video blocks over white and #f3f1ed stone, warm-black #201f1e square buttons, bronze-beige #b7a98e labels, uppercase Decimal 600 headlines at 45px and GothamSSm 15px body, 2px inputs and no shadows.

jaguar.name: Jaguar
jaguar.description: Jaguar's international home page (jaguar.com/en-xi), warm stone #ebece6 with charcoal #333433 text, an in-house jaguar typeface from weight 100 at a 145px hero to 16px buttons, white 56px-high pill buttons with 56px radii, 9px cards and a dark footer wordmark.

jam-area.name: Jam Area
jam-area.description: Italian communication and branding agency (Lake Maggiore): a single 800px screen on cream #fefff8 with charcoal #1e1e1e, giant 301px FKScreamer JAM and AREA wordmarks, 18.8px NeueMontreal-Bold labels, a red #e11010 accent dot, floating work thumbnails and no shadows.

jao-chang.name: จ้าวช้างไวไฟ
jao-chang.description: Thai agricultural-machinery brand site (rice combine harvesters, Phitsanulok) in Prompt headings and Kanit body, orange #ff7700 as the brand action colour, navy #1e3a8a as secondary, slate ink #64748b and #1e293b on #ffffff with 22px-radius product cards and pill buttons.

jas-asset.name: JAS Asset
jas-asset.description: JAS Asset (jasasset.co.th) Thai listed rental-space and property company site: red #bb020b accents and cards, Lora 500 serif display with Poppins body, grey #53565a chairman band, #f7f7f7 and #f0f0f0 light sections, outlined 16px buttons with a 20px bottom-right corner and 44px card corner.

jasmine-gunarto.name: Jasmine Gunarto
jasmine-gunarto.description: Motion designer's portfolio (New York): warm grey canvas #ebeae4 with near-black #090909 ink, a gigantic 252px uppercase mg display at weight 800 and Manrope 800 labels at 10 to 12px, cream #eee9d1 nav text, 25.4px pill tags, one dark project row and no drop shadows.

jason-bergh.name: Jason Bergh
jason-bergh.description: Director and cinematographer portfolio on pure black #000000 with lemon #ffeec8 type, an Editorial New 200 display at 84.48px (-1.6896px tracking), 6.4px Monument Grotesk Mono body labels, 9.728px uppercase Monument Grotesk nav, a #1e1e1c filter bar and 3px-radius thumbnails.

jasper.name: Jasper
jasper.description: Jasper, the AI agent platform for marketing teams: white #ffffff and #f2f2f3 surfaces, deep navy #00063d ink, flame #fa4028 square-cornered CTAs (0px radius, hover #801a10), Feature serif display at 73.83px/-2.21px over ABC ROM 16px/22.4px body at weight 450, and pastel tiles in peach, sky, mint, pink and lilac.

jaymart-group.name: Jaymart Group Holdings
jaymart-group.description: Bangkok holding company's English investor home page: white canvas with black #000000 text, Jaymart red #ed1c24 accents, Mukta 800 uppercase headings (80px display, 42px section) over 20px/30px body, a 100px side rail, 4px radii and soft grey card shadows #d6d6d6.

jaymart-insurance.name: Jaymart Insurance
jaymart-insurance.description: Jaymart Insurance homepage: Prompt typeface at 12px body and 14px links, charcoal ink (#333333), brand red (#d9282d) in a red gradient header and footer band, charcoal footer (#3e3e3e), white cards with 15px radius and a faint #d2d2d2 shadow, pill-shaped section labels at 40px radius and busy campaign banners.

jb-design.name: Seyed Mohammad Javad Bathaei Portfolio
jb-design.description: A one-person developer portfolio at javadbat.github.io, built on a pale blue gradient canvas with a single deep-blue brand ink (#00448c), a high-contrast display serif ("title-font", 700, 40px, 1.6px tracking) for the name, a rounded text face for everything else, 24px-radius grey-blue project cards and one soft, inset-shadowed pill button.

jbl.name: JBL Thailand
jbl.description: Harman's Thai storefront for JBL (th.jbl.com): white canvas with black text and a #ff3300 orange-red action color, Roc Grotesk headlines at 42px and 34px, Arial 14px body and uppercase 14px buttons with 1px tracking, 30px-radius pills and 10px/20px rounded tiles, a #111111 footer and glow shadows.

jd-com.name: JD.com Global (京东全球版)
jd-com.description: JD.com's global-edition shopping home page (global.jd.com), Simplified Chinese: cool grey canvas #f5f6fa with white 8px-radius cards, JD red #ff0f23 search button and hover color, Microsoft YaHei and PingFang SC at 12px to 18px, gray footer #eaeaea and a soft 2px 8px 1px shadow.

jeep-g.name: Jeep
jeep-g.description: Jeep.com, the official US Jeep site: white #ffffff canvas with black #000000 header and footer, #212121 headings, deep forest green #1e4544 brand buttons and a lighter #487f70 'VIEW INCENTIVES' button (hover #3a675b), 2px corners, uppercase Roboto 14px/700 labels with 0.7px tracking, and Roboto 700 headlines at 33px and 56px.

jesko-jets.name: Jesko Jets
jesko-jets.description: Private jet charter brand site on a warm cream canvas (#fff8ed) with espresso ink (#312726), stone accent (#7a716e) and black hero fields, set entirely in GT America Expanded and Extended with tight negative tracking, 64px display headings and small 5px to 53px radii plus a 9999px pill.

jesper-landberg-4.name: Jesper Landberg
jesper-landberg-4.description: Portfolio of Swedish design engineer Jesper Landberg: a pure black (#000000) stage with white (#ffffff) text, one variable sans at 11.9467px and 8.53333px uppercase labels, a floor grid and curved 3D project panels, with 17.07px and 9999px radii and no color accent.

jetblue.name: JetBlue
jetblue.description: JetBlue's booking site (jetblue.com) on a white #ffffff canvas with #f6f6f6 bands, set entirely in the in-house served face jbklarheit (book 400, semibold 600, extrabold 800). Action colour is the pure blue #0000aa (--color-primary) that darkens to navy #000080 on hover; headlines run in core blue #00205b and #000064, body copy in #212121. Shapes are soft: 24px promo cards, 12px category cards, full 9999px pill buttons, and a signature search button that is square on the left and pill-rounded on the right (0px 9999px 9999px 0px).

jetbrains.name: JetBrains
jetbrains.description: JetBrains' marketing site is a near-black developer canvas (#19191c over a #000000 page ground) with white text, white pill buttons with 26px radius, JetBrains Modul 250-weight lowercase display at 44px for the hero and JetBrains Sans for everything else, product cards outlined in translucent white, and pink #f31199 category accents.

jib-computer.name: JIB Computer Group
jib-computer.description: Thai IT retailer (JIB Online): navy #2c3d92 header, white canvas, #333333 Kanit text at 10-16px, red #c9302c and #ff0000 price and buy accents, 3px radii and square 0px buttons in a dense Bootstrap-era product grid.

jiffy.name: PTT Retail Management (Jiffy operator site)
jiffy.description: The corporate site of PTT Retail Management Company Limited (pttrm.com), the operator that publishes the Jiffy convenience-store promotions — a fixed-width white content panel on a deep navy page (#0e1b46), navy (#003371) tab buttons and footer, Lucida Grande at 11px to 13px, sky-blue (#0099ff) and pure blue (#0000ff) text links, and 4px corners.

jim-thompson.name: Jim Thompson
jim-thompson.description: Thai luxury silk and lifestyle retailer on a white canvas (#ffffff) with black ink (#000000), a custom Jim Thompson Roman serif at 40px for headings, Public Sans light 14px body and wide Akzidenz-Grotesk Pro Ext uppercase buttons with 1px radius and a #d83d26 hover.

jitter.name: Jitter
jitter.description: Jitter motion-design tool site: black TWK Lausanne 800 headlines (80px hero, 72px sections) with Inter 16px body, #19171c ink on white and #f2f1f3 cards with 40px corners, a lavender #b593ff pill CTA and black #19171c pill buttons with 50px radius, and violet, blue and yellow accent cards.

jll.name: JLL
jll.description: Global commercial real estate firm, JLL Southeast Asia: white canvas with blush #f7ece3 bands, deep teal ink #0e1d23, signal red #de0614, Source Sans 3 at 48px display and 20px body, 6px to 12px radii and translucent teal-tint buttons.

jobbkk.name: JOBBKK
jobbkk.description: Thai job board JOBBKK: white canvas with slate text (#64748b, #333333), signal red #ff1111 actions, custom db-normal and db-bold Thai fonts at 56px display and 22px body, pill inputs, 12px to 40px radii and lavender-blue soft shadows.

jobsdb-thailand.name: Jobsdb Thailand
jobsdb-thailand.description: Thai job board Jobsdb (by SEEK): white canvas, magenta #e60278 primary action, navy-grey ink #2e3849 and slate #5a6881 text, SeekSans at 24px semibold display and 16px buttons, 8px to 24px radii and 2px inset ring outlines instead of drop shadows.

jobthai.name: JobThai
jobthai.description: Thai job board JobThai: white canvas with pale grey surfaces (#f0f2f5, #f6f7fb), near-black ink #222222, brand orange #fe6d43 with square 40px buttons, Sarabun and Prompt Thai fonts at 16px and 20px labels, 4px base radius and 1px #dedede outlines.

jobtopgun.name: JobTopGun
jobtopgun.description: Thai job search and Super Resume site (JOBTOPGUN) built with Tailwind: cyan primary #06c5f3 with #00bff9 hover, white and #f9fafb canvas, Poppins with Kanit fallback, 8px buttons, 16px cards and soft blue-tinted shadows.

joby.name: Joby Aviation
joby.description: Electric air-taxi maker Joby Aviation: flat saturated blue canvas (#007ae5) with warm cream text (#f5f4df), jobyDisplay at 80px weight 550 with -2.4px tracking, jobyText 14px body, 16px cards and capsule radii up to 160px around cinematic photography.

john-deere.name: John Deere
john-deere.description: John Deere US storefront and brand site: white canvas with near-black ink #1b1c1b, enterprise green #367c2b pill buttons with #185f11 hover, Inter 36px bold display over Open Sans body, 8px cards, circular category tiles and a --jddc- CSS variable system.

johns-hopkins-medicine.name: Johns Hopkins Medicine
johns-hopkins-medicine.description: Johns Hopkins Medicine home page: white canvas with #eaeff1 bands and navy and teal message blocks, Noto Serif display at 42.6421px with 8px tracking over Noto Sans 16px body, square #0078d3 buttons and a #09141e footer.

johnson-and-johnson.name: Johnson & Johnson
johnson-and-johnson.description: Johnson & Johnson corporate home page: white and warm grey (#f9f8f7) canvas, black headlines in Johnson Display at 72px, brand red #eb1700 category bars and circular arrow buttons, a #312c2a utility bar and pill-only radii.

jonite.name: Jonite
jonite.description: Decorative stone grating maker Jonite: cool light-grey canvas (#e6e7e8) with near-black ink #0e0e0e, PP Neue Montreal sans and Silka Mono uppercase labels, black 35.56px pill buttons, square stone still-life photography and no shadows.

joy-from-africa.name: Joy from Africa to the World
joy-from-africa.description: Joy from Africa to the World, the V&A Waterfront Cape Town festive microsite (jfa-awards.snp.agency): an off-white stage (#f7f7f2) behind pastel blob-framed illustrations, navy (#003056) type only, Voyage display caps at 63.7px (43.68px mobile) and Gill Sans 600 at 12px uppercase for navigation. No radius, no buttons with fills, one soft shadow.

jpmorgan-chase.name: JPMorganChase
jpmorgan-chase.description: JPMorganChase corporate home page: white canvas (#ffffff) with black (#000000) text, a warm sand band (#f4efe7), a charcoal footer-style surface (#202020) and a bronze accent (#8f5a39). Headlines are set in the light Tiempos serif (weight 300, 72px desktop, 40px mobile); body and UI in the Sons sans-serif at 20px and 16px. Buttons and links are fully rounded pills (100px) and nothing carries a shadow.

jpmorgan-thailand.name: J.P. Morgan Thailand
jpmorgan-thailand.description: J.P. Morgan in Thailand about-us page: white canvas with #f5f7f8 grey panels, the Amplitude typeface at 64px light display and 16px body with 0.32px tracking, #31373d ink, bronze #936846 brand accent, teal #1a7b99 action links, square corners and a deep brown #35210d logo bar.

jrw-utility.name: J.R.W. Utility
jrw-utility.description: J.R.W. Utility Public Company Limited (jrw.co.th), a Thai electrical-power and telecom/ICT system contractor, uses a white canvas #ffffff, grey body text #747474, navy #2b3360 and blue #3e8ef6 accents with a cyan #03a9f4 underline, set in Prompt at 15px/34px body and 32px/700 headings.

jt-express-thailand.name: J&T Express Thailand
jt-express-thailand.description: J&T Express Thailand (jtexpress.co.th), a Thai parcel-delivery company site: white canvas (#ffffff), signal red (#e60000) for the primary button, section underlines and hero search panel, and the Kanit Thai/Latin typeface throughout (700 for headings at 50px desktop / 30px mobile, 400 for 16px body in grey #666666). Buttons are 8px-radius red rectangles, 36px tall.

juice-agency.name: Juice
juice-agency.description: Juice, a creative branding and web agency in Orlando (juice.agency): a pale cream canvas (#ffffeb) with near-black ink (#1d1c1b), Riposte grotesque at 300/400 for headlines and copy (47.001px h2, 31.334px uppercase h1) and Juice Mono, an all-caps monospace, for buttons and metadata. Pastel pill-less buttons (#b6dedb mint, #d8dbc6 sage) with 1.96px corners; no shadows.

julien-calot.name: Julien Calot
julien-calot.description: Julien Calot, visual artist and multidisciplinary creative (juliencalot.com): a near-white gallery canvas (#fafafa) that lets saturated paintings carry all the color, black (#000000) micro-type in Doner at 8px, a condensed FF DIN Pro Black logo and series titles (23px, weight 900, uppercase) and a strict square-cornered, shadowless layout with every radius measured at 0px.

jungceylon.name: Jungceylon
jungceylon.description: Jungceylon (Patong, Phuket) is a resort-town shopping mall whose homepage pairs a magenta Cormorant Garamond 600 serif headline (#ed008c, 40px) with plain Arial and Helvetica-style hv_ body copy on a white canvas, a dark grey #3f3f3f navigation strip, black rectangular READ MORE buttons with zero radius, and loud photographic banners in the Phuket tropical palette.

just-eat.name: Just Eat Takeaway.com
just-eat.description: The corporate and investor site of Just Eat Takeaway.com, set in JET Sans Digital (800-weight 48px display, 16px body) on a warm #f5f3f1 canvas with white #ffffff panels, ink #242e30, a near-black #141c1f pill button with 50px radius, and the brand orange #ff8000 reserved for hero imagery, maps and the logo.

k-c-property.name: K.C. Property
k-c-property.description: K.C. Property (kcproperty.co.th) Thai residential developer site in Prompt weight 300: teal #32bcad brand accent and hover, orange #f2ad48 2px outlined Readmore buttons with 10px radius, near-black #222222 text on white #ffffff with #f5f5f7 section backgrounds and 6px shadowed project cards.

kaidee.name: Kaidee
kaidee.description: Kaidee, Thailand's online second-hand marketplace: Inter-based sans with 'Kaidee' first in the stack, a brand-indigo (#4f68e8) 12px-radius 44px button, #fafafa page ground, white 16px-radius cards, orange HOT and navy PREMIUM badges.

kaiser-permanente.name: Kaiser Permanente
kaiser-permanente.description: Kaiser Permanente member front door (healthy.kaiserpermanente.org/front-door): deep navy header bands (#0d1c3d, #003b71) over a light grey page (#f7f7f7) and white cards, Gotham 5r headings and Gotham 4r body at 16px, outlined 100px-radius pill buttons with a pale blue fill (#e6f2f7) and a #0074ad link blue. Cards use a 4px radius with a 0.04-alpha 20px shadow.

kajabi.name: Kajabi
kajabi.description: Kajabi's marketing homepage sets Haffer (400 to 600) in near-black #0a0a0a on a warm off-white #fdfdfc canvas, with a 56.5714px display headline at -1.13143px tracking, a square-cornered 2px black Start Free Trial button, and a full-width black product band whose muted warm-gray text is #bcb9ae.

kaleida.name: Kaleida
kaleida.description: Kaleida, 'The Hologram Company' (wearekaleida.com): a near-black stage (#0e0e0e) with pure black (#000000) panels, white (#ffffff) Saans type, a #666666 secondary grey and #222222 hairlines. Hero type is 107.288px uppercase Saans at weight 400 (44.85px on mobile), body 18px. No radius, no shadow, no filled buttons; accents #ff3500 and #4b00ff exist only as root variables.

kami.name: kami (紙 / 纸)
kami.description: Editorial paper system: warm parchment canvas, ink-blue accent, serif-led hierarchy. Built for resumes, one-pagers, white papers, portfolios, slide decks — anything that should feel like high-quality print rather than UI. Multilingual by design (EN · zh-CN · ja).

kapook.name: Kapook.com (กระปุกดอทคอม)
kapook.description: Kapook.com, a Thai news and lifestyle portal: Noto Sans Thai throughout, a teal (#4abdac) header and wide teal call-out bar, white cards with 6px-radius pill tags, 22px/700 section headings and photo-led story cards with white overlay headlines.

karmart.name: Karmarts
karmart.description: Karmarts is a Thai premium beauty e-commerce platform whose storefront is a quiet neutral shell around loud campaign artwork. The system is built on the Prompt typeface at 13px/14px, a near-black #0a0a0a primary, off-white #fafafa canvas, white cards, a #ebebeb hairline, a single magenta #e91e8c accent, and pill, 16px and 24px radii.

karmarts.name: Karmarts Public Company Limited
karmarts.description: Karmarts Public Company Limited corporate and investor site (karmarts.co.th/en/home): a hot pink (#e53988) header, bullets and call-to-action, a warm charcoal footer (#3e3935) topped by a 6px pink rule, white pages, and Roboto Condensed throughout (700 headlines at 40px, 16px uppercase buttons, 15px light links). Square corners, a rectangular SUBSCRIBE button, no brand gradients.

kartell.name: Kartell
kartell.description: Kartell official US site (kartell.com/us/en/ktus): a gallery-white (#ffffff) and black (#000000) shop for designer plastic furniture, set entirely in Helvetica Neue (80px weight-500 uppercase hero, 46.4px section titles, 16px body), with #212529 outlined square buttons, a greige panel (#d1ccc3), 0px corners on controls and no shadows.

kayak.name: KAYAK
kayak.description: KAYAK's travel-search homepage (measured on the en.kayak.co.th redirect) is a white, airy layout in TT Hoves Variable — 44px/700 hero headline, 32px/700 section titles, 600-weight card titles — with an orange #ff690f→#e8381b gradient Search button, a #f0f3f5 12px-radius hero panel, 32px-radius white cards, #192024 ink, teal #0b7b99 links and 9999px pills, all named by --color-*/--size-border-radius-* tokens.

kazz-magazine.name: KAZZ Magazine
kazz-magazine.description: KAZZ Magazine (kazz-magazine.com), a Thai entertainment and fashion news site on the tagDiv Newspaper WordPress theme: white page (#ffffff) with near-black text (#111111), grey excerpts (#767676), dark charcoal category chips (#363636) and a blue accent (#5d74ad); Roboto 21px headlines, Open Sans body, Ruda 700 uppercase menu. Square corners, no shadows, dense three-tier news grid.

kbank.name: KBank
kbank.description: KASIKORNBANK (KBank) personal-banking site: white #ffffff canvas under a full-bleed dark photographic hero, KBank green #00a94f for the 8px-radius 48px 'See all services' button, links and the footer link bar, deep green #005a2a footer sitemap, slate #40515e product band, #333333 body text, all set in the served webfonts kurious-looped (headings, 26px/400 h1, 33px section heads) and kurious-looped-cond (13px/16px UI text).

kbtg.name: KASIKORN Business-Technology Group (KBTG)
kbtg.description: KBTG (kbtg.tech), the technology arm of KASIKORNBANK: a dark teal-black site (#333333 stage, #0d1a1a tiles, #000000 footer) with white type and a single aqua accent (#62cbc9) for emphasis words, rules and arrows. Set in the kurious family at weight 400 per file (96px display, 64px headings, 18px body), 4px and circular shapes, no shadows.

kddi.name: KDDI
kddi.description: KDDI Corporation Japanese corporate site (kddi.com, 'Spark Your Journey'): pale blue-grey page (#f1f2f6) with white (#ffffff) cards, near-black text (#222222) and a deep indigo key color (#0e0d6a) for the contact button and View All arrows, with sky accents (#1eace5, #ebf6ff). DM Sans with Noto Sans JP at 15px/1.7, 8px-radius controls, no shadows.

khan-academy.name: Khan Academy
khan-academy.description: Khan Academy as measured on khanacademy.org — a white canvas, near-black #151521 ink and an indigo #5753fa CTA (8px radius, 40px tall, hover #363498) on the Plus Jakarta Sans marketing homepage (42px/700 hero), sitting on top of the open-source Wonder Blocks design system whose classic product theme uses Lato, Wonder Blocks blue #1865f2, off-black #21242c, 4px radii and a #0b2149 dark-blue footer. Pill subject chips (100px radius, 1px #cbcbcd), colourful 16px-radius testimonial cards and a black footer close the page.

khon-kaen-sugar.name: Khon Kaen Sugar Industry Public Company Limited
khon-kaen-sugar.description: Corporate and investor site of Khon Kaen Sugar Industry (KSL Group) set in Noto Sans Thai on a #d9d9d9 grey canvas with #555555 ink, #ee3635 red 100px-radius pill buttons, #ec430f orange nav, a #171717 footer and a 50px hero over aerial map imagery.

khon-kaen-university.name: Khon Kaen University
khon-kaen-university.description: Khon Kaen University (kku.ac.th/en) pairs a terracotta brand red #a73b24 with Kanit headlines and Sarabun body text on a white canvas, using 8px cards, 999px pill buttons and soft 18px/46px shadows around photographic news and ranking tiles.

kia.name: Kia America
kia.description: Kia America (kia.com/us/en) is a dark midnight-navy #05141f automotive showroom set in the proprietary designk typeface family, with square-cornered 0px buttons, white-on-photo hero type at 40px/-1.6px tracking and edge-to-edge vehicle photography.

kiehls.name: Kiehl's
kiehls.description: Kiehl's Since 1851 storefront: a black #000000 header and footer framing a white #ffffff apothecary shelf, Amiri serif headings (44px/700 hero, 32px/400 section titles, 20px/700 product names) over Roboto 14px body, Roboto Condensed 16px/700 uppercase labels on square black buttons (0px radius, 39px tall) that invert to white on hover, 20px-radius shortcut chips and 10px-radius UGC tiles.

king-power.name: King Power Online
king-power.description: King Power Online (kingpower.com/en) is a duty-free shopping site in the proprietary KingPowerHeadline and KingPowerText faces, using bright royal blue #0b56a4 for navigation and actions, price-red #ef3b37, 4px-radius outlined buttons and white product cards on a #f8f8f8 page.

king-power-mahanakhon.name: King Power Mahanakhon
king-power-mahanakhon.description: King Power Mahanakhon (kingpowermahanakhon.co.th) is the Bangkok tower attraction site: deep navy #052142 and footer blue #133b64 with a gold #eba600 Get Tickets button, King Power Headline and Text typefaces, and pill-shaped outlined controls with 35.2px radius.

kirz.name: KIRZ
kirz.description: KIRZ (kirz.com) is a Thai enterprise IT-infrastructure provider whose site pairs deep navy #193446 with champagne gold #e9c77b, sets Thai and Latin text in Anuphan at 60px/700 hero scale, and uses 4px gold buttons with 10px translucent stat cards.

kiwi-ds.name: Kiwi.com
kiwi-ds.description: The Kiwi.com travel-booking home (kiwi.com/en): circular type at 28px/700 headings and 16px body, deep green primary #007061 on 12px-radius 52px CTAs, brighter green #008f7b for the search button, ink #252a31, cloud-grey canvas #f5f7f9 and mint tint #e1f4f3, over photography and 3D illustrations.

klarna.name: Klarna (US home)
klarna.description: Klarna's US home page (klarna.com/us) pairs near-black plum #0b051d with signature Klarna pink #ffa8cd, sets 84px bold Klarna Title headlines over Klarna Text body, and uses 99999px pill buttons, 16px cards and 48px device-frame corners.

klm.name: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines
klm.description: KLM's web system (Air France-KLM "Aero" design system) as shipped on klm.com — a warm sand canvas #f5f1ed, deep navy #002746 text and footer, action blue #0070c2 hovering to #005496, pale-blue tonal buttons #d0e7f6 with 12px radius and 1.25px tracking, white 24px-radius cards, and the custom KLM Universal Sans in Display (headlines, 500) and Text (body, 400) cuts.

kmutt.name: King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi (KMUTT)
kmutt.description: KMUTT's English home page (kmutt.ac.th/en) is a slate-grey #626a74 and charcoal #343a41 university portal set entirely in DBHeavent at 20px to 26px, with translucent yellow #ffde02bf news-card captions, 4px link corners and photo-led news tiles.

knight-club.name: Knight Club
knight-club.description: Knight Club (knightclub.co.th), a Thai government-technology provider on Next.js and Tailwind: Kanit at 800 for a 108.8px display, burgundy #6e0625 action, gold #b39359 accent, charcoal #1a1a1a, slate ink #475569, square 0px buttons and 8px-radius cards.

knight-frank.name: Knight Frank
knight-frank.description: Knight Frank (knightfrank.com) is an independent global real-estate consultancy site in Tiempos Headline serif and Suisse Intl sans, using signal red #d0103a on near-black #202320 and white, with square 0px buttons, clay #efefeb cards and a dark red #9b1632 hover.

knock.name: Knock
knock.description: Knock's marketing site sits on a warm off-white #fbfaf7 canvas with #1c2024 ink, PP Neue Montreal 500 headlines (60px/64px, -1.2px), Inter body text, a coral #ff6c52 'Get started' button (4px radius, hover #e33a1e), white 12px-radius cards with a 1px #e6e4de inset ring, and Telegraph design-system variables (--tgph-*).

knoll.name: Knoll (Home shop)
knoll.description: Knoll's home-furnishings shop (knoll.com/shop) is a restrained gallery-style store in Haas Grotesk Display Web, charcoal #333333 on white with warm #f1f1e9 bands, a red-orange #dc3a0f accent rule, square 0px buttons and full-bleed room photography.

kobalte.name: Kobalte
kobalte.description: Kobalte's documentation site for its unstyled SolidJS component toolkit: white canvas, zinc text #3f3f46 with #18181b headings, Lexend Variable titles over Inter Variable body, a sky-blue #027dbb link accent, 6px-radius demo buttons in #0284c5, and soft tinted callouts.

koh-kae.name: Kohkae
koh-kae.description: Kohkae (โก๋แก่) snack brand's online store: a saturated red #e20d17 header with a white active-nav pill, Prompt type at weights 700 and 800, a white canvas with #f1f1f1 surfaces, and 15px-rounded sticker-like banners and cards led by a cartoon mascot.

kolibri.name: KoliBri (ITZBund)
kolibri.description: KoliBri's public site and component docs use Verdana throughout (32px bold H1, 16px body at 26.4px leading), a slate #334455 hero and footer on white, a single deep-blue action #003a5c with a #ccebf7 light-blue secondary, 5px-radius outlined buttons, and flat, semantic, accessibility-first Web Components styled by swappable themes.

kom-chad-luek.name: Kom Chad Luek (komchadluek.net)
kom-chad-luek.description: Kom Chad Luek (komchadluek.net) is a Thai news portal in the Prompt typeface with a red #d70000 brand, black-to-red 45-degree gradient bars, #f9f9f9 page ground, 38px bold white headlines over photographs and 20px-radius card tops.

konami.name: KONAMI GROUP CORPORATION
konami.description: KONAMI Group Corporation (konami.com/en) is a flat, square-cornered Japanese corporate portal: white canvas, #333333 text, a #b60014 red Konami logo and heading bars, a #777777 grey navigation strip and UD Gothic typefaces at 14.4px body.

kononenko-architectural-bureau.name: Kononenko Architectural Bureau
kononenko-architectural-bureau.description: Kononenko Architectural Bureau (kononenkogroup.com) is a monochrome portfolio site: pure black #000000 on white with grey #929292 captions, a tightly tracked grotesque at 116.667px for headlines, a serif at 26.6667px for statements, and full-bleed architectural renders.

kontur.name: Kontur
kontur.description: Kontur (СКБ Контур) is a Russian business-software ecosystem whose site pairs a near-black #151515 hero and white #ffffff canvas with the Lab Grotesque typeface (700 display at 56px, 400 body at 16px), a #015ccb link blue, per-product accent colours such as mint #00bea2 and blue #2291ff, 2px input radii, 16px card radii and pill buttons.

korea-gov.name: Korea Government (KRDS)
korea-gov.description: The Korea Design System (KRDS) published by the Ministry of the Interior and Safety — a government UI kit built on the Pretendard GOV typeface at 17px body and 44px bold display, a single civic blue (#256ef4) for primary actions with a deeper #0b50d0 hover and #052b57 navy text, white canvases, 8px-radius 64px-tall buttons and 12px-radius outlined cards with #cdd1d5 hairlines.

koto.name: Koto
koto.description: Koto (koto.com) is a near-black creative-agency site — canvas #060606, grey #989898 body copy, white #ffffff headlines and links, a #ffe800 yellow wordmark — set entirely in the studio's own gtKotoheim, gtKotoheimCondensed (300) and gtKotoheimMono families, with 6px-radius translucent cards and no buttons.

kpi-insurance.name: Krungthai Panich Insurance (KPI)
kpi-insurance.description: Krungthai Panich Insurance (KPI) Thai homepage: EuclidCircularB with Noto Sans Thai fallback, 36px semibold headings, royal blue (#2c67c6) pill buttons at 56px radius with 60px height and white text, cyan (#56bed6) secondary pills, #f8f8f8 page with white 24px-radius cards, diagonal-cut photography and 0 10px 20px shadows.

kpmg.name: KPMG
kpmg.description: KPMG global home (kpmg.com/xx/en): white canvas, KPMG blue #1e49e2 actions and a deep #00338d band color, OpenSans Regular and SemiBold body with OpenSans Condensed Bold 48px headlines, 32px-radius pill buttons, flat surfaces with no box shadows.

kraft-heinz.name: The Kraft Heinz Company
kraft-heinz.description: Kraft Heinz corporate site (kraftheinzcompany.com): white canvas, bright cyan #09afdc headings and outlined MORE buttons, navy #122a4e navigation, Gotham SSm sans with a 120px Gotham Condensed uppercase hero line, square-cornered buttons and a blue gradient footer.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: Kraken's marketing site: a cool lavender-white #f6f5f9 canvas with near-black #101114 headings, a single owned purple #7132f5 on 12px-radius buttons, Kraken-Brand display type at 48px, Kraken-Product UI type, and large rounded dark panels (#191322, #302744) holding product screenshots.

krating-daeng.name: Krating Daeng (TCP Group)
krating-daeng.description: Krating Daeng (กระทิงแดง) energy-drink product page on TCP Group's site: white #ffffff canvas, deep navy #151f6d headings, red #e4002b accent text, #212529 body, DBHeaventRounded at 90px display and 24px body, 100px-radius outlined pills, and a pink and yellow gradient glow behind rounded white product cards.

krungthai-axa.name: Krungthai-AXA Life
krungthai-axa.description: Krungthai-AXA Life English homepage: white canvas (#ffffff) with deep navy ink (#2a2e80) and brand blue (#00008f) headings, a coral CTA (#f07662) at 8px radius, DB Helvethaica X 75 Bd display at 52px and DB Helvethaica X 55 body at 22px, line-icon product tiles and warm lifestyle photography.

krungthai-card.name: KTC (Krungthai Card)
krungthai-card.description: KTC English home (ktc.co.th/en): black header and footer, white pill buttons with 24px radius and 32px height, brand red #e43d31 filled-action color, Gotham with Sukhumvit Tadmai Thai fallback at 48px display and 18px body, rounded 12px cards on a #fafafa surface.

kuehne-nagel.name: Kuehne+Nagel
kuehne-nagel.description: Kuehne+Nagel global home: white canvas with deep navy #003369 and #002954 bands, action blue #0073e9 buttons (6px radius, 40px tall), SuisseIntlRegular at 18px body and 32px display, mint #08c792 highlights, flat surfaces with photographic cards.

kvs-studio.name: KVS Studio
kvs-studio.description: KVS Studio (kvs.services) entry screen: black canvas, SF Mono uppercase at 14px and 16px, signal orange #ff5500 labels with black text, a pale #f0f0f0 CRT screen holding a dithered ASCII logo, zero border radius, brace-wrapped {LABELS} and no box shadows.

kwi-insurance.name: KWI Insurance Public Company Limited
kwi-insurance.description: KWI Insurance English homepage: white canvas, deep navy #0b233f buttons and panels, Kaisei Opti serif with Bai Jamjuree fallback in uppercase, #4c4c4c body ink, pale blue #e5f2ff bands and square 0px-radius buttons.

l-i-s-a.name: L.I.S.A. by Locomotive
l-i-s-a.description: L.I.S.A. (lisa.locomotive.ca), the Locomotive agency's interactive assistant: a black-on-white interface in HelveticaNowDisplay at 26px, a 3D CRT-headed character as the only imagery, 12-column grid with 20px gutter, a #312DFB menu color and 999px black pill buttons on mobile.

lacrapule-studio.name: LaCrapule Studio
lacrapule-studio.description: LaCrapule Studio (lacrapulestudio.com), a Paris CGI and film studio: full-bleed project photography under white uppercase type, 64px display in a custom bl face with -2.56px tracking, tiny 10.67px to 12.44px sa captions, outlined 3.56px-radius filter chips that invert to white, no shadows.

lalamove-thailand.name: Lalamove Thailand
lalamove-thailand.description: Lalamove Thailand home (lalamove.com/th-th): Roboto at 80px display and 14px body, Lalamove orange #ff671d square-cornered buttons and cards, charcoal #3c3c3b text, pale #f1f3f4 bands, Thai-language copy over orange vehicle photography.

lama-lama-2.name: Lama Lama
lama-lama-2.description: Lama Lama (lamalama.com), an Amsterdam digital agency: near-black #1a1c1c canvas with warm off-white #f9f4eb type, SuisseBPIntl 73px uppercase bold display with -1.46px tracking, Sometype 10px uppercase mono labels, 4px-radius buttons 50px tall, a six-hue palette and no shadows.

lamborghini.name: Lamborghini
lamborghini.description: Automobili Lamborghini's website as measured on lamborghini.com — a square-cornered, uppercase-display system set in the proprietary LamboType (fallbacks Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial), with a 120px / 110px display headline, 72px-tall zero-radius buttons, a white canvas alternating with full-bleed near-black photographic bands (#181818, #000000), and a muted gold (#917300) filled button.

land-and-houses.name: Land and Houses
land-and-houses.description: Land and Houses (lh.co.th/en), Thai property developer: navy #003c71 bands and square 48px buttons, gold #b08731 rules, grey #f2f2f2 and white sections, NotoSansThai at weights 200 to 600 with 20px body and 14px nav, 8px-radius photo cards.

land-rover.name: Land Rover (UK site)
land-rover.description: Land Rover UK home (landrover.co.uk): a three-panel full-height model selector (Range Rover, Defender, Discovery) with white square EXPLORE buttons, AvenirNext 10px uppercase labels at 3px tracking, ink #0c121c and slate #4a4f54 text, 0px radius and a dense legal footer.

lando-norris.name: Lando Norris
lando-norris.description: Lando Norris official site (landonorris.com): dark green #282c20 and cream #f4f4ed with electric lime #d2ff00 buttons (6.4px radius), Brier serif and Mona Sans Variable, 86.67px Brier uppercase headlines at -2.59px tracking, oval and pill shapes, no shadows.

landor.name: Landor
landor.description: Landor brand-consultancy home page measured from landor.com: white canvas with Landor Blue #0e1adf text and panels, a single lime-yellow #ecfd01 pill CTA with black text and 300px radius, and the Landor Sans Beta family at weights 400 and 700.

later.name: Later
later.description: Later's influencer-marketing site: heavy Super X sans Display 900 headlines (74.8279px hero) with Inter Tight body, black #000000 ink on a cream Grid Glow #f8f2ea canvas, Hot Take orange #fe3f00 buttons with square corners and a clipped bottom-right corner, and Viral Crush purple #5124c1 bands.

launchdarkly.name: LaunchDarkly
launchdarkly.description: LaunchDarkly's runtime-control site: #191919 near-black bands against #f8f8f8 light panels, an acid-lime #ddff46 'Book a demo' button with 12px corners, orange #ff9d29 and blue #405bff product accents, bold headingFont3 64px/700 headlines tracked -3.2px, bodyFont 22px/500 copy and large 24px-radius cards.

layrid.name: Layrid
layrid.description: Layrid, a '100th Projects' commemorative portfolio site measured live: near-black #080808 canvas, #dcdcdc text, PP Neue Montreal Medium with Noto Sans JP for Japanese, square 0px corners and a black uppercase 12px VIEW MORE button.

lays.name: Lay's
lays.description: Lay's US snack site measured live: Lay's yellow #ffda03 canvas, cream #f0ede1 recipe band, red #e61a22 pill actions, flavor-coded product tiles, and the custom Lays and LaysExtraBold families with 16px and 50% rounding.

lazada-thailand.name: Lazada Thailand
lazada-thailand.description: Lazada Thailand marketplace home page measured live: light #f5f5f5 canvas with white modules, Lazada orange #f57224 for actions, NotoSans-Regular text at 12px to 22px, small 2px to 6px radii and dense product grids.

le-creuset.name: Le Creuset
le-creuset.description: Le Creuset US home page (lecreuset.com), measured — white #ffffff canvas, black #000000 text, square grey #656565 uppercase BUY NOW buttons that hover to #f8f8f8, Taviraj 48px/300 serif display over Nunito Sans 16px/300 body, seasonal #bb480b promo band, navy #051426 feature panel, 0px corners throughout.

le-monde.name: Le Monde
le-monde.description: Le Monde French news home page measured live: white #ffffff canvas, slate #2a303c text, near-black #181a1e masthead, a yellow #ffc700 S'abonner button with 3px radius, The Antiqua B serif headlines and Marr Sans text.

ledger-brandbook.name: Ledger Brandbook
ledger-brandbook.description: Ledger Brand Book (brand.ledger.com) measured on its Guidelines page: white canvas with #fbfbfb cards, black text and #0000008c body copy, orange #ff5300 accents, Ledgermono display, Brut Grotesque text, Hmalphamono tags and zero radius.

leica.name: Leica
leica.description: Leica Camera's Drupal-based site (leica_redesign_theme) runs a quiet warm-neutral system: Outfit at 300/400/600 only — 76px/85.12px weight-400 page titles, 54px h2, 18px/28px light body — alternating #f2efeb warm-sand and #ffffff bands with #222222 warm-black ink, #f5f5f5 cards, a #d1d4d3 footer, and 48px warm-black pill buttons (24px radius, 10px 64px) carrying a 12px Leica-red #e20612 dot that turns the whole button red on hover.

lemlist.name: lemlist
lemlist.description: lemlist (lemlist.com) is an outbound-sales SaaS site: Manrope 600 headlines (56px, -2.24px tracking) over Inter 14–16px UI text, #18181a/#7d7d7d ink on white with #e6e6e6 frames, lemlist blue #316bff, a Mars-orange #d86a33 hero and a #010113 space-navy footer, with 8–10px radii.

lemon-squeezy.name: Lemon Squeezy
lemon-squeezy.description: Lemon Squeezy pairs an electric purple #5423e7 hero and a yellow #ffc233 announcement bar with Circular Pro Book headlines (80px, -3.2px tracking) and Inter body text in #121217 / #6c6c89, white 40px-radius pill buttons that warm to #ffd266 on hover, and pastel/saturated colour-block feature panels.

lenovo.name: Lenovo
lenovo.description: Lenovo US home page measured live: white canvas with #ededed footer, Lenovo purple #7a126b buttons at 8px radius (hover #4d144a), Montserrat 600 headlines at 56px, Noto Sans body, Lato nav, and the Lenovo red #e1251b logo.

letude-creative-studio.name: L'Étude
letude-creative-studio.description: L'Étude international boutique creative studio site measured live: red #ee382b hero, #9597a7 gray canvas, electric blue #012094 headline text, #151515 labels, and the Indivisible family from 13px uppercase tags to 89.6px statements.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: Conversion-focused design that removes friction and guides users toward action through clarity, trust, and speed.

lexus.name: Lexus
lexus.description: Lexus USA home page measured live: white canvas with black bands, black text, square 0px buttons (white EXPLORE and BUILD at 50px height), the nobel typeface at 300 to 700 weights, gray #adadad and #707070 secondary text and a #b6a171 gold accent.

lg-g.name: LG USA
lg-g.description: LG Electronics USA (lg.com/us) is a retail storefront on LG Warm Grey #f0ece4 and #e6e1d6, with LGEI Headline 40px headings, LGEI Text 14–20px body, a #ea1917 red pill button (32px radius, soft rgba(27,26,30,0.15) shadow) that inverts to white on hover, and 24px-radius white product cards.

lh-bank.name: LH Bank
lh-bank.description: LH Bank (Land and Houses Bank, Thailand) personal-banking home page measured live: #f1f3f5 canvas, white cards at 15px radius, sky-blue #39a3ce 36px pill-style buttons, #333333 text, and the proprietary LHBankHeader family in three weights.

lidar-drone-scanning.name: Aevion Lidar Drone Scanning
lidar-drone-scanning.description: Aevion Lidar Drone Scanning tech demo by Riotters, measured live: #fdfdfd and white canvas, slate #24363f ink and button, light-weight switzer type up to 240px, protoMono labels, hairline #9fe2ff3d rules and square 0px buttons.

lidl.name: Lidl
lidl.description: Lidl US home page measured live: white canvas, #353b42 text, Lidl blue #0050aa pill buttons (hover #002466), Lidl yellow #fff000 secondary buttons (hover #ffc400), dark #1e2124 labels and the proprietary LidlFontPro family at 16px, 26px and 29px.

lightnet.name: Lightnet
lightnet.description: Lightnet (cross-border payment infrastructure) design system: Inter at weight 400 with a 60px hero, indigo #29338a gradient fading to aliceblue #f0f8ff, white 50px-radius pill buttons and 30px bordered cards.

lightning-design.name: Lightning Design System
lightning-design.description: Salesforce's Lightning Design System 2 (SLDS 2) and its default Cosmos theme — white and light-gray surfaces with a single electric-blue accent (#066afe), a system-font UI stack at a 13px base with 600-weight buttons, pill-radius buttons (240px), 8px inputs, 12px cards and 20px containers; the documentation site around it uses Inter and AvantGardeForSalesforce.

lightship-1.name: Lightship
lightship-1.description: Lightship (all-electric travel trailers, lightshiprv.com): F37Bolton at weight 400 with tight negative tracking, a warm cream page tone #faf6ef under black ink #000000, a coral accent #fa5c40, 20px and 100px radii, full-bleed photography.

ligne-roset.name: Ligne Roset
ligne-roset.description: Ligne Roset (French contemporary furniture, ligne-roset.com/en): Gotham display type at light weights 350-450 with negative tracking, ProximaNova body, white canvas #ffffff, near-black #191919 pill buttons with 46px radius, photography-led.

likova.name: LIKOVA
likova.description: LIKOVA (Class A Business Center, likova.space): all-uppercase TT Norms Pro at weights 400 and 450, white canvas #ffffff against deep navy #070b20 sections, a single 10px radius, architectural photography with a large wide-tracked wordmark.

lime.name: Lime
lime.description: Lime's homepage on li.me: Poppins at weight 400 only (72px/79.2px 'Ride Green' hero, 40px/56px section heads at -0.2px, 14px/25.2px body), black #000000 ink on a white #ffffff canvas alternating with full-bleed black #000000 bands, and Lime green #00dd00 pill buttons (40px radius, 12px 24px padding, 48px tall, black label) that flip to black with white text on hover. Grey #eeeeee 20px-radius vehicle cards with product cut-outs, darker greens #00b200 and #00ab4e for eyebrows and step titles.

lindt.name: Lindt
lindt.description: Lindt Switzerland (lindt.ch/de, Lindt Schokolade seit 1845): Optima display and button type with Roboto body, white canvas #ffffff over a #f2f2f2 page tone, gold #917236 square buttons, grey ink #555555, bright red #e91138 promo labels, product-photo tiles.

linear-app.name: Linear
linear-app.description: Linear's marketing site as measured on linear.app — a near-black canvas (#08090a) with panel surfaces (#0f1011), Inter Variable at its signature 510 weight with tight negative tracking (64px / 64px display, -1.408px), a light pill call to action (#e5e5e6 fill, 9999px radius, 32px tall), hairline borders (#ffffff14), and Berkeley Mono for code and captions.

lingo.name: Lingo
lingo.description: Playful, minimal design with bright colors, rounded shapes, tactile 3D borders, and friendly illustrations for approachable interfaces.

linktree.name: Linktree
linktree.description: Linktree's homepage stacks saturated full-width colour bands (lime #d2e823, hydrangea blue #2665d6, currant #780016, plum #502274) set in the proprietary Linksans at 800 weight with tight negative tracking, forest-green #254f1a pill buttons (9999px) and soft 32-64px rounded media cards.

lit.name: Lit
lit.description: Lit (lit.dev) uses a Material-3-style token set from its own colors.css: Lit blue #334eff square-cornered (0px) buttons hovering to #4d63ff, #f4f4f4 background with white #ffffff bands, #242424 text, a full-bleed #4d63ff logo band and a #000000 'Explore Lit' band, all in Manrope (16px/27.2px body, 800-weight feature labels) with Roboto Mono for code.

liveblocks.name: Liveblocks
liveblocks.description: Liveblocks' marketing site is a black #000000 page with warm-grey #918d8d body text, Suisse Intl (suisse 400/500) headlines at 60px/66px with -1.2px tracking, white #ffffff 8px-radius CTAs with black labels, 4px-radius panels outlined by a 1px #272626 ring, and light product-mock cards (#f9fbfd, #fefefe) set into the dark page.

lo2s.name: LO2S
lo2s.description: LO2S (lo2s.com, live-event visuals studio portfolio): Geist at 10.6667px weight 700 with -0.106667px tracking, near-white #f7fcfe text on full-screen black video, a 9999px pill radius, no buttons, chrome reduced to numbered links.

lockheed-martin.name: Lockheed Martin
lockheed-martin.description: Lockheed Martin (lockheedmartin.com): DIN 2014 W01 Light headings with DIN W01 Regular body, white canvas #ffffff and #f2f2f2 bands, square 55px buttons filled corporate blue #0360ae, near-black hero imagery, 0px button radius.

locomotive.name: Locomotive
locomotive.description: Locomotive, the Montreal digital-first design agency, runs a strictly black #000000 on white #ffffff site with no rounded corners (0px everywhere), 2px black rules, PP Locomotive New at 70px/400 for display and Helvetica Now Display at 26px/400 for nearly all other text, plus a #312dfb full-screen menu colour declared in its CSS.

loewe.name: LOEWE
loewe.description: Loewe's international homepage measured at www.loewe.com/int/en/home: white canvas (#ffffff), pure black text (#000000), the proprietary Avus typeface at 14px body and 22px headings, square corners (0px radius), and a mustard accent (#f2ca56) taken from the site's own --lw-* token set.

logitech.name: Logitech
logitech.description: Logitech's US storefront homepage: white canvas with near-black #1b1b1b headlines, grey #707279 body copy, one electric mint #00fdcf (the site's --brand) on 60px-radius pill buttons, Brown bold at 64px with -3% tracking, 12px-radius image cards and product photography; an email-offer modal overlays the first view in the capture.

logrocket.name: LogRocket
logrocket.description: LogRocket's logrocket.com marketing site: white #ffffff canvas framed by star-speckled purple gradient bands (#764abc, #430a6d), near-black #17141b text, vinila display type (62px/400 at -1.86px) over Inter body, white 9999px pill buttons on purple, a black active segmented tab, and 12px-radius cards with 1px translucent ink borders.

logseq.name: Logseq
logseq.description: Logseq (logseq.com), "a privacy-first, open-source knowledge base": a dark teal site on #01222a and #001419. System ui-sans-serif headlines at 64px/60.8px with +1px tracking that pair a 400 muted-teal phrase with a 600 white phrase, #f3f4f6 text, #0369a1 and #195d6c download buttons with 4px–8px radius, and translucent #002b36 cards.

longbow.name: Longbow
