longbow.description: Longbow (British hand-built featherweight sports cars, Webflow build at db-longbow.webflow.io): Bebas Neue wordmark, EB Garamond italics, Geist Mono uppercase labels, grey canvas #888c8f, white primary #ffffff, 12px radius, studio car photography.

loom.name: Loom
loom.description: Loom's marketing home (an Atlassian product): white #ffffff canvas with pale blue #e9f2fe sections and footer, Loom blue #1868db pill buttons and banner, near-black #101214 text and dark bands, violet #bf63f3 accents, Charlie Display 700 headlines at 56.5px over Charlie Text body, 9999px pills and 39-66px rounded feature panels.

loops.name: Loops
loops.description: Loops (loops.so) is an email platform for SaaS with a warm stone palette: Newsreader 500 serif headlines (44px, -0.88px), Inter 16.8px/28.56px body in #63635e, near-black #21201c pill buttons (40px radius), #fdfdfc/#f9f9f8 canvas, #e9e8e6 hairlines and an oxblood #7d1b0c footer striped in #fc5200 orange.

lottiefiles.name: LottieFiles
lottiefiles.description: LottieFiles animation platform site: DM Sans LF 96px/500 headlines at -4.8px tracking with Inter LF UI text, zinc #09090b ink and #71717b body grey on white and #f4f4f5 bands, teal #019d91 buttons with 12px and 6px corners, 16px-radius cards, a yellow #f0b100 AI band and brand Mint #00ddb3.

lotuss.name: Lotus's
lotuss.description: Lotus's Shop Online (lotuss.com/en, Thai grocery retailer): LotusSmartHL typeface at weights 400-900, white canvas #ffffff, teal #00bcb4 brand header and links, orange-red #f24822 and red #e1221c promo accents, 8px and 18px radii, dense promo-banner grid.

louvre.name: Musée du Louvre
louvre.description: Musée du Louvre (louvre.fr/en): a black #000000 museum site with #1a1a1a and white #ffffff sections, uppercase LouvreSerif headings at 48px, Montserrat 600 tracked caps for labels, Roboto for text, and pill-shaped buttons (40.96px radius) in Louvre green #008573 that darken to #0a4f51 on hover.

lovable.name: Lovable
lovable.description: Lovable's marketing site as measured on lovable.dev — a warm off-white page (#fcfbf8) with charcoal text (#1c1c1c), the Camera Plain Variable typeface (48px / 600 headlines at -1.92px), a near-black 8px-radius "Get started" button (#000000e0), 24 to 32px rounded white cards with layered ring shadows, and a saturated blue-to-pink gradient behind the hero prompt box.

loxley-pacific.name: Loxley
loxley-pacific.description: Loxley Public Company Limited (loxley.co.th/en/home, Thai trading, technology and services group): Montserrat with Noto Sans Thai, white canvas #ffffff, gold #d9a243 pill buttons with 30px radius, navy #26417e links, uppercase 31px headings.

lpn.name: LPN Development
lpn.description: LPN Development (L.P.N., lpn.co.th) condominium developer site: DB Helvethaica type with a 50px bold heading and 20px body, #737373 and #333333 grey ink on white and #f5f5f5 bands, a #58c1e9 sky-blue accent, 10px to 18px radii, soft 3px shadows on cards and bright campaign banners above Lumpini project photography.

lucid.name: Lucid
lucid.description: Lucid Software (lucid.co), maker of Lucidchart and Lucidspark: GraphikWide 200 headlines at 64px/64px with a bold #1071e5 blue accent phrase, Graphik 20px/27px body in #282c33, square 0px-radius Cool Grey 100 #282c33 buttons (hover #4c535d), #fafbfc and #f7f4e4 bands, a deep #2f3296 indigo section, and offset 2px 2px 4px card shadows.

lucid-motors.name: Lucid Motors
lucid-motors.description: Lucid Motors (lucidmotors.com): Lucid Serif VF display at 72px over Lucid Sans VF small caps labels with 2px tracking, near-black canvas #0f0f0f, white 4px-radius buttons, champagne gold #d7be96 accent, full-bleed automotive photography.

lufthansa.name: Lufthansa
lufthansa.description: Lufthansa's web system — LH Deep Blue #05164d (official Pantone 4146, RGB 5/22/77) as header, ink and brand colour on white; LH Yellow #ffad00 (Pantone 2010) reserved for the one functional action, the 'Search flights' button (hover #ffbd32) with deep-blue text; the proprietary LufthansaHead (Bold/Light, fluid sizes ~17.7–46.2px) for headlines over LufthansaText (14/18px); 4px buttons, 8px cards with a blue-tinted rgba(5,22,77,.1) shadow, and maui-* web components.

lululemon.name: lululemon
lululemon.description: lululemon's US shop: Saans 400/500 on a #ffffff canvas with warm near-black #140f0f ink, 72px and 64px light-weight headlines with -4% tracking, fully rounded 44px pill buttons in #140f0f or the pale #f4f3f2 hero variant, #f9f9f8 subdued surfaces and the #c8102e accent red from the 'zest' design tokens.

luminaire-authentik.name: Luminaire Authentik
luminaire-authentik.description: Luminaire Authentik (luminaireauthentik.com, Canadian custom lighting manufacturer): PP Editorial New serif headings at 53.3333px with DM Sans body, warm sand canvas #e8e0d2, deep brown ink #433c35, terracotta #8c4630 bar, 70px pill buttons, tile and lamp photography.

lunch-money.name: Lunch Money
lunch-money.description: Lunch Money's site: a light #fafafa page set entirely in Avenir (60px/600 headline in #444444, 16px/27.2px body in #343434), a deep teal #2c6a64 pill CTA with a teal glow that darkens to #244f4a, lighter #44958c teal for links and 3px-radius secondary buttons, #fbb700 yellow underline accents, 5px white cards and a mint #eef4f2 footer.

lusano.name: Lusano
lusano.description: Lusano (lusano.com, heirloom-quality furniture, Los Angeles): single typeface EB Garamond at 14.6286px weight 400 in roman and italic, off-white canvas #f7f4ef with deep brown ink #4a2214, a five-step brown ladder, 4.57px radius, a pixel-grid infinite gallery.

lush.name: LUSH
lush.description: LUSH UK home page (lush.com/uk/en), measured — black #000000 84px header and footer, white #ffffff canvas, full-bleed product photography under curved dark caption bands, Inter 14–18px with a custom 'handwritten' 39.2px display face, white 40px-radius Sign me up! button and 16px-radius #333333 input.

luxury.name: Luxury
luxury.description: High-end dark aesthetic with bold headings, monochromatic palette, and premium feel for luxury brand experiences.

lxl-creative.name: LxL Creative
lxl-creative.description: LxL Creative is a UK entertainment campaign agency site: warm near-black canvas #27201d, cream ink #fcf2bd, orange #ff5121 accent, Owners Wide uppercase headings with Scribo script and Manrope UI, 12px rounded photography.

lyft.name: Lyft
lyft.description: Lyft's homepage on lyft.com: a white #ffffff canvas alternating with off-white #f1f0ec bands, deep plum-black #1d0c17 ink, and Lyft's custom Rebel Sans (RebelSansDisplay 600 at 60px/66px for 'The world awaits', RebelSansText 600 at 36px/45px for section heads, 16px/22px body). Primary actions are dark magenta #820076 pills, 48px tall with 48px radius and 0 24px padding, carrying 18px/500 white labels; hot Lyft Pink #ff00bf is kept for the logo. Ride cards use 16px corners and a two-layer hairline shadow.

m-c-4-0.name: Mallard & Claret
m-c-4-0.description: Mallard & Claret (M&C) is a London and Brisbane web agency site: coral #fb4d4d hero band, charcoal #262626 ink, FK Grotesk Neue in 400 and 500 with strongly negative tracking, a single 20px pill radius and full-bleed project media.

mac-cosmetics.name: M·A·C Cosmetics
mac-cosmetics.description: M·A·C Cosmetics storefront: achromatic black, white and #f5f5f5 interface, Druk Text uppercase headings with Roboto Mono body, square 0px black ADD TO BAG buttons, round shade swatches and edge-to-edge beauty photography.

madar.name: Madar
madar.description: Madar logistics platform site: midnight navy canvas #172e64 and indigo #060a3d, white Suisse type at weights 300 and 400, orange accent #fb441a and #ff6340, 5px radius, translucent cyan cards and no shadows.

made-with-gsap-1.name: Made With GSAP
made-with-gsap-1.description: Made With GSAP subscription library of JavaScript motion effects: white hero then near-black #0a0a0b, acid lime #c9fe6e JOIN pill, LayGrotesk headings and PPNeueMontrealMono uppercase labels, 12-column grid and 4px to 25px radii.

mae-pranom.name: Maepranom
mae-pranom.description: Maepranom Thai sauces site: warm cream #fff6eb canvas, brand red #c72931 and gradient pills, dark red-brown ink #451611, Chonburi serif headings with DB Helvethaica X body, full-bleed red product chapters and 24px cards.

maersk.name: Maersk
maersk.description: Maersk (maersk.com), the integrated container-logistics company, builds its site on the Maersk Design System — proprietary Maersk Headline at light 300 weight (50px hero, 40px sections) over Maersk Text 16px/24px, near-black #141414 filled buttons (hover #363636) with a 5px radius and 7px 16px padding, white 8px-radius cards bordered #dbdbdb, link blue #0073ab, the brand sky-blue #42b0d5 as secondary, and full-bleed photography under a dark gradient header.

mailchimp.name: Mailchimp
mailchimp.description: Mailchimp.com — Cavendish Yellow (#ffe01b) pill buttons ringed in warm near-black (#231e15) on a #f5f5f5 canvas with white 24px-radius cards, Means Web serif display at 64px/400 with -1.2px tracking against Graphik Web sans at 16px, and a dark brown band with yellow-highlighted numbers.

mailru.name: VK Mail.ru
mailru.description: The Mail.ru portal is a dense Russian-language news-and-services page on a white canvas with graphite ink #2c2d2e, a vivid VK blue #0077ff for the login and search buttons, blue #0070f0 headline links, soft grey #87898f meta text, 20px-radius feed cards with a faint blue shadow, and the VK Sans Display / MailSans / Arial type stack.

major-cineplex.name: Major Cineplex
major-cineplex.description: Major Cineplex Thai cinema booking site: pure black canvas, white DB Gin Siam X type, gold #d2aa5a structure with a gold BUY TICKET bar, hot red #ff283c booking button, 10px posters and 26px metadata pills.

major-development.name: Major Development PCL.
major-development.description: Major Development PCL. Thai property developer site: white canvas, Tailwind gray ink #4a5565, slate #364153 buttons and status bars, single stidti family at 14px, three-up project cards with 12px radius and minimal 5% shadows.

make.name: Make
make.description: Make (make.com) runs a light, lavender-tinted marketing site set entirely in Satoshi: a 60px/500 display headline with -1.2px tracking in plum #342237, muted plum body copy #69586c on white #ffffff, violet #8f4bd2 'Try it free' buttons with 8px radius that darken to #803bbf on hover, 16px-radius feature cards and 1200px content inside a 1280px frame.

make-it-real-foundation-merch.name: Make It Real Foundation Merch
make-it-real-foundation-merch.description: Make It Real Foundation merch store: ultramarine #2423ad hero and deep navy #02022f story scenes, white extended Benzin type at huge sizes, periwinkle #5857ff pill buttons, fluid viewport-scaled radii and hand-drawn sun and cloud art.

makesend.name: Makesend
makesend.description: Makesend Sameday-Delivery Thai courier site: white canvas, navy #06163a headings, brand orange #f47929 buttons, golden #fcc500 benefit band, Kanit for Thai and Latin, 4px radii and soft low-opacity shadows.

makro.name: Makro PRO
makro.description: Makro PRO Thai wholesale online store: white canvas, brand red #e82026 price blocks and banners, gold and burgundy flash-sale panels, Noto Sans Thai at 12px, 8px-radius bordered product cards and round red add buttons.

malaysia-gov.name: MyGovernment
malaysia-gov.description: MyGovernment (malaysia.gov.my), Malaysia's official government portal, is set in Poppins with a #1b76de blue pill search button, 72px bold hero headlines over a warm photograph, slate #64748b body copy, #f1f5f9 service panels, 80px-radius cards and persona illustrations.

mama.name: Thai President Foods Plc (mama.co.th corporate site)
mama.description: Corporate site of Thai President Foods, maker of MAMA noodles - warm orange #ff7e00 buttons and headings on a #f5f5f5 canvas with white #ffffff cards at 16px radius, set in the Prompt family (promptregular, promptlight, promptmedium) with Roboto and arial/tahoma fallbacks, 6px button corners and a fixed 1180px content column.

mammoth-murals.name: Mammoth Murals
mammoth-murals.description: Mural agency in Birmingham, Alabama - saturated yellow #ffd900 canvas with near-black #120011 ink, cream #fff6e5 sections, oversized uppercase Obviously 800 headlines (149px hero) paired with Suisse Int'l 500 body at 15.5px, 4px radii and pill-bordered nav buttons.

manatal.name: Manatal
manatal.description: Manatal AI recruitment software site at manatal.com: Montserrat 54px bold headlines with -1.6px tracking, #145aff 12px-radius buttons in Open Sans 600, pale blue #d4e8ff hero wash, navy #0f1f3d footer, floating screenshot panels with soft shadows.

manchester-city.name: Manchester City
manchester-city.description: Manchester City (mancity.com) is a white #ffffff club site in the Kippax, Kippax Modern and KippaxCondensed typefaces, with dark-blue #001838 ink, a sky-blue #98c5e9 header, electric-yellow #e6ff00 square BUY TICKETS buttons, #dde6ed neutral panels, uppercase condensed 40px headlines and a #001838 footer.

mandarin-oriental.name: Mandarin Oriental
mandarin-oriental.description: Luxury hotel group site: white and #f5f5f5 canvas with black #000000 ink, sage #b7cdc2 pill buttons (22px and 28px radii), gold #b59060 utility links, Futura PT headlines in uppercase and AvenirNext LT Pro 14px body, over full-bleed destination photography.

mandms.name: M&M'S
mandms.description: M&M'S US shop and brand site: white #ffffff canvas with near-black #040607 ink and brown #5a1f06 labels, pill buttons (light #f3f6fa fill with brown outline, inverting to brown on hover), seasonal saturated card colors on 10px radii, and the custom AllTogether Serif (300/700) and Sans (300/400/700) families.

mantine.name: Mantine
mantine.description: Mantine, the React component library — a white, light-gray surface system with a single blue action color (#228be6, blue shade 6), 8px default radius, system-font UI at 14 to 16px with 600-weight buttons, a 10-step color ramp per hue, and a docs site that sets headlines in Outfit at 450 weight (72px / 79.2px on the home page).

mantis.name: Mantis
mantis.description: Mantis, a New York City experience studio: neutral grey #bdbdbd canvas with #cfcfcf surfaces, near-black #181818 ink, one electric green #00ff00 button with black text and 4px radii, set entirely in Denim (display 85px, -4.25px tracking, weight 500) with Graebenbach Mono declared for body.

manvsmachine.name: ManvsMachine
manvsmachine.description: ManvsMachine (mvsm.com) shows its film and design work as an edge-to-edge mosaic of video tiles on a pale grey #f4f4f4 canvas, with every word in one face, Universus Sans: 36px/400 white project titles (-0.2px tracking) over the footage, 20px/400 #231f20 chrome text, a #656763 secondary grey, square 0px corners and no shadows.

marie-antoinette.name: Marie Antoinette
marie-antoinette.description: Marie Antoinette, a Paris communications, PR, influence and events agency: a pure black #000000 canvas with off-white #f3f4f2 type, full-bleed campaign imagery, giant uppercase Arnika serif titles (80px, -3.2px tracking) and Suisse BP Intl 20px sans captions, with every corner square (0px).

mars.name: Mars, Incorporated
mars.description: Mars, Incorporated global corporate site: Mars blue #0000a0 headlines and square buttons on white, mint green #00d7b9 and yellow #ffdc00 feature bands, #3c3c3c body copy in the proprietary MarsCentra family (Extrabold 56px display, 16px/28px body) with 8px-radius brand tiles.

marshall.name: Marshall
marshall.description: Marshall (marshall.com US store): black #000000 canvas over full-bleed gig photography, white #ffffff square buttons with black text, #8c8c8c body copy, uppercase NeueHelveticaPaneuropean 800 headlines (56px/56px) and NeueHelvetica 500 body at 18px, every corner square (0px).

marsun-shipyard.name: MARSUN PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED (Marsun Shipyard)
marsun-shipyard.description: Marsun, a Thai shipbuilder and ship-repair company: white canvas with navy #004581 headings, footer and hover fills, teal #018abd button fill, #4a4a4a body copy, all set in db_heavent (60px bold display, 24px body), 5px button radius, and ocean-water photography.

marvell-tile-stone.name: Marvell Tile & Stone
marvell-tile-stone.description: Marvell Tile & Stone, Perth tiling and natural stone artisans: warm stone canvas #e9e4df with #e3ded9 panels, brass-olive #b1a781 and #9b926a type, dark umber #35311f sections, neueMontreal in light 400 at very large sizes (80px and 48px) with negative tracking, and a floating 8px-radius dark nav pill.

maserati.name: Maserati
maserati.description: Maserati global site: a white and near-black #02070d luxury canvas, one saffron-yellow #ffc845 square button (54px tall, 11px uppercase Everett Medium at +1px tracking), giant uppercase Everett Light headlines at 92px with -3.68px tracking, and cinematic full-bleed car video.

mass-rapid-transit-authority-of-thailand.name: Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA)
mass-rapid-transit-authority-of-thailand.description: Thai metro authority site at mrta.co.th/th: red #d72027 top bar and navy #172655 / #0e215a bands, Prompt 14.4px body, 6px-radius poster news cards on #e6e6e6, white announcements list with navy date badges; intro splash excluded.

massachusetts-general-hospital.name: Mass General Brigham (Massachusetts General Hospital)
massachusetts-general-hospital.description: Massachusetts General Hospital page on the Mass General Brigham site: deep navy #213243 text, mint #8bffcd pill buttons (43.2px radius, hover #00e682), teal #01828e and light-teal #d9f0f2 surfaces, #003a96 links, Roboto Slab 64px headlines over Roboto body at 16px/25.6px.

mastercard.name: Mastercard
mastercard.description: Mastercard's website as measured on mastercard.com — a warm cream canvas (#f3f0ee) with warm near-black ink (#141413), the proprietary "mccom" typeface at weights 450 and 500 with negative tracking (64px / 64px display, -1.28px), 20px-radius pill buttons, large stadium-shaped photo cards, and a burnt signal orange (#cf4500) in the Made design tokens.

masterclass.name: MasterClass
masterclass.description: MasterClass's cinematic dark streaming storefront — a pure black #000000 canvas with white #ffffff Sohne (Klim Söhne) text, crimson #e32652 'Get MasterClass' buttons (hover #d61a46) at 8px radius and 44px height, condensed Sohne Schmal 500 uppercase poster headlines up to 96px, Ivar Display Condensed serif for editorial titles, #272c33 testimonial cards and #222326 / #43454c graphite controls, all driven by --mc-color-* CSS custom properties.

material.name: Material Design 3
material.description: Google's Material Design 3 documentation site (m3.material.io) measured as a product of the Material system itself — a lavender-tinted #fefbff page with #f8f1f6 containers, #6442d6 purple pill buttons 80px tall with 48px radius, Google Sans display type at 88px/475 over Google Sans Text body, 24px-radius cards, and a left icon rail. The underlying system's published baseline tokens (primary #6750a4, Roboto, 28px extra-large corner) are cited from the material-web repository.

material-minimal.name: Material Minimal
material-minimal.description: Material Minimal is MDBootstrap's own refinement of Google Material Design, shown on material-minimal.com as a white canvas with a pale blue-grey wash, Roboto throughout (56px bold display at -1.4px tracking, 16px body), a single cobalt blue primary #3b71ca, pill CTAs with a 160px radius and 12px uppercase labels, and soft layered shadows on 16px-radius cards.

matichon.name: Matichon Online
matichon.description: Matichon Online (matichon.co.th), Thai news portal measured live: black masthead on a white canvas (#ffffff, ink #111111), one orange accent #fc7a32 on pill chips (25px radius), DB Heavent headlines at 36px weight 700 with Kanit for navigation.

matichon-publishing-house.name: Matichon Publishing House (MatichonBook.com)
matichon-publishing-house.description: Online bookshop of Matichon Publishing House, measured live: white canvas (#ffffff), red primary #cf212c on square-cornered add-to-cart buttons, sand #fee6a4 background area, Boon Thai typeface with 26px uppercase section headings.

max-mara-jacket-circle.name: Max Mara Jacket Circle
max-mara-jacket-circle.description: Max Mara Jacket Circle game microsite entry screen, measured live: coral #d45054 field, burgundy #68142b text, cream #ebe1bd note, Libre Baskerville serif with a 78.6666px title and 20px italic body, zero radius and no shadows.

max-mara-untamed-heroine.name: Max Mara Untamed Heroine
max-mara-untamed-heroine.description: Max Mara Untamed Heroine story microsite entry screen, measured live: painted sage background (largest area #c6c4b0), cream #ebe1bd type, Libre Baskerville 60px title and 20px italic body with Inter 12px notes, 8px radius.

max-milkin-portfolio.name: Max Milkin Portfolio
max-milkin-portfolio.description: Creative frontend developer portfolio measured live: near-black #10120f bands alternating with pale sage #c2cabb, white uppercase RF Dewi at 12px, Bebas Neue wordmark, 40px outlined pill links, no shadows.

maxima-therapy.name: Maxima Therapy
maxima-therapy.description: Maxima Therapy, a neurodivergent-support provider, measured live: butter #fff2b7 canvas, orange-red #fd4401 primary, yellow #fdcb40 header, green #00b351 footer, Robuck Rounded 48.1482px headings and ABC Diatype Rounded Plus text.

maya-chiangmai.name: MAYA Lifestyle Shopping Center
maya-chiangmai.description: MAYA Lifestyle Shopping Center, Chiang Mai: warm ivory #f5f3ef canvas, champagne gold #c1ac69 square buttons, Chonburi serif display at 50px with Kanit light body, zero-radius geometry and collage-style category art.

maybelline.name: Maybelline New York
maybelline.description: Maybelline New York home page measured live: black header and footer on a white canvas, brand yellow #ffd000, Neue Helvetica Pro uppercase headlines at 70px, light Helvetica Neue body, 2px-radius outlined buttons, 8px cards.

mayo-clinic.name: Mayo Clinic
mayo-clinic.description: Mayo Clinic home page: mayo-display serif headlines (76px light hero, 32px and 24px bold), mayo-sans 20px/28px body, #080808 ink on #ffffff, Mayo blue #0057b8 square 52px buttons with #1371d5 hover, #8cc5ff hairlines, a #0d0d33 donations band, #012d61 footer and #e1f0ff legal strip, 8px image cards and capsule search.

mazda.name: Mazda USA
mazda.description: Mazda USA official site measured live: white canvas, near-black #101010 ink, Mazda Type uppercase headings at 35px with 3.5px tracking, white 3px-radius buttons 45px tall, slate #4a5b6e footer.

mazda-thailand.name: Mazda Thailand (Mazda Sales (Thailand) Co., Ltd.)
mazda-thailand.description: Mazda Thailand home page measured live: black header and hero, white pill buttons 46px tall that turn burgundy #910a2c on hover, navy #253246 statement band, MazdaType TH at 54px uppercase and 20px Thai body.

mbk-center.name: MBK Center
mbk-center.description: Design language of the MBK Center shopping-mall website: Kanit for all Thai and Latin text, near-black #111111 ink on white, a red-violet #ac1681 action colour with a #e10098 hover, a 4px button radius, and a loud multicolour gradient (gold to orange to magenta to violet to indigo) behind vividly illustrated category tiles.

mc-jeans.name: Mc Jeans (mcshop)
mc-jeans.description: Mc Jeans online shop (mcshop.com) measured live: white canvas, near-black #181818 ink, yellow #ffc800 promotion strips, red #fc0009 emphasis, Noto Sans Thai at 24px bold titles, 8px inputs and pill selectors.

mcard-mall.name: M Card
mcard-mall.description: M Card (mcardmall.com) is the loyalty-card site of The Mall Group's shopping complexes: a white page with #1a1a1a black pill buttons that turn red #c9252c on hover, the DBAiryStd type family up to 72px, a charcoal lifestyle band, 10px-radius cards and a bold red campaign hero.

mccann.name: McCann
mccann.description: McCann global advertising network home page measured live: black #000000 and #030303 fields, off-white #fcfcfc text, giant light-grey wordmark, Mccan Headline display type up to 360px with Lato 10px fine print, zero radius, no shadows.

mcdonalds.name: McDonald's
mcdonalds.description: McDonald's US site: a plain #ffffff canvas with #292929 Speedee text, a single golden #ffbc0d 48px-radius pill CTA with a 1px #c08b00 border (hover #ffcc49), white outline pills bordered #7c7c7c, #006bae underlined links, a #292929 utility bar, 12px-radius promo images and teaser cards with a hairline #cecece border, all set in the proprietary Speedee typeface (400/700, -0.15px tracking).

mckinsey.name: McKinsey & Company
mckinsey.description: McKinsey & Company (mckinsey.com) sets light-weight McKinsey Sans (300) headlines and a Bower serif hero on Deep Blue #051c2c, with Electric Blue #2251ff square-cornered buttons, white #ffffff content bands, Cyan #00a9f4 hovers and almost no rounding (0px buttons, 2–16px elsewhere).

mclaren.name: McLaren Automotive
mclaren.description: McLaren Automotive global site measured live: white and black bands with #f0f0f0 grey, black 65 percent text, McLaren orange #ff8000 on hover, McLaren Sans Display and Text, sharp 0px corners and 46px white rectangular buttons.

mcot-public-company.name: MCOT Public Company Limited (MCOT)
mcot-public-company.description: Thai state media group site at mcot.net/www/th: black header with Kanit 18px body and 30px weight 600 headings, channel colour bands in purple #9013fe, blue #3684da and orange #e67b38, a #6506bc button, 16px-radius video cards.

mea.name: Metropolitan Electricity Authority (MEA)
mea.description: Metropolitan Electricity Authority portal: white canvas with #f2f2f2 panels, #333333 ink, maroon #862633 tab links, orange #d64300 accents, db_ozone type at 22px/19px, and 20px pill outline buttons.

medium.name: Medium
medium.description: Medium's logged-out home is a one-screen editorial poster: a warm off-white #f7f4ed canvas, a gt-super serif headline at 120px/400 with -6.6px tracking, sohne sans text in #242424, near-black #191919 pill buttons, thin black rules and a green ink-print illustration; accent green #1a8917 is declared in its tokens.

medtronic.name: Medtronic
medtronic.description: Medtronic corporate home: white canvas with #f5f5f5 bands, navy #170f5f headings, electric blue #1010eb actions, #1e1e1e dark feature band, AvenirNextWorld at 47px/700 display and 20px body, 10-24px radii and 100px pill search.

medusmo.name: Medusmo
medusmo.description: Medusmo home: dark #31312f hero canvas turning to #f5f5f5 and #e4e4e4 panels, lime #dafb71 pill CTA, Doumbar uppercase display at 55.98px and 111.96px with negative tracking, Inter 12-15px body, 149px full pills and 11.2px cards.

meech213.name: Meech213
meech213.description: Meech213, the portfolio of photographer and filmmaker Dametreus Ward: warm paper canvas #f5f4f1, pure black ink, articulat-cf 14.1px uppercase nav and Ceraph Roman 35.25px statements, no filled buttons, 9999px pill only.

meechok-plaza.name: Meechok Plaza
meechok-plaza.description: Meechok Plaza Community Mall, Chiang Mai: a Wix-built site with a coral-to-crimson gradient hero, white Poppins display type, crimson #d9385b pill CTAs, navy #03264e text, aerial photography and a coral footer with yellow text.

meer-mohsin.name: Meer Mohsin
meer-mohsin.description: Meer Mohsin portfolio: pure black #000000 canvas, white text, blood-red #d60407 headline and #990000 secondary red, 170.66px uppercase light-font display, ruthie script at 202.66px, Neue Montreal preloaded, pill radii and a flame-footer.

mega-bangna.name: Mega Bangna
mega-bangna.description: Mega Bangna (Megabangna, ศูนย์การค้าเมกาบางนา) is the east-Bangkok family shopping centre whose official site at mega-bangna.com uses DB Heavent Rounded Thai type at 50px and 36px in slate #425055 on a white canvas, MyriadPro body copy at 16px, a Mega red #e2211c square-cornered sign-up button, and loud seasonal promotional banners.

meituan.name: Meituan (美团)
meituan.description: Meituan corporate site (meituan.com): canvas #f7f8f9, navy-black ink #111925, brand yellow #ffd100, white 16px-radius news cards, MTTiJ display at 52px/500 and PingFang SC body at 14px, Chinese-first with a soft yellow hero glow.

mekha-cloud.name: Mekha Cloud
mekha-cloud.description: Mekha Cloud (mekha.cloud), a Thai cloud provider: pale-blue canvas #eaf1fb with frosted-glass panels, blue #0068d9 gradient pill CTAs, ink #51545b and #17181b, system SF Pro and Noto Sans Thai at 94.72px/740 display and 16px body, 999px pills and 24px cards.

mercadolibre.name: Mercado Libre
mercadolibre.description: Mercado Libre's web presence as measured on mercadolibre.com (a yellow #ffe600 country-picker page with Arial 36px bold and #333333 ink) and on mercadolibre.com.mx (white and #ebebeb marketplace surfaces, Proxima Nova, Andes blue #3483fa action color, 5px buttons, 6px cards, a #ffe600 header).

mercari.name: Mercari
mercari.description: Mercari corporate site (about.mercari.com) — a white-canvas Japanese-English editorial layout in near-black #222222 ink with Mercari Red #ff0211 reserved for eyebrow labels, hover states and circular icon buttons, set in Avenir-Black and Avenir-Roman with Yu Gothic fallbacks and MercariSans on mission headings, using 4px, 10px and 34px radii and a pale blue #e4eefa service band.

mercedes-benz.name: Mercedes-Benz
mercedes-benz.description: Mercedes-Benz USA homepage (mbusa.com): near-black #0d0d0d header and footer, white #ffffff canvas, #9f9f9f nav labels, a #0078d6 blue button with 2px radius and 48px height, MBCorpoATitleCond 56px headlines over full-bleed car imagery, MBCorpoS 16px for text, and tall dark shopping-tool tiles.

merck.name: Merck
merck.description: Merck corporate home (merck.com, US): white canvas with flat teal #00857c panels and buttons, black ink, grey #747474 body, Invention typeface at 37px/300 display and 16px body, 1px radii, photography of scientists and patients.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.description: Mercury's marketing site is a dark, cinematic business-banking page: an indigo-black canvas (#171721) carrying soft lavender-white ink (#ededf3), one electric indigo action color (#5266eb) on 32px-radius pill buttons, and frosted translucent secondary pills. Type is the custom Arcadia family served as arcadia (UI/body) and arcadiaDisplay (headlines) at unusual variable weights 360, 420 and 480, with slightly positive tracking (0.42px at 28-42px). Cards are #1e1e2a panels with 12px corners and 32px padding; the pricing page flips to a near-white #fbfcfd canvas with #272735 ink.

mesh-ds.name: Mesh Design System
mesh-ds.description: Mesh is nib Group's design system and its documentation site: a deep forest green (#144a38) used for headlines, links and pill buttons on a sage (#dae6d2), cream (#f5f0d6) and peach (#fedcc6) banded layout, set in the system sans stack at bold 60px with negative tracking, with 8px-radius outlined cards and a lime (#82e578) accent.

meta.name: Meta
meta.description: Meta's corporate "about" page (meta.com/about) is a white page with one saturated blue action, #0064e0, on fully rounded 100px pill buttons 44px tall, set in the Optimistic VF variable typeface (48px/500 headline with 0.576px tracking, 18px body) in cool blue-gray inks (#1c2b33, #5d6c7b), with 24px-radius #f8f9fb cards and a full-bleed photographic video hero under a translucent white header.

metalab.name: Metalab
metalab.description: Metalab's site is a pure-black (#000000) stage with white (#ffffff) type, set in PP Eiko (Pangram Pangram) at ultra-light weight 240 for 88px display lines and Basis Grotesque Pro (Colophon) at 16px/400 for everything else. Actions are translucent-grey 32px pills (#bababa33, 50px radius) that turn transparent with a 1px white outline on hover; the only chroma is the brand purple #584dff carried by a 3D star render.

metamask.name: MetaMask
metamask.description: MetaMask home: black #0a0a0a pill CTA on a white page of saturated feature tiles (purple #190066, peach #ffa680, forest #013330, sky #cce7ff), MMPolyVariable 106.67px display, MMSansVariable and MMEuclidCircularB text, 28-89px radii, dark phone frame.

metlife.name: MetLife
metlife.description: MetLife.com home (Global Employee Group Benefits): white canvas with warm #fbfaf8 bands, ink #2d2d2d, deep navy-teal #003652 primary buttons and headings, ivypresto-text serif 68px display with Inter body, 4px buttons, 12px cards and 999px outline pills.

metrabyte-datacenter.name: Metrabyte Cloud (เมทราไบต์ คลาวด์)
metrabyte-datacenter.description: Metrabyte Cloud (metrabyte.cloud), a Thai VPS and hosting provider: white canvas, brand red #e82331 pill CTAs with a 10px offset shadow, #202736 navy footer, skv Thai-Latin type at 16px body and 36px display, 50px pills and red speech-bubble cards.

metropolis-test-drive.name: Metropolis Test Drive
metropolis-test-drive.description: Metropolis Test Drive (testdrive.metropolis.io): an interactive Metropolis parking walkthrough on a white card over a grey 3D city, #5f59ff indigo square buttons, #1c1c1c ink, TT Hoves at 36px and 47.45px with negative tracking, 4px and 8px radii and 50% pins.

mfc-asset-management.name: MFC Asset Management
mfc-asset-management.description: Thai mutual-fund portal in Kanit 300/400: white #ffffff canvas, #af1217 brand red for links and bands, #911a2a maroon headings, #333333 body text, #f2f3f5 panels, soft low-opacity shadows, 5px-radius cards and #ff0000 negative NAV figures.

mg-thailand.name: MG Cars Thailand
mg-thailand.description: MG Cars Thailand (MG SALES (THAILAND)) home page measured at mgcars.com/th: Thai-language car showroom on a white #ffffff canvas with #000000 ink, brand red #d2232a for underlines and accents, Sukhumvit typeface at 18px body and 40px uppercase section titles, rounded cards (17px), pill and 30px buttons.

mgronline.name: Manager Online (MGR Online)
mgronline.description: Manager Online (ผู้จัดการออนไลน์, MGR Online) Thai news portal measured at mgronline.com: dense white and #f1f1f1 canvas, #333333 body ink, #ff0000 red accents, black video bands, C-Font family at 14px body and 25.2px section headings, 10px-radius dark headline cards over photos.

micro.name: Micro
micro.description: Micro (micro.so) home page measured: warm off-white #f5f5f5 canvas, near-black warm ink #221f1c, haffer sans at 72px weight 900 mixed with a perfectlyNineties serif accent, 10px-radius dark Sign up button with an inset bottom edge, #fafafa cards at 14px radius with soft layered shadows.

microsoft-ai.name: Microsoft AI
microsoft-ai.description: Microsoft AI (MAI) home page measured: warm cream #fef9ed canvas, brown-grey ink #5d524b, Bradford LL serif at 111.111px with -4.44444px tracking for the Humanist Superintelligence hero, Red Hat Mono labels at 13.3333px, square-cornered pale-tan #fbf0dc model chips, coral-to-peach #fbd3be imagery.

microsoft-fluent.name: Microsoft
microsoft-fluent.description: microsoft.com home: white header and light-gray sections alternating with full-bleed black product heroes, a Segoe UI Variable text stack at 16px, Aux Mono display headlines at 40px with -1px tracking, Microsoft blue #0078d4 buttons with 8px radius, 24px-radius cards and 16px-radius suggestion chips.

microsoft-fluentui.name: Microsoft Developer
microsoft-fluentui.description: Captured on developer.microsoft.com (the Microsoft Developer home, not the Fluent UI docs): a near-white canvas (#fefefe) fading to pale blue (#f4fafd), navy ink (#17253d) and heading ink (#0e1726), deep Azure-blue pills (#005597) and a Microsoft-blue action (#0078d4), Segoe UI Variable Display at 50px/52px for the H1, 16px Segoe UI Variable Text body, and soft 24px-radius cards over a 200px-radius pill control.

midjourney.name: Midjourney
midjourney.description: Midjourney's home page: a near-black indigo #06051d canvas under a blue ASCII-text hero, JetBrains Mono 16px/26px body in #cad5e2 with #63b3ed underlined links, DM Sans 16px/500 pill buttons (9999px) each tinted its own hue, and 8px-radius glassy #96c8ff33 image tiles.

midlife-engineering.name: Midlife Engineering
midlife-engineering.description: Midlife Engineering (midlife.engineering) sound-therapy site measured: light grey #ebebeb canvas, #262626 ink, orange #ff611a accent dot and highlight words, PP Neue Montreal Medium at 262.67px with -10.5068px tracking, a dark #141416 hardware-style sampler UI with 32px-radius keys.

mikki-sindhunata.name: Mikki Sindhunata
mikki-sindhunata.description: Mikki Sindhunata portfolio (mikkisindhunata.com) measured: full-bleed dark film still over #000000 with #e8e8e8 text, Anton SC uppercase display at 64px, B612 Mono 9.6px uppercase labels, outlined 24px-radius nav buttons 36px tall, pill play control.

milledollars.name: MilleDollars
milledollars.description: MilleDollars (milledollars.fr) creative video bureau home page measured: full-screen film stage with #e0dee1 canvas behind, #181818 ink and #ffffff overlay text, ABCDiatype uppercase at 16px with 8.88889px nav labels, Migra serif for the tagline, no measured radius or shadow.

mindmarket.name: MindMarket
mindmarket.description: MindMarket (mindmarket.com) market-research agency home page measured: lime #8ed462 hero over a cream #f5f1e4 page, #2c2e2a ink, blue #2ba0ff accent, Inter weight 500 at 124.16px with -7.4496px tracking, white nav and card panels, 10px-radius outlined Get a quote button, yellow #f5e211 footer.

mini.name: MINI
mini.description: MINI's official homepage (mini.com, measured at /en_MS/home.html): a white canvas (#ffffff) with pure black ink (#000000), a 64px uppercase serif display face (MINIBold, Georgia fallback) over full-bleed photography, MINISansReg 16px for navigation and body, underlined footer links that turn teal #017ea4 on hover, and circular 50% controls.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.description: Stripped-back design emphasizing whitespace, clean typography, and restrained color for maximum clarity and focus.

minimax.name: MiniMax
minimax.description: MiniMax's marketing site pairs a bright sky-blue gradient hero and white sections with Outfit display type (108px/500, -4.32px tracking), DM Sans body at weight 330, and Libre Baskerville serif taglines; actions are black 32px-radius pills 38px tall (#000000 Login) or white-outlined pills on the hero, and model cards sit in frosted #ffffff40 frames over the brand's official orange, purple and cyan gradients.

ministry-of-commerce.name: Ministry of Commerce (กระทรวงพาณิชย์)
ministry-of-commerce.description: Thai Ministry of Commerce portal (moc.go.th) set in the Prompt typeface on white #ffffff with #000033 ink, deep navy #0a214a bands, #fecb01 yellow pill-tab buttons (5px radius, black text) and #002ab2 blue price-section labels with 10px radius.

ministry-of-education.name: Ministry of Education (กระทรวงศึกษาธิการ)
ministry-of-education.description: Thai Ministry of Education portal (moe.go.th) set in the DB Heavent typeface at 18px/500 on a cream #faf3e1 canvas, with a #ffc300 yellow quick-link band, a dark green top utility bar, #2b7dff blue 3px-radius buttons and a 50px-radius pill search field.

ministry-of-energy.name: Ministry of Energy (กระทรวงพลังงาน)
ministry-of-energy.description: Thai Ministry of Energy portal (energy.go.th) set in the Sukhumvit typeface with a #303030 dark footer, #ffffff page body, #ff5000 orange 6px-radius buttons with white text, #2b2b2a navigation ink and a numbered 01-07 top navigation over hero photography.

ministry-of-higher-education-science-res.name: Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation (กระทรวงการอุดมศึกษา วิทยาศาสตร์ วิจัยและนวัตกรรม, อว.)
ministry-of-higher-education-science-res.description: Thai MHESI portal (mhesi.go.th) set in Noto Sans Thai on white #ffffff with black ink, #6d3076 purple 4px-radius buttons with white 14px text, #cd4527 orange-red accents and a #fcb124 yellow-gold top band, with large news photography cards and a #080808 dark band.

ministry-of-labour.name: Ministry of Labour (กระทรวงแรงงาน)
ministry-of-labour.description: Thai Ministry of Labour portal (mol.go.th) set entirely in the Kanit typeface, with a violet palette built on #9d52da (primary) and #791ec3 (deep purple), white #ffffff canvas, #626262 body ink, square 0px primary buttons and a 4px secondary button, and a dense service-icon grid on a patterned purple band.

minor-food.name: Minor Food
minor-food.description: Minor Food corporate site: a navy #13213c and white editorial layout pairing condensed Manuka headlines at 44px, Newsreader serif body at 18px and Plus Jakarta Sans labels, with a square uppercase FIND OUT MORE button, hairline-bordered news cards and flat depth.

minor-international.name: Minor International
minor-international.description: Minor International (MINT, minor.com/en/home) hospitality and restaurant group site measured: navy #13213c bands and light #fafafa/#f5f3f4 panels, taupe-bronze #7c684a square buttons, gold #a58744 headline accents, Muli at 48px bold uppercase with 1.44px tracking, square corners.

minor-smart-kids.name: Minor Smart Kids
minor-smart-kids.description: Minor Smart Kids (minorsmartkids.com) is a playful Thai educational-toy and learning-media distributor site: blue #0d62ab and sunshine yellow #febe2c waves, warm black #251f1b text, the Mitr and pslxomyim typefaces up to 100px, and chunky 15px-radius buttons with hard offset shadows.

mintlify.name: Mintlify
mintlify.description: Mintlify's marketing site is a white, airy documentation-platform page — near-black ink #08090a on a #ffffff canvas, an arizonaFlare display headline at 50px/400 with -2px tracking over Inter 14–24px body and UI text, flat 4px-radius black buttons, 12px-radius warm-neutral cards (#f9f6f3), and one green accent (#0c8c5e) reserved for links, counters and focus states, with light-green gradient line art behind the hero.

miro.name: Miro
miro.description: Miro's homepage is a light-gray (#f0f0f0) canvas with dark ink #1c1c1e, a single saturated blue action #3859ff on 8px-radius buttons 40px tall (Noto Sans 16px/600), Roobert PRO Medium headlines at 56px/500 and 40px/400 with -1.2px tracking, floating product UI fragments joined by blue connector lines, and rounded 16-24px cards plus tall photo cards with white statistic overlays.

mistral-ai.name: Mistral AI
mistral-ai.description: Mistral AI's homepage is a warm-cream (#fbfbf8 and #f5f4ef) page ruled into cells by thin #e4e3de lines, with ALTMistral display type at 96px/500 and -1.92px tracking over Inter 16px UI text, square-cornered black buttons (#09090b, 48px tall) beside 6px-radius gray buttons, a dark #151524 testimonial band, and pixel-art illustrations in orange, amber and red blocks echoing the pixel-cat logo.

mit.name: MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
mit.description: MIT (mit.edu) home page measured: white and #f7f7f7 canvas, black #000000 ink, MIT Red #750014 top bar with bright red #ff1423 underlines and search button, Neue Haas Grotesk Text 15.96px body and Display 700 headings, 28px news headline, near-square corners.

mitsib-leasing.name: Mitsib Leasing
mitsib-leasing.description: Mitsib Leasing PCL (mitsibleasing.com), a Thai taxi and vehicle finance company on WordPress with the Betheme theme: orange #f36d37 brand bands, near-white canvas #fcfcfc, Prompt body at 300, Athiti navigation, Roboto controls, flat 0px buttons and 2px accent radii.

mitsubishi-motors-thailand.name: Mitsubishi Motors Thailand
mitsubishi-motors-thailand.description: Mitsubishi Motors Thailand (mitsubishi-motors.co.th/en) measured: black and white stage with anthracite #686d71 text, MMC-Bold at 63.008px for hero lines, MMC-Regular 16px body, tracked uppercase 14px outlined buttons with no radius, brand reds #ed0000 and #bd0000 from the site's own variables.

mitsubishi-ufj.name: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG)
mitsubishi-ufj.description: Japanese financial-group corporate site in MUFG red #e60000 on white #ffffff with #333333 body ink, set in Hiragino Kaku Gothic Pro / Meiryo at 28px bold h1 and 12px body, near-square corners (2px, 4px) and outlined red buttons.

miux-studio.name: MIUX Studio
miux-studio.description: Seattle brand and digital design studio site in warm neutrals: tan #d5c8b0 hero, cream #f7f3ed canvas, sage #b9bdab panels, #333335 ink, one self-hosted sans at weight 400-500 with negative tracking, 42.6667px display and 12px radii.

mixpanel.name: Mixpanel
mixpanel.description: Mixpanel's product-analytics site: a #fafafa canvas, gray-10 #1f2023 headlines and pill buttons with 100px radius, 70%-black body text, Garnett Medium 48px/400 headlines tracked -0.96px, ABC Arizona light-italic serif quotes, signature purple #7856ff glows, and deep plum #33001f and forest #00332a feature bands.

mk-real-estate.name: M.K. Real Estate Development
mk-real-estate.description: M.K. Real Estate Development (mk.co.th, Thai: เลือกบ้านมั่นคง) home page: psl_kittithada_proregular Thai type in uppercase-tracked 40px headings, a dark #3d3d3d filter bar and #282828 footer, white and #f2f2f2 project sections, a #6d007c purple search button and 30px-rounded promotion tiles over a dark #261229 popup scrim in the capture.

mk-restaurants.name: MK Restaurants
mk-restaurants.description: Thai restaurant-group site (mkrestaurant.com/en) in MK red #ed2e34 pill buttons with 45px radius and green #00a249 accents on white, set in PSL Kanda Pro Bold at 22px with 32px headings, food photography and bilingual Thai/English promo banners.

mk1642.name: MK Delivery 1642
mk1642.description: MK Online Delivery (mk1642.com) ordering site - a #d00016 deep-red header over white, #ed2e34 red 5px-radius 'Read more' buttons and price chips, #333333 body text, db_helvethaica x55 regular and x75 bold at 26px base, photo-led promotion cards with 10px radius.

mob-links.name: Moblinks
mob-links.description: French streetwear e-commerce site (moblinks.fr) in saturated yellow #ffbf00 and warm cream #fff2df with brown #6b3e28 ink, navy #001976 blocks, set in the Ringold display face at weight 500 with white pill buttons and 26.65px card radius.

mobbin.name: Mobbin
mobbin.description: Mobbin's design-reference-library site: one variable family, saans, with 80px/652 headlines and 16px/456 text, near-black #141414 ink and buttons on white, translucent #4040400f grey cards with 32px corners, 9999px pill buttons, a #707070 secondary grey and a #141414 footer — no brand hue.

modern.name: Modern
modern.description: Contemporary editorial style with serif typography, minimal palettes, and clean layouts for polished digital products.

moderna.name: Moderna
moderna.description: Moderna corporate site (modernatx.com) in deep blue ink #053f68 on pale blue canvas #f8fdff with a dark teal #083952 footer, Aeonik at 40px bold headings and 18px body, 12px-radius white cards with soft layered shadows and a red #d1343e accent.

moma.name: MoMA
moma.description: The Museum of Modern Art (moma.org): a white #ffffff canvas with black #000000 type set in the museum's own MoMA Sans at weight 900 with tight negative tracking, square 0px corners everywhere, black buttons, and flat full-width campaign bands in brand green #8fc421, teal #6bdcc5 and blue #00b7f2.

momoney.name: MoMoney, the Museum of Money
momoney.description: Dallas interactive money museum site (museumofmoney.com) in neo-brutalist style: cream #fff5dd canvas, #111111 ink, magenta #b82297 and yellow #f4f242 buttons with hard 4px offset shadows and 0px radius, Archivo Black uppercase headings over Manrope body.

monarch-money.name: Monarch
monarch-money.description: Monarch (monarch.com, formerly Monarch Money): a warm cream #fffaec page with white and sand #f3ecd7 panels, ABC Oracle Light 59.68px hero over ABC Otto serif section heads, warm near-black #2a2926 ink, orange #f86713 pill CTAs that deepen to #f35b16, a #e64818 closing band, and Beltram Mono uppercase eyebrows in orange.

moncler.name: Moncler
moncler.description: Moncler US online shop (moncler.com/en-us): warm off-white #f7f8f3 canvas, black #000000 type and footer, white #ffffff type over dark full-bleed campaign imagery, grey #b2b2b2 secondary text. One family, MonclerGothicWeb at 400/500 — 42px hero, 32px section titles, 14–16px body — with square 0px corners and no shadows.

monday.name: monday.com
monday.description: monday.com's marketing homepage runs on Poppins in regular weight with tight tracking (56px headline at -2.24px), black ink on white and #f3f4f5, a single periwinkle-violet #6161ff for 160px-radius pill buttons that darken to #452aea, warm #f2ede9 panels with 3D agent illustrations, and product-board mockups full of green, orange and pink status cells.

mondelez.name: Mondelēz International
mondelez.description: Mondelēz International corporate site in brand purple #4f2170 with green #287819 headings on white, set in the custom MDLZ BITE TYPE display face (100px uppercase) over Calibri 21px body, with outlined pill buttons of 40px radius and a brand-logo strip.

moneybuffalo.name: Money Buffalo
moneybuffalo.description: Money Buffalo (moneybuffalo.in.th), a Thai personal-finance explainer site: white canvas, navy #031c52 text, royal blue #1e45ef accent, db admin Thai display type at 52px, 50px pill chips, 10px cream cards and a buffalo mascot in rate and price tables.

mongodb.name: MongoDB
mongodb.description: MongoDB homepage system: a teal-black stage (#061621) with cream (#fdfeec) text, one spring-green (#00ed64) button with #001e2b labels and 4px radius, Sohne Condensed 700 uppercase headlines, Sohne 16px body, 12px dark cards with 1px translucent white borders.

monix.name: Monix
monix.description: Monix (Thai fintech, FINNIX lending app) design system: Rubik headings at 88px weight 500, light grey canvas #f0f2f2, single turquoise action color #40d2d2, near-black #131313 headlines, 6px buttons and 12px shadowed cards.

mono.name: Mono
mono.description: Monospace-driven, matrix-inspired design with high-contrast elements, compact density, and a hacker-chic aesthetic.

monocle.name: Monocle
monocle.description: Monocle's site monocle.com measured live — a white #ffffff newspaper grid in black #000000 Plantin serif (32px lead headlines, 20px story heads, 18px body), Helvetica Neue 13px bold uppercase for utility labels and square yellow #ffc500 SUBSCRIBE / LISTEN LIVE buttons, a #2a2929 radio band, sky-blue #64d5ff city-guide cards with 8px corners, cream #fdfcf3 panels and a black footer.

monolog.name: MONOLOG
monolog.description: MONOLOG brand and web design studio site (bymonolog.com) in warm grey #e8e8e3 and near-black #080807, with Khteka headings at 131px weight 700 and -3.93px tracking, Suisse Mono captions, 2.4px radii and compact #181715 buttons with an arrow icon.

monomax.name: Monomax
monomax.description: Monomax (monomax.me) is a Thai streaming service for series, movies, sport and live TV, set on a near-black #121212 canvas with white NotoSansThai text, a single orange #fa4616 action color, 8px-radius buttons and pill-shaped chips.

montblanc.name: Montblanc
montblanc.description: Montblanc's US homepage is a white (#ffffff) and black gallery-style retail page set in the proprietary MontblancType at 14px body and tracked 18px uppercase display, with square 0px black and outlined 48px buttons, grey and cream bands, and product photography as the only colour.

montfort.name: Montfort Group

nipa-cloud.description: NIPA Cloud, a Thai sovereign cloud provider: navy #232c65 headings on a #fefefe canvas, magenta #e91e76 buttons with 8px corners, Prompt and Sarabun type (64px hero, 18px body), white 12px-radius cards with #dfdfdf borders and a named type scale.

nirvana.name: Nirvana Development
nirvana.description: Nirvana Development (nirvanadevelopment.co.th) Thai residential developer: full-bleed architectural photography with a 72px Montserrat 200 white headline, SukhumvitSet Thai fallback, #404142 ink, #fefefe canvas and 3px radius outlined tabs.

nissan-thailand.name: Nissan Motor (Thailand)
nissan-thailand.description: Nissan Motor (Thailand)'s English site: Nissan red #c3002f square buttons (0px radius, 14px uppercase), a proprietary Nissan Light/Regular/Bold family (48px display, 16px body) on white with #eeeeee panels, black footer, and no shadows or rounded corners.

nitex.name: NITEX
nitex.description: NITEX, a real-time fashion supply chain: acid neon #d7ff00 against black #000000 and white #ffffff, a 68px uppercase RightGrotesk headline, PPNeueMontreal 15px body, Fragment Mono 12px uppercase labels, 0px radius everywhere and slanted shapes.

nivea.name: Nivea Thailand
nivea.description: Nivea Thailand home (nivea.co.th, reached from the nivea.com market chooser): NIVEABrandType Bold and ExtraBold uppercase headings in deep blue #0032a0 on a pale #ebf1fd canvas, electric blue #0f60ff pill buttons with 56px radius, circular product and editorial crops, and a solid blue footer.

nk-studio.name: /nk.studio
nk-studio.description: /nk.studio home: DM Sans (variable, weights 300 to 700) in a near-black #070b0a stage with warm off-white #fdfdf9 text, mint accents #00ffc2 and #20e7b7, 67.1925px hero headline with -1.34385px tracking, a floating 10px-radius translucent nav pill, and a cream sheet with 20px top corners.

no-art.name: No Art
no-art.description: No Art (noartmusic.com): monochrome #000000 on #ffffff, all-caps Chivomono monospace at 10.6667px to 16px with Nue Haas Grotesk Text Pro 600 statement headings at 42.6667px and -1.44px tracking, square corners, a full-bleed video hero and illustrated poster strip.

noble.name: Noble Development
noble.description: Noble Development (noblehome.com) home page measured in English: DB Heavent type at 32px headings and 22px inputs, black #000000 ink on white, #d26132 orange accent from the site's own --btn-color-orange variable, #f5f5f7 light panels, 4px and 10px radii and a black footer, over bright full-color project campaign banners.

noho.name: Noho
noho.description: Noho (noho.ink) furniture storefront: Switzer 600 headings at 53.376px with -2.13504px tracking on warm neutrals #f1eee9, #e7e2da and #cdc0b0, charcoal ink #3c3c3c, square white and charcoal buttons, and flat-color photography of chairs.

nok-air.name: Nok Air
nok-air.description: Nok Air (nokair.com) airline home: saturated yellow #ffcb0b header, booking panel and 50px-tall 5px-radius buttons with black text, DBOzoneX type at 21px body and 40px to 60px headings, pale-yellow #fefcc3 bands and circular photo badges.

nok-mini.name: Nok Mini Airlines
nok-mini.description: Nok Mini Airlines (nokmini.com) commuter-airline site: a boxed WordPress layout in Ubuntu 16px / 27.2px on white #ffffff over a #e6e6e6 base, #444444 text, a #16a1e7 active nav tab with white 12px bold caps, #0b91ea links and square corners.

noomo-showcase.name: Noomo Showcase
noomo-showcase.description: Noomo Showcase (showcase.noomoagency.com): a black WebGL stage with pale blue-white text #d9e0ed and #d2e0ff, cobalt #0004eb buttons with 6px radius and a round arrow tile, PP Neue Montreal grotesk with GT America Mono nav at 14px.

nordhealth.name: Nordhealth
nordhealth.description: Nordhealth (Nordic healthcare and veterinary software) marketing site: Nordhealth Sans at 80px/700 with -1.2px tracking over an accent-blue #3559c7 hero, white cards with layered #0c1a3d shadows, navy #09142f and #081c4a anchors, a #081c4a 10px-radius primary button with a frosted white secondary, and red, yellow and cyan underline accents.

nordstrom.name: Nordstrom
nordstrom.description: Nordstrom (nordstrom.com) retail home: Brandon Text bold 60px hero headline over full-bleed photography, near-black ink #191a1b on white and #f0f3f5, sale prices in #d82508, 4px-radius black buttons and cards with a 1px 4px soft shadow, built on the NDLS design variables.

nordvpn.name: NordVPN
nordvpn.description: NordVPN's site: Inter 600 headlines at 48px/62.4px over white and near-black #141415 sections, #2a2a2d body ink, red #e02f1f Get NordVPN pills 48px tall that hover to #9e1c10, Nord blue #3e5fff for accents and links, pale blue #f3f7fc FAQ bands, and 12px/20px/40px radius cards.

norgram-co.name: Norgram
norgram-co.description: Norgram (norgram.co) design-studio portfolio: Helvetica Now Display at weight 400 with -0.72px tracking, a 77.4589px heading, white #ffffff project list beside #141414 and #1f1f1f panels, #efefef and #777777 text, 4px image radii and translucent #55555599 news cards.

northern-bangkok-monorail-mrt-pink-line.name: Northern Bangkok Monorail (MRT Pink Line)
northern-bangkok-monorail-mrt-pink-line.description: Northern Bangkok Monorail (nbm.co.th) MRT Pink Line site: magenta #c2007a header, search card and footer, pale pink #efd8de bands, white cards with a 2px 7px soft shadow, Sarabun light type at 16px / 22px, and 26px-radius pill 'Read more' buttons.

northvolt.name: Northvolt
northvolt.description: Northvolt (northvolt.com) is a white #ffffff, photo-led battery-maker site set entirely in the custom Northvolt Grit typeface, with #222222 ink, square-cornered #44a27a green 'Join us' buttons, 40px regular-weight headlines, 100px stat numerals, a #333333 notice bar and an #080808 black footer.

norway-designsystemet.name: Digdir (Norwegian Digitalisation Agency)
norway-designsystemet.description: Design language of digdir.no, built on the open Designsystemet token set: Inter at 400/500 weights, deep navy ink #1f2c3d on white, accent blue #0062ba for interaction, warm sand #f8e7c1 content cards with 8px radius, and flat illustration instead of photography-heavy heroes. Buttons use a 4px radius; the footer flips to navy #1e2b3c.

nothin.name: NOTHIN'
nothin.description: NOTHIN' (noth.in), a Paris creative studio: PP Neue Montreal 500 at 64px with -0.64px tracking and uppercase 9.6px UI, black #000000 and white #ffffff with grey #8e8e8e labels, 80px-radius pill buttons with a 1px #ffffff66 border, and glossy 3D imagery.

nothing.name: Nothing
nothing.description: Nothing's US Shopify store (assets on Shopify's Oxygen CDN) is a greyscale, type-led system on a #f4f4f4 canvas with #040404 ink: NType82-Regular headlines at 48px/32px weight 400 (and a 100-weight 'title' cut), the Ndot-Regular dot-matrix face for category and logo labels, LatteraMonoLL 11px uppercase for every nav label and callout, Geist Variable for long-form copy, black 4px-radius buttons (12px 16px, 40px tall), 8px-radius product tiles, and a single #ffc700 yellow accent.

notion.name: Notion
notion.description: Notion homepage: white page with warm off-white cards (#f6f5f4), alpha-black text (#000000f2), one blue #0075de with 8px-radius buttons, NotionInter at 96px weight 600 with -4.6px tracking, 12px cards and very faint layered shadows.

novartis.name: Novartis
novartis.description: Novartis (novartis.com) global home: Volta Modern Display at weight 500 with 0.4px tracking, 40px headline on a near-white #fcfcfc canvas with #161616 ink and #f2f2f2 bands, orange #ff4e00 link and focus accents, warm editorial photography and 1px circular carousel buttons.

novo-nordisk.name: Novo Nordisk
novo-nordisk.description: Novo Nordisk corporate site measured live: deep navy #00008f on white #ffffff, a pale aqua #bfffff surface, the proprietary Novo typeface at 15px/24px body, pill buttons with 85px radius and full-bleed human photography.

npr.name: NPR
npr.description: NPR home page measured live: white #ffffff canvas, NPR blue #0a61db pill buttons with 60px radius, NPRSans headlines at 18px/500, NPRSerif 14px/21px teaser copy, and dense news cards with 4px image corners.

ns-nl.name: NS Dutch Railways (NS)
ns-nl.description: NS's site uses its own NS Sans (a Frutiger-based face) in bold blue (#003082) on white, with the railway yellow #ffc917 as the hero field, a single action blue (#0063d3) on 6px-radius buttons, 12px-radius cards with soft layered shadows, and real-people photography of travellers on yellow-and-blue trains.

nsw-gov.name: NSW Government
nsw-gov.description: NSW Government (nsw.gov.au) is built on the NSW Digital Design System — Public Sans throughout (700 headings at 48px/32px/20px, 16px/24px body), white canvas with #22272b text, NSW Blue 01 #002664 for buttons, links and nav labels, NSW Red #d7153a as a 4px accent rule, #f2f2f2 off-white panels, 4px radii on buttons and cards and 30px pill links for popular pages.

nt-thailand.name: NT (National Telecom)
nt-thailand.description: National Telecom (NT) home page measured live at ntplc.co.th/en: NT yellow #f8d247 hero and top bar, black #000000 pill buttons with 25px radius, a custom NT typeface in Thai and Latin at 18px/700 buttons, and a dark #555859 footer.

ntt.name: NTT
ntt.description: NTT, Inc. global site measured live: white #ffffff canvas, NTT blue #0072bc for the logo, cards and footer, Noto Sans with an 88px/92px bold-to-light hero headline, Noto Serif italic question labels, 60px pill buttons and pastel sky and teal cards.

nubank.name: Nubank
nubank.description: Nubank (Nu) corporate site nu.com: Nu Purple #8d0de3 and its deeper steps #5d0599, #3f026a and #1e002f, used as the dominant page field (#8d0de3 covers the largest area) with white #ffffff text, set against warm cream bands (#f3efe6, #fffef6, #f8dcc6) and white sections. Type is the proprietary Nu Sans family, served as nuSansDisplaySemibold for 88px/83.6px hero titles with -3px tracking, nuSansDisplayMedium for 24-52px headings and nuSansRegular 20px/28px for body. Buttons are full pills (1000px radius, 56px tall, 16px 32px padding, 18px/600 with +0.5px tracking); cards use 12-16px corners.

nulogy.name: Nulogy
nulogy.description: Nulogy marketing site (nulogy.com): white canvas with navy #0f1f3d headings, a gold #ffc704 primary button and statistics, Blender uppercase 54px headlines over IBM Plex Sans body, 5px and 8px button radii and soft navy-tinted card shadows on 14px rounded cards.

nutella.name: Nutella
nutella.description: Nutella international site measured live at nutella.com/int/en: Nutella red #e20019 on white #ffffff, Montserrat in weights 900 and 700 with a 48px h1, 40px-radius pill buttons, a red pill navigation bar and photographic product scenes.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia.description: NVIDIA homepage: white surfaces with #1a1a1a text, square 0px-radius #76b900 green buttons with black 700-weight labels at 16px, 2px-radius white cards with a 5px soft glow, NVIDIA-NALA at 36px bold headlines and 15px body.

oatly.name: Oatly
oatly.description: Oatly's US site rendered as a desktop 'browser window': a cream #fffef6 panel with a 1px #000000 frame on a white #ffffff grid backdrop, black #000000 Margo Pro Regular uppercase text at 16px, square cards with a 1px black border and a hard 2px 2px 0 black offset shadow, pastel tag chips (#fdcf85, #98c5d3, #f8c8d8, #c6c6c6), a black 9999px pill SHOW MORE button in Margo Pro Bold, and loud display faces (Girdo Black Pro, Toni Noveau Pro) on inner pages.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.description: Obsidian's obsidian.md is a dark, product-first page: #0f0f0f body with #1e1e1e/#1f1f1f feature panels, the system UI stack (60px/600 headlines at -1.2px, 16px/24px body) in #eeeeee and #bcbcbc, violet #7c3aed 8px-radius 60px-tall download buttons that hover to #8b5cf6, and #a78bfa text links.

obys-2.name: Obys Agency
obys-2.description: Obys Agency portfolio measured live at obys.agency: pure black #000000 on white #ffffff with grey #c9c9c9 inactive items, the custom Obys typeface at 71.1111px display and 9.77777px body with negative tracking, zero radius everywhere and a centered vertical image column.

obys-design-books.name: Obys' Design Books
obys-design-books.description: Obys' Design Books (library.obys.agency) measured live: near-black #0e0e0e canvas, a grey #7c7c7c paper panel with white KHTeka bold type at 70px/70px, a #d25933 orange quote panel, a #f5f5f5 ruler column, 10px and pill radii and tight negative tracking.

ocbc-thailand.name: OCBC Group
ocbc-thailand.description: OCBC Group about-us page (the URL queued for OCBC Thailand): OCBC Red #e30613 accent bars, Geomanist 36px light display with OpenSans 18px body, slate-ash ink #363b40 and #3d525d, link blue #005efd, 5px radii, and award cards with a 0 2px 15px 8px 2% black shadow on a white canvas.

octopus-energy.name: Octopus Energy
octopus-energy.description: Octopus Energy's UK site: a deep night-purple #100030 canvas with #180048 bands, pale 'azure' #f0ffff text, cyan #60f0f8 headlines and links, a hot-pink #f050f8 primary button (hover #fa98ff) with 12px corners and a 2px same-colour border, violet #5840ff secondary accents, huge 60px-radius panels, all set in the custom Chromatophore typeface (300/400/500/700/800).

odd-ritual.name: Odd Ritual
odd-ritual.description: Odd Ritual golf apparel store (oddritualgolf.com) measured live: white #ffffff and light grey #f4f4f4 surfaces, black #000000 text, electric blue #050fff accent, PP Neue Montreal at 40px uppercase 600 with -1.2px tracking, Instrument Serif labels and zero radius.

odyssee.name: Odyssée
odyssee.description: Odyssée medical aesthetics clinic (odysseeclinic.com.au, Hunters Hill NSW) measured live: warm white #fffcf8 canvas, navy #1e305e type, psTimes serif at 48px headings and baselGrotesk 14px body, 12px uppercase nav, zero radius and full-bleed skin photography.

off-menu.name: Off Menu
off-menu.description: Off Menu studio site (offmenu.design) measured live: near-white #fdfdfc canvas, near-black #12110d ink, Neue Montreal at weight 500 with a 36px/40px project title and 16px/20px body, pill and 8px to 40px radii, and circular project thumbnails on an empty field.

office-of-agricultural-economics.name: Office of Agricultural Economics (สำนักงานเศรษฐกิจการเกษตร, สศก.)
office-of-agricultural-economics.description: Thai OAE portal measured at oae.go.th/home (the real home behind a memorial landing page), set in Kanit with Sarabun, on #ffffff and a #f7f8f9 body, with #2b4497 navy-blue buttons (8px radius, white 16px weight 600 text), #1245af links and a published custom-property token scale.

officemate.name: OfficeMate (OFM)
officemate.description: OfficeMate Thailand (ofm.co.th) measured live: white #ffffff canvas with a #ebf1f4 page tint, deep navy #2c2d4e text, flash-sale red #ff0000 buttons with 4px radius, Kanit at 12px/18px body and 13px buttons, and a dense Thai e-commerce layout.

oflyn.name: Oflyn
oflyn.description: Oflyn French streetwear boutique (oflyn.fr) measured live: pure black #000000 canvas, white #ffffff type with 8% white #ffffff14 button fills, fluid Neue grotesk at 13.952px and 25.8987px statements, abc uppercase labels, 4px radius chips and grey studio product photography.

ogaki.name: OGAKI
ogaki.description: Social-first beauty agency site (ogakidigital.com) in a warm bone canvas #f2edeb with near-black ink #221f20, set in two typefaces: Reckless (serif, weights 300/400) for headlines and menu, GT America (grotesk, 400/700) in uppercase for navigation and labels. Radii are only 4px and 8px; no shadows, no CTA button fill.

ogilvy.name: Ogilvy
ogilvy.description: Ogilvy agency home page (ogilvy.com): a full-bleed signal red #eb3f43 hero and statement section over a white #ffffff page, black #000000 and #231f20 text, set in two in-house faces, Ogilvy Sans for navigation and Ogilvy Serif for the 60px statement copy. Flat, shadowless, 0px corners with one circular 50% element.

oimachi.name: Oimachi
oimachi.description: Copenhagen branding, Webflow and AI-visibility studio site (oimachi.co): light grey canvas #f0f0f0, pure black #000000 headlines and primary buttons, Aeonik at weight 300 with tight negative tracking, an italic Feature Deck accent, and small 3.17px to 5.86px radii with one 79.17px pill. No shadows or borders.

okta.name: Okta
okta.description: Okta's marketing site: SeasonMix serif headlines at 56px/63.84px weight 400 over a warm off-white #fbfbfa canvas, Aeonik sans for UI and body at 16px/22.4px, an electric blue #0131ff Contact us button with a 30px radius, deep navy #00033e glass cards on blue gradient panels, and a charcoal #1e1e1e footer.

olay.name: OLAY
olay.description: OLAY US store (olay.com): white #ffffff and #fdfdfd surfaces, near-black #161716 primary buttons with 8px radius, Boston typeface at weight 900 for headlines with 1% tracking, Inter for small UI text, soft 16px card shadows and product photography carrying all saturated color.

old-navy.name: Old Navy
old-navy.description: Old Navy storefront (oldnavy.gap.com): white canvas, deep navy #05274c pill buttons with 999px radius and 12px 32px padding, black #000000 text, orange-red #ee4110 accent, set in the ON Sans family (Display 55.7px headline, Text 12-14px UI), flat surfaces and photography-led bands.

olha-lazarieva.name: Olha Lazarieva
olha-lazarieva.description: Portfolio of designer Olha Lazarieva (olhalazarieva.com): a light #f7f7f7 hero and a near-black #101010 section, giant uppercase Sofia Sans Condensed headings at 186.667px with -15.3334px tracking, Spline Sans Mono 300 uppercase captions, 2px radius only, no shadows or filled buttons.

olipop.name: OLIPOP
olipop.description: OLIPOP's Shopify storefront: a warm cream #fff6ea canvas, deep forest-teal #14433d ink set in Alias Ano (16-20px), chunky WindsorEF 800 display headlines (90px hero, 52px sections), hot-pink #e31a82 pill CTAs (50px radius, hover plum #5a0c3c), forest #034638 secondary pills, a plum #5a0c3c announcement bar and a #008168 green footer.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.description: Ollama's marketing site is a near-monochrome, text-first page - white canvas (#ffffff), neutral-900 ink (#171717), muted neutral-500 captions (#737373), the system ui-sans-serif stack with a tight 22px/500 headline at -0.55px tracking, and a single pill-shaped (9999px) near-black "Get started" button that darkens to #000000 on hover.

olympics.name: Olympics
olympics.description: Olympics.com, the IOC's digital home — white #ffffff canvas, #f5f5f5 rounded story cards (12px), full-bleed black photo heroes with olympicHeadlineRegular 56px/700 headlines, olympicSans body at 18–20px in near-black #020202, Olympic blue #0078d0 for the menu block and primary pill, light grey 32px-radius pill buttons, and ring-colour category tiles (#ee212e, #ffb13c, #01a54a).

omega.name: OMEGA
omega.description: OMEGA homepage measured at www.omegawatches.com: a white canvas (#ffffff) with grey body text (#555555), omegact uppercase headings with 4.8px to 6.08px letter-spacing in a crimson (#c40d2e), square-cornered 0px buttons, and translucent white ghost buttons over full-bleed watch photography.

omise.name: Omise
omise.description: Omise payments home page (omise.co/en, queued as Opn): near-black #05080d hero with mint #80ffbf buttons at 6px radius, Outfit weight 300 uppercase display at 140px, DM Sans for body, light #f5f7fa solution cards with blue #3333ff caption tabs, two shadow stacks.

on-energy.name: ON.energy
on-energy.description: ON.energy site (on.energy): acid-yellow #fff313 statement panels against black #000000, Univers Next Pro weight 300 with -4% tracking at 56.89px, ABC Monument Grotesk Mono 12px uppercase labels, square black buttons and a 14.22px-radius yellow action chip, no shadows.

on-running.name: On
on-running.description: On (on.com), the Swiss running and sportswear brand. A monochrome commerce system: pure #ffffff canvas, #000000 ink and #000000 pill CTAs (40px radius, 48px tall, 0 24px padding) that hover to #333333. All text is set in the served family "On" (Dinamo's custom On Diatype) at 400/500/700, with "On Mono" uppercase micro-labels, fluid clamp() sizes such as 48.448px and 15.104px, tight negative tracking on display type, full-bleed photography, a #f0eceb product backdrop and amber #995c00 product labels.

one-medical.name: One Medical
one-medical.description: Amazon One Medical's primary-care marketing system — warm editorial serif headlines in GT Super Display (72–88px, weights 500/600) over light Ginto 200 body copy at 18px/31.5px, set in deep jade #004d49 on white #ffffff with a jade #005450 pill CTA (36px radius, 16px 40px padding, hover #068466), avocado #abcc76 and melon #ffc776 secondary pills, clear-day #eef6f4 and warm #f5f3ef bands, 10px-radius photo cards and a jade footer.

oneplus.name: OnePlus
oneplus.description: OnePlus US store (oneplus.com/us): white and #fafafa product stages with black #000000 bands, black 999px-radius Buy now pills (32px high, hover #4d4d4d), OnePlus Sans Regular and Medium at 36px headlines, a 4px-or-pill radius system and translucent ink colors like #1a1a1af2.

onsen.name: Onsen UI
onsen.description: Onsen UI's site (onsen.io) fills its hero with a red-orange gradient (#ef3e29 fill, #f03b2a button) under white headlines, then drops to white and #fafafa sections with light-weight Helvetica Neue copy in grey (#666666), red section titles at 24px, square 3px uppercase buttons, and a phone mockup running the framework's own iOS-style components.

onyx-hospitality.name: ONYX Hospitality Group
onyx-hospitality.description: ONYX Hospitality Group home page (onyx-hospitality.com/en): white canvas with stone #eeebe7 and dark #32353a bands, near-black #111419 square buttons, plum #522953 pill Subscribe, Rubik 600 uppercase headings at 46px, Noto Sans 300 body, circular photography crops.

ookbee.name: Ookbee
ookbee.description: Ookbee Thai e-book store (ookbee.com): yellow #ffd54c header and buy buttons, black #000000 menu bar and footer, white and #f5f5f5 product shelves, Kanit at weights 400 and 700, red #e52735 prices, 3.2px header buttons and 48px pill buy buttons.

opal-tadpole.name: Opal Electronics
opal-tadpole.description: Opal Electronics (op.al, queued as Opal Tadpole): a black #000000 page with white #ffffff Die Grotesk C text at 18.64px regular and a 43.5px bold lowercase headline, +2% letter spacing, a single yellow #ffdb00 accent, full-bleed product photography and 0px radius everywhere.

open-props.name: Open Props
open-props.description: Open Props (open-props.style) is a library of CSS custom properties, and its site shows it - a pale #f8f9fa canvas with white #ffffff cards, near-black #030507 ink on a system-ui stack, weight-900 headlines at 56px and 40px, indigo link and code colors (#4263eb, #364fc7), small 5px control radii, and layered multi-stop soft shadows from the library's own shadow scale.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.description: Calm, near-monochrome system anchored in deep teal-black with generous white space and editorial typography.

opencode-ai.name: OpenCode
opencode-ai.description: OpenCode (opencode.ai) is a monospace-only, terminal-flavored product site - warm off-white canvas (#fdfcfc), near-black ink (#201d1d) and mid-gray body text (#646262), a Berkeley Mono / IBM Plex Mono stack at 16px, 38px bold headline, 4px-radius solid dark buttons, 6px inputs and tabs, hairline borders, and no shadows or gradients.

opendoor.name: Opendoor
opendoor.description: Opendoor's 2026 marketing site is a warm-paper interface — #fbf9f9 canvas, #23201d warm-black ink with #5e564e muted copy, one saturated accent blue #0042e6 for every CTA (12px radius, 44px tall, with a -4px inset bevel in #0021d9), Graphik (Commercial Type) at 400/500 with tight negative tracking (48px/-2.4px section heads) and a single DM Serif Display 60px hero line, 20px-radius photo cards and a floating 64px address field.

openstatus.name: OpenStatus
openstatus.description: openstatus.dev is a monospaced, square-cornered page: Commit Mono for every heading and paragraph (30px/36px 600 h1, 16px/28px body), white #ffffff cells divided by 1px #e5e5e5 grid lines, #0d0d0dcc ink, a #171717 'Get started free' block button at 0px radius, and status colors #20c45f, #f49f1e and #3a81f6.

openui5.name: OpenUI5
openui5.description: OpenUI5 project site: white and #f4f9fb bands, brand blue #1873b4 with #0f9be6 gradient hero, black ink, SAP's 72 typeface at 17.6px body and 37.431px headings, flat blue illustrations, no shadows, 5px-radius buttons.

optikka.name: Optikka
optikka.description: Optikka's single-page product site is a warm sand canvas (#e6d9cc, with a lighter #ece6df largest area) carrying espresso text (#443218) in PPNeueMontreal 500, a 99.5555px tracked-tight hero, and one vivid ember accent (#fd4319) with zero measured border radius.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.description: Oracle.com runs on the variable OracleSansVF (base weight 350, light 300 headlines at 40px/52px) in near-black #161513 on a warm #f1efed page ground with white #ffffff 12px-radius split cards, #312d2a 4px-radius buttons (hover #3a3632) and #006b8f text links.

orage.name: Orage Studio
orage.description: Orage studio's site (Directors and post-production studio, Paris) is a black canvas (#000000) with white PPSupplyMono text in 10.6667px uppercase, a translucent #00000033 title bar, zero border radius and full-bleed film stills framed like a terminal console.

orange.name: Orange
orange.description: Orange's corporate group site (orange.com/en) is a black, white and orange system: HelvNeueOrange bold headlines up to 100px, a square-cornered #ff7900 button with black text that flips to black on hover, hairline #cccccc rules, #eeeeee panels, and large editorial photography of people.

orangetheory.name: Orangetheory Fitness
orangetheory.description: Orangetheory's US site pairs a warm cream canvas (#f4eddf) and near-black ink (#0a0a0a) with an orange (#ff8633) that fills pill buttons (32px radius) and rounded 30px feature cards, set in PPRightGrotesk 700 at 60.8px with 300-weight 14px body.

oreo.name: OREO
oreo.description: OREO's US shop (oreo.com) runs a saturated #0047d9 blue page body with white sections (#ffffff), near-black #0b0505 text, Pluto 900 uppercase display at 80.7887px with -5.65521px tracking, pill buttons (9999px) and a #1db9ff 3px button border.

origin-property.name: ORIGIN Property
origin-property.description: ORIGIN Property's English home page (origin.co.th/en) sets IBM Plex Sans Thai on white (#ffffff) with navy headings (#0d1e3a), an orange accent (#f46e0b), a dark #121417 button with 10px radius and a floating pill-shaped glass nav.

orsted.name: Ørsted
orsted.description: Ørsted's corporate site is a calm Scandinavian system set entirely in the bespoke Orsted Sans: 44px/500 headlines over full-bleed offshore-wind photography, 16px/25.6px body on a #ffffff canvas with #000000 ink, a single #007acc blue for actions and links, deep #001142 navy bands, #f2f2f2 subtle surfaces, 8px-radius 44px-tall bold buttons, 12px-radius hairline (#d8dbdd) cards and 40px-radius search fields.

oryzo-ai.name: ORYZO AI
oryzo-ai.description: ORYZO AI (oryzo.ai) is a satirical product campaign site by the design studio Lusion: a near-black brown canvas (#100904), cream ink (#ffedd7), burnt-orange accent (#dc5000), halyard-display-variable uppercase at weight 500 and 12px to 32px radii.

oscar-health.name: Oscar Health
oscar-health.description: Oscar's site sits on warm paper (#f7f5eb) with dark-brown ink (#1f0d05), pairing Klim's Heldane Display serif (served as 'display', 120px hero, 71px section heads, -1% tracking, italic for emphasis) with Lineto's Lettera Text sans (served as 'sans', 20px/32px body). The action color is Hot Blue #4f50ff on 56px pill buttons (hover #181867); stat tiles use 16px radius in blue, yellow #ffae00, teal #3fa6b4 and red-orange #ff6b3d.

osmo-1.name: Osmo
osmo-1.description: Osmo (osmo.supply), a Webflow and HTML resource membership for creative developers: a #f4f4f4 page with #201d1d ink, violet #6840ff and lime #a1ff62 accents, Haffer type with tight negative tracking (99.5556px / -5.97333px) and very small radii.

osotspa.name: Osotspa
