osotspa.description: Osotspa's English home page (osotspa.com/en/home) is a consumer-products corporate site in DB Heavent: white canvas, #131313 ink, teal #00a3ad hotline pill, brand blue #003087 buttons, #002871 footer, 40px pill radii and uppercase headings at 66px.

oura.name: Oura
oura.description: Oura's smart-ring storefront — a warm sandstone canvas #f7f1e8 with sandstone-500 #4a4741 ink, condensed "Editorial New" serif headlines (80px/300 with -4px tracking, 68px/400) over AkkuratLL sans UI and body (16px/24px), a single Oura blue #2a72de fully rounded pill CTA (12px 24px, hover #2056a6), dark #4a4741 secondary pills, 12px-radius photo cards, #efe6db testimonial cards and a graphite #1c1b1a news band.

ousmane-dembele-ballon-dor.name: Ousmane Dembélé - Né Pour Briller
ousmane-dembele-ballon-dor.description: A French editorial tribute microsite (ousmaneballondor.fr) on an off-white #fffcf5 page with a #0d0d0d dark block, club-colour sections (#610505, #ffd400, #05192e), red #bb2929 nav text and Doner and Being type, from 6.4px labels to 240px display.

outfit.name: OUTFIT by ++hellohello
outfit.description: OUTFIT, the apparel store of the design studio ++hellohello: an #ede4dd page with signal-red #ff0001 text, a giant 163.2px wordmark, 24px / -0.6px tracked display, black and #d2cac3 surfaces, and a cyan #00c0eb nav-role colour; every corner is square.

outsource-consultants-inc.name: Outsource Consultants, Inc.
outsource-consultants-inc.description: Outsource Consultants, Inc., a New York building-code and permit consultancy, as built at oci.madebybuzzworthy.com: cobalt #1925aa blocks against a #e8e6e0 paper page, PP Neue Montreal at 142.222px, GT America Mono labels at 10.6667px, and strictly square corners.

ova-investment.name: OVA Investment
ova-investment.description: OVA (ova-investment.com), a Montreal investment fund: a pure black page (#000000) with white text, Neue Montreal at 80px weight 500 for section words, Geist Mono labels, a sunset-gradient hero with curved image cards, and no measured border radius or shadows.

oxford-university.name: University of Oxford
oxford-university.description: University of Oxford home page measured live: Oxford blue #002147 ground, cyan #26d2ff buttons with #002147 text, Tiempos Headline serif 500 at 51.816px for display and DM Sans 16.248px body, 6px button radius, pill 9999px chips, 4.9px spacing unit, inset-ring shadows instead of drop shadows.

pace.name: Pace Development
pace.description: Pace Development Corporation (pacedev.com) corporate site: Cantarell 12px body text in #666666 on white, a deep navy #212844 (the site's --base-color--primary) for the footer band and text blocks, a #f8f8f8 secondary surface, a #6daadb light blue, a sharp-cornered flat layout and full-bleed night photography of Bangkok towers.

pacific-park.name: Pacific Park Sriracha
pacific-park.description: Pacific Park Sriracha Shopping Center is a Sri Racha mall site built in royal-navy #232d80 and sky-blue #3270b6 with an orange #f7901e accent and a pink #fe579c active-menu state, set in Noto Sans Thai (16px body, 21px menu, 48px headings), with full-bleed category photo tiles and event cards underlined by an orange rule.

pacman.name: Pacman
pacman.description: Retro arcade-inspired design with pixel fonts, dotted borders, playful high-contrast colors, and 8-bit game aesthetics.

pacome-pertant-portfolio.name: Pacôme Pertant Portfolio
pacome-pertant-portfolio.description: Pacôme Pertant motion and sound designer portfolio, measured at its entry screen with a #0a0a0a canvas, #fafafa text, Indivisible Variable 500 at 80px with -4px tracking and 24px body, a 50px-radius light pill button labelled enter with sound, declared pop green #21ffc0.

paddle.name: Paddle
paddle.description: Paddle's site is a warm off-white #f9f8f7 and sand #ebe7df page with near-black #1c1a15 ink, a condensed serif (serrifCondensed, 400) for 64px headlines over Inter body text, 10px-radius dark buttons, 24px-rounded white story cards and a signature yellow #ffd400 used for one call-to-action panel and small icon chips.

paisana-house.name: PAISANA(House)
paisana-house.description: PAISANA(House) design membership site measured live with a white and near-black #111010 band system, indigo #332eca Subscribe buttons with white text at 0px radius, neue-haas-grotesk-display 400 at 57.28px with -0.32px tracking, lavender #e1dffd band and pastel plan tints.

palantir.name: Palantir
palantir.description: Palantir home page measured live with Alliance No.1 and No.2 at weight 400, neutral surfaces #efefef, #f3f3f3, #ffffff, dark #1e2124 and hero #0d0e10, text #666666, white square Get Started button with #1e2124 text, 2 to 4px radii and tight negative tracking.

palmer.name: Palmer
palmer.description: Palmer dinnerware exploration site measured live with a warm #f5f6ee canvas, #222222 ink and dark controls, TWK Lausanne 300 at 106.667px with -4.26667px tracking, 12px body, hairline #a1a19c, 2.67px control radii and no UI shadows.

palmetto.name: Palmetto
palmetto.description: Palmetto (palmetto.com), the US home clean-energy company: white #ffffff and warm off-white #fbfbf7 pages, a sage #dae3d8 panel, near-black green ink #1f2723, and Palmetto75 red #f9593b for every call to action and the footer (hover #d73e20). Headlines are ultra-heavy ABC Solar Display 800 at 88px/88px; body is Saans 500 at 21px/28px. Buttons are 16px-radius, 50px tall with 16px 20px padding and morph to a 32px radius on hover; cards and panels use very large 28-64px corners.

palo-alto-networks.name: Palo Alto Networks
palo-alto-networks.description: Palo Alto Networks' site: TT Hoves 500 headlines at 44px/52.8px in white on near-black #141414 and #000000 bands, Cyber Orange #fa582d eyebrows and logo, #f76a43 pill buttons with a 36px radius and black text that hover to #f98768, deep red-black #190000 recommendation strip, Strata yellow #ffcb06 product CTA and CelestePro serif inputs.

panasonic.name: Panasonic North America
panasonic.description: Panasonic North America (na.panasonic.com) sets proxima-nova 700 headlines on Panasonic blue #1953b4 and white, with navy #0f315f and #f0f0f0 feature panels, white or black 12px-radius buttons (48px tall, 12px 24px padding), 16px-radius imagery and circular industry thumbnails.

panda-css.name: Panda CSS
panda-css.description: Panda CSS (panda-css.com) is a build-time, type-safe CSS-in-JS library whose marketing site is a loud neo-brutalist page - a #fde047 yellow hero, black and white bands, Onest at weight 700 with tight negative tracking (210px wordmark headline), Geist Mono for code and eyebrows, yellow #facc15 accents, and 3px black borders with hard 4px offset black shadows.

pantheon-media-group.name: Pantheon Media Group
pantheon-media-group.description: Pantheon Media Group home screen measured live: black #000000 canvas with #f2f2f2 text over full-bleed video, uppercase PPMori 400 at 17.8105px with 0.534316px tracking, DMMono for bracket glyphs, 0px radius everywhere and no shadows.

pantip.name: Pantip
pantip.description: Pantip Thai community forum measured live in its dark theme: purple-navy canvas #353156, cards #3c3963, primary #7459c8 follow buttons with white Arial 600 text, Roboto 16px reading text in translucent lilac #e9e5f6de, yellow #fbc02d panel titles and 2px to 4px radii.

panus-assembly.name: Panus Assembly
panus-assembly.description: Panus Assembly (พนัส แอสเซมบลีย์) Thai truck-body maker site measured live: lime #8ec33d action tabs, deep blues #013b63 and #025086, #333333 body text, thaisans_neue Thai fonts at 20px, dark navy #001422 footer and single-corner 20px tab rounding.

paolo-vendramini.name: Paolo Vendramini
paolo-vendramini.description: Paolo Vendramini brand design portfolio measured live: white #ffffff and black #000000 with one pure blue accent #0000ff, NeueMontreal-Bold uppercase 12px captions, PPNikkeiMaru serif display, a 4-column 2rem-gutter grid, 16px radius and no shadows.

paper.name: Paper
paper.description: Paper-textured, print-inspired design with minimal colors, clean serif/sans typography, and tactile surface qualities.

paper-tiger.name: Paper Tiger
paper-tiger.description: Paper Tiger NYC web design agency measured live: white #ffffff and black #000000 with lavender #9589d3, lagoon #6dc9bc and tart #fa435b accents, giant Rightgrotesk 900 capitals, Onsitestandard 18px body, DMMono caps labels and square corners.

paradise-park.name: Paradise Park
paradise-park.description: Paradise Park (ห้างพาราไดซ์ พาร์ค), an MBK Group mall on Sri Nakarin Road, Bangkok: white canvas, dark #323232 text, orange #fe5706 and lime #93d500 accents, the proprietary dbo_zone_x Thai typeface, pill buttons at 50px radius and 10px cards.

paragon-department-store.name: Paragon Department Store
paragon-department-store.description: Paragon Department Store is the website of The Mall Group's flagship Bangkok department store: a white page with a centered script-and-serif wordmark, a thin champagne-gold #a49e89 rule and accents, near-black #1f1e1f text in small 12px uppercase navigation, and grey #cccccc promo cards that carry loud red, black and purple campaign banners.

park-ui.name: Park UI
park-ui.description: Park UI (park-ui.com) is a component library built on Ark UI and Panda CSS, and its site is a quiet neutral showcase - Outfit type at 60px/700 with -1.2px tracking, a near-white #fcfcfc canvas, black solid buttons (#000000) with 4px radii, #d9d9d9 hairlines, #646464 body text, and soft layered shadows on 6px cards.

partizan.name: Partizan
partizan.description: Partizan film production site measured live: white #ffffff interface frames and black #000000 text around a mosaic of footage, Teodor serif at 42.6667px with -1px tracking, GT America Standard 500 uppercase 8.88889px navigation, one 8.89px radius and no shadows.

passione.name: Passione Shopping Destination
passione.description: Passione Shopping Destination (แพชชั่น), a Thai shopping mall site: white canvas and a solid magenta #ed0281 directory panel, Celias display type at weight 800 with DB HeaventRounded body text, 10px and 20px radii, rounded promo photography.

patagonia.name: Patagonia
patagonia.description: Patagonia's storefront is a photography-first, near-monochrome system: Ridgeway Sans at weight 300 for body and 500 for headlines (64px/70.4px hero with -1.28px tracking), Copernicus serif for Stories, #000000 ink on a #ffffff canvas with #f5f5f5 8px-radius image tiles, a #1b2b79 navy hero panel, 30px-radius pill buttons (9px 28px, 39px tall) and a full-black #000000 footer, with #fa4616 orange reserved for activism headlines.

patek-philippe.name: Patek Philippe
patek-philippe.description: Patek Philippe's homepage pairs Open Sans Light uppercase display type at 40px with Lora serif body at 16px, charcoal ink #2e2e33 on a white canvas, one warm taupe accent #8c7a66, pill-shaped 9999px outlined buttons and full-bleed photography; flat, with no shadows.

patreon.name: Patreon
patreon.description: Patreon's home page is a scroll of full-bleed creator photography and periwinkle-blue (#71a0ff, #94bbff) bands, set in the ABC Oracle variable font at an ultra-light 250 weight (166.667px hero with -10px tracking), with black #000000 26.67px-radius pills with white text and a black footer.

patternfly.name: Red Hat
patternfly.description: Red Hat's corporate site (redhat.com) on its Red Hat Display and Red Hat Text typefaces — near-black #151515 hero panels against white #ffffff, brand red #ee0000 pill buttons with 64px radius, #0066cc link blue, 16px-radius outlined cards with #c7c7c7 borders and a 36px/500 display headline over 18px body copy.

paul-kalkbrenner.name: Paul Kalkbrenner
paul-kalkbrenner.description: Official site of electronic musician Paul Kalkbrenner: a white page with pure black ABC Diatype Plus Variable type at weight 700, a 133.333px display headline with -6.66667px tracking, a #c5c5c5 grey recordings band, #a7ff9c and #ff6831 accent blocks, and 13.33px or pill radii.

paypal.name: PayPal
paypal.description: PayPal US homepage: white canvas with a sky-blue #60cdff hero, brand blue #0066f5 and navy #002991 panels, proprietary PayPal Pro 900-weight headlines (82.9px, tight tracking), 24px body in PayPal Pro Text VF, and 48px pill buttons with an 8 percent navy tint fill.

pea.name: Provincial Electricity Authority (PEA)
pea.description: Provincial Electricity Authority's English home page: white canvas, magenta brand #a80c8a with a #a80689 fill, aktiv-grotesk-thai at 400 to 600, 40px section titles, 16px rounded white service cards with a soft rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.08) shadow and 24px pill-like filter buttons.

peaencom.name: PEA ENCOM International
peaencom.description: Corporate site of PEA ENCOM International Co., Ltd., a solar and electrical-systems company, set in Inter with Prompt for Thai on a dark slate #343a40 canvas, green #00c96d highlights, translucent black #000000a6 header and square 52px buttons with a #00a65a border.

pedestal.name: Pedestal
pedestal.description: Pedestal, the Danish-design TV stand brand: pale #fafafa canvas with #eeeeee tiles and #212121 ink, FK Display at 160px with -6.4px tracking, Suisse Intl at weights 400 to 500, near-square 2px and 4px corners, and a flat dark #212121 Configure button.

pega.name: Pega
pega.description: Pega's homepage uses Lora 700 serif headlines at 64px in deep navy #001f5f with Open Sans body, #3e67bb pill buttons, a yellow #ffc836 accent and a navy-to-violet palette; the Constellation design system documents a separate Roboto Flex application UI.

peloton.name: Peloton
peloton.description: Peloton's onepeloton.com retail system as measured — Inter (variable 100–900) throughout, near-black ink #181a1d with grey #65666a secondary copy, a cool off-white #f5f7f9 page surface alternating with white #ffffff, one Peloton Red #df1c2f (hover #d00c2a) for purchase CTAs, and fully rounded pill buttons whose radius is half their 56/48/40px height.

penpot.name: Penpot
penpot.description: Penpot's penpot.app marketing site: pale #f5f8fb canvas, dark blue #151035 text and footer, Work Sans throughout (72px regular hero with a 600-weight 'Together.'), turquoise #14ceca 8px-radius buttons with dark blue labels, outlined 1px #151035 secondary buttons, and a brand palette of magenta #f23ae5, violet #6911d4 and indigo #2f226c from the official brandbook.

pensatori-irrazionali.name: Pensatori Irrazionali
pensatori-irrazionali.description: Pensatori Irrazionali, a European creative house: light grey #f5f5f5 canvas, black and #434343 helveticaNow type at weight 400, 60px display with -1.5px tracking, uppercase 12px LEARN MORE buttons on #434343 with 0px corners, and neon #2bff00, #f669e4, #ff0066, #adf800 swatches.

pentagram.name: Pentagram
pentagram.description: Pentagram's site is an achromatic gallery catalog: a #ffffff canvas alternating with #222222 and #000000 bands, all text set in Optimo's Plain (served as "Plain, Arial, sans-serif") at weight 400 with 500 reserved for the wordmark and filter chips. Ink is #1a1a1a, secondary text #767676, display type 52px with -1.04px tracking. The only interactive fill is a translucent #00000012 chip with a 4px radius; imagery is square-cornered and carries all of the color.

pepsi.name: Pepsi
pepsi.description: Pepsi (pepsi.com, measured at https://www.pepsi.com/): a pure black canvas (#000000) with white uppercase text in pepsi-owner-extended, an electric blue #0000fe pill call-to-action with 30px radius and 18px uppercase label, brighter blues #0025ff and #2e86ff for accents, 60px section headings, and glowing product-can photography.

pepsico.name: PepsiCo
pepsico.description: PepsiCo corporate site: white canvas, deep navy #02355a text and footer, light-blue #a5caee pill buttons, lime #bfde7d and forest #0f440e accents, Pressural 900 uppercase display at 224px with -7.84px tracking, Gilroy 400 to 600 body, and 24px or full-pill corners.

permian.name: Permian
permian.description: Sneaker brand site for Permian (permianworld.com): cool grey #dddddd canvas with product photography, electric blue #1f35f9 for text, buttons and footer, white #ffffff panels, supplyMono 12px uppercase labels, ballinger bold headlines, square 0px corners and dashed blue frame lines.

perplexity.name: Perplexity
perplexity.description: Perplexity's logged-out home screen: a near-white #fbfbfb canvas with a left sidebar, pplxSans type at weight 400, deep teal-black text #071f21, a teal #016a71 accent, a 24px 'What do you want to know?' heading, a white rounded search box and 8px to 16px radii with 9999px pills.

perspective.name: Perspective
perspective.description: Spatial depth design with isometric views, vanishing points, and layered elements that guide attention through 3D-like realism.

petrobras.name: Petrobras
petrobras.description: Petrobras corporate portal (Brazil): white canvas, #373737 text, brand green #008542 with a #fdc82f yellow accent, link blue #0b5fff, Petrobras Sans at weight 700 with a 38px hero title, 8px cards with a #d7d7d7 border, 4px inputs and fully rounded green buttons.

pfizer.name: Pfizer
pfizer.description: Pfizer corporate home page (pfizer.com), measured — white #ffffff canvas, Pfizer Blue #2e29ff pill buttons (58.67px radius) hovering to #00009d, #0000c9 blue links, #0a0a0a text, pale #f2f9fc and #e0f5ff section tints, Pfizer Tomorrow 72px display and 42px titles over Pfizer Diatype 24px/20px text, 16px-radius cards with a soft 32px shadow.

phantom-land.name: Phantom Studios
phantom-land.description: Phantom Studios (phantom.land), a technology-led creative agency in London and Auckland: pure #000000 canvas with #ffffff text, Helvetica Now 500 to 700 with ballinger-mono 10.88px uppercase captions, 28px section titles, 48px pill buttons and 40px tag chips, no shadows.

philips.name: Philips (United States)
philips.description: Philips US home page (usa.philips.com): white canvas with #f6f8f9 product cards, #15191e text, Philips blue #0061c2 pill buttons and a #0b5ed7 top bar and footer, Neue Frutiger World at weights 350 and 700, a 36px hero title and 6px card corners.

philips-hue.name: Philips Hue
philips-hue.description: Philips Hue US storefront: white canvas with #f9f9f9 bands, #101010 text, a Hue blue #0066f5 pill button (hover #0050a8), a #000826 midnight-blue nav, sohne type at weights 400 and 700, a 48px page title with 56px line height and 100px pill corners.

phive-clubs.name: Phive Clubs
phive-clubs.description: Phive Clubs (phive.pt/en) is a dark warm-black #161003 fitness-club site with saturated yellow #ffe000, all-uppercase PPFormula and AcidGrotesk at weight 400, 29.392px rounded slabs and a white pill outline button.

phonepe.name: PhonePe
phonepe.description: PhonePe's home page sets Inter Tight at 32px/500 headlines and 22px grey body on white, with a deep-space dark hero (#040417), a brand purple #5e2b9d for 160px-radius pill buttons, a #21153d dark purple card surface and soft illustrated product cards.

piaget.name: Piaget
piaget.description: Piaget (piaget.com/us-en) is a Swiss luxury watch and jewelry site: white canvas, Piaget blue #022969 ink, PhxsgRhymesDisplay serif at weight 280 over PhxsgNeutrafaceText, square 0px corners and full-bleed campaign panels.

pico-css.name: Pico CSS
pico-css.description: Pico CSS (picocss.com) is a minimal, class-light CSS framework for semantic HTML, and its site is airy and light - white canvas, #373c44 slate text, Figtree 700 headings (50px h1) over a system-ui 20px body, a #0172ad blue primary and #181c25 contrast button, 5px radii, and a very soft multi-layer blue-gray card shadow.

pictoric.name: Pictoric
pictoric.description: Pictoric (pictoric.com.ua) is a Ukrainian illustration studio site: grey #f6f6f6 canvas, chocolate brown #411f15 ink, yellow #ffe515 stickers, GTAmericaLCGV uppercase at weights 700 and 900, 14.22px card radius.

pieterkoopt-r.name: PieterKoopt®
pieterkoopt-r.description: PieterKoopt® (pieterkoopt.nl) is a Dutch painting-buying service: near-black green #171c1c canvas, beige #d4c6b9 text, sage green #7a8b69 call to action, Basic Grotesque uppercase with tight tracking and 2.67px button radius.

pinecone.name: Pinecone
pinecone.description: Pinecone, the vector database and AI knowledge platform: #fbfbfc and #ffffff canvases, warm near-black #1c1917 headings over #57534e body text, electric blue #002bff square CTAs (0px radius, hover #222160), gtPlanar at 44px/700 and 16px/24px, JetBrains Mono code tabs, and 1px #e7e5e4 hairline grids.

ping-an.name: Ping An Group
ping-an.description: Ping An Group (group.pingan.com) is a corporate finance site: white canvas, Ping An orange #f05a23 headlines and buttons, GothamRounded at weights 400 and 500, dark warm-grey #4b4a48 footer, 3px solid buttons and pill outline secondary.

pinterest.name: Pinterest
pinterest.description: Pinterest.com landing page as measured: a white canvas with near-black (#000000) text, the single saturated brand red #e60023 on its "Join Pinterest for free" and "Log in" buttons (16px radius, 48px tall, #cc001f on hover), warm sand neutrals (#e5e5e0) for secondary fills, and the proprietary Pin Sans family at weights 400 to 900, with a 48px/900 hero headline. Photographs carry all the color; the chrome stays neutral.

pipedrive.name: Pipedrive
pipedrive.description: Pipedrive's CRM homepage sets a Haffer 52px/700 green #017737 headline on a mint #d7f9d3 hero, Inter body text in navy #192435 on white, violet #6861f2 4px-radius 'Try it free' buttons that deepen to #413d99 on hover, lavender #e1e1ff secondary buttons and a yellow #ffde00 pill.

pitch.name: Pitch
pitch.description: Pitch (pitch.com), the Berlin-built AI presentation workspace: white #ffffff canvas against deep violet #280f62 bands, electric violet #5318eb primary, lime #c4ee87 sign-up chips, Mark Pro Bold display at 180px/-7.2px over Eina 03 Regular 16px body, 4px button radius and 16-40px rounded cards.

plaid.name: Plaid
plaid.description: Plaid (plaid.com) is a fintech data-network site: white canvas, navy #02294b ink, teal #05565c, footer #00172e, Plaid Sans and Cern, tightly tracked headings and fully rounded pill buttons with soft multi-layer shadows.

plan-b-media.name: Plan B Media
plan-b-media.description: Plan B Media (planbmedia.co.th) is a Thai out-of-home advertising site: navy #002563 header, light #f7f7f7 canvas, Montserrat 800 hero over Prompt 300 body, white 100px pill buttons and 20px rounded cards.

plane.name: Plane
plane.description: Plane.so home: white #ffffff canvas alternating with near-black #0f0f10 bands, Satoshi 58px/430 headlines with -1.74px tracking, Inter UI text at weight 430 in #1d1f20 and #4e5355, near-black #090b0c 8px-radius buttons, #f7f7f8 12px-radius product cards with #eaebeb borders and a blue #006399 accent for eyebrows.

planetono.name: Planetoño
planetono.description: Planetoño (planetono.space) is a playful space-food concept site: flat red #eb3322 canvas, cream #f7f2e5 display type, black #000000 outlines, Futura Passata bold with -2.18px tracking and Poppins 15px body.

planetscale.name: PlanetScale
planetscale.description: PlanetScale's marketing site is a single-typeface terminal page — the system ui-monospace stack at 16px/24px for every heading, paragraph and button, #414141 ink on a #fafafa canvas, a #fbca00 announcement bar, #f35815 orange square-cornered CTAs (0px radius everywhere), #0b6ec5 inline links and #111111 tab buttons.

plasmic.name: Plasmic
plasmic.description: Plasmic's plasmic.app marketing site: white #ffffff canvas alternating with near-black violet #060317 sections, Inter throughout (80px/600 hero at -3px tracking), black #0d0d12 pill buttons with #ededec labels, a purple-pink-coral-orange gradient (#8636f8, #f020b3, #f8475e, #ff9421) on highlighted headline words, and 21px-radius translucent dark cards with #343337 borders.

platinum-fashion-mall.name: Platinum Fashion Mall
platinum-fashion-mall.description: Platinum Fashion Mall runs a WordPress site set entirely in Montserrat with Prompt for Thai, where headings and the Platinum logotype share one royal indigo, #272897, on a white canvas; headlines are 800-weight Montserrat at 24px, navigation is 600-weight uppercase at 18px, and big rounded corners of 25px to 70px shape cards and outlined buttons.

plausible.name: Plausible Analytics
plausible.description: Plausible Analytics' marketing site: a #f9fafb and white page in the system-ui font stack, 48px weight-800 headlines with -1.2px tracking and an indigo #5850ec highlight, slate #4b5563 body text at 18px/32px, #5850ec CTAs with 6px corners that lighten to #6875f5, and a dark #252f3f footer.

playstation.name: PlayStation
playstation.description: The PlayStation Thai-language home page as measured: a white canvas under a black Sony strip, a dark #121314 games band, light-weight (300) Thai-capable headings, and a single PlayStation blue #0070cc on pill-shaped sign-in and learn-more buttons (hover #005499). Condensed uppercase AlternateGotNo1D appears at 52px for promo titles; SST loads at 400/500/700. Photography and console renders carry the color.

pluralsight.name: Pluralsight
pluralsight.description: Pluralsight's marketing site uses PS TT Commons at weight 400 for 56px headlines with -2px tracking, a deep ink-purple #130f25 for pill buttons and dark bands, warm #f7f5f4 surfaces, white 20px-radius cards with soft shadows, and hot pink (#ff1675, #e7005e) and lime (#cfff6e) accents.

podium.name: Podium
podium.description: Podium (podium.global) is a sports creative studio site: black #000000 canvas with white and black uppercase bold Futura (57.408px headings, 24px display, 16px body), Univers Condensed footer, and every element square at 0px radius.

polaris-design.name: Shopify Polaris
polaris-design.description: Polaris, the Shopify UI framework now shipped as s-* web components, measured on the shopify.dev docs and in its live component previews: Inter at a 13px/450 base, near-black #303030 primary buttons and text, 8px-radius controls 28px (buttons) or 32px (fields) tall, 12px-radius sections, pale tone fills for badges and banners, and a docs shell in cool blue-greys.

polestar.name: Polestar
polestar.description: Polestar (polestar.com/global) is an electric-car site: white #ffffff canvas with #f0f0f0 panels, black text, Polestar Unica at weight 400 with tight negative tracking (-1.2px at 30px), square outlined buttons and photography-only color.

politico.name: POLITICO
politico.description: POLITICO (politico.com) is a US political news front page: white canvas, black bold din-2014 headlines (58px lead), POLITICO red #d71920 accents, tracked uppercase 10px bylines, 8px cards and a navy #121522 footer.

polyplus.name: Polyplus Entertainment
polyplus.description: Polyplus Entertainment (polyplus.co.th) is a Thai TV production company site: white canvas with a #f7f7f7 program band, #0099cc footer, Arial 14px and 12px at weight 400, blue #0066ff links turning orange #ff6600, and square 0px corners.

pomelo-fashion.name: Pomelo Fashion
pomelo-fashion.description: Pomelo's US storefront (pomelofashion.com/us/en) is a white-canvas, photo-led fashion shop: black #000000 ink, a #e4e4e4 grey product-tile ground, CircularXX Web Medium/Regular set small (12-20px), 1px square outlined SHOP NOW buttons with 1.35px uppercase tracking, and a #dd5260 coral reserved for error and sale emphasis.

ponpon-mania.name: Ponpon Mania
ponpon-mania.description: Ponpon Mania (ponpon-mania.com) is an interactive comic by Justine Soulie and Patrick, a single 1280x800 illustrated scene on a near-black #171717 canvas with cream #feece3 Libre Franklin 700 labels at 15px, a black 'read now' pill over flat purple, orange, pink and green artwork, and 3px, 25px and 42px radii.

pop-up-10-ans-la-rosee.name: Pop-up 10 ans La Rosée
pop-up-10-ans-la-rosee.description: Entry page of La Rosée's 10th-anniversary pop-up microsite (popup.larosee-cosmetiques.com): a white 24px-radius welcome card with a Chaparral serif 30px title in navy #304656 and Basis sans 14px copy in slate #82909a, floating over a full-bleed 3D paper-flower scene in powder blue, pink and yellow.

porsche.name: Porsche
porsche.description: Porsche's site is built on its own Porsche Design System: Porsche Next type at 16px/400, black #010205 buttons with 12px radius and 56px height, white #ffffff canvas with full-bleed dark car photography, 24px and 32px rounded image tiles, and frosted translucent grey secondary buttons.

posthog.name: PostHog
posthog.description: PostHog.com as measured: an operating-system-style desktop of translucent windows over a grass wallpaper, set in the RoundHog typeface (500 body, 800 headlines at 36px), on a sage cream #eeefe9 canvas with #fdfdf8 cards, amber #cd8407 call-to-action buttons with a 1px #b17816 border and 8px radius, and the brand red-orange #f54e00 reserved for active tabs and frames.

postman.name: Postman
postman.description: Postman runs a warm-black #0e0704 developer page: gtStandard 56.32px/500 headlines in cream #fff0de, Inter 19px/30.4px body in #cdbfad, IBM Plex Mono labels and code, a #e0531f orange 5px-radius Sign Up button hovering to #ff6c37, pill chips with #ffe0c424 hairlines, 10-12px-radius cards and glowing orange-violet gradients.

postmark.name: Postmark
postmark.description: Postmark (postmarkapp.com) puts Elizeth 700 slab-serif headlines (52px) over Rund Text body copy on a signature #ffde00 yellow hero and a warm #faf9f7 canvas, with #007bc8 blue buttons (4px radius, 1px inset ring) darkening to #005e99, coloured feature headings (#ed746f, #6e5bff, #4fc47e) and line illustrations.

pp-neue-montreal.name: PP Neue Montreal
pp-neue-montreal.description: Specimen site (neuemontreal.com) for Pangram Pangram's PP Neue Montreal grotesque: a #1a1a1a dark canvas with cream #f0e7d4 type, an #ff4000 orange-red signature, a #d82f2f red hero, multicolour display words in green, yellow, blue and pink, and pill-shaped controls (999px to 1000px) set in the typeface itself.

prachatai.name: Prachatai (ประชาไท)
prachatai.description: Prachatai.com, Thai independent news site: a dense white newsroom front page with a black category bar, alternating #cccccc and #ffe2c9 section bands, Anuphan 600 headlines at 24px and Sarabun 15-16px copy, a #e96024 orange 'read more' button, #ff6347 theme links and 4-6px radii.

prada.name: Prada
prada.description: Prada's US store (prada.com/us/en) is a white, photography-first system set entirely in Grilli Type's GT-America (400/500/700): 32px/500 hero titles in white over full-bleed 1280x720 campaign media, 14px/500 uppercase underlined text CTAs with 0.2px tracking, #000000 ink with #4e555a and #767676 secondary greys, #f7f7f7 editorial bands, a #111111 news section, #ebebed product wells and 0px corners on every button, card and image.

preact.name: Preact
preact.description: Preact (preactjs.com) is a white #ffffff docs-style site under a full-width Preact purple #673ab8 hero, system-ui type (64px/100 thin section headings, 16px/26.4px body in #444444), uppercase letter-spaced 4px-radius buttons with 3px #eeeeee borders, and dark #101725 code blocks with Material-style syntax colours (#ff696d, #ffcb6b, #c792ea).

preline-ui.name: Preline UI
preline-ui.description: Preline UI, the open-source Tailwind CSS component library, as measured on preline.co and in its live component previews: a stone-grey page (#f5f5f4 canvas, #292524 ink), one electric blue #155dfc for solid buttons and links, 8px-radius 46px buttons and fields, 12px cards, the system-ui font stack, and a gray-toned demo palette (#e5e7eb borders, #1e2939 text) inside the previews.

premier-league.name: Premier League
premier-league.description: premierleague.com as measured — Premier League purple (#37003c) as the single ink and action colour on a near-white lilac-tinted canvas (#faf9fa) with white 12px-radius content cards, the league's own Premier Sans served as PremierLeague / PremierLeagueBold with uniform -0.02em tracking (32px hero, 24px section heads, 16px card titles), fully rounded purple pills, and a neon brand gradient (yellow #ebff00 to green #00ff87 to cyan #05f0ff) reserved for accents like the Join myPL ring.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: Apple-inspired premium aesthetic with precise spacing, modern typography, and a refined, polished visual language.

priceza.name: Priceza
priceza.description: Priceza, Thailand's price-comparison portal: a proprietary Priceza typeface, a blue (#1e7be5) 4px-radius 'เช็คราคา' button on 8px bordered product cards, a 47.9864px white hero headline over photography and an orange sale ribbon.

prime-road-power.name: Prime Road Power
prime-road-power.description: Prime Road Power (PRIME, primeroadpower.com), a Thai solar-power developer, uses a white canvas #ffffff, near-black ink #1d1d1d and a signature red #bb241d for its View more buttons and FY 2025 heading, set in Prompt with Raleway and Sarabun accents, 3px button corners and grey #f8f8f8 country cards.

primeng.name: PrimeNG
primeng.description: PrimeNG's site pairs Inter var at light weight 400 with tight negative tracking (60px display, -3px) on a near-white slate canvas, a near-black navy primary (#020617) on pill-shaped 48px hero buttons and 6px-radius docs buttons, and slate greys for text, with a full dashboard screenshot as the hero image.

primereact.name: PrimeReact
primereact.description: PrimeReact, the React component library whose v11 site is primereact.dev, as measured on its home page and Button and InputText docs: Inter on slate neutrals (#334155 text, #f8fafc page, #e2e8f0 borders), a near-black #020617 primary, 6px-radius 35px demo buttons and inputs, pill-shaped hero buttons, and -3px tracking on the 60px headline.

principal-thailand.name: Principal Thailand
principal-thailand.description: Thai fund-management and provident-fund site in FS Elliot Web and ekkarach: white #ffffff ground, #035fa4 blue links and 4px-radius buttons, #0091da header blue, #373737 charcoal footer, #464646 body text, no shadows.

prinsiri.name: Prinsiri
prinsiri.description: Prinsiri (prinsiri.com) developer site: SMBAdvance Thai type at 40px headings and 23px light body, brand purple #6b3a6f with deeper #5a1d60 and an orange #ed6423 promotional accent, #58595b grey ink on a #e2ded6 canvas with white cards, 3px-radius outlined buttons and bright house photography.

prisma.name: Prisma
prisma.description: Prisma (prisma.io) is a white #ffffff page with Sora headings (57.6px/500 hero), Inter body at 16px/26px in #646567, black #000000 pill CTAs (12px 24px, 48px tall), glassy 18px-radius cards with #e5e5e5 borders, and the brand 'prism ray' — cyan #01d7e4, yellow #f3c306 and red #f34a60 bands at −16° — over grain-washed rainbow panels.

privy.name: Privy
privy.description: The Privy digital-identity and e-signature site (privy.id, Indonesia): Google Sans Flex Variable at 56px/700 headlines, DM Sans on buttons, Privy red #e60034 pill buttons, deep plum ink #430a23, white content bands, beige #f2e8dd footer and dark burgundy sections with a dotted pattern.

procreate.name: Procreate
procreate.description: Procreate's home page is a black #000000 showcase set in the system UI font: 70px/600 headlines with -0.35px tracking, 20px/30px body, blue #0076ff 'Buy now' pills (100px radius, hover #2189ff) beside graphite #262626 'Learn more' pills, and #121212 product cards with 24px corners and a 10% white hairline, all built around vivid full-bleed artwork.

procter-and-gamble.name: Procter & Gamble (P&G US)
procter-and-gamble.description: P&G's US corporate site (us.pg.com): Montserrat throughout, royal-blue #003da5 as both ink and brand fill, a #f2f7ff pale-blue content band, white canvas, pill buttons with 44px radius, circular and arched image masks, and soft blue-grey shadows such as rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) -8px 16px 16px.

produx-design.name: Produx Design
produx-design.description: Produx (produx.design), a branding studio whose site is a near-black #0e0e0e canvas with a huge thin PRØDUX wordmark, At Aero grotesque headlines at 56.832px, DM Mono 12-17px uppercase labels in bracket syntax, and large tilted flat panels in olive #303930 and #545e54; radii are pill-only.

proennet.name: PROEN Corp Public Company Limited
proennet.description: PROEN (proen.co.th/web), Thai data-center, ISP and multi-cloud provider: IBM Plex Sans Thai throughout, sky blue #00b3ff and #009de0 on a white canvas, #f2f2f2 grey carousel band, #373737 charcoal footer, white outlined pill buttons with 25px to 100px radii over full-bleed cloud and data-center photography.

professional.name: Professional
professional.description: Polished, business-ready design with modern typography, structured layouts, and a trustworthy visual identity.

propertyscout-th.name: PropertyScout
propertyscout-th.description: PropertyScout (propertyscout.co.th), an English-language Thailand property rental and sales platform. Roboto at 400, 500 and 700, orange-red #e74119 buttons with 6px radius, navy #002a55 stats band and footer, green #0c8b46 verified badges, #fafafa and #ebebeb section greys and 16px listing cards.

prospect-logistics.name: Prospect Logistics and Industrial Freehold and Leasehold REIT
prospect-logistics.description: Investor site of Prospect Logistics and Industrial REIT in Gothic A1 with Noto Sans Thai (900-weight uppercase headings at 44.7px), deep navy #1a3870 canvas, orange #f59024 figures, green #3bb04a accents, white ink and square outlined buttons with 2.4px tracking.

proton.name: Proton
proton.description: Proton's privacy-suite site: ProtonSerif (ABC Arizona Flare) headlines at 60px/63.6px with -2.4px tracking in deep violet #372580, ProtonSans (Inter) body at 16px/26px in #4b5563, Proton purple #6d4aff pill buttons 50px tall that hover to #4a2dc5, on white with #f6f7f9 panels, 24px-radius cards and a lavender #e2dbff tint.

prototype-3.name: Prototype (Prototype Studio)
prototype-3.description: Prototype (prototypestudio.fr), a French creative house for daring brands: a white canvas ruled with 1px #00000014 hairlines and diagonal construction lines, black type in condensed uppercase DeanGothicCMP (88.8889px display) and light italic SilvanaDisplay serif (40px statements), with only pill-shaped (9999px) elements.

prudential.name: Prudential Financial
prudential.description: Prudential Financial's US home page (prudential.com): a white canvas with #1a1d1e text, Prudential blue #0066cc for links and the primary pill, navy #091f3d and #001f45 bands, a #443bb2 indigo card band, #ffd200 yellow for Request a call and Log In, Pru-Modern condensed headlines and Open Sans body, radii from 3px to 44px.

prudential-thailand.name: Prudential Thailand
prudential-thailand.description: Prudential Thailand English homepage: Open Sans with negative tracking at 18px body and 32px semibold headings, Prudential red #da291c on 96px-radius pill buttons (48px tall, #a31f15 hover), #f8f9fb and #fff4f6 tinted panels, #131313 hero black and 16px card corners.

pruksa.name: Pruksa Real Estate
pruksa.description: Pruksa Real Estate (pruksa.com/en), Thai home developer: warm grey #f2f2f1 canvas, #444444 text, one olive green #6d981d for the search action, DB Gill Siam X uppercase headings at 46px, square 1px-outlined buttons with 0px radius, and full-bleed project cards under a saturated campaign carousel.

psu.name: Prince of Songkla University
psu.description: Prince of Songkla University (psu.ac.th/en), southern Thailand: white canvas, #666666 body copy, deep PSU blue #003c71 footer and links, light blue #68a8de accent, psu-font 40px 600 headings, uppercase tracked menus over a blue silk hero, 3-4px corners and a translucent pill TOP NEWS button.

ptt.name: PTT Public Company Limited
ptt.description: PTT's corporate portal (pttplc.com/en) is set entirely in the proprietary PTT45Pride typeface (16px body, 44px hero), on a pale aqua canvas (#edfcfe) with navy ink (#183259, #002f5b), a white 9999px pill 'View All' button with a soft 4px 4px 8px shadow, and 16-25px radii on cards and inputs.

ptt-global-chemical.name: PTT Global Chemical
ptt-global-chemical.description: PTT Global Chemical (GC) pairs a corporate blue (#0056b8) and deep indigo (#1b1466) with DM Sans plus Noto Sans Thai at 18px body and a 34.8512px bold h2, 40px pill buttons and search field, 10-50px rounded cards, and very soft shadows over white and #f2f2f2 surfaces.

ptt-ngd.name: PTT NGD
ptt-ngd.description: Corporate site of PTT Natural Gas Distribution Co., Ltd. in PSL Kanda Thai display faces (112px uppercase headline) and 13px Tahoma body on white, with a dark translucent #323232ab numbered header, yellow #f3eb0a section accents, sky-blue #26aae2 text and #dddddd form fields.

ptt-oil-retail.name: OR (PTT Oil and Retail Business)
ptt-oil-retail.description: OR's English home page (pttor.com/en/home) uses the DB HelvethaicaMon X typeface at 20px body with 1px tracking, a cyan-blue CTA (#00aeef) on white and #ecf4fd, deep indigo headings (#1b1464), 10-12px rounded buttons, and 100px or circular image masks with a soft rgba(49,69,244,0.1) 0 15px 45px shadow.

pttep.name: PTTEP (PTT Exploration and Production)
pttep.description: PTTEP's English home page (pttep.com/en/home) is set in Inter with Noto Sans Thai at light 300 weight (19px body, 44px display on #474747 ink), with a cyan accent (#009fda), pale blue bands (#f3faff, #ccecf8), 8-10px rounded outlined buttons and no box shadows.

publication.name: Publication
publication.description: Print-inspired visual language for books, magazines, and reports with editorial grids and expressive typography.

puma.name: PUMA Thailand
puma.description: PUMA's Thai storefront (th.puma.com, puma.com redirects here) is monochrome: black (#000000) uppercase 15px/600 Shop Now buttons with square corners, #181818 ink on white, Noto Sans Thai 700 uppercase headlines at 56px and 24px, FFDINforPuma for the cookie button, and no shadows.

purpose-talent.name: Purpose Talent
purpose-talent.description: Purpose Talent is a warm cream-and-ink search consultancy site: #f9f2e9 canvas, #1e1e1e ink, a #f0b420 yellow pill CTA with white Raleway 700 text, uppercase Tay Bea display type at 110.08px and 52.48px, 16-35px card radii, and soft warm shadows (rgba(123, 94, 92, 0.06)).

pusher.name: Pusher
pusher.description: Pusher, the hosted realtime APIs company (a MessageBird company), marketed in Maison Neue (500-weight 48px display, 16px/28px body) with a deep-aubergine #300d4f ink and button fill on a pale lavender #f9f8ff canvas, a violet #7000ff accent, dark #3e414f code panels, 4px-radius 48px-tall buttons and 6px-radius panels.

pwc.name: PwC
pwc.description: PwC's global home page (pwc.com/gx/en) pairs ITC Charter serif headlines (52px/700 with -2px tracking, 108.8px/800 hero) with Helvetica Neue body, a flat peach CTA (#ffaa72, black text, 0px radius), brand orange #fd5108, white and #fff5ed bands, no shadows and no rounded corners.

px-push.name: PX PUSH
px-push.description: PX PUSH is a retro-tech design subscription site: SemiSqueezed display type at 153.6px with -1.28px tracking, Mono 14px captions, ink #111111 and silver #bababa on #71737d and #1a1a1a, electric blue #03049c panels, a #00ff00 status dot and 6.4-12px radii with no shadows.

qantas.name: Qantas
qantas.description: Qantas Airways' web booking and marketing system — proprietary "Qantas Sans" served at 300/400/500/700, Qantas Red #df0000 for every filled CTA (hover #bc0b07, pressed #99110b), charcoal ink #323232 on white with warm-grey #f3f2f1 search fields and teaser surfaces, 24px-radius search button and 800px pill buttons, 8px cards with a signature 64px "kangaroo-tail" corner, and a three-tier base/alias/comp CSS-variable token architecture.

qatar-airways.name: Qatar Airways
qatar-airways.description: Qatar Airways' US booking home page: pale lavender-grey #f2f3fa canvas, near-black #1f212b ink, burgundy #8e2157 'Search flights' button with 32px corners (hover burgundy #5c0931), white 64px-radius 'Book now' pill, Jotia Light 48px/56px headlines over Graphik 16px/24px body, all driven by --f-brand-* tokens.

qtc-energy-th.name: QTC Energy
qtc-energy-th.description: Corporate site of QTC Energy Public Company Limited (qtc-energy.com), a transformer, EV-charger and solar business. Prompt typeface at weights 200 to 500, blue #00558f headings and buttons, orange #f15a29 emphasis, deep-navy #001439 band, warm #f7f5f4 section tint and 27px-radius product cards.

qualcomm.name: Qualcomm
qualcomm.description: Qualcomm's marketing homepage measured at www.qualcomm.com: a white and pale-grey canvas (#ffffff, #f5f6f7), Alfabet display headlines at 48px/400 with +0.48px tracking, Roboto Flex body at 14px, a 4px-radius blue button (#2849d2) and a saturated Snapdragon red (#e71324) product card with 16px corners.

quality-houses.name: Quality Houses
quality-houses.description: Quality Houses (QH, qh.co.th) residential developer site measured on its Thai home page: thaisans type at 20px body and 30px bold H1, navy #17497c square-cornered buttons with a #63b3d8 hover, #333333 ink on white, #f0f0f0 bands, 1px #dadada inputs and full-bleed property photography.

quasar.name: Quasar
quasar.description: Quasar is a Vue.js framework, so its design language is two layers - a Material-derived component library (Roboto, 3px button radius, 4px generic radius, uppercase 500-weight buttons, brand primary #1976d2) and a docs site that dresses it in a deep-space navy canvas (#080e1a) with Montserrat headings, electric cyan #00b4ff titles and a single orange #ea5e13 call to action on white cards.

quebec.name: Québec.ca
quebec.description: The Government of Québec portal at quebec.ca, built on the government's own design system with Roboto bold headings at 48px, Open Sans body at 16px, a white canvas, link blue #095797, dark text blue #223654, pale-blue chips #dae6f0, a coral accent #e58271 and square 0px corners everywhere.

quiet-cubes.name: QuietCubes
quiet-cubes.description: QuietCubes sells luxury office pods on a near-black canvas (#0a0a0a) and warm beige (#dbd5ca) bands, set in Inter Tight Variable at 12.443px body with 49.7718px and 42.6616px headings, tiny 8.88783px uppercase buttons in #ebebeb and white, orange accent #ff8333, 4-5px radii and pill chips at 42.66px.

quizlet.name: Quizlet
quizlet.description: Quizlet's study-tool marketing site sets everything in Hurme Geometric Sans (served as hurme_no2-webfont) on a cool #f6f7fb canvas with #282e3e slate body text and a 44px/700 black headline. The single action color is Quizlet blue-violet #4255ff (token twilight-500) on 200px pill buttons, darkening to #423ed8 on hover; feature cards are 24px-radius tiles in #4255ff, mint #d9ffcc and teal #12c1cb, and the page uses a 4px-dominant radius and soft #282e3e-tinted shadows.

quora.name: Quora
quora.description: Quora's logged-out home: a single white #ffffff login card with a 3px radius and #dee0e1 border over a full-bleed illustrated mural, system-UI type (-apple-system stack) at 13px and 15px, #636466 grey copy, #195faa links and a #2e69ff pill Login button.

qwik.name: Qwik
qwik.description: Qwik (qwik.dev) runs on a deep indigo canvas #151934 (--qwik-dark-purple-bg) with white Poppins headlines (80px/600, -2.4px tracking), sky-blue #18b6f6 highlight words and buttons, Qwik purple #ac7ef4 / #976ae2 accents and bands, 8px-radius buttons with 15px 35px padding, 11px-radius bordered cards and a white footer.

r-ga.name: R/GA
r-ga.description: R/GA's home page is a black and white agency site: Helvetica Variable (HelveticaVariableforRGAW05) in heavy uppercase at 100px/900 with -3px tracking, 27px/31px body with -0.8px tracking, HelveticaNeue 56px display, 0px radius everywhere and no shadows, with colour supplied by work imagery.

radaville.name: Radaville Studio
radaville.description: Radaville Studio's entry page (radaville.studio) is a one-screen dark splash: #000000 and #040404 canvas with espresso #311512 and #1d0100 surfaces, cream ink #ebe5df and #f1e6d2, PPNeueWorld at 66.6667px for a loader counter, PPNeueMontreal 16px body, a pale pill Enter button and no shadows.

radian.name: Radian
radian.description: Radian's EXR electric enduro site (rideradian.com) uses Instrument Sans at weight 500 with tight negative tracking (53.3333px h1 at -1.33333px, 12px body), warm off-white #f5f3ef over near-black green #121714, a flat #fdeb07 yellow Pre-order button with 0px radius, 640px pill controls and no shadows.

radical-face.name: Radical Face
radical-face.description: Radical Face is the artist home page for music, writing and visual art: a warm paper canvas (#f0eeeb) with black ink (#000000), a near-black footer (#0e0e0e), TimesNow serif body at 21.3333px, SuisseIntl sans labels at 13.3333px weight 600, a condensed Druk wordmark, and small outlined pill links with 12px radius.

radix-ui.name: Radix UI
radix-ui.description: Radix is a component system, not just a site - Radix Primitives, Radix Themes and Radix Colors. The marketing page sets a 78px adobeTextPro serif headline in near-black #1c2024 against white, with untitledSans body and buttons at 8px radius, while the Themes library itself ships indigo #3e63dd solid buttons at 4px radius on a 12-step, alpha-aware colour scale.

raffles.name: Raffles Hotels & Resorts
raffles.description: Raffles Hotels & Resorts is a luxury hotel site: white canvas (#ffffff) with soft grey-black text (#3c3c3c), a deep green (#0c1f1e) for headings and the secondary button, blush (#f6f1ef) and taupe (#d5c0b5) bands, CanelaThin serif headings at 44px weight 250, LatoRegular 15px body, and square 0px uppercase AkzidenzGroteskPro buttons in #141414.

railway.name: Railway
railway.description: Railway is a dark #13111c night-sky page: IBM Plex Serif headlines (54px/500, -1.96px), Inter 16px/28px body in #f7f7f8, a muted #553f83 purple 8px-radius Deploy button with a translucent border, 12px-radius #ffffff0d glass cards, JetBrains Mono data tables and teal, navy and plum section tints.

raimon-land.name: Raimon Land
raimon-land.description: Raimon Land (raimonland.com, measured at /en/home) luxury developer site: Proxima Nova type with a 31px bold uppercase heading and 3px-tracked 25px section titles, #111e6c deep navy actions with white text, #111820 ink on white, #f1f3f7 blue-grey bands, square 0px CTAs and full-bleed Bangkok skyline photography.

rakuten.name: Rakuten
rakuten.description: Rakuten is a cash-back shopping site: white canvas (#ffffff), grey ink (#575757) and charcoal (#252525), a purple primary (#8529cd, hover #9b50d6) on pill buttons 56px high with 9999px radius, Stag light serif headings at 46px weight 300, Rakuten Sans UI body at 20px, pastel tinted cards with 16px radius and a charcoal footer.

rambler.name: Rambler
rambler.description: Rambler.ru portal design language — a pale periwinkle canvas (#f5f7ff) under a sky-blue gradient header, near-navy ink (#1e2332), SB Sans Text at 15px/500 for UI and 600 for headlines, pastel-blue (#4b7dff) 10px-radius buttons beside the brand's Rambler Blue (#315efb), and 20px-radius white cards with photo-led news tiles.

ramotion.name: Ramotion
ramotion.description: Ramotion's agency site is a light #fafafa page in Graphik (Graphik Web) with a centred 92px/600 headline (-3.2px tracking), #262626 text and filled #262626 pill-like buttons (20px radius 'Contact', 40px radius 'Let's talk'), #6f7984 secondary text, #cccccc hairlines, 8px-radius project images in a staggered grid and no shadows.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.description: Ramp's site is a restrained, editorial finance page on a white #ffffff canvas with warm-gray #f4f2f0 panels and near-black #0c0a08 ink. Every word is set in Lausanne at a single weight (400). Headlines are large (64px/64px h1) with a two-tone trick: the second half of a sentence drops to 60% ink (#0c0a0899). One acid accent, 'solar' #e4f222, fills the primary CTA (6px radius; 8px on the 52px hero form button) and brightens to #f5ff78 on hover; the secondary CTA is a #1a1919 black button. Cards use 12px corners with 1px #2121211a hairlines; the footer is #1a1919 with 128px vertical padding.

rappi.name: Rappi
rappi.description: Rappi Mexico delivery site: a saturated #ff441f hero with white PP Object Sans display type (56px/63.84px, -1.44px tracking), ink #2e2c36 on white, green #29d884 accents, 22px-radius category tiles, 8px inputs and cards, and short Spanish microcopy.

rare-beauty.name: Rare Beauty
rare-beauty.description: Rare Beauty (Selena Gomez) runs a warm editorial Shopify storefront on a cream #fdfbf8 canvas with blush #fdf6f0 bands, set in "Ogg Regular" serif headlines at weight 400 (48px section titles, 56px hero) over "Neue Hass Unica Regular" body copy, with deep burgundy #6f0936 as both the brand ink and action colour — square 0px buttons 36px tall with tiny 10–12px uppercase labels tracked 4–5px, outlined by default and filling burgundy on hover — plus round 50% portrait crops and navy #000914 text.

ratchthani-leasing.name: Ratchthani Leasing (ราชธานีลิสซิ่ง)
ratchthani-leasing.description: Ratchthani Leasing English homepage: white canvas, teal-green #01aa8d primary buttons and table headers, blue #0b5d99 and #13609b navigation and backdrop, red #ee3741 headline accent, Kanit typeface and 4px button radius.

ravi-klaassens.name: Ravi Klaassens (R—K Design & Code)
ravi-klaassens.description: Ravi Klaassens (R—K Design & Code) is a design-and-code studio portfolio: warm grey canvas (#e0dedd) with pure black ink (#000000), a single oxblood accent (#891a20), ReplicaLL 26.6667px weight 500 headings with -1.06667px tracking, Suisse Intl Book labels at 10.6667px, near-square corners of 2.13px to 5.33px and a black footer.

raycast.name: Raycast
raycast.description: Raycast's marketing site is a near-black (#07080a) stage for one idea, a hero of diagonal brand-red (#ff6363) stripes behind a 64px Inter 600 headline, with a light-grey (#e6e6e6) 8px-radius download button as the only solid action, Inter throughout with GeistMono kickers, and translucent black cards edged with 1px white-alpha hairlines.

razer.name: Razer
razer.description: Razer's US storefront is a pure-black (#000000) gaming catalogue lit by one neon green, #44d62c, used on 3px-radius uppercase Titillium Web CTAs; RazerF5 headlines at 40px/700 uppercase, Roboto 16px body in #bbbbbb, and a #111111 footer.

razorpay.name: Razorpay
razorpay.description: Razorpay marketing site: white and #f8fafc surfaces, navy ink #192839, electric blue #305eff action color, TASA Orbiter Display headlines (48px/56px) with Inter body (16px/24px), 4px 48px-high buttons, white cards with a soft 2px 16px shadow and full-bleed blue campaign banners.

re-max.name: RE/MAX (Thailand, remax.com)
re-max.description: RE/MAX (the measured remax.com Thailand English home page) is a real-estate portal: warm off-white canvas (#faf9f5), navy ink (#000e35), a vivid blue primary (#0043ff) on square uppercase Montserrat buttons 52px high, Montserrat 40px headings and 16px body, beige panels (#f5f3ea), 4px radii and a navy footer.

readme.name: ReadMe
readme.description: ReadMe's marketing site pairs an editorial serif (STKBureauSerif 64px/400 hero, 24px section heads) with STKBureauSans UI text, Geist Mono eyebrows and an Inter/system body stack; a deep-navy #000342 hero, white #ffffff canvas, electric-blue #012bff pill CTAs (9999px) and 8px-radius product cards with a layered hairline shadow.

readyidc.name: ReadyIDC
readyidc.description: ReadyIDC is a Thai data-center and ISP site: dark navy hero imagery (#0e1131) with white type on a white canvas (#ffffff), grey ink (#54595f), an orange accent (#f15721), Prompt headings at 69.12px weight 600 with 1.4592px tracking, Sukhumvit Set buttons, translucent 10px-radius tab buttons and 16px-radius cards with deep shadows.

readymag.name: Readymag
readymag.description: Readymag's site is a white #ffffff gallery of customer work with black #000000 type in uploaded custom fonts (30px/31px hero at -1.6px tracking, 12px/500 body), #ec520b orange 200px-radius pill buttons that hover to #282828, frosted #f4f4f4f5 nav pills, and a bento grid of 8px-radius tiles in #ff5900 orange, black, blue and lime.

real-madrid.name: Real Madrid
real-madrid.description: Real Madrid CF (realmadrid.com/es-ES) is a white #ffffff club site set in the custom RMNeue typeface with navy #0f2145 ink, an electric-violet #3e31fa primary with a #3e31fa→#8760f6 gradient on 16px-radius 64px 'Comprar ahora' buttons, pale #eef2fd panels, 16px-radius cards and violet-tinted soft shadows.

red-bull.name: Red Bull
red-bull.description: Red Bull (redbull.com US English) is a media-led brand site: light grey canvas (#f8f8f8) with white cards (#ffffff), deep navy ink (#000f1e), a single crimson action color (#db0a40), the Bull VF variable typeface at 18px body and 32px weight 700 headings, 8px card radii, pill-shaped controls (9999px) and a translucent navy navigation pill.

red-cross.name: American Red Cross
red-cross.description: The American Red Cross site (redcross.org) runs on Red Cross Red #e11b22 for every action, Roboto 900 headlines in #333333/#212529 on white, Open Sans for the header utility layer, a #007caf link blue, 3px button corners with a soft rgba(0,0,0,0.15) 0 2px 4px shadow, and full-bleed photo bands of volunteers at work.

red-planet-hotels.name: Red Planet Hotels
red-planet-hotels.description: Budget hotel chain in the Philippines on a Wix site: white canvas, black ink, red #da291c pill buttons with 30px radius, uppercase Lemon Sans-style display headings at 60.7px, Didact Gothic body at 20px, black footer.

reddit.name: Reddit, Inc.
reddit.description: Reddit, Inc.'s corporate site (redditinc.com) is built on OrangeRed #ff4500, black (#000000) and white: RedditDisplay ExtraBold 70px/800 headlines, Reddit Sans 20px/28.8px body, OrangeRed pill buttons (19.5px and 40px radii) and 24px-radius white stat cards on black bands.

redhat-vanilla.name: Canonical Ubuntu
redhat-vanilla.description: Canonical's Ubuntu homepage is a dark Vanilla-framework page: Ubuntu variable typeface at weights 300 to 550, a #262626 canvas with white text, square-cornered (0px radius) #008013 green buttons, #6699cc link blue on dark, and a 40px h1 at 550 weight with 48px line height.

redis.name: Redis
redis.description: Redis (redis.io), real-time data for agents and apps: a midnight #091a23 canvas with #0d212c cards, Redis red #ff4438 on dark-red #351d22 'Try Redis' buttons, dusk #163341 secondary buttons, acid yellow #dcff1e highlights, a condensed uppercase primaryFont display at 100px/85px over Space Grotesk 16px/25.6px body, 5px button and 10px card radii.

redwood-team.name: Redwood Team
redwood-team.description: Redwood Team is a Spanish-language production company showreel site: a pure black canvas (#000000), cream ink (#f9f3de), a single red accent (#e91b00), the Plaak display face at 204.444px with -4.08889px tracking for project names, Inter 500 uppercase labels at 17.7778px, and video frames with 8.89px rounded corners.

reebok.name: Reebok
reebok.description: Reebok's official US site is a retail storefront: white canvas (#ffffff) with black ink (#000000) and black square buttons 66px high, Neue Plak Extended Bold uppercase headlines at 66px, Neue Plak Regular 14px body, a blue promo bar (#244496), amber (#ffaf04) accent glow, full-bleed campaign photography and 0px button corners.

ref-digital.name: REF Digital
ref-digital.description: REF Digital is a digital agency site: a greige canvas (#c4bab0) with black type (#000000), full-width royal-blue case-study bands (#10096b), Habitus light display type at 49.7778px with -1.49333px tracking, tiny uppercase Aeonik labels at 10.6667px, thin black-outlined buttons and no rounded corners anywhere (every computed radius is 0px).

refined.name: Refined
refined.description: Carefully curated, modern minimal style with elegant serif typography and understated, sophisticated palettes.

reform-collective-5.name: Reform Collective
reform-collective-5.description: Reform Collective is a digital design and branding agency: a cream canvas (#f9f8ed) over black bands (#000000), charcoal project cards (#27282e) with 14.22px radius, a red pill call to action (#d00401, 74px high), editorialNew light serif display at 94.2208px with -2.82662px tracking, foundersGrotesk 17.7792px body and uppercase service tags.

regeneron.name: Regeneron
regeneron.description: Regeneron is a biotechnology company site: white canvas (#ffffff) with black text, a blue primary (#2169e6) on rounded buttons, an icy tint (#f6fafe), blue-to-purple-to-magenta gradient accents, Roboto Condensed bold headlines at 42px, Roboto 18px body, 8px button radii and large 80px corners on story cards.

regional-container-lines.name: RCL Group
regional-container-lines.description: RCL Group (Regional Container Lines) corporate site: a white canvas with a deep #004b8e blue navigation drawer, SourceSansPro-Light 72px hero text over aerial container-port photography, OpenSans bold 14px uppercase navigation with 1px letter spacing, and a single 30px radius used on a handful of elements.

relats.name: Relats
relats.description: Relats Top Tier site: near-black #0a0a0a canvas with white ink, Roobert (400/500) for text and DM Mono for labels, a white pill button with #1d1d1d text and 13.34px radius, an #eae4df warm card surface, and full-bleed video and product photography of protective sleeving.

reliance-jio.name: Jio
reliance-jio.description: Jio consumer site (Reliance Jio): white canvas with #0f3cc9 blue actions, JioType Black 40px/900 headlines with -1.2px tracking, JioType Medium 16px body in translucent black #000000a6, rounded 24px photo cards, pill-shaped controls, and warm lifestyle photography.

relume.name: Relume
relume.description: Relume's relume.ai marketing site: warm off-white #f1f0ee canvas, #101010 Geist text (56px regular hero, -1.68px tracking), hot magenta #ff00f4 6px-radius buttons and Geist Mono uppercase eyebrows, pink #ff9fff and cyan #98eafd gridded showcase panels, and 16px-radius cards outlined in translucent #1b19191a hairlines.

remarkable.name: reMarkable
remarkable.description: reMarkable's 'Ark' web system: warm paper-cream surfaces (#f3efe7 sections on a #fcfbf8 base, #d9d2c4 and #e0dacc bands), near-black #211e1c footer and dark hero, a single pen-blue #2559f4 action colour (hover #1142d4) on 2px-radius buttons, reMarkableSerif at weight 375 for fluid headlines (59.168px h1) and reMarkableSans 400/500 for body (20.8992px) — both proprietary reMarkable typefaces.

remix.name: Remix
remix.description: Remix (remix.run) is a black-canvas (#000000) developer site: a giant electric-blue racing wordmark, Inter 76.8px/700 headlines tracked to -2.304px, JetBrains Mono uppercase keyboard-shortcut nav, brand blue #2dacf9 for hover and highlights, translucent white pill buttons (999px) and glassy 24px-radius panels with #5f91cd46 borders and inset light shadows.

remote.name: Remote
remote.description: Remote's homepage sets the Rotina typeface (300/400/700) in ink #14191e over a purple #500087 to cyan gradient with a giant pale-cyan wordmark, translucent white #ffffff4d cards, 6px-radius ink buttons with #fafafa text, 2px inset-outline secondary buttons and Nova/Zora design-system tokens.

renault.name: Renault Group
renault.description: The Renault Group corporate site (renaultgroup.com) is a dark editorial magazine, a black canvas (#000000) with white RenaultGroup-Variable headlines at weight 700, full-bleed photographic cards at 16px radius, 100px-pill buttons in white or black, warm taupe (#978b7f) chrome and a rare signal red (#e60000) for "new" chips.

render.name: Render
render.description: Render sets light Roobert 300 headlines (80px, -2.4px tracking) and PP Neue Montreal body text in #0d0d0d on white, with square 0px-radius black buttons (66px and 48px tall), #e3e3e3 hairline grids, a #8a05ff violet accent for highlighted words and icon tiles, a multicolor service list and a #141414 footer.

replicate.name: Replicate
replicate.description: Replicate's homepage sets a white canvas (#ffffff) against a hot magenta-to-yellow gradient hero, with 72px rb-freigeist-neue headlines at weight 700, basier-square body, JetBrains Mono code, square black buttons (#000000, 0px radius) and pill-shaped filter chips. It reads as a developer tool dressed in a print-poster palette.

replit.name: Replit
replit.description: Replit sets everything in its own Replit Diatype (64px/400 headlines at -3.84px, 20px/26px body) in warm #312e2e on a #faf6f1 off-white canvas, with #ff3c00 orange 8px-radius buttons, 24px-radius feature cards in peach #f9aa8b, coral #ff764d and dark #2c3328, 6px-radius prompt chips and a mono uppercase eyebrow style.

resend.name: Resend
resend.description: Resend is a dark-first email API brand, a pure black canvas (#000000) with soft white-alpha text (#f0f0f0, then #a1a4a5), 96px domaine serif headlines beside aBCFavorit and Inter, and glassy outlined buttons at 16px radius. Panels are blue-black (#0b0e14) with faint blue-white hairlines, and colour is withheld for logos and code.

reshaped.name: Reshaped
reshaped.description: Reshaped is a React and Figma design system whose own site is a white canvas set in Inter (48px semibold display, 16px body), near-black ink #1f1f1f, a single electric blue #1760fa for primary actions, 6px-radius buttons, hairline outlines on faded neutral #ebebeb surfaces, and live component demos on a dotted grid.

retool.name: Retool
retool.description: Retool's homepage is a dark #151515 canvas with warm cream #e9ebdf type and pill buttons (hover #ffffff), Saans light-weight (300) headlines at 68.9231px with -0.022em tracking, PX Grotesk for small UI labels, a cream 20px-rounded AI prompt card with a deep 0px 68px 116px shadow, and #e9ebdf1f hairlines.

retro.name: Retro
retro.description: Throwback design with vintage-inspired typography, high-contrast retro palettes, and nostalgic visual elements.

revelatio-studio.name: Revelatio Studio
revelatio-studio.description: Revelatio Studio site: pure #000000 canvas with white ink at several opacities, Neue Haas Grotesk Text Pro 55 Roman at 31.99px with -0.96px tracking, tiny 9.33px interface labels, translucent #ffffff29 glass buttons with a 3.55px radius, and an ASCII-rendered team portrait hero.

revolut.name: Revolut
revolut.description: Revolut's UK homepage as measured on the live site — a full-bleed photographic hero with white Aeonik Pro 500 display type at 84.6578px, a near-black #1f1f1f pill call-to-action (9999px radius, 10px 24px padding), Inter at 12px for running text, and alternating white, #000000 and #191c1f bands. Product UI is driven by a --rui-* token set shipped in the page CSS.

ribbit.name: Ribbit
ribbit.description: Ribbit (ribbit.dk), a Copenhagen studio site: light #fafafa page with a dark #2f2f2f feature band and #502b1a brown footer, enormous 249.6px FKTEcho condensed display type with -6.4px tracking, FKGroteskNeue 12px uppercase navigation, and a 21px-radius pill navigation.

rice-department.name: Rice Department (กรมการข้าว)
rice-department.description: Thai Rice Department portal (ricethailand.go.th) set in IBM Plex Sans Thai with Bai Jamjuree and Sarabun accents, on white with black ink, a #e9d189 pale-gold search button (4px radius), a #e9b621 gold header, #129137 green active tabs and gold-outlined service tiles.

rightmove.name: Rightmove
rightmove.description: Rightmove (rightmove.co.uk), the UK property portal, pairs a deep navy #000433 with an electric mint-teal #2cdebe / #00deb6 accent on a white #ffffff page and #f2f3f4 footer. Everything is set in Dalton Maag's Effra at 400/500 with a +0.1px letter-spacing (hero 45px/500, headings 24px and 20px/500, body 16px/24px in #4e516b), controls are 8px-radius rectangles 48px tall, content cards are 16px-radius, and the hero search sits in a translucent navy 24px-radius panel over dusk aerial photography.

rijksmuseum.name: Rijksmuseum
rijksmuseum.description: Rijksmuseum (rijksmuseum.nl/en): full-bleed photography stacked edge to edge on a slate #40474f body and black #000000 footer, all text in white RijksText (400/700) with bold uppercase headings at 21.408px, small white 12px uppercase labels, and 2px-radius buttons in Rijksmuseum orange-red #cc4c28 or translucent white #ffffff33.

ring.name: Ring
ring.description: Ring home security site: white canvas with #424242 body ink, near-black #121212 buttons with 8px radius and 18px bold RingSans labels, #0063a5 blue navigation links, #f6f8fa and #fafbfc cool grey surfaces, 12px-radius bordered product cards, and 42px/500 display headlines.

riot-games.name: Riot Games
riot-games.description: Riot Games' corporate site (riotgames.com) is a near-black, art-led game publisher shell — #0a0a0a hero and news bands, a #1f1f1f games band and a #111111 fixed header, with crimson #d1363a as the single brand accent on pill CTAs (25.6px Sign In, 24px Explore Careers). Section titles are set in the proprietary Riot Sans Latin at 48px/700 with -1.44px tracking; everything else runs Inter V Latin (16px/400 body, 31.008px/700 feature titles) with tight negative tracking, 8px-radius news cards and parallelogram clip-path game cards.

ripples-commerce.name: Ripples Commerce
ripples-commerce.description: Ripples Commerce e-commerce agency site: white canvas with black ink, a #0063ff blue pill CTA (14px 24px padding, 48px high), Montserrat display text at 96px and 102.4px with negative tracking, pale blue-violet gradient hero wash, and leaf-shaped image masks with 280px and 300px corner radii.

rippling.name: Rippling
rippling.description: Rippling's homepage sets the Basel typeface (400/500) in black on white and warm sand #f2eeeb, frames it with a deep plum #4a0039 hero and a lilac #eab8f2 announcement bar, and drives every action with a 4px-radius amber #ffa81d button (hover #f59701) and 12px-rounded sand case-study cards.

ritz-carlton.name: The Ritz-Carlton
ritz-carlton.description: The Ritz-Carlton luxury hotels site: white canvas and #e9f1fa pale blue bands, #1c1c1c square-cornered buttons with 13px Swiss-721 bold labels, Caslon540Std serif headings and body at 18px, 12px uppercase navigation with 1.3px tracking, and thin #916e27 gold rules.

rive.name: Rive
rive.description: Rive's home page is a black #000000 Framer site with a game-UI flavour: uppercase Orbitron 900 headlines (40px, +0.4px tracking), Tomorrow uppercase labels and buttons (12px/500, +1.2px), Inter and Inter Display body copy in 60% white, dark #1d1d1d buttons with 4px corners (hover #222222), #111111/#121212 panels and small neon accents in orange #ffa41c, green #71ff19 and cyan #19f2ff.

rivian.name: Rivian
rivian.description: Rivian's site is a photo-led, near-monochrome system set entirely in its proprietary Adventure face (a Pentagram adaptation of Söhne) at 400/500/600 — a 72px/600 hero with -3px tracking, 200px/500 model marquees, 16px/24px body — on a #f2f2f2 product canvas with #ffffff surfaces, #000000 and #151515 ink, #212121 footer, and a single yellow voltage (#ffaa00, hover #ffbd2e) on 9999px pills; 40px-radius 56px buttons, 12px floating nav, 20px media cards.

robinhood.name: Robinhood
robinhood.description: Robinhood's 2024 identity as shipped on robinhood.com: a black #000000 canvas of full-bleed photography, Robin Neon #ccff00 for every primary pill button and the lime footer, warm near-black #110e08 as the dark text and button colour. Headlines alternate between Martina Plantijn (110px/400 hero, -0.5px) and Phonic (52px/40px/400 with -2px to -1px tracking); all running text is Phonic 16px/24px at -0.25px. Buttons are 44px-tall 36px-radius pills with 0px 32px padding that fade to 0.85 opacity on hover.

roblox.name: Roblox
roblox.description: Roblox's logged-out web surface is a dark sign-up page — a #121215 form card and footer over a tilted mosaic of game thumbnails, all text set in the proprietary Builder Sans (300/400/500/700/800). Body ink is #f7f7f8 with #d5d7dd secondary, links are #70a0ff, the emphasis action is cobalt #335fff, and every button, field and card uses an 8px radius.

robot.name: Robot
robot.description: Robot (therobot.tv) production company site: #e3e4d8 warm grey canvas, #000000 and white sections, #fe0000 red accent for bracketed links and a generative grid, OTMedium squeezed condensed typefaces up to 466.64px, 13px uppercase tracked labels, and every element with a 0px radius.

roche.name: Roche
roche.description: Roche corporate site: white canvas with black ink, Roche blue #0b41cd square-cornered buttons (56px high, 18px roche-sans), a light-weight 200 roche-sans at 40px for headlines, roche-serif pull quotes, warm grey #544f4f secondary text and #022366 hover.

rockstar-games.name: Rockstar Games
rockstar-games.description: Rockstar Games' site is a black (#000000) stage for full-bleed key art, set entirely in Monotype's Helvetica Now (Display 700 for 54px/45px headlines, Text 400/700 for 18px body and buttons). Text is soft grey (#ebebeb, #cecece) not white; actions are 54px pills with 1000px radius tinted per game — #fff6b2, #ffd4a8, #ffb2c6, Rockstar gold #fcaf17 — or white-outlined on art; cards are rgba(255,255,255,.1) with 8px radius.

rogers.name: Rogers
rogers.description: Rogers Communications consumer site: Rogers red #da291c with 32px-radius pill buttons (44px high, Ted Next Var 16px weight 600), white and #fafafa page, #1f1f1f dark panels, 4px-radius cards, 42px/700 headlines with -0.3px tracking, and a #2f6fa7 blue link color.

roland.name: Roland
roland.description: Roland Global site (roland.com/global): #141414 and #000000 dark navigation and footer, a #ff5a00 orange logo tile and accent, proxima-nova in light 300 weight at 13px for body and 80px for the hero title, uppercase 18px labels, #e5e5e5 grey bands, and a pill search field with 37.5px radius.

rolex.name: Rolex
rolex.description: Rolex's site is a white (#ffffff) and near-black (#212121) editorial frame around full-bleed watch and cultural photography, set entirely in Monotype's Helvetica Now Text at 300/400/700 with a 71.936px/700 hero headline, RolexFont-S tracked labels, a single Rolex green (#127749) for hover and links, translucent pill buttons (rgba(118,118,118,0.3), 9999px, 0 35px, 44px tall), a 45-degree green gradient CTA and a #f8f8f8 footer.

rolls-royce-motor-cars.name: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars
rolls-royce-motor-cars.description: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars home page measured at rolls-roycemotorcars.com: a black canvas (#000000) of full-bleed car video, white uppercase Riviera Nights display type at 70px/300 with 2.5px tracking, and a white pill button (#ffffff fill, #151515 text, 30px radius) labelled DISCOVER MORE.

roojai.name: Roojai
roojai.description: Roojai Thailand insurance site measured at roojai.com/en: Prompt typeface at 400 and 500, deep navy #003b71 hero and footer, orange #d84000 Get Quote button with a #ff5011 gradient and highlight, white cards with 20px radius and a navy-tinted 28px shadow.

rose-media-and-entertainment.name: Rose Media and Entertainment
rose-media-and-entertainment.description: Rose Media and Entertainment (rose.co.th), a Thai music and documentary label site: db_helvethaica_x55/x65 Thai faces plus Tahoma, red #d71921 nav and footer, a #555555 music grid band, 3px radius gray #9a9a9a buttons and a 38px input.

rosewood.name: Rosewood Hotels & Resorts
rosewood.description: Rosewood Hotels (rosewoodhotels.com) measured home: off-white #fafbf5 canvas, cream #f0eee0 bands, forest green #013d2d square RESERVE button, Engravers Gothic Bold caps with wide tracking plus Austin Light Web serif, zero radius, almost no shadow.

royal-bank-of-canada.name: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC corporate site)
royal-bank-of-canada.description: RBC (Royal Bank of Canada) corporate site, rbc.com/about-rbc.html: RBCDisplay headings with Roboto body, RBC blue #006ac3 actions with #0051a5 hover, yellow #fedf01 Sign In button, white cards on a #eeeeee band, near-square 1px button radius.

rs-group.name: RS Group
rs-group.description: RS Group (rs.co.th), Thai entertainment and commerce company, brand purpose "Life Enriching": a single serif family gt_sectra (Trirong, serif fallback) at 15px body and 26px headings, black on white with #f7f7f7 bands and #505052 secondary text, zero radius, no shadows.

rs-music.name: RS Music
rs-music.description: RS Music (rsmusicth.com), Thai label site "RS MUSIC IS BACK!": black pages with white Kanit uppercase headings, magenta #e708ff accents and buttons (2px radius, 44px high), purple #8601ff hover, release cards with magenta category chips and a 4-up artist photo grid.

runwayml.name: Runway
runwayml.description: Runway's homepage as measured on the live site (runway.com) — one typeface, abcNormal, at weights 400 to 600; a white canvas with #0c0c0c full-width dark panels; compact 6px-radius buttons in #262626 with white 14px/600 labels; hairlines in #e5e7eb; no box shadows measured; and a blue-violet #2b22fa announcement bar above a photographic hero.

rvp.name: Road Accident Victims Protection Co., Ltd. (บริษัท กลางคุ้มครองผู้ประสบภัยจากรถ จำกัด)
rvp.description: RVP (กลางคุ้มครองผู้ประสบภัยจากรถ) homepage: white canvas, purple #774cb8 primary with deep #3d1982 accents, a font named "line" at 700 weight, 12px-radius buttons, 24px cards and a Tailwind colour scale on the root.

ryanair.name: Ryanair
ryanair.description: Ryanair Ireland home (ryanair.com/ie/en): Roboto only at 400 and 700, navy #073590 text on a blue booking header, yellow #f1c933 pill actions (16px radius, 32px high), light #f4f4f4 canvas with white cards, 2px and 4px card radii and very soft shadows.

s-2k.name: S-2K (Honda S2000 tribute)
s-2k.description: S-2K (s-2k.webflow.io), a Webflow tribute site to the Honda S2000 (1999-2009): off-white #efefef and near-black #0e0e0e, PP Neue Montreal at weight 200 up to 192px, IBM Plex Mono 12.8px uppercase labels, orange #ff7700 markers, no radius, no shadows.

s-and-p.name: S&P Syndicate
s-and-p.description: S&P Syndicate (snpfood.com/en/home), Thai restaurant, bakery and food group: Kanit at weight 300 body and 500 headings, S&P red #e32126 buttons (3px radius, 46px high) and red-to-maroon gradient bands, light #f4f4f4 canvas with white cards.

safety-insurance.name: Tokio Marine Group Thailand
safety-insurance.description: Tokio Marine Group Thailand landing page (reached from safety.co.th): white canvas with deep teal ink (#022b39), petrol-blue pill buttons (#00546c, hover #006d8a), lighter teal secondary (#33abba), Lato Bold headings at 30.56px, pastel category chips, a rounded dark footer (#032b39) and a sky-and-lifestyle hero.

sahapat-delivery.name: Sahapat Delivery
sahapat-delivery.description: Sahapat Delivery (sahapatdelivery.com) is a Thai online grocery storefront on a light #f4f4f5 canvas with white #ffffff product cards, Noto Sans Thai at 400 and 600, #242526 ink, a red #ff2a00 sale accent, 8px card radii and a soft rgba(96, 108, 171, 0.18) card shadow.

sakazuki.name: SAKAZUKI
sakazuki.description: SAKAZUKI (sakazuki.io), a Japan culture membership guided by Suntory group: hagrid display and hagrid-text serifs at weight 400 only, warm #e1d6ce canvas, black and #c30d23 red sections, square 52px MINT button with a white border, no shadows.

sakol-energy.name: Sakol Energy
sakol-energy.description: Sakol Energy Public Company Limited (SKE, sakolenergy.com) uses a white canvas #ffffff, charcoal ink #333333, a gold #e5b71b READ MORE button, slate #5c666f bands and an #ececec footer, all set in Myriad Pro; its entry gateway is a monochrome mourning page in PSL Malinee Pro 56px.

saksiam-leasing.name: Saksiam Leasing Public Company Limited (ศักดิ์สยามลิสซิ่ง)
