saksiam-leasing.description: Saksiam Leasing homepage: white canvas, navy #243865 pill buttons and header, ink #192543, sukhumvitTadmai typeface at 48px/800 for display, 32px button radius, 28px cards and a --main-blue and --main-yellow root colour scale.

salary-hero.name: Salary Hero
salary-hero.description: Salary Hero site at salary-hero.com: Poppins 48px bold headlines, violet #745bf7, lavender #f3f3ff, indigo #251a52 and magenta #982a96 colour blocks, white pill buttons with #542ad8 hover, 16px-radius stat tiles and a floating dark pill nav.

salesforce-g.name: Salesforce
salesforce-g.description: Salesforce's home page (measured on the Thai locale salesforce.com/th/) pairs ITC Avant Garde 70px/400 headlines in navy #002c6e with Salesforce Sans 16px body in #181818, a #0176d3 4px-radius 'start free' button (hover #0b5cab), #066afe pill buttons, and translucent 32px-radius product cards on deep #032e61 bands.

salomon.name: Salomon
salomon.description: Salomon US store: uppercase salomonSansFont 700 headlines (42px hero, 32px with -1.5008px tracking) over full-bleed outdoor photography, Inter 400/600/700 for UI and 14px body text, #141414 ink on #ffffff, #f5f5f5 secondary surfaces, a #000000 S/PLUS member footer, translucent #ffffff59 48px-radius search field and pill-shaped buttons.

samart-group.name: Samart Group (Samart Corporation)
samart-group.description: Samart Corporation Public Company Limited group site - white page with navy (#2d3359) Kanit text, a #0b4596 royal-blue MORE/SUBMIT button family, 10px-radius bordered business cards, and a dark #363537 header and #323437 footer; Thai-first copy with English subtitles.

samart-telcoms.name: Samart Telcoms
samart-telcoms.description: Samart Telcoms (samtel.com), Thai ICT and telecom group: Kanit at weights 300 and 500, orange #f05a22 pill buttons (25px radius, 47px high, 2px tracking), blue #1b67cc headings, white cards with a 5px radius on a #dedede page, dark #1e252d footer and #1c1918 top bar.

samitivej.name: Samitivej Hospital
samitivej.description: Samitivej Hospital (samitivejhospitals.com), Bangkok private hospital: Helvetica Neue uppercase headings with 1px to 2px tracking, deep green #004729 and brass gold #b18e50, sage #dce0d6 bands, square 50px buttons, soft white and gold-tinted panels, no shadows.

sammakorn.name: Sammakorn
sammakorn.description: Sammakorn (sammakorn.co.th) Thai luxury-housing developer site in DB Heavent 300 to 700: navy #012168 primary with white text, warm beige #efece7 search band, gold-brown #867551 rules, tan #bbb19d chips, square 0px buttons and 4px chips on a white canvas.

sammitr-motors-manufacturing.name: Sammitr Motors Manufacturing PLC
sammitr-motors-manufacturing.description: Corporate site of Sammitr Motor Manufacturing PLC, a Thai logistics-transport and automotive-parts maker. White canvas, a saturated red #ed1b25 nav bar and accents, Athiti display headings at 40.8px/600 over Roboto 16px body, pill-shaped 99px secondary buttons and a charcoal #2c2c2c footer.

samsung.name: Samsung
samsung.description: Samsung US storefront (samsung.com/us): white #ffffff pages with #f7f7f7 product stages, black #000000 text and black pill CTAs (17.7778px radius, 36px tall at 1280px) that invert to white on hover, blue #006bea for hover and savings, SamsungSharpSans 700 for display headlines (49.7778px / 35.5556px) over SamsungOne 400/700 for UI and body, 7.11111px tile radius, and a type/spacing scale that is fixed at 1440px and scales down proportionally below it.

san-rita.name: Atelier San Rita
san-rita.description: Portfolio site of Atelier San Rita, a Canadian creative studio. A map-as-interface home on icy blue #dde2e4 with forest-green #2d3329 ink, adventure-yellow #e2ffcc highlights, F37 Stout compressed capitals at 56px over 10px bold monospace labels, and no rounded corners anywhere.

sanity.name: Sanity
sanity.description: Sanity's homepage as measured on the live site — a #0b0b0b near-black canvas, white Waldenburg display type up to 112px with -4.48px tracking, IBM Plex Mono uppercase 13px button labels, pill buttons filled #ff4100 (with a #ff560a brand variable in the page CSS), a full-width orange logo band, and dark Studio mockups with 3px to 12px radii.

sanofi.name: Sanofi
sanofi.description: Global biopharma corporate site at sanofi.com/en. White canvas, Sanofi Sans 16px body and 700-weight 48px headlines with Sanofi Serif italic accents, brand purple #7a00e6 for links, hover and arrows, 4px-radius buttons, 8px-radius bordered article cards and a #f5f5f5 Global selector.

sanook.name: Sanook.com
sanook.description: Thai news and entertainment portal at sanook.com. White canvas, brand red #f70000 channel tabs, Sukhumvit 33px bold headlines with Prompt 30px section headings, light grey card shadows, 20px-radius search and login pills, and dense multi-column card rows.

sansiri.name: Sansiri
sansiri.description: Thai property developer site at sansiri.com/thai. White canvas, brand blue #0053b5, GraphikTH Regular and SemiBold with 36px headings, 50px-radius pill buttons and inputs, 16px-radius project cards with soft shadows, and a #f6f6f6 footer.

santander.name: Santander
santander.description: Santander Group corporate site at santander.com/en. White canvas, brand red #ec0000, proprietary Santander Headline and MicroText fonts with a 48px hero headline, a 47px Online Banking button with 4px corners, pale blue statistic tiles and a #f7f7f7 footer.

sanuk-games.name: Sanuk Games
sanuk-games.description: Indie game studio site at sanukgames.com. White canvas with #767676 Source Sans Pro 16px text, deep red #ce1a1a links and hover, Raleway navigation over an illustrated dark header, a #1c1c1c footer, and square corners throughout with no shadows.

sap-fundamental.name: SAP (sap.com)
sap-fundamental.description: SAP's product pages: the proprietary 72 Brand Variable typeface (Arial fallback) in medium weight, near-black navy text (#223548) on white, a single saturated blue (#0057d2) for the floating Contact us button and every link, a pale blue hero band (#ebf8ff), 8px-radius buttons with a soft blue-grey drop shadow, and a dark #222222 footer.

sappe.name: SAPPE
sappe.description: SAPPE Public Company Limited's English corporate site (sappe.com/en) — a white canvas carrying a single saturated red (#ec1c25) for the logo, nav hover, headlines and full-bleed action tiles, set in the DB Havel / DB Helvethaica Thai-Latin family at heavy 900 weight for display and 400 for body, with 50px pill-radius red panels and a muted slate-grey (#7c858c) paragraph voice.

sarakadee-books-wiriyah-business.name: Sarakadee Magazine
sarakadee-books-wiriyah-business.description: Thai documentary magazine site at sarakadee.com. White canvas, #212529 ink, red #ff0000 SUBSCRIBE button, Anakotmai 36px headlines with Sarabun 16px/30px body, square black and white buttons, a split photo-and-dark-panel hero and a dark two-tone footer.

sasom.name: SASOM
sasom.description: SASOM (Thai streetwear and collectibles marketplace) design system: Noto Sans Thai at 12 to 16px, neutral #f9f9f9 canvas, near-black #18181b login button with 4px radius, pill shortcuts and 12px media tiles.

savills.name: Savills
savills.description: Global real estate services site at savills.com. White canvas with #313131 ink, Savills yellow #ffdf00, navy #35384b footer, red #cd171e uppercase links, Domine serif 56px headlines over Gotham 16px body, and square corners with no shadows.

savor.name: Savor
savor.description: Savor fats brand site at savor.it. Cream canvas #fff9eb, maroon ink #370808, #f0e7d7 buttons with 5px radius and #e6dac4 hover, Suisse Intl 17.7px body with Roslindale Display Condensed 111.6px hero type, no borders or shadows.

sc-asset.name: SC Asset
sc-asset.description: SC Asset (scasset.com, measured at /en/) residential developer site: BrutGrotesqueThai type with 36px weight-300 headings and -0.72px tracking, #000000 ink on white, a #ff6200 orange accent for nav band and tags, pale peach and #fee6ee pink promotional bands, 10px and 15px radii, and large house photography.

scale-ai.name: Scale AI
scale-ai.description: Scale AI home page: monochrome enterprise-AI site in the aeonik grotesque at weight 400, 64px display with -0.64px tracking, black #000000 primary buttons with 8px radius on a white #ffffff canvas, body ink #575757, tinted cards in #a8927c, #193a29 and #79648c.

scania-thailand.name: Scania Thailand
scania-thailand.description: Scania Thailand (สแกนเนีย ประเทศไทย) country home page: deep navy #041e42 header and 80px Scania Sans Headline Bold headings on a white #ffffff canvas, full-bleed documentary truck and bus photography, square corners, body ink #000000de at 16px.

scb.name: SCB (Siam Commercial Bank)
scb.description: SCB's personal-banking website — a light #f9f9fa canvas with white 4px-rounded cards on a soft 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.07) shadow, SCB purple #7a58bf for 44px buttons and links, deep purple #462279 footer, Sukhumvittadmai type in a single 400 weight (bold via the sukhumvittadmai_bol face) — 54.08px hero headlines, 28px card titles, 16px/22.4px body.

scbx.name: SCBX Group
scbx.description: Dark corporate fintech hub in SCBX proprietary typefaces: #151a1f near-black ground, white #ffffff headings, #aeb3b4 secondary text, #d3adff lavender accent, square 1px white outlined buttons with no shadows and 4px radius only on one element.

scg-express.name: SCG Express
scg-express.description: SCG Express parcel-delivery site: SCG red #ed1c06 hero and tiles, teal #008c74 accent, db_helvethaica 700 uppercase 48px headings, 14px body, square color-block service tiles, pill tracking input with 9999px radius, grey #e6e7e8 footer.

schneider-electric.name: Schneider Electric
schneider-electric.description: Schneider Electric global corporate site: Arial Rounded MT for SE type, green #3dcd58 primary from --se-primary, grey #f0f1f2 page body on #fcfcfc canvas, white cards with 8px radius and #e6e6e6 border, dark product-render panels at 16px radius.

scot-gov.name: Scottish Government
scot-gov.description: gov.scot is built on the Scottish Government Design System: Roboto throughout (44px/56px bold H1, 19px/32px body), near-black ink (#1a1a1a), brand blue (#0065bd) for links and the primary button, a white canvas (#ffffff) with light grey panels (#f8f8f8, #ebebeb), square 0px corners and a thick blue top rule above each content section. Hover blue is #00437d.

sculpting-harmony.name: Sculpting Harmony
sculpting-harmony.description: Sculpting Harmony, a Getty interactive story on Frank Gehry and the Walt Disney Concert Hall: orange #ffa441 opening field, black #000000 ink, Reckless serif and Roboto Mono uppercase labels, bracketed buttons with 32px radius, chapter colors #4596ff, #16a147, #ff6359.

se-ed.name: SE-ED (ร้านหนังสือออนไลน์ SE-ED)
se-ed.description: SE-ED's online bookstore: Poppins with Noto Sans Thai fallback, a red (#e50000) brand with 30px-radius outlined buttons, a near-black (#222323) category bar, 8px product cards and bold 32px/700 shelf headings on white.

seacon.name: Seacon Development
seacon.description: Seacon Development (seacon.co.th, Thai: ซีคอน รับสร้างบ้าน) custom home builder site: Prompt type at 32px light headings and 14px body, navy #1f3765 ink and #1d2a4e bands on a #d4d4d4 canvas, a #ed1c25 red accent, pill-rounded 100px search field, soft navy shadows and large house-render imagery.

seacon-bangkae.name: Seacon Bangkae
seacon-bangkae.description: Thai-language site of Seacon Bangkae mall, set in Red Hat Display with a 199.897px outlined uppercase hero, Roboto and Mitr text, white and #f5f5f5 canvas with black ink, #f37c4b orange accent, a #00000080 glass header and 32px-radius frosted news cards.

seacon-square.name: Seacon Square
seacon-square.description: Design language of the Seacon Square shopping center website: a white canvas with black headings, white text on translucent bars and #959595 captions, a translucent black header, Red Hat Display 700 uppercase for the giant SEACON hero word, Roboto with Mitr as the Thai companion for everything else, full-pill controls (100px radius), with event posters and photography doing nearly all of the colour work.

seasats.name: Seasats
seasats.description: Seasats ocean-autonomy site: seasonMix serif display at 110.222px, seasonSans body, supplyMono uppercase labels, off-white #fffdfd canvas, ink #232323, forest-green #2b3922 button cap, mint accent #e3ede4, radii scaled from 0.8rem.

seb.name: SEB
seb.description: SEB (Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken) group website built on SEB's Green Design System: the proprietary SEB SansSerif at weight 450, a near-black #0a0b0b ink on white, a single deep forest green #003824 for the primary pill button and hero panel, warm-grey #f7f8f7 cards with 12px radius, a #1a1a1a footer, and semantic red, green, blue and amber for market and status data.

seek.name: SEEK
seek.description: SEEK's Australian job-search site (seek.com.au) is built on the Braid design system's seekJobs theme: SeekSans (weights 400, 600, 700), slate ink #2e3849 and #5a6881 on white, a hot SEEK pink #e60278 for the search button, deep navy #051a49 for the search band, 8px-radius controls with 2px inset outlines, 16px and 24px rounded surfaces, and a 4px spacing grid.

sega.name: SEGA
sega.description: SEGA home page: black #000000 and navy #0d1126 bands with electric blue #0057ff primary, Inter Tight 800 uppercase headings at 108px, Poppins 16px body, 48px-radius tag buttons, skewed clip-path action buttons, 8px card radius and large soft shadows.

semantic-ui.name: Semantic UI
semantic-ui.description: Semantic UI, a CSS and jQuery component framework whose site and docs are set in Lato 14px/16px on white, with the framework's #2185d0 primary blue, #1b1c1d black, #e0e1e2 default grey buttons, rgba(34,36,38,0.15) hairlines, 4px button radii and a dark-to-warm gradient hero carrying white outlined buttons.

semrush.name: Semrush
semrush.description: Semrush marketing homepage as captured in October 2026: tight, heavily tracked Lazzer headlines (84px/600, -3.36px) in off-black #181e15 on white and pale mint #dceeeb, a lavender #c190ff pill CTA with 100px radius, an off-black #181e15 secondary pill, lime #89ff75 and aqua #18f0bf accents, and frosted-glass search and card shells with a 0 2px 12px 5% shadow.

sena.name: Sena Development
sena.description: Sena Development (sena.co.th) Thai homes and condos site in db_heavent 300 to 600 with teal #32bcad actions, 8px button radius, 10px card radius, 50px outlined chips on a white #ffffff canvas with an orange #e1762d tag color.

sennheiser.name: Sennheiser
sennheiser.description: Sennheiser storefront home page: sennheiserFont 400/500 type, black #000000 pill buttons at 54px, ink #303030 on white #ffffff, grey #f4f4f6 product tiles, blue #037cc2 active category row, teal #003746 footer, 8px card radius.

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.description: Sentry's homepage as measured on the live site — a #1f1633 'rich black' purple canvas over a #150f23 base, white Dammit Sans display type at 88px/700 with Rubik text and Monaco code, uppercase 14px/700 buttons with 8px radius, a hot pink #fd44b0 highlight word in headlines, blurple #6a5fc1 pills, and violet-framed product cards.

sephora.name: Sephora
sephora.description: Sephora's US storefront: a white #ffffff product-grid canvas under a black #000000 category band, set entirely in "helvetica neue" (14px/400 body, 20px/700 section heads), black #000000 ink with #666666 secondary text and #136bea links, a single red #cf112c (hover #e2030f) for the filled pill CTA and sale prices, 2px black outlined pills (9999px) for most actions and 4px-radius cards edged by a 1px #eeeeee inset shadow.

serpentine.name: Serpentine
serpentine.description: Serpentine (serpentinegalleries.org): white and #f2f2f2 pages with a teal #00cbab visit band, giant condensed Platanus headlines (125.356px hero), Tstar Pro 700 uppercase labels, Noe Text serif body at 16.15px, white buttons and image cards with a single rounded bottom-left corner (10px / 20px).

serve-robotics.name: Serve Robotics
serve-robotics.description: Serve Robotics home page: Roobert type with 107.461px display and -2.4px tracking, midnight green #083031 ink and primary, deep green #0f4233 bands, pale green #cee8e1 cards, mustard #ffc942 and mint #61e5c0 accents, 8px card radius.

servicenow-g.name: ServiceNow
servicenow-g.description: ServiceNow's marketing site pairs a deep Infinite Blue (#032d42) chrome with Wasabi Green (#62d84e / #63df4e) capsule CTAs, set in the proprietary ServiceNow Sans family (Light for body, Bold 48px for the hero h1). Radii are capsule 500px buttons, 24px and 32px cards, 8px inputs; focus is a 2px #3eaa2b outline.

servicetitan.name: ServiceTitan
servicetitan.description: ServiceTitan's marketing site sets Sofia Pro headlines (44px/700, -2.2px tracking) and Nunito Sans body text on a white canvas with a #22252a charcoal hero card, a coral-red #e24f4f call to action with 8px corners, a #0265dc blue secondary, and documents its product system, Anvil2, with the same two typefaces.

set-exchange.name: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET)
set-exchange.description: SET home page: market-data portal with amber #fbb034 primary buttons and tabs, charcoal #1e1e21 and #2a2e34 modules on white #ffffff, DB Helvethaica X headings with Sarabun 14px body, pill search field, 0px-radius primary button, red #ff3c3c declines.

settrade.name: Settrade (SETTRADE.COM)
settrade.description: SETTRADE.COM Thai home page: white and #f8f9fa canvas, blue #154e92 primary with navy #1d3352 footer, green #17af54 for gains and links, DB Helvethaica X for headings and Sarabun for navigation, dense market-data tables.

seven-eleven-th.name: 7-Eleven Thailand
seven-eleven-th.description: 7-Eleven Thailand (7eleven.co.th, operated by CP ALL) is a white-canvas promo catalogue set entirely in the Thai typeface DBHelvethaicaMonX (regular) and DBHelvethaicaMonXBd (bold cut, served at weight 400), with a 24px body size, deep 7-Eleven green #00693e for 36px section titles and the full-bleed footer, brighter green #00a550 for nav hover, grey #525252 body ink, square 0px image tiles on #f2f2f2, and 50% circular carousel controls.

seventeen.name: Seventeen
seventeen.description: Seventeen creative agency site: Webflow build in Bagosscondensed 400 with a 49.2727px headline on /about, slate #afaea7 and black #000000 bands on a white #ffffff canvas, white-highlight headline blocks, no shadows and no measured corner radius.

sf-cinema.name: SF Cinema
sf-cinema.description: SF Cinema home page: Mantine-based site in Smarn Film type, SF blue #4285cf and #2062af gradient bands, dark footer #231f20, uppercase 12px nav, 8px-radius pill buttons at 30px, 24px rounded band corners, ink #3c3c3c on white #ffffff.

sg-capital.name: SG Capital
sg-capital.description: SG Capital (sgcapital.co.th/en/home), a Thai non-banking financial services provider: FC Iconic typeface at 400 and 600, white canvas #ffffff, brand red #f5333f, brand blue #003da6, black pill buttons with 30px radius and 16px-radius cards with a soft blue shadow.

shadcn.name: shadcn/ui
shadcn.description: shadcn/ui as measured on ui.shadcn.com and its button docs — Geist at 14px/500 buttons and a 48px/600 headline with -2.4px tracking, neutral greys (#000000 primary, #fafafa on-primary, #737373 muted, #e5e5e5 border), a 10px base radius scale with 26px pill hero buttons, and hairline card shadows.

shader-development-studio.name: Shader Development Studio
shader-development-studio.description: Shader (shader.se), a Norrköping creative development studio for WebGL, 3D and AI experiences. Pure black canvas #000000, a single warm off-white #fcf9f3 for all text, one typeface (STIX Two Text serif, 16px/24px, weight 400), and square corners everywhere: no rendered border radius.

shake-shack.name: Shake Shack
shake-shack.description: Shake Shack's US home page shakeshack.com measured live — white #ffffff header, black #000000 footer, Shack green #418613 pill 'Order Now' button (40px radius) that inverts to white on hover, white 'ORDER NOW' pills (30px) on 80%-black #000000cc hero panels, and Jost throughout: 60px/700 headlines, 17px/700 capitalised buttons, a bold 32px Roboto MENU label.

shangri-la.name: Shangri-La Hotels and Resorts
shangri-la.description: Shangri-La Hotels and Resorts (shangri-la.com): luxury hotel group site with PlayfairDisplay serif headings (36px/44px, weight 500) over Montserrat 14px/20px body, a gold #e0aa14 square-cornered Join Now button with #333333 text, white canvas #ffffff, pale grey #f4f5f6 sections and a deep teal #0b363c footer area.

shark-energy.name: SHARK Energy
shark-energy.description: Brand site for SHARK Energy Drink (a drink from Osotspa) on a dark #252424 canvas with #929292 body text, #408bd1 blue buttons, #0f4693 deep-blue hero, a 189px uppercase 28Days watermark word, Source Sans Pro 300/900 and sparse 4px, 14px and 40px radii.

sharplink.name: Sharplink
sharplink.description: Sharplink (sharplink.com), an institutional-grade Ethereum treasury company listed on Nasdaq: Archivo 88px/84.48px display headings with tight negative tracking, Archivo Narrow 13px uppercase button labels, warm off-white canvas #f7f7f5, #f3f3f3 square CTA with a brand-blue #0e76ff arrow tile, and 0px radius everywhere.

shazam.name: Shazam
shazam.description: Shazam's web home is a white (#ffffff) Apple-style chart catalogue opened by a dark, blurred-artwork hero; NeueMontreal Bold headlines at 60px/700 with -0.6px tracking, #1c1c1e ink, Shazam blue #066bff for links and arrows, 16px-radius song cards and 50px pill buttons.

shed.name: Shed
shed.description: Shed (shed.design), a brand design and interior architecture agency: OwnersWeb 600 uppercase display at 205.6px/185.04px, SequelWeb sans for body (48px/48px weight 500 in the intro statement), RecklessWeb serif accents, white canvas #ffffff, ink #1c1c1c, light-blue #6ccaff link accent and 128px/50% rounds.

shein.name: SHEIN
shein.description: SHEIN's Thailand storefront (th.shein.com), measured — black #000000 header, nav and square Subscribe buttons, light grey #f6f6f6 and white #ffffff surfaces, promo orange-red #f93a00 prices, trend purple #9462ff, Muli 13px nav, Jost 28px banner titles, system-ui 12–16px copy, 0px buttons with 6px cards.

shell.name: Shell Global
shell.description: Shell Global (shell.com): white canvas #ffffff with grey ink #4a4a4a, Shell yellow #ffc800 buttons with 8px radius and 48px height, 16px-radius cards on #f5f5f5, a proprietary custom-font bold for headings (32px/48px, 28px/42px, 20px/30px) over an Arial stack at 14px/21px.

shell-thailand.name: Shell Thailand
shell-thailand.description: Shell Thailand customer site (shell.co.th/th_th/customer.html): white canvas #ffffff, grey #f5f5f5 cards, ink #4a4a4a, Shell yellow #ffc800 buttons that invert to ink on hover, custom-font headings over Arial, 6px and 8px button radii and 16px link tiles.

shift-5.name: Shift5
shift-5.description: Shift5 (shift5.io), operational intelligence software for defense and transportation fleets: signal-orange #ff5841 canvas, graphite #202020 ink, grey #b9b9b9 buttons with 24px radius, NonSans 177.778px/170.667px display with -3.55556px tracking, and AuxMono 12px uppercase monospace labels.

shippo.name: Shippo
shippo.description: Shippo (goshippo.com), the multi-carrier shipping software and API, runs its marketing site on a saturated mint-green canvas (#25d695) with a deep teal action color (#00484e), black text, Rethink Sans 700 headlines (64px hero, 48px sections) over neue-haas-unica body copy (24px/32px lead, 600 buttons), 8px-radius buttons 56–60px tall, and flat green cards outlined with a 3px black border that echo its bold-outline illustration style.

shiseido.name: Shiseido
shiseido.description: Shiseido (shiseido.com, US store): white canvas #ffffff with black #000000 ink, square-ish black 12px uppercase ShiseidoGinzaExtBold buttons (5px radius, 40px tall), a red #d6001c promo bar and Get Help pill, ShiseidoGinzaExtRegular 36px/43.2px headings over ShiseidoGinzaRegular 14px/19.6px body.

shoelace.name: Shoelace
shoelace.description: Documentation site of the Shoelace web components library: white canvas, #18181b text on the system UI font stack, sky-blue #0284c7 primary button with 4px radius and 40px height, danger #dc2626, soft cool-gray shadows; a Web Awesome sunset modal overlays it.

shopat24.name: ALL Online
shopat24.description: 7-Eleven's ALL Online store, measured on its ShopAt24 page: white canvas, #009f3c green navigation bar, #00c300 green links, #e62739 sale red, #455d70 slate text, DB Ozone X typeface at 22px, 17px radii on product cards.

shopeepay-thailand.name: ShopeePay Thailand
shopeepay-thailand.description: ShopeePay Thailand (shopeepay.co.th): e-wallet marketing site in Shopee orange #ee4d2d on white #ffffff with charcoal ink #202325, Thai type in SukhumvitBold 32px and 22px headings over Thonburi 14px body, 8px-radius bordered feature cards, and a 36px-tall orange download button.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.description: Shopify's marketing homepage is a near-black, cinematic dark theme: a #02090a canvas with deep forest-green (#041e18) and midnight-navy (#000a1e) panels, white type in the variable Shopify-Inter family at light weights (300/330) with negative tracking up to -1.92px at 96px, and a single white pill CTA (9999px radius, 56px tall) that turns #d4d4d8 on hover.

shopify-supply-performance-pack.name: Shopify Supply (Performance Pack)
shopify-supply-performance-pack.description: Shopify Supply, Performance Pack (shopify.supply): the Shopify merch store as a dark black #000000 storefront with bone-white #eeece2 text, an italic Condor 40px/40px uppercase headline, Fraktion monospace labels, Inter-Variable body at 16px/24px, a #6fc992 green accent and fully round (pill) controls.

siam-cement-chemicals.name: SCG Chemicals
siam-cement-chemicals.description: SCG Chemicals (SCGC) corporate site, scgchemicals.com/en/home: white canvas, #333333 body text in Prompt 14.4px, teal #009989 headings in the custom scg typeface at 34.56px/600, pill-shaped 50px outlined buttons that fill #009989 on hover, and teal-to-indigo photographic bands.

siam-cement-group.name: SCG (Siam Cement Group)
siam-cement-group.description: SCG (Siam Cement Group, scg.com/en): Thai industrial conglomerate site in the custom SCG typeface (700 headings at 32px/43.2px), SCG red #da291c pill buttons 42px tall, near-white canvas #fcfcfd, navy-slate ink #101828, green #079455 stat cards with a 50px bottom-left radius, and a #252a36 footer.

siam-center.name: Siam Center
siam-center.description: Design language of the Siam Center website: a near-black canvas (#000000 with #050505, #0b0b0b and #111111 steps) carrying white Montserrat text, one electric yellow #ffec00 accent for navigation and buttons, square corners, and loud multicolour poster illustration inside white editorial cards.

siam-city-cement.name: INSEE Group (Siam City Cement group site)
siam-city-cement.description: INSEE Group page of Siam City Cement (siamcitycement.com/en/home): white canvas with #f9f9f9 page body, INSEE red #e50019 blocks and buttons with square 0px corners, ink #4b4b4b, the custom insee typeface in uppercase (54px/54px weight 700 headings, 20px nav) and circular 50% country flags.

siam-discovery.name: Siam Discovery
siam-discovery.description: Design language of the Siam Discovery retail site: Noto Sans Thai throughout with uppercase 600-weight navigation and 40px section titles, near-black #212529 ink and #838385 grey copy on white, cool-grey #dedede panels, black bands, and one indigo-blue #39489c action colour on square-cornered 40px buttons.

siam-paragon.name: Siam Paragon
siam-paragon.description: Siam Paragon (siamparagon.co.th), the Bangkok luxury shopping mall site: pale cool canvas #f2f5f5, near-black ink #030305, a gold #d0b857 nav hover accent, all-Roboto uppercase set at weight 400 with negative tracking (46px/48.3px display), square corners everywhere and no shadows.

siam-rath.name: Siam Rath (สยามรัฐออนไลน์)
siam-rath.description: Thai daily-news portal on a white #ffffff canvas with #f1f5f9 slate page tint, near-black #020618 ink, Google Sans/Prompt/Kanit display type and Sarabun body, a #059669 emerald link accent, translucent maroon #80032699 story cards and a 2px corner radius.

siam-sport-syndicate.name: Siam Sport Syndicate (Siamsport Print)
siam-sport-syndicate.description: Corporate site of Siam Sport Syndicate PCL, a Thai commercial printing company: white canvas, hot pink #fa1e5a primary with white text, near-black #242424 footer, Kanit in weights 300 to 800, and a 3px button radius with a 50px-tall Contact us button.

siamgas.name: Siam Gas
siamgas.description: Corporate site of Siamgas and Petrochemicals PCL. (shown as Siam Gas Group): a light-gray #eaeaea canvas, flat Siam-blue #0071bb label bars with white 16px bold Helvetica Neue caps, red #ff0000 accents, Arial 13.3333px body copy and square 0px corners.

siamsport.name: Siamsport (สยามกีฬา)
siamsport.description: Thai sports news portal on a white canvas with hot pink #fa1e5a primary, black #000000 headlines, Kanit 400/500 display type with Sarabun 14px body, Bootstrap-based layout, 8px cards with a 16px-blur shadow, 12px pink pill-ish tags and a #282828 footer.

sidewave.name: Sidewave
sidewave.description: Sidewave (sidewave.it), an Italian digital studio site: near-black #111111 canvas, white #ffffff text, Fraktion Mono 12.8px uppercase labels, Fraktion Sans body, Bigger Display 900 headlines, inverted white-on-black link chips and a single 5px radius over full-bleed violet WebGL/video imagery.

siemens-energy.name: Siemens Energy
siemens-energy.description: Siemens Energy global home page: dark purple #1b1534 ink and navigation, electric purple #8a00e5 pill buttons (30px radius, white 16px bold text), Siemens Sans 700 at 60px/70px headlines and 24px/32px body, a #410d71 deep-purple band and a white canvas.

siemens-healthineers.name: Siemens Healthineers
siemens-healthineers.description: Siemens Healthineers corporate home: a black #000000 editorial canvas with #e6e6e6 text, a white header, white pill buttons (100px radius, #1a1a1a 18px/600 text, 1px #4d4d4d border), SH Headline bold 30px headlines, Siemens Sans body and an orange #ec6602 hover accent.

siemens-ix.name: Siemens
siemens-ix.description: Siemens' corporate site (siemens.com) pairs the proprietary SiemensSans face with deep-blue ink #000028, sand surfaces #f3f3f0, a turquoise #00cccc primary button with black text that turns #00ffb9 on hover, square 0px corners at 56px height, and full-bleed industrial photography.

siena-film-foundation.name: Siena Film Foundation
siena-film-foundation.description: Siena Film Foundation (siena.film), a boutique film production house: pure black #000000 canvas, warm off-white #faf7ef ink, a #ffc700 gold accent, Neue Brucke uppercase titles at 48px with -1.44px tracking, NB International and P22 Parrish micro-labels, a 14px card radius and an ENTER splash gate.

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: Signal's site pairs a white canvas with a periwinkle #9dbbf8 hero, Signal blue #2c6bed text on white 8px-radius buttons, Inter ExtraBold 60px/800 headlines over Inter 20px/28px body text, 16px-radius white feature cards with soft shadows, pastel illustration panels and a #3c3744 footer.

sileent.name: Sileent
sileent.description: Sileent, an AI content studio site (title: Sileent | AI content studio): pure black #000000 canvas with white #ffffff text, PPNeueMontrealTT 500 at 37.5px for titles, GTAmericaMono 500 numbered micro-labels, no borders, no shadows and no rounded corners over full-bleed grayscale film.

silent-house.name: Silent House
silent-house.description: Silent House (silent-house.com), a live-experience studio group site: white #ffffff canvas, black #000000 ink, #999999 gray secondary text, aktiv_grotesk at weights 400/450/500 with strong negative tracking (54px headline at -2.16px, 160px section titles at -6.4px) and small 4.5px radii.

silkspan.name: Silkspan
silkspan.description: Thai insurance comparison and financial products site (SILKSPAN Financial Supercenter): blue #0050a0 and #00478e, white and #f9fafc canvas, #222222 text in system-ui with Kanit Medium accents, 6px radii, soft blue-tinted card shadow.

silpakorn.name: Silpakorn University
silpakorn.description: Silpakorn University (su.ac.th/en), Thailand's creative university: deep green #003f39 canvas and footer, SU green #008174 buttons, #f5f5f7 page tint, manop-variable body at weight 680 and the custom SILPAKORN70yr display face, with asymmetric 20px corner radii and 130 circular elements.

silver-pinewood-residences.name: Silver Pinewood Residences
silver-pinewood-residences.description: Silver Pinewood Residences (silver-pinewood.com), a premium residential complex site: warm beige #f0eae2 canvas, charcoal #282828 sections and ink, #ba8f71 and #998170 beige accents, TTFors 500 set entirely in uppercase with tight negative tracking (44px headline at -1.76px, 76px at -4.56px).

simonholm-studio.name: Simon Holm Larsen - Brand Designer (simonholm.studio)
simonholm-studio.description: Portfolio of brand designer Simon Holm Larsen: near-black #1a1a1a canvas, white #ffffff type, #a3a3a3 gray labels, a PP Neue Montreal style grotesk (Ppneuemontrealtt) at 128.592px for project titles with -4.167px tracking and 10.716px micro-labels, full-bleed project imagery.

simple.name: Simple
simple.description: Straightforward, no-frills design with clean typography, neutral colors, and intuitive layouts that stay out of the way.

simple-analytics.name: Simple Analytics
simple-analytics.description: Simple Analytics' site: a #fcfcfc canvas with teal-grey inks (#2a373a headings, #425659 body), Space Grotesk at 36px/700 for headlines and 16px/24px for copy, coral-red #ff4f64 pill CTAs with a tinted glow that darken to #de3243, 16–24px-radius white cards with #d0e1e3 borders, and hand-drawn line charts as section dividers.

sing-sian-yer-pao-daily-news.name: Sing Sian Yer Pao Daily News (星暹日报)
sing-sian-yer-pao-daily-news.description: Chinese-language Thai newspaper portal (singsiandailynews.com): white canvas #ffffff, text #333333 and #666666 in Microsoft YaHei at 16px, a newspaper red #cd131c for section accents and rules, 5px and 10px radii, and a dense headline-list layout with a 10px-radius search input.

singapore-airlines.name: Singapore Airlines
singapore-airlines.description: Singapore Airlines' web system as measured on singaporeair.com — a deep navy primary "#00266b" (header gradient, SEARCH button, section headings) over a pale "#fafafa" canvas, gold "#f99f1c" hover accents in the header, and electric blue "#0254ec" links. Headlines are set in Arthur Baker's Sigvar Serial (served as sigvar / sigvar_serial-regular) at 26–32px, UI and body text in Mark Simonson's proxima-nova at 11–18px. Buttons are near-square (2px radius), 11px/600 uppercase with 1.5px tracking; destination cards are 4px-radius photo tiles with a soft 2px 4px 4px shadow that blooms on hover.

singapore-gov.name: Singapore Government (gov.sg)
singapore-gov.description: The gov.sg portal pairs a single typeface, Inter at weights 400 to 600 with tight negative tracking on display sizes, with a flat Singapore red (#c30000) for its hero band and filled "Find out more" buttons, white and #f3f4f6 content bands, and a near-black #18181b footer. Buttons have 4px corners, cards 8px, and the page is photographic and editorial rather than form-driven.

singer-thailand.name: Singer Thailand
singer-thailand.description: Thai appliance and phone e-commerce storefront set entirely in PSL Kanda: white #ffffff canvas, crimson #e50040 header strip and footer, #dd191d red nav tab with #ffeb3b yellow text, #282828 body ink, square 0px buttons, #e5e5e5 hairlines.

singha-estate.name: Singha Estate
singha-estate.description: Singha Estate (สิงห์ เอสเตท) corporate real-estate site: deep navy canvas #0f1f2e with a #153050 footer, white text, antique gold #be9a62 accent, the proprietary SinghaEstate typeface at 16px body and 30px uppercase headings with 0.5px tracking, and tiny 3px and 5px radii.

singtel.name: Singtel
singtel.description: Singtel's consumer telecom storefront for Singapore: white canvas (#ffffff) with ink #231f20, a single red action color #ed1a3d on pill-ish 20px buttons, Lato Regular/Bold set at 16px body and 48px section headings, pastel service tiles and a black device-showcase band.

sipgate.name: sipgate
sipgate.description: sipgate.de, the German cloud-telephony and AI-agent platform: PX Grotesk bold at 80px mixed with Tiempos Light serif in headlines, near-black #121212 pill buttons that flip to electric lime #deff00 on hover, white and #f8f8f8 canvas, soft cornflower #edf2ff and mint #ebf5eb section tints, and 24px-radius cards.

siripinyo-reit.name: SIRIPINYO BUILDING
siripinyo-reit.description: Leasing site for the 17-storey Siripinyo office building near BTS Phaya Thai, set in Sofia Sans Condensed (62px display, 22px light body) on a deep blue #144b83 canvas with brighter #0055ac header, white ink, 20px-radius buttons and 10-30px rounded blocks.

six-senses.name: Six Senses
six-senses.description: Six Senses (sixsenses.com): a calm wellness-resort site in plum and parchment. Canto Roman 400 serif headlines at 50.4px with negative tracking, Avenir Next 14px/22.4px grey #666666 body, Avenir Next Condensed 500 uppercase labels, a #4d1443 plum 46px-radius Search pill, white pages and #f8f8f2 bands.

sizzler-thailand.name: Sizzler Thailand
sizzler-thailand.description: Sizzler Thailand (ซิซซ์เล่อร์), the Minor Food Group steakhouse site: deep forest-green canvas #124f31 with #05351d and #064d2c bands, cream #feeed6 nav text, signal red #ec1425, the db_ozone Thai/Latin face at 16px body and 64.6px section titles, and a food-photo-led promo layout.

sk-telecom.name: SK Telecom
sk-telecom.description: SK Telecom (SK텔레콤) corporate home: white canvas #ffffff with a #f6fafd tint, ink #1a2232, indigo #3a46cd accent, SKT Sans Text/Display with a 110px weight-800 display, 16px rounded tiles and a 100px pill outline button for the newsroom link.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.description: Sketch's home page pairs Reckless serif headlines (76px/500, -1.5px tracking) with InterVariable body copy (20px/500 in #5c5c5c) on a light grey #f5f5f5 and white canvas, near-black #151515 pill-like buttons with 24px radius and a carved inset shadow, 20px-radius feature cards in white and black, and soft pink-lilac gradient washes.

skeumorphism.name: Skeumorphism
skeumorphism.description: Real-world mimicry with textured surfaces, 3D effects, and familiar physical metaphors for intuitive digital interfaces.

skillshare.name: Skillshare
skillshare.description: Skillshare's creative-learning marketing system, set entirely in Grilli Type's proprietary GT Walsheim Pro (served as "GT Walsheim Pro") at 700 for headlines and 400 for body text. Black (#000000) text on a white (#ffffff) hero and card surface, set between full-bleed black (#000000) canvas bands with white (#ffffff) body ink that cover most of the page. The only filled action is a mint-green #55da9b button with a 4px radius and black label (hover #50cf93). Accents are a #5620c1 violet text link, a #24c2f2 cyan active tab pill (100px radius) and #dcdee1 hairlines. Class cards use an 8px radius with a soft 0 2px 4px shadow, and the browse header and footer sit on near-black #0b1215.

skooldio.name: Skooldio
skooldio.description: Skooldio (สคูลดิโอ) Thai upskilling platform: black hero and white course sections, signal amber #faa91a with white labels on 100px pill buttons, Rubik with IBM Plex Sans Thai at 16px body and a 60px weight-500 hero, 16px-radius gradient course cards and soft navy-tinted shadows.

slack.name: Slack
slack.description: Slack's homepage pairs a white canvas and black Salesforce-Avant-Garde headlines (64px, weight 700) with a deep aubergine #481a54 band and a #730394 purple CTA: square 4px-radius, uppercase 14px/700 buttons that darken to #481a54 on hover, plus 16px-rounded product windows lifted by a soft 32px black-10% shadow.

sleek.name: Sleek
sleek.description: Modern minimalist aesthetic with clean lines, intentional color palette, subtle interactions, and consistent spacing.

slush.name: Slush
slush.description: Slush (slush.app), the Sui crypto wallet: white and sky-blue #dceeff rounded containers on a black frame, black Aeonik Pro text at 56.9px display and 21.3px body with negative tracking, Lateral weight-800 poster headlines, flat sticker colors (#ffd731, #55db9c, #5c4ade, #fb4903) and 1px black outlined pill buttons.

smallroom.name: Smallroom
smallroom.description: Smallroom (สมอลล์รูม), the Bangkok pop-music label site: light grey canvas #f2f3f4, ink #212529 and black, Helvethaica Thai-Latin type at 24px light body with 40px and 64px weight-900 uppercase titles, 24px-radius image tiles with soft 8px 16px shadows and a hand-drawn dog mascot logo.

smarthr.name: SmartHR
smarthr.description: SmartHR corporate site (smarthr.co.jp): white pages with near-black ink #1d1c1b and SmartHR Green #00c4cc, a giant Heebo weight-100 wordmark line at 113px, YakuHanJP/Noto Sans JP text with wide tracking, black arrow buttons, 1px black rules and ribbon-like turquoise imagery.

smeg.name: Smeg
smeg.description: Smeg international home page (smeg.com), measured — near-black #020202 page with white #ffffff text and a white product section, Raleway 26.4px/400 headlines with 0.32px tracking, Mulish 10px/300 body, 8px/700 uppercase tracked text links with a rule, warm gold #baa483 accent text, 10px radius only.

smooothy.name: Smooothy
smooothy.description: Smooothy (smooothy.federic.ooo), the open-source smooth slider library page: pure black canvas #000000 with white #ffffff text in Geist at 41.6px headings with -3.328px tracking and 14px semibold links, no rounded corners at all, no color accents, and hand-drawn white line icons beside large bubble lettering and 3D food slides.

snap.name: Snap Inc.
snap.description: Snap Inc.'s corporate home (snap.com) is a near-monochrome editorial page: white (#ffffff) canvas, black (#000000) Inter 44px/400 mission statement, #757575 uppercase nav, three product tiles and a 25px-radius black-outlined language pill; Snap Yellow #fffc00 lives in the shipped CSS and in product imagery.

snickers.name: Snickers
snickers.description: SNICKERS official site: white canvas #ffffff alternating with chocolate-brown #3c1400 bands, indigo #21008c pill buttons (30px radius, 61px high), campaign display type at 64px with 0.7px tracking, Drupal-hosted primary, secondary and headline typefaces, and product-photography-led sections.

snowflake.name: Snowflake
snowflake.description: Snowflake AI Data Cloud site: white canvas with pale blue and #f6f9fa surfaces, Snowflake blue #249edc pill buttons (45px radius, white uppercase Texta labels), Texta weight-900 uppercase display up to 120px, Lato 16px body, a #042130 navy footer and layered cool-grey shadows.

softbank.name: SoftBank
softbank.description: SoftBank Corp. global English home (softbank.jp/en): white canvas with #ecf0f4 news band, text #424242 in Helvetica at 16px, bright blue #357eec pill button (50px radius, 60px high) and a #3b87fb service nav band, 30px-radius tilted card carousel and photo news tiles.

sohub.name: SOHub
sohub.description: SOHub is a digital agency site that sets Inter at 56px/600 with tight negative tracking on a cool off-white canvas (#f0f6f8), with near-black ink (#0c1016), pill-shaped uppercase buttons (9999px radius, 58px tall), 24px rounded project cards and a Tailwind plus HeroUI CSS stack.

soil.name: SOIL
soil.description: SOIL is a Japanese performing-arts showcase site in black (#1c1d1e) on white (#ffffff): giant SeasonMix serif display caps at 48px/600 with -1.92px tracking, Akzidenz-Grotesk Next body at 17.7664px, thick dashed and solid rule lines, square 2 to 4px corners and no buttons.

solartron.name: Solartron
solartron.description: Solartron (บริษัท โซลาร์ตรอน จำกัด (มหาชน)) language-gate landing page at solartron.co.th, measured as a full-bleed rooftop solar photograph with a light-weight Trirong serif headline (24px, weight 300) in #eeeeee, outlined 3px-radius enter buttons, and a #333333 footer.

solidjs.name: SolidJS
solidjs.description: SolidJS (solidjs.com) pairs a white #ffffff canvas with a blue gradient hero built from the repo's own solid palette — light #4f88c6, medium #446b9e, default #2c4f7c, dark #07254A — set in Gordita (36px/600 hero headline, 16px/28px body), with 8px-radius 48px-tall blue buttons that hover to #414042 and 24px-radius light-grey #f3f5f7 panels.

solk.name: SOLK
solk.description: SOLK is a Swiss biocircular footwear shop that stays almost colorless: white canvas (#ffffff), black ink (#000000), SuisseIntl Regular at 14 to 20px with SuisseWorks serif accents, square 0px corners, 1px black outlined buttons and large editorial photography of shoes and people.

som.name: SŌM
som.description: SOM (SŌM) is a Belgian functional-elixir brand whose site sets ABC Diatype and ABC Diatype Mono on white (#ffffff) and near-black (#0e0f11), with an orange-red accent (#ff3a1f), 4px-radius uppercase mono buttons, frosted translucent cards over blurred dark photography and a 14px mono UI scale.

somboon-advance-technology.name: Somboon Advance Technology (SAT)
somboon-advance-technology.description: Somboon Advance Technology (SAT) is a Thai automotive and agricultural parts maker listed on the stock exchange; its measured home page is a corporate site in Roboto Condensed with a navy primary (#102241), white canvas (#ffffff), uppercase 14px square buttons with a hard 5px offset shadow and a stock ticker in the header.

somefolk-r.name: Somefolk®
somefolk-r.description: Somefolk® (SF.CO) is a London design-and-Webflow portfolio: Helvetica Now Display and Swizzy Mono in uppercase on a cinematic black-navy 3D hero, a huge "SF'26" wordmark, a cream (#f6f6eb) closing section with charcoal (#343434) text, 1.42px corners and tiny 9.96px mono labels.

son-daven.name: Son Daven
son-daven.description: Son Daven is a Ukrainian investment hotel project whose site uses a sand canvas (#a89474) with dark brown ink (#2c2824), KTF Metro Roman serif display in uppercase with -0.064em tracking, tiny 8.89px KTF Metro Blueline uppercase labels, square buttons and circular outlined call-outs over architectural renders.

sonos.name: Sonos
sonos.description: Sonos sets everything in aktiv-grotesk (Aktiv Grotesk) at 400 and 500 on a white #ffffff canvas with black #000000 ink, cinematic full-bleed lifestyle video, charcoal #2e2e2e promo bands and footer, light #f4f4f4 product panels, and 80px-radius pill buttons — filled black "Add to cart", black-outlined white "Shop new arrivals", light #f4f4f4 "Subscribe".

sony.name: Sony
sony.description: Sony Electronics' US store (electronics.sony.com): a white #ffffff canvas framed by a pure #000000 header and footer, set in Sony's proprietary SST typeface by Monotype (served as SST, SST-Roman, SST-Heavy, SSTPro-Roman, SSTPro-Medium, SSTPro-Bold), SST-Heavy 40.0588px/43.0327px section headlines, #2f353d body copy, square 0px buttons — #2d75c7 outlined 'Shop now' CTAs and an amber #b65e0c 'Add to Cart' — a #2d74c7 promo strip, 4px inputs, 5px product tiles and 30px soft-shadow benefit cards.

sothebys-realty.name: Sotheby's International Realty
sothebys-realty.description: Sotheby's International Realty's website is a luxury-property system in deep navy #002349 with a gold #c29b40 hairline accent, white pages, and a three-serif type stack: FreightBigBook for the 46px hero headline, MercuryDisplay-Roman for 28px section titles, and BentonSans-Book at 16px for body, with small 4px-radius outlined buttons.

soulcycle.name: SoulCycle
soulcycle.description: SoulCycle's site pairs Helvetica Neue LT Std (Roman, Medium, Bold files) with SoulCycle yellow (#ffde00) on black (#000000) and white (#ffffff), 54px/64px display with -1px tracking, 14px bold buttons with square or 5px corners, and dark #111111 article cards under yellow tracked eyebrow labels.

soundcloud.name: SoundCloud
soundcloud.description: SoundCloud (soundcloud.com): a near-black #121212 canvas with #ffffff text and #999999 secondary text, set entirely in Klim's Söhne. The landing page shouts in 65px/800 uppercase Söhne headlines and uses white #ffffff pill CTAs (9999px, 46px tall) with #121212 labels; the app uses 4px-radius 32px buttons on #303030. SoundCloud Orange #ff5500 is the brand accent; links are #699fff on dark, focus rings 2px #044dd2.

south-china-morning-post.name: South China Morning Post
south-china-morning-post.description: South China Morning Post's home page is a dense news front built on Source Serif 4 600 headlines at 23px/27.6px with -0.575px tracking, Roboto and Roboto Condensed UI text, a navy action color (#2c4692) on white (#ffffff), hairline #dfdfdf rules and 2px-radius uppercase buttons.

southwest-airlines.name: Southwest Airlines
southwest-airlines.description: Southwest Airlines' booking site uses Southwest Sans in bold 35.2px/52.8px headlines, a Southwest blue (#304cb2) and deep navy (#111b40), the signature yellow (#ffbf27) for every primary button, 2px-radius controls, light grey (#f4f4f4) page ground with white cards and a soft 0 5px 5px shadow.

sowieso-wero.name: Sowieso Wero
sowieso-wero.description: Sowieso Wero is the merchant-facing Wero landing page for the iDEAL-to-Wero transition: GT Walsheim Wero at 139.935px/800 on a butter-yellow canvas (#fff48d), near-black ink (#1d1c1c), white pill buttons with hard 0 6px 0 offset shadows, 1px ink outlines, tilted cards and pink-orange-purple gradients.

spacex.name: SpaceX
spacex.description: SpaceX's homepage is a pure #000000 stage for full-bleed photography, with uppercase D-DIN-Bold headlines at 60px/54px (-1px tracking), 16px D-DIN body in #f0f0fa, and ghost buttons: 50px tall, 4px radius, a 50% black fill and a 1px #f0f0fa59 outline that fills solid #f0f0fa on hover.

spacious.name: Spacious
spacious.description: Generous whitespace, consistent padding, and grid-based layouts for clean, readable, and breathing interfaces.

sparebank1.name: SpareBank 1
sparebank1.description: SpareBank 1 is a Norwegian banking alliance whose site pairs a white canvas and near-black ink (#020a0a) with deep navy "fjell" (#002776), water blue (#005aa4) and a forest-green pill CTA (#00754e), set in the proprietary SpareBank1-regular, SpareBank1-medium and SpareBank1-title-medium typefaces with Arial fallbacks. Buttons are fully rounded pills, cards carry a 16px radius, and flat editorial illustration sits beside warm documentary photography.

spcg.name: SPCG
spcg.description: Investor and corporate site of SPCG Public Company Limited, a Thai solar-power developer, set in Gotham (Book, Medium, Bold) with Prompt fallbacks, 38px uppercase display headings, navy #222d68 and red-orange #ff4c15 accents on white, 10px-radius photo cards and light grey #ebebeb bands.

specialized.name: Specialized
specialized.description: Specialized's retail site uses DINPro bold 48px/60px headlines with -1px tracking on white (#ffffff) and charcoal ink (#252525), grey-white (#f8f8f8) 4px-radius buttons, 8px to 10px rounded product and campaign cards, a metal grey ramp and black footer with Specialized red (#da291c) in the stylesheet.

spectrum-design.name: Adobe Spectrum
spectrum-design.description: Adobe's Spectrum design-system site is a calm #f7f7f7 canvas with white cards, Adobe Clean type (64px/500 display, 16px/400 body in #717171), near-black #131313 pill buttons (48px at 24px radius, 32px at 16px radius) and a single blue, #3b63fb with hover #274dea, reserved for announcements.

splice.name: Splice
splice.description: Splice (splice.com): a near-black #121214 UI over full-bleed video and #000000 sections, with Söhne Breit (served as SoehneBreit, 400) for wide display headlines — 48px/60px hero, 36px section titles — and InterVariable for UI (16px/24px body). Primary actions are cobalt #1253ff pills (64px radius, 13.504px 32px, hover #0033ff); nav links are #a6a8ad turning white; links #528fff; accents come from a five-color tile palette (#f4d04e, #7cf727, #ff8aa6, #62daff, #b874ff).

spline.name: Spline
spline.description: Spline's home page is a pure-black #000000 product page set in Geist: 64px/450 headlines with tight -3.84px tracking in 90% white, #8a8a8a body copy at 18px/28px, light #eeeeee pill buttons with black labels that brighten to #ffffff on hover, ghost pills with #2e2e2e borders, translucent filter chips and #101010 cards with 16px corners framing the 3D editor.

splunk.name: Splunk
splunk.description: Splunk's homepage is a near-black stage (#000000 canvas, #ffffff text) in Inter 400-800, with an orange-to-magenta gradient on key headings, a magenta primary (#ce0070) on 24px-radius pill buttons 44px high, a white pill nav bar, and translucent white-10% cards with 24px corners over dark video and product imagery.

spotify.name: Spotify
spotify.description: The Spotify web player home view is a dark, panelled app: #000000 frame, #121212 panels with 8px corners, white and #b3b3b3 text in SpotifyMixUI/SpotifyMixUITitle (24px bold section titles, 16px body), white pill buttons, and a Spotify Green (#1ed760) bright accent, with circular artist art and 6px-rounded album covers.

spring-news.name: Spring News
spring-news.description: Spring News (springnews.co.th), the Thai digital-news site of Nation Group: Prompt typeface at 14-32px with 0.2px tracking, a full-bleed #ffff00 yellow header and footer on a #ffffff canvas, near-black #000000f2 text, square corners and no button fills.

springs.name: Springs
springs.description: Springs (springs.estate), a premium residential development site: Victor Serif display at 100px/120px with -2px tracking, TT Commons Pro 20px body and 10px uppercase nav, deep green #162d24 canvas, beige #e0d1b6 ink and a #f5e8d1 cream page body.

sproutsocial.name: Sprout Social
sproutsocial.description: Sprout Social's marketing site pairs a near-black #040404 canvas with white rounded content panels, Proxima Nova at 800 weight for 57px headlines, a Fern green #98e58e call to action with a Cactus #59cb59 hover, 6px button radii and 16px card radii, all built on the Seeds design system.

square.name: Square
square.description: Square (squareup.com/us/en), the payments and point-of-sale platform from Block, Inc.: Exact Block serif display at 81px with -2.916px tracking, Cash Sans 14px body, Square Sans Text 16px navigation, #006aff blue actions, black footer and #f7f6f5 product tiles.

square-enix.name: Square Enix
square-enix.description: Square Enix games portal (square-enix-games.com/en_EU/home): light grey #f0f0f0 page of three-column article cards, generic sans-serif at 16px body and 28px/700 headlines, white READ MORE buttons with #c80000 red bold uppercase text, near-black header and square corners.

squarespace.name: Squarespace
squarespace.description: Squarespace's home page is a near-monochrome, photography-led page on black #000000 with white sections: Clarkson sans throughout (60px/300 display at -3.6px tracking, 15px/21px body), Clarkson Serif for 26px card titles, square-ish white 'GET STARTED →' buttons with 4px radius and uppercase 14px/500 labels that hover to #dddddd, and #2f2f2f product cards with 8px corners.

squarespace-foundations.name: Squarespace Foundations
squarespace-foundations.description: Squarespace Foundations (brand.squarespace.com), the brand-guidelines microsite for Squarespace: Clarkson at 71.11px with -2.84px tracking and 21.33px body, a #111111 dark theme with white text, a white logo slide, no radii, no shadows and no buttons.

squid-brand.name: Squid Brand
squid-brand.description: Squid Brand (น้ำปลาตราปลาหมึก), Thai fish sauce: full-bleed food photography heroes, flat leaf-green #76bc21 square buttons, deep indigo #313283 headlines, a light #f5f5f5 values panel, the Line typeface and a #242729 footer.

sri-panwa.name: Sri Panwa
sri-panwa.description: Sri Panwa Phuket (sripanwa.com), a luxury pool-villa hotel and private-residence site: CoreRhino 13px body with 15.6px and 26px uppercase orange #ed591b headings, Gotham Medium 12px navigation, a #1c1c1c header, black panels over full-bleed photography and square corners.

srt-electrified-train-airport-rail-link.name: SRT Electrified Train Co., Ltd. (SRTET)
srt-electrified-train-airport-rail-link.description: SRTET (srtet.co.th), operator site for the SRT Red Line commuter trains and the Airport Rail Link: psl_kittithada Thai type at 21.6px body and 36px/700 titles, a #bc1320 red nav bar and accents on a white canvas, a station-line route map, #333333 ink and mostly square corners.

ssense.name: SSENSE
ssense.description: SSENSE (ssense.com/en-us), the luxury-fashion retailer's editorial-led home page: Favorit SSENSE Inter uppercase headlines at 49.875px with -2px tracking, JHA Times Now serif body at 20px light, #333333 ink on white, 10px outlined pill buttons with a #979797 hairline and 11px uppercase navigation.

sstr-friction-reduction.name: SSTR Friction Reduction Systems
sstr-friction-reduction.description: SSTR (sstr.tech/en), a drilling-engineering company's site: ABC Monument Grotesk uppercase headlines at 42.67px with -1.49px tracking, a #18191b and #eff0f1 dark/light section rhythm, a single #e75326 orange with #0c0c0c text on 55px-tall angular buttons and a three-tier brand/alias/mapped CSS token system.

stability-ai.name: Stability AI
stability-ai.description: Stability AI (stability.ai), the generative-media company's marketing site: Archivo 18px body and 61px/700 hero headline with -0.61px tracking, Figtree 600 buttons, a #1e1e1e charcoal canvas, #a381ff violet pill buttons with 300px radius and 1px bordered 8px-radius content cards.

stackblitz.name: StackBlitz
stackblitz.description: StackBlitz's home page is dark slate #1c1f25 with Manrope 600 headlines (94px/94px, -2px), Inter 16px/32px body in white at 80% (#ffffffcc), a #1574ef 'Try Bolt.new' button with 10px radius and inset white ring, cyan #4cedff highlights, and a pale #fbfeff testimonial band with a 6px-radius white card.

standard-chartered-thailand.name: Standard Chartered Thailand
standard-chartered-thailand.description: Standard Chartered Bank (Thai) country site on sc.com/th: SC Prosper Sans in Regular, Medium and Bold at 16px body and 56px display with 1px letter-spacing, brand blue #0473ea, indigo #020b43 toolbar and footer, green #38d200 accent, pill buttons with a 25px radius and 50px height.

stanford-university.name: Stanford University
stanford-university.description: Stanford University (stanford.edu), the university home page: Cardinal Red #8c1515 header on a white canvas, edict serif display at 64px/440 and Source Sans 3 body at 20px/28px, #111111 ink, red pill buttons, 12px-radius dark stat cards and 12px-rounded photographs.

starbucks.name: Starbucks
starbucks.description: Starbucks' homepage alternates full-width #006242 green promo bands with warm food and drink photography on a white canvas, set in SoDoSans (24px/600 headlines, 16px body) with fully rounded 50px pill buttons: a black 33px 'Join now', an outlined 'Sign in', and white-outlined pills on green that brighten to #00754a on hover.

starbucks-reserve.name: Starbucks Reserve
starbucks-reserve.description: Starbucks Reserve's site starbucksreserve.com measured live — a white #ffffff gallery page with black #000000 type, a single copper-gold accent #976d3f for hovers and highlights, a warm near-black #231f20 footer, widely tracked uppercase Trade Gothic Bold Condensed headlines (102.4px hero, +12.5px tracking) over Avenir LT Std body copy at 14px with a 33.6px line height, and square photo collages.

starling.name: Starling Bank
starling.description: Starling's 2025 "Good with money" web system — aubergine #321e37 ink and footer, electric-teal #50ffeb buttons with 4px corners (hover #29e6d1, active #24d2be), a warm #f8f5f0 page canvas with white 24px-radius cards, Avantt (variable, weights 450/550/600, negative tracking, 48px/54px hero) for text and CoFo Sans Semi-Mono 550 for every button, label and nav item.

starmark.name: STARMARK
starmark.description: STARMARK is a Thai kitchen and wardrobe furniture manufacturer whose Wix-built site is a quiet white gallery. It uses a #ffffff canvas, mid-grey #606060 body ink, near-black #242323 accents, a #282828 hairline, square corners with no rounding, and a mix of Avenir LT Light 14px body, DIN Neuzeit Grotesk 22px and a Thai display face at 35px.

stars-microelectronics.name: Stars Microelectronics
stars-microelectronics.description: Stars Microelectronics (Thailand) PCL (starsmicro.com), an EMS, OSAT and photonics manufacturer: Gotham at 80px/500 for the hero and 20px/32px body, #00896b green from the site's own --primary-color, a blue-to-green gradient banner, white and #1e1e1e text, small 4-10px radii and a slanted white logo tab.

steam.name: Steam
steam.description: Valve's Steam store (store.steampowered.com): a dark slate UI — #0f1924 homepage body, #1b2838 product pages, #171d25 global header — set in Motiva Sans with #c6d4df soft text and #66c0f4/#67c1f5 links. Actions are Steam blue #1a9fff (current nav item, search submit) and the green Add to Cart gradient (#75b022 to #588a1b, 2px radius, 15px/30px label); discounts are lime #a1cd44 or #4c6b22/#beee11 blocks. Corners are tiny (1–4px), density is high, 12px is the dominant text size.

stefan-vitasovic-portfolio25.name: Stefan Vitasović | Creative Developer
stefan-vitasovic-portfolio25.description: Single-screen portfolio of a creative developer in Stockholm: warm paper canvas #f1efeb, charcoal ink #252526, one blue accent #066bbd, set entirely in HelveticaNowDisplay Medium and Bold with an 80px lowercase display, zero border radius and no shadows.

steven-com.name: Steven.com
steven-com.description: Dark single-screen site for Steven.com, the creator-economy company: #121212 canvas, white #ffffff type and #a0a0a0 secondary text, Field Gothic Trimmed uppercase 48px headline with Host Grotesk 13.2px labels, 16px and pill radii, centered rotating ecosystem dial.

stitches.name: Stitches
stitches.description: Marketing site of Stitches, the CSS-in-JS library, now marked as no longer maintained. White canvas (#ffffff), near-black ink (#11181c), a pale lavender pill button (#ede9fe with #5746af text), tight negative tracking on a 59px Untitled Sans headline, dark code panels (#1a1523) and 8px radii.

storybook.name: Storybook
storybook.description: Storybook's storybook.js.org site: deep navy #0d1026 canvas under a pink-orange-blue aurora hero, white #ffffff Nunito Sans text (56px/700 headlines), white pill CTAs with black labels, ocean-blue #029cfd links, and the Storybook design-system palette led by coral #ff4785 and ocean #029cfd; inputs and chips use 4–6px radii.

storytelling.name: Storytelling
storytelling.description: Narrative-driven design using visuals, copy, and interaction to guide users through engaging, emotionally resonant journeys.

strapi.name: Strapi
strapi.description: Strapi's marketing site and Design System — a dark #030712 hero over white sections, Poppins throughout (43px semibold display, 15px body), indigo-violet #4945ff action buttons with 8px radius on the site and 4px radius, 36px tall buttons in the system-font Design System, deep-indigo ink #292875 and a lavender #f6f6ff surface.

strava.name: Strava
strava.description: Strava's web design language as measured on strava.com — a white canvas with a sand footer (#f9f8f5), a single signal orange (#fc5200) for every primary action, warm near-black inks (#43423f body, #21211f UI, #000000 headings), the in-house-served Boathouse sans (400/600) for UI and BoathouseExtended 600 for big marketing display (72px/60px/48px), 4px-radius rectangular buttons and a 56px pill CTA on mobile.

stringtune.name: StringTune
stringtune.description: Marketing site for StringTune, Fiddle.Digital's CSS-first, JS-light scroll-animation library: #101214 near-black canvas, #e6dfe4 warm grey display text, #ff4f36 red accent, KHTeka and KHTekaMono type, 84.17px display, glass pill buttons with 20px radius.

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.description: Stripe's marketing homepage: a white canvas, deep navy ink (#061b31) with slate body text (#50617a), an indigo primary (#533afd) on 4px-radius buttons, and the variable font sohne-var set at light weight 300 with negative tracking, over soft pastel gradient product cards.

studio-alphonse.name: Studio Alphonse
studio-alphonse.description: French production studio site: #e5e2d6 warm canvas, #292f33 blue-black ink, #c29230 dark yellow, #4f52be purple and #ba4f5e red accents, set in Transducer Vf variable (400 to 900) with a 44.8px uppercase hero and 6px card radius.

studio-dado.name: Studio DADO
studio-dado.description: Hospitality interior design studio site in Coral Gables: #ffffff canvas, #000000 ink, #5d5346 warm brown footer, uppercase high-contrast serif display at 138.24px with -2.7648px tracking and a 17.0667px sans text face, every corner 0px radius, WordPress-built.

studio-freight.name: Studio Freight
studio-freight.description: Studio Freight's home page is a single warm off-white #fefdfc screen scattered with project thumbnails around a centred 'Moving Missions Forward' in Jannon (jjannon-regular) at 40.5px, with all chrome in Publico Text Mono at 14px/15.68px (+0.14px) rendered black through mix-blend-mode: difference, a 12px layout margin, 8px column gap, square 0px corners and a declared #00ff6a green and #457db6 blue.

studio-k95-3.name: Studio K95
studio-k95-3.description: Italian graphic and brand studio from Catania: full-viewport interactive 3D gallery on electric blue #1500e1 with white #ffffff type in one variable font "adaptive" at 16px and 14px with 0.5px tracking, a 999px pill switch and no shadows.

studio-namma.name: Studio Namma
studio-namma.description: Creative studio site: #e4e4e4 canvas with #111111 ink, a 208px uppercase Mixtape Extra Condensed 800 hero tracked at -9.6px, Gt Pressura Mono 14.4px labels at 1.95px tracking, 4.8px to 100px radii, Webflow theme variables and a light/dark pair.

studio-nuts-r.name: StudioNuts®
studio-nuts-r.description: Campaign and visual studio site: white #ffffff canvas, #101010 ink, pink #c31d9f logo accent, 76.8px uppercase Acumin Pro Extra Condensed headline with -1.92px tracking, OpenSauceOne 11.52px labels, no shadows and imagery-led project strips.

studio-tyrsa.name: Studio Tyrsa
studio-tyrsa.description: Paris creative studio portfolio: white #ffffff canvas, #000000 ink with 30%, 40% and 10% black steps, a single Untitled Sans family at 10.9714px captions and 32.9143px headings tracked tightly, edge-to-edge project tiles and a 999px pill radius for chips.

studio-x.name: Studio X
studio-x.description: Commercial interior design studio (Hong Kong, Singapore, Macao): warm cream #f2f0e6 canvas, #1d1d1d ink, orange #ff4101 pill buttons, light-weight Serrif Compressed display at 67.4423px with Saans 15.8606px text, frosted pill dock with inset glass shadows.

studio375-2.name: Studio375
studio375-2.description: Italian communications and web agency: gradient photographic hero with white text, white #ffffff body, #808080 grey labels, thin hatton serif at weight 200 for statements (64px) with neue sans 20px for navigation, 2px white outlined pill buttons with 29px radius.

styled-components.name: styled-components
styled-components.description: Documentation-first homepage of styled-components, the React CSS-in-JS library. Off-white canvas (#fcfcfc) over a #f5f5f5 panel, ink #14161b, a periwinkle-blue primary (#628eff) on 3px-radius buttons, Figtree 700 display at 40px, Inter body at 16px and Google Sans Code at 14px for code.

stytch.name: Stytch
stytch.description: Stytch's site alternates a warm off-white #fbfaf9 page with near-black #1d1d1d bands, sets headlines in Booton Bold (76.8px hero at -2px, 40px section titles) and buttons in Chivo Mono 13px, uses a pale-blue #b2d6de primary button and #1d1d1d dark buttons at 4px radius, and a lime #e6fd13 highlight for nav hovers and announcements.

subaru.name: Subaru of America
subaru.description: Subaru of America home page measured live: a white and cool-grey (#f7f8f9) retail shell with a near-black blue hero band (#1d252c), one Subaru blue (#1971d4) action color, HelveticaNeueLTW05 Roman, Medium and Bold at 17px body, and 5px corners on buttons and vehicle tiles.

substack.name: Substack
substack.description: Substack's logged-out home feed (substack.com): a white #ffffff reading canvas with #363737 system-ui text at 15px/21px, #777777 meta, Cahuenga 500 serif display lines (32px/39.68px on the green #2f6d5d hero), SF Pro Display 800 titles, Substack orange #ff6719 8px-radius buttons that darken to #d74d00, #eeeeee secondary buttons, 12px-radius cards with 1px #0000001a hairlines and #0083d5 mention links.

sui.name: Sui
sui.description: Sui blockchain home page measured live: a black hero with a blue-and-white radial light-streak image, white and #f4f5f7 content bands, TWK Everett at 80px with -5.85px tracking, TWK Everett Mono labels, square-cornered #298dff buttons, and slate greys #6c7584 and #4b515b.

sunday.name: Sunday Robotics
sunday.description: Sunday Robotics home page (sunday.ai) measured live: a white editorial page with off-black #1a1a1a text, #f7e731 yellow accent, a 120px headline in a custom sans plus a mono face for 14px labels, soft 4 to 24px radii, and full-bleed lifestyle photography of the Memo home robot.

sunday-insurance.name: Sunday Insurance
sunday-insurance.description: Sunday Insurance Thai homepage: warm orange (#fa4616) brand on a #f7f7f7 and white page, charcoal ink (#2a2c2e) with gray running text (#76777a), a custom Thai-capable sans in 60px bold hero headings, 16px-radius cards with #e8e8e6 hairlines, pill controls at 100px radius and a sunset family-photo hero.

sunrun.name: Sunrun
sunrun.description: Sunrun's site: warm cream #fffbf0 / #fffcf5 pages alternating with near-black #070911 and #000000 bands, navy #1f2647 pill buttons (800px radius, hover #49517d) and white pills on photography (hover #d4d5da), the commercial Roobert typeface at 500 for headlines (56px h1, -1.12px) and 400 for body, pale-blue #c3dbff text on dark, 16px and 24px rounded cards.

supabase.name: Supabase
supabase.description: Supabase's homepage: a near-white canvas (#fdfdfd) with white cards, near-black headings (#030303) over grey body copy (#696969), a single deep brand green (#0e7e4e) on 9.29px-radius buttons, Manrope headlines at 46px weight 500 and Inter text at 15px.

supalai.name: Supalai
supalai.description: Supalai (ศุภาลัย) Thai property developer home page measured live: a white page with the Prompt typeface at weights 300 to 500, a gold #c2883e call-to-action, charcoal #333132 and dark-brown #3c2415 panels, #f1f2f2 grey bands, square buttons, 6px and 18px corner radii, and soft 2px shadows.

supercell.name: Supercell
supercell.description: Supercell's corporate site supercell.com/en measured live — a white #ffffff news wall framed by a black #000000 header and footer, accessible blue #0f62d6 buttons (120px pill, 8px rectangle) darkening to #0a4fb0, pink #fb4a9d category tags, and the custom Supercell type family: SupercellHeadline-Heavy uppercase at 56px for the wordmark-style h1, SupercellText at 17–18px for copy.

superhuman.name: Superhuman
superhuman.description: Superhuman's homepage (Go, Mail, Docs): a warm off-white canvas (#f7f5f2) broken by maroon, plum and teal cards, warm near-black ink (#292827), a purple primary (#714cb6, lavender #d4c7ff on dark), the variable font Super Sans VF at weights 460 to 600, and 8px and 12px radii.

superlocal-design-festival-25.name: Superlocal
superlocal-design-festival-25.description: Superlocal design festival site (superlocaldesign.com, Spanish, 2026 edition) measured live: a silver #bcbcbc canvas fading to copper #ff661a, off-black #1a1302 ink, a dotted display face at 72px and 56px, fontSans in 600 and 700 with tight tracking, and white pill buttons with 999px radius.

supersports.name: Supersports
supersports.description: Supersports Thailand online sports retailer (supersports.co.th) measured live: a navy #001a2d header, a lime #55ff06 announcement bar, NotoSansThai in weights 400 to 900, white and #f5f5f5 grounds, square SHOP NOW buttons, sale red #d01345, and 8px 24px asymmetric corners on category and product tiles.

surveymonkey.name: SurveyMonkey
surveymonkey.description: SurveyMonkey's home page sets bold National 2 headlines (92px/700, -1.84px tracking) in forest #0f2e21 on a warm off-white #fefdfb canvas, with slate #333e48 body copy, pill-shaped green #08794a 'Get started free' buttons (hover #089b5e), a mustard #e2bf36 'Sign up free' pill, deep-forest #00301f feature bands and mint #d6f5de cards with 28px corners.

susco.name: SUSCO
susco.description: SUSCO Public Company Limited (susco.co.th), a Thai fuel-station operator on Bootstrap 5: psl_display_pro Thai display type at 77px and 28.8px body, yellow #ffdc00 and blue #0079c2 brand colors, translucent charcoal #3d4049 price-board card with 15px radius.

sutera.name: Sutéra
sutera.description: Sutéra, the portfolio of designer Stella Mühlhaus (sutera.ch), measured live: a white page with pure black text, a 59.136px uppercase NeueHaas headline, PPNeueMontreal at 10.368px for tiny outlined labels, grey #9e9e9e and sky #b5e9ff accents, 1px black outlines, and 10px radius tag pills that invert on hover.

suvarnabhumi-airport.name: Suvarnabhumi Airport
suvarnabhumi-airport.description: Suvarnabhumi Airport official site (suvarnabhumi.airportthai.co.th, Airports of Thailand) measured live: a sky-blue #03a9f4 navigation bar, Kanit at 12px body and 17px semibold headings, white and #f1f1f1 bands, #4b4b4b text, #00aff4 accent, 7px card corners with soft grey 8px shadows, and a circular icon list.

suzuki-motor-thailand.name: Suzuki Motor (Thailand)
suzuki-motor-thailand.description: Suzuki Motor (Thailand) Co., Ltd. home page (suzuki.co.th) measured live: a white and #f5f5f5 Thai-language car catalogue with a #202020 menu bar, Suzuki blue #00368f square buttons, red #de0009 price and underline accents, Sukhumvit Set Medium and SemiBold at 16px with 0.3px tracking, and 30px to 50px rounded details.

sweden-gov.name: Government Offices of Sweden
sweden-gov.description: government.se, the English-language site of the Swedish Government Offices: white canvas, near-black text #0c0c0c, link and button blue #145ea5, a dark navy #00406a header nav and Search button, Open Sans-named Light, Regular and Semibold webfonts at 36px, 18px and 14px, light gray #f0f0f0 side boxes, and 4px radii on buttons.

sweetgreen.name: sweetgreen
sweetgreen.description: sweetgreen's web system is a warm cream canvas (#f4f3e7) with near-black ink (#0e150e), deep forest green (#00473c) and an electric lime (#e6ff55) for pill-shaped calls to action (1000px radius). Type is the custom SweetSans / SweetSansText family by MCKL Type at a single 400 weight, with 80px SweetSans display headlines on 68px leading, uppercase 24px card titles tracked 0.72px, and Grenette (weight 200, -2.25px tracking) for 48px category tabs. Full-bleed food photography, sage (#d8e5d6) and tan (#e8dcc6) section bands, and 20px-rounded product images.

swiss.name: Swiss Post
swiss.description: Swiss Post (post.ch) pairs a signature postal yellow (#ffcc00) with white canvas, black ink and warm grey card surfaces (#f4f3f1), set in the proprietary Swiss Post Sans at light 300 for body and bold 700 for headings. Controls are nearly square (3px and 4px radii) with one circular back-to-top button, and photography of staff and stamps carries the warmth.

swiss-re.name: Swiss Re
swiss-re.description: Swiss Re Group home page (swissre.com) measured live: a white corporate page with slate #3c4150 text in Swiss Re Sans at weight 200 and 22px, a single teal #006e73 accent on outlined capsule buttons, a black and steel-blue lattice hero, and wide soft shadows (0 10px 60px at 20% black) under overlapping white cards.

sxsw.name: SXSW
sxsw.description: SXSW (sxsw.com) is a white #ffffff WordPress site set entirely in Founders Grotesk, Founders Grotesk Text and Founders Grotesk Mono, with black #000000 25px-radius pill CTAs, a #ffc107 SXSW-yellow 'Buy' pill, an orange #f59830 hero gradient, #f4f4f4 8px-radius stat cards and a #0f1012 footer.

symphony-communication.name: Symphony Communication
symphony-communication.description: Symphony Communication PLC home page (symphony.net.th) measured live: a black page with white IBM Plex Sans text, #e63e26 red-orange pill buttons (50px radius, 56px tall), red-to-navy gradient headings, a white #231f20 header, angled red and purple gradient tiles, and a world-map footprint panel.

synthesia.name: Synthesia
synthesia.description: Synthesia, the AI video and avatar platform for business: white #ffffff and #f7f7f7 canvases, near-black navy #090b22 buttons and headlines, indigo #3e57da accents, Basiersquare at 72px/-4.68px display down to 16px/22px body, 10px button radius, 16px glass code cards and a #0d0f2c footer.

t-mobile.name: T-Mobile
t-mobile.description: T-Mobile USA home page design system: TeleNeo 800 headlines (48px/24px), system-ui body, magenta #e20074 actions with #770141 hover, white and #f5f5f5 surfaces, 8px card radius, square 0px primary button, #333333 footer.

tabnine.name: Tricentis
tabnine.description: Tricentis (tricentis.com, where tabnine.com now redirects after Tricentis acquired Tabnine) sets Open Sans 800 headlines (68px/72px, -0.68px) in white on deep navy #001b41 and in charcoal #343941 on white, with an amber #ffb400 'Get a demo' button (6px radius, #343941 bold text), cyan #59c8e6 eyebrows, #004c97 stat cards with 12px radius and an orange #ff6c0e header action.

tailwindcss.name: Tailwind CSS
tailwindcss.description: Tailwind CSS homepage and docs: a white canvas with near-black gray-950 ink (#030712), slate-gray body text (#4a5565), a black 32px-radius pill button, 96px Inter display type at -4.8px tracking, mono code (loaded as plexMono), sky-blue (#74d4ff) code accents and hairline grid decoration.

take-two.name: Take-Two Interactive
take-two.description: Take-Two Interactive corporate home page: Gotham 600 titles at 24px, 700 uppercase 16px buttons, yellow #fcea17 and red #e60012 slide CTAs, #d7d7d7 and white surfaces, 4px button radius, 8px card radius, translucent #ebebebcc nav.

takeda.name: Takeda
takeda.description: Takeda global home page: Gotham at 700 42px display and 400 16px body, brand red #bd120a, white canvas with #edf2f4 story bands, 30px card and photo radius, 9999px pill secondary buttons, square 56px primary button, charcoal #333333 footer.

talend.name: Qlik Talend
talend.description: The Talend homepage now ships as Qlik Talend: a white canvas with Inter (600 headlines at 42px, 18px body), navy #19426c headings, a Qlik green #008936 primary with 30px-radius pill buttons, a floating white header pill with a 40px radius, and isometric green and teal data illustrations.

tana.name: Tana
tana.description: Tana's home page pairs Source Serif 4 at weight 500 with tight tracking (48px/52.8px at -2.16px; 32px section heads) and Inter 15px/22.5px body in #6a6a6a on an off-white #fbfbfb canvas, with a warm near-black #0c0805 'Download for Mac' button (14px radius, 54px tall), pastel gradient product panels and 20px-radius photo cards.

tao-kae-noi.name: Tao Kae Noi
