tao-kae-noi.description: Tao Kae Noi global site: a loud seaweed-snack brand page built on flat red (#ea212c) bands with scalloped white wave dividers, a yellow (#fdc53e) pill CTA, black Montserrat 900 uppercase headings at 48px, and product-pack photography.

tarad.name: Tarad.com
tarad.description: Thai e-commerce service provider (TARAD.com) on Bootstrap 4: blue #0039c4 and #0066b2 bands, orange #f24a0b service buttons, Kanit at 16px and Sukhumvit Set for buttons, 4px radii, white and #eeeeee canvas.

target.name: Target
target.description: Target Corporation retail home page: Helvetica for Target bold 38px display and 16px body, bullseye red #cc0000 pill buttons, white canvas with cream #faf0e6 and #f1e0cb deal bands, 12px card radius, soft four-layer card shadow.

tata-motors-thailand.name: Tata Motors Thailand
tata-motors-thailand.description: Tata Motors Thailand English home page: Calibre Black, Light and Regular type, navy #0a0a5f bands, bright blue #2f7fe2 uppercase square 64px buttons, white canvas, 10px value-tile radius and soft 5px glow shadows.

tate.name: Tate
tate.description: Tate (tate.org.uk): a white #ffffff gallery site set entirely in Tate New Pro ('Tate regular') at weight 400, with widely tracked uppercase headings (58px, 6.38px tracking), grey #767676 body copy, square-cornered #1a1a1a buttons with white labels, an aqua #85dee7 membership accent and #0072ce blue link hovers.

tcdc.name: TCDC (Thailand Creative & Design Center)
tcdc.description: TCDC Thai-language All Program page: Poppins with Kanit and Sarabun, single green #2e8037 accent on white with a black top bar, 28px pill buttons, circular icon controls and a two-column poster card grid with thin green rules.

td-bank.name: TD Canada Trust
td-bank.description: TD Canada Trust personal-banking home page: TD Graphik Medium and SemiLight, TD green #008a00 square 42px buttons with #0d7c16 hover, deep green #1a5336 headings, white canvas with pale green bands, no rounded corners and circular line icons.

tdesign.name: Tencent
tdesign.description: Tencent corporate home page (tencent.com): a white canvas (#ffffff) with black ink (#000000), Tencent blue (#0052d9) used for the logo, active language and links, an 85px italic-style display face "Tencent W7" over a full-bleed hero photograph, Haas Grot Disp Web at 500 and 600 weights for text, 10px-radius news thumbnails and a full-width black "For consumers" band.

teambition.name: DingTalk Teambition
teambition.description: DingTalk Teambition's marketing site is a light, airy project-management pitch in the system font stack (-apple-system with PingFang SC for Chinese), 60px bold display headlines in #212121, a charcoal #353535 solid CTA with 8px radius, a blue-to-violet gradient download button, #0089ff blue eyebrow labels and generous 30px-radius pale cards on a white canvas.

ted.name: TED
ted.description: TED (ted.com) is a white #ffffff editorial video site set entirely in Inter with tight negative tracking, near-black #121212 text, TED red #eb0028 uppercase topic labels, a #d91e18 4px-radius MEMBERSHIP button, a black topic bar, a #262626 newsletter band and a #121212 footer.

teenage-engineering.name: teenage engineering
teenage-engineering.description: teenage engineering's site is a scaling, 980px-based layout set in its own te-20 / te-40 faces at weights 100 and 300 (plus TechnoType on product pages) — near-black #0f0e12 lowercase text on white #ffffff, full-bleed black product photography, light-grey #f6f8f7 product tiles, link blue #0071bb, and tiny dark 3.91837px-radius "add to bag" pills.

telefonica.name: Telefónica
telefonica.description: Telefónica's corporate site (telefonica.com/es) pairs a vivid electric blue #0066ff with deep navy ink #031a34 on white, using the Telefonica Sans family in light, regular, medium and demibold cuts, 20px to 40px rounded cards on pale #f2f4ff tint, 100px pill outline buttons with 0.55px-tracked 11px uppercase labels, and full-bleed blue photographic heroes.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Telegram's site (telegram.org) is a light, document-like page: white #ffffff canvas, #333333 system-font text at 15px, Telegram blue #0088cc for links, tabs and the 26px/600 feature titles, a #318fd3 999px-radius pill on mobile, 4px radii elsewhere, and duck sticker illustrations.

telekom.name: Deutsche Telekom
telekom.description: Deutsche Telekom corporate home page (telekom.com): a black canvas (#000000) with white text and a #202020 pill navigation bar, magenta (#e20074) as the brand action color, white 64px pill buttons with black bold labels, TeleNeo Var type (56px/500 hero, 48px/700 headings, 24px body) and very round 24 to 42px section containers over sunset photography and pastel blue and violet panels.

telenor.name: Telenor Group
telenor.description: Telenor Group corporate home page: Telenor proprietary family with Telenor Bold 24px headings and 16px body, indigo #2d28cd links, deep navy #000f3c header and footer, white canvas, square corners, no shadows and photo-led three-column cards.

telescope.name: Telescope
telescope.description: Telescope recommendations site: Beausite 57px light headline with -0.38px tracking, DM Mono 12.35px uppercase labels, warm paper canvas #f4f3f0, near-black #1a1915 text, pale lime #e3f794 sign-up pill, 2px photo radius and no shadows.

telha-clarke.name: Telha Clarke
telha-clarke.description: Telha Clarke architecture studio home page: Europa-Grotesk at weight 400 with a 14px to 89px fluid scale, pure black on white with pale #cacfcb footer text, 0px radius everywhere, no shadows and unframed architectural imagery.

telkom-ot.name: Telkom-OT
telkom-ot.description: Telkom-OT aluminium injection-molding tools site: Aeonik Pro 125px headline with Sfmono uppercase 14px labels, flat grey #d9d9d9 canvas, near-black #1e1e1e text, coral #ff5948 buttons with #ff6e5f hover, 4px and 6px radii and a hard dark halo shadow.

telstra.name: Telstra
telstra.description: Telstra Personal home page: Telstra Display 700 56px headlines and Telstra Text Variable 16px body, navy #131a35 ink and 36px-radius 48px buttons, interactive blue #0d54ff, 16px bordered cards, cream #fbf8f3 panels and #f2f2f7 footer.

temu-g.name: Temu
temu-g.description: Temu's Thai storefront measured at temu.com — white #ffffff canvas, Temu orange #fb7701 primary with white text, blue #1d86e6 header band, green #0a8800 trust and "local" badges, grey #555555 product copy, near-black #1e1e1e footer, miui/system-ui sans stack at 13–14px, 4px and 3px small radii plus 9999px pills.

tengile-malamala-collection.name: Tengile MalaMala Collection
tengile-malamala-collection.description: Luxury safari collection in Greater Kruger and Sabi Sand: warm bone canvas #f5eee9, deep olive ink #373f1d, moss green #5c6e21 footer, PP Fragment light display at 106.667px/220 over Inter 14-16px, square corners with 2px and 4px radii, no shadows.

terminal21.name: Terminal21

tero-entertainment.name: Tero Entertainment

tesla.name: Tesla

thai-credit-bank.name: Thai Credit Bank

thai-denmark.name: Thai-Denmark Milk Shop
thai-denmark.description: Thai-Denmark Milk Shop (thaidenmark.com), the online shop for Thai-Denmark dairy products: white canvas, milk-carton red #ef1c23 pill CTAs at 35px radius, Noto Serif Thai body text, blue-tinted product tiles with 10px radius and WoodMart store patterns.

thai-enquirer.name: Thai Enquirer

thai-health-insurance.name: Thai Health Insurance PLC (ไทยประกันสุขภาพ)

thai-life.name: Thai Life Insurance (ไทยประกันชีวิต)

thai-name-server.name: Thai Name Server
thai-name-server.description: Thai Name Server Co., Ltd. (ThaiNS), the .th and .ไทย registry operator: white canvas with a #98afc7 steel-blue frame, #001b46 navy header band, #2b2977 indigo logo and nav text, #333333 body in the system UI font at 16px, a Bootstrap 5 layout with 4-5px radii.

thai-namthip.name: ThaiNamthip Coca-Cola
thai-namthip.description: ThaiNamthip Coca-Cola's corporate site is Thai-first with Poppins and Prompt headings at weight 700, a Coca-Cola red action color #ec1c24, full-bleed #e41e2b product bands, and heavily rounded 24px panels and 48px media frames with faint red-tinted glow shadows.

thai-news-agency.name: Thai News Agency (สำนักข่าวไทย อสมท)

thai-oil.name: Thai Oil
thai-oil.description: Thaioil Group corporate site (thaioilgroup.com): white canvas, DB Heavent Thai type at 72/48/24px, heading blue #1d4f86, cyan #4ccaf4 links with 2px radius, cyan glow card shadows and 8-10px photo-card corners over industrial photography.

thai-paiboon.name: Thai Paiboon Insurance (ไทยไพบูลย์ประกันภัย)

thai-parliament-television.name: Thai Parliament Television (TPCHANNEL)
thai-parliament-television.description: TPCHANNEL (tpchannel.org), Thai Parliament Television's news and video portal: Prompt Thai type at 14px body, black header with gold #ffd684 nav, #f1f1f1 page gray, gold-tint #ffd68426 pill buttons with #b8800f text at 50px radius and 8px thumbnails.

thai-post.name: Thai Post
thai-post.description: Thai Post newspaper site (thaipost.net): white canvas, navy #003254 headlines in Prompt with Sarabun 18px body, red #e11612 accents, charcoal #363636 bands, flat rule-divided layout and #ededed pill buttons at 64px radius with #b82e24 hover.

thai-rath.name: Thairath (ไทยรัฐออนไลน์)

thai-rung-ruang.name: TRR Group
thai-rung-ruang.description: Corporate site of TRR Group (Thai Roong Ruang Sugar Group, maker of the Lin sugar brand), set in Kanit 300-500 with 35px section headings, deep sugar-cane brown #502c1e ink on white, blush surfaces #e8e0dd and #dfdfdf, a soft #cbbab3 secondary text, and photographic full-bleed bands.

thai-rung-union-car.name: Thai Rung Union Car

thai-setakij.name: Thai Setakij Insurance (TSI Insurance)

thai-smile-bus.name: Thai Smile Group (Thai Smile Bus)
thai-smile-bus.description: Thai Smile Group site (thaismilegroup.com), operator of Thai Smile Bus: full-bleed hero photography, navy #203556 Prompt text on white, charcoal #1b1b1b search band, giant outlined Bebas Neue numerals, 10px fields and soft shadows.

thai-union.name: Thai Union Group

thai-wah.name: Thai Wah
thai-wah.description: Thai Wah Public Company (TWPC) corporate site: a white page with full-bleed agricultural photography, 50%-black text panels, navy #0e1149 headings, sky-blue #00a1ed navigation, Poppins/Prompt type with a 42px weight-500 display style, and flat 4px-corner controls.

thai-watsadu.name: Thai Watsadu (ไทวัสดุ)
thai-watsadu.description: Thai Watsadu online store (thaiwatsadu.com): #f1f1f1 canvas with white bands, brand red #b8292f buttons at 4px radius, custom kittithada Thai type at 21-24px, 6px cards, a Material-style header shadow and a red service band.

thaibma.name: The Thai Bond Market Association (ThaiBMA)
thaibma.description: ThaiBMA homepage: warm off-white canvas #f9f7f7, orange #f37021 navigation bar and brand colour, peach #ffe9d9 quick-link tiles, dark #33302b footer, SF UI Text with Inter and Noto Sans Thai, data-dense cards with 16px radius.

thaibulksms.name: Thaibulksms
thaibulksms.description: Thaibulksms marketing site (thaibulksms.com): white canvas, ink #1d1d1f pill buttons, brand blue #006bff and cyan #00c7ff on sky-blue photographic hero, one custom Thai font at 14/16/32/55px, 20px cards with Tailwind large shadows.

thaijob.name: ThaiJob
thaijob.description: Thai job board (ThaiJob.com): blue #1d65bf hero band with a red search action, white and #f6f6f6 canvas, #222e39 slate footer, Prompt typeface at 14-36px, 4px radii and bordered job-row lists.

thailand-board-of-investment.name: Thailand Board of Investment (BOI)
thailand-board-of-investment.description: Thailand Board of Investment English site (boi.go.th/en): white canvas with navy #003471 utility bar and footer, PT Sans 16px body and uppercase 18px navigation, blue #0b5aa2 tile strips, 3-10px radii and Material-style card shadows.

thailand-education-and-research-network-.name: ThaiREN (Thailand Education and Research Network Association)
thailand-education-and-research-network-.description: ThaiREN association site (thairen.net.th): white page with navy #000033 Tahoma text at 14px, orange #ff6600 title and #e98236 links, gray #cccccc rules, square corners and a single narrow centered column in a legacy 2000s style.

thailand-internet-exchange-th-ix.name: Thailand Internet Exchange (TH-IX)
thailand-internet-exchange-th-ix.description: Neutral internet exchange of Thailand: NT type at weights 400 and 700, white canvas #ffffff, gray ink #4f4f4f, slate #52595f buttons, yellow-orange accents (#ffa800, #ffd100), 15px button radius and 40-50px card corners.

thailand-post.description: National postal operator portal (ไปรษณีย์ไทย): tahoma, arial at 14px weight 400, white canvas #ffffff, ink #333333, signal red #ff3333 navigation, buttons and footer, 0px button radius with 10px panels, dense Bootstrap-style service layout.

Helvetica Neue at weights 300 to 500, vermilion #d6410f search button, green #4fb84f menu bar, deep-blue #004375 promo bands, #527bc0 footer, light #ecf0f1 page tint and mostly 4px corners.

thailandpost-mart.name: Thailand Post Mart

thaipat-insurance.name: Thaipat Insurance (ไทยพัฒนาประกันภัย)

thaipbs.name: Thai PBS

thaire.name: Thai Reinsurance
thaire.description: Thai Reinsurance (THRE) English homepage: white canvas with gray Arial body text (#6b6b6b), near-black Prompt headings (#1a1110), Red Hat Display hero type at 50px, a yellow (#ffd400) READ MORE button with navy text (#00005a) at 3px radius, dark navy footer (#191d2d) and moody photographic panels.

thaivivat.name: Thaivivat Insurance
thaivivat.description: Thai insurer (ประกันภัยไทยวิวัฒน์) home page: PSL Kanda headlines and Prompt body at 20px, brand green #00a350, gray text ladder #666666, light band #f1f2f2, 4px and 8px radii, dark #323232 footer.

thaiware.name: Thaiware
thaiware.description: Thai free-software download and IT news site (Thaiware.com): blue #0c78a6 navigation and headings, deep #005377 buttons, white and #f7f7f7 canvas with pale teal #eef5f7 and #edf5f4 cards, Kanit light 15px text, 8px radii.

thammasat.name: Thammasat University

thanachart-capital.name: Thanachart Capital
thanachart-capital.description: Thai holding-company investor site in PSL KandaModern and PSL Text Pro: warm near-black #231f20 on white, saturated orange #f27021 rounded panels, peach #fef1e9 sections, #e3e3e3 footer with 48px rounded top, outlined 4px-radius buttons.

thansettakij.name: Thansettakij

thappline.name: Thai Petroleum Pipeline Company Limited (Thappline)
thappline.description: Corporate site of Thai Petroleum Pipeline Co., Ltd. (บริษัท ท่อส่งปิโตรเลียมไทย จำกัด) in Prompt only, with a 120px display headline, 18px body, blue #0092df and #2992df on white, footer #1c6ba3, 24px-radius stat cards with #d6d6d6 borders and a soft 9.899px offset shadow.

the-atlantic.name: The Atlantic
the-atlantic.description: The Atlantic's site is black #000000 type on a white #ffffff page: AGaramondPro 400 headlines (38px/44px lead, 46px/52px article h1) and 22px/33px article body, uppercase Atlantic Serif section titles (32px, 1px tracking), a Logic Monospace metadata layer for bylines and kickers, Graphik 14px nav, one red #e7131a Subscribe button with 4px radius, 12px-radius colored game cards and a black footer.

the-best-you-by-klook.name: The Best You by Klook
the-best-you-by-klook.description: Klook campaign quiz microsite: poppins 400/600 and cubano, white canvas #ffffff, off-black #222222 text, embossed pill buttons with 33.33px radius, 8px polaroid cards, over a blue-violet-orange gradient and a 3D boarding-pass ticket.

the-coffee-club-thailand.name: The Coffee Club
the-coffee-club-thailand.description: The Coffee Club Thailand site - a light-grey (#f3f4f6) and white page with slate (#364153) body and near-black (#101828) Arial headings at 36px bold, orange (#f54a00) hover and divider accent, sand (#f0e6d2) footer, 8px-radius photo cards with a soft drop shadow.

the-creative-website-manualtm.name: The Creative Website Manual™
the-creative-website-manualtm.description: Editorial web-craft microsite by Huy and Ivor: PPNeueMontreal display with negative tracking, Rand Mono uppercase labels, near-black #070707 stage, #eaeaea ink, amber #ffb700 accent, square panels and pill controls, flat with no shadows.

the-drake-hotel.name: The Drake Hotel
the-drake-hotel.description: Toronto boutique hotel and arts venue: Sequel Sans headlines with negative tracking, Maison Mono uppercase copy at 10px, charcoal #222223 canvas, white buttons with 2px radius, boxed outlined headings, wine #672b3c and cream #f0eeeb panels.

the-guardian.name: The Guardian
the-guardian.description: The Guardian's news front built on its open-source Source Design System: a white (#ffffff) page under a Guardian blue (#052962) masthead, GH Guardian Headline serif at 500/700 (28px/32.2px section and lead headlines, 34px article headlines), GuardianTextEgyptian 17px/23.8px body, GuardianTextSans UI, pillar colours (news #c70000, opinion #c74600, lifestyle #bb3b80), yellow #ffe500 nav hover and pill buttons with radius equal to height (44px / 36px).

the-house-of-wonders.name: The House of Wonders (Audemars Piguet 150 years)
the-house-of-wonders.description: Audemars Piguet 150th-anniversary interactive microsite: black #000000 canvas, white Helvetica Neue at weights 100 and 300, Times Now italic accents, outlined 9999px pills, 8px cream #fefdf5 panel and five dark room tints.

the-lookback.name: The Lookback
the-lookback.description: Better Off studio year-in-review microsite entry screen: huge uppercase heavy sans headline at 89.856px with tight 76.3776px line height, mono uppercase index at 11.9467px, black #000000 on white #ffffff, 2.56px to 4.27px radii, no shadows.

the-mall-group.name: The Mall Group
the-mall-group.description: Thai retail group corporate site: db_airystd uppercase captions with 6px tracking, SamsungSharpSans-Regular navigation, white #ffffff canvas, #171717 ink, black serif wordmark, hairline #c0c0c0, square content corners, hero photography carrying color.

the-mall-lifestore.name: The Mall Lifestore
the-mall-lifestore.description: The Mall Lifestore (themalllifestore.com), the Bangkae, Bangkapi, Ngamwongwan, Korat and Thapra mall site — a black canvas (#000000) with white text, pure red (#ff0000) for giant DBAiry_Std display headlines up to 160px, GTFlexa_Ext for body, white 5px-radius buttons, and full-bleed night photography of the malls and their promotions.

the-matter.name: The Matter
the-matter.description: Thai independent news and culture site (thematter.co, tagline 'Make News Relevant'). White canvas with black feature bands, coral-red #ff463d editor's-pick pills and pill buttons (25px radius), headlines in the custom 'The Matter' face at 600 weight (36px hero, 26px card), Poppins uppercase 11px/2px tracking labels.

the-met.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
the-met.description: The Met (metmuseum.org): white #ffffff pages with #222222 headings and #6d6d6d text, a serif Austin display headline (66.7981px at 1280px) over Inter UI type on a fluid clamp() scale, Met red #e4002b buttons with 4px corners that darken to #a6192e, #f4f4f4 cards and a deep green #004032 Cloisters panel.

the-momentum.name: The Momentum
the-momentum.description: Thai long-form magazine (themomentum.co). White canvas, black ink and one pure-blue #0000ff kicker accent; wide-tracked uppercase Wolpe Pegasus labels (24px, 2px tracking), Martini Thai Neue Slab Black story titles (30px), Thongterm body, 9999px circular controls and almost no shadows.

the-monolith-project.name: The Monolith Project
the-monolith-project.description: Scroll-driven WebGL storytelling site, measured on its entry screen: grey #cfcfcf canvas with black #000000 prompt text, beige credit text #ffebbc and #fff6df, red #ff002f variable, BRCobane uppercase 20px display type, square corners and no measured radius.

the-nation-thailand.name: The Nation Thailand
the-nation-thailand.description: English-language Thai news site (nationthailand.com): white canvas with navy #17205c trending and hero bands, royal-blue #1f299a links and borders, Poppins in 300/400/600 plus Buenard serif, 64px capitalised hero headlines, 6px thumbnail radius, round 100% social icons, and a Bootstrap-derived stylesheet.

the-new-york-times.name: The New York Times
the-new-york-times.description: The New York Times home page (nytimes.com): white #ffffff page, #121212 ink, #5a5a5a summaries, #dfdfdf hairline rules and #ebebeb/#f8f8f8 grey wells; a slate-blue #567b95 square subscribe button and #326891/#346eb7 accents. nyt-cheltenham headlines (24px/300 feature, 20px/700 news), nyt-imperial 14px summaries, nyt-franklin 11px uppercase labels; 3px button shape.

the-new-yorker.name: The New Yorker
the-new-yorker.description: The New Yorker's site is a white #ffffff page with #333333 / #000000 text: IrvinHeadingPro 400 display headlines (36px/40px homepage hero, 42px article h1), TNYAdobeCaslonPro 400 body and promo headlines (21px/31.5px, 22px/28px, 17px/24px summaries), NeutrafaceNewYorker bylines, Graphik 12–13px interface type, a small #0879bf Subscribe button that hovers to #07588b, #db3334 rubrics, 48px pill Listen buttons and black #000000 full-width feature units.

the-obsidian-assembly.name: The Obsidian Assembly
the-obsidian-assembly.description: Private-assembly brand site (obsidianassembly.com): off-black #151415 and warm cream #f1eade surfaces, a white 8px-radius SEEK ADMISSION button, OTJubilee-Platinum display serif with Switzer UI type, translucent white pill tabs and scroll-driven cinematic sections.

the-one-enterprise.name: The One Enterprise
the-one-enterprise.description: ONEE, Thai media and entertainment group (theoneenterprise.com/en): white page, black ink and a square-cornered black READ MORE button, db-heavent in weights 100, 300 and 500 with 72px headings, dark #25262a showcase panels, and channel artwork supplying all color.

the-ordinary.name: The Ordinary
the-ordinary.description: The Ordinary (DECIEM) runs a clinical, near-monochrome Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront: white #ffffff canvas, #333333 body ink, Raleway at 16px/24px for copy and 36px/700 for section headlines, Geologica 12px/700 uppercase for button labels, square 0px buttons (black #000000 48px modal CTA, #e1ded9-outlined 44px Add To Cart) beside 110px pill outlines, #f8f8f8 product tiles, a black promo bar and a DECIEM brand-switcher strip above the header.

the-pendragon-cycle.name: The Pendragon Cycle
the-pendragon-cycle.description: Promotional site for The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin (pendragoncycle.com), a dark #1a1a1a immersive page with warm parchment tan #9c8e7d and cream #fff5eb type in the serif faces LTC Goudy Oldstyle Pro, Gryphius MVB and Antiquarian Scribe, driven by a full-screen sound-enable gate.

the-peninsula-bangkok.name: The Peninsula Bangkok
the-peninsula-bangkok.description: Peninsula Hotels riverside flagship in Bangkok (peninsula.com): white canvas, bronze #867050 square-cornered RESERVE buttons, Minion Pro 44px display serif with Futura Book at 18px, soft #f9f9f9 booking panels and warm heritage photography.

the-pizza-company.name: The Pizza Company
the-pizza-company.description: The Pizza Company 1112, Thai pizza ordering site (1112.com/th): white and #f2f4f7 surfaces, brand green #00794e buttons with 16px and 12px radii, red #e70000 deal flags, FC-Iconic Thai display type in five weights and soft 4px card shadows.

the-power-of-storytelling.name: The Power of Storytelling
the-power-of-storytelling.description: Noomo agency microsite The Power of Digital Storytelling (storytelling.noomoagency.com): periwinkle #c4c5f1 canvas, navy #29345a ink, a 249.6px TheSeasons italic title and TTNeoris sans at 66px with tight negative tracking, pill radii and translucent white overlays.

the-standard.name: THE STANDARD
the-standard.description: THE STANDARD Thai news and business media (thestandard.co/homepage): white canvas, black ink, pure red #ff0000 MORE buttons with 3px radius, Kanit 700 headlines at 26px and 22px, Helvetica Neue 14px navigation, black feature bands and 4-up card rails.

the-state-of-the-gallery.name: The state of the gallery
the-state-of-the-gallery.description: mesh3d microsite The state of the gallery (mesh3d.gallery): blue-black #08090d canvas, pale #cfdee5 text, a single neon #ecff3e Browse the gallery button with 19px radius and glow, 200px overusedGrotesk counter numerals and Geist 600 labels.

the-symphony-of-vines.name: The Symphony of Vines
the-symphony-of-vines.description: Cinematic, sepia-toned wine storytelling site for Chateau Oublié: PalaceItalic display at 105px with -4.5px tracking, Bellefair serif body at 24px, parchment canvas #f4f0ec, dark olive ink #332f22 and an aged-gold accent #9c6e49, with zero-radius surfaces.

the-washington-post.name: The Washington Post
the-washington-post.description: The Washington Post home page (washingtonpost.com), built on the Washington Post Design System (WPDS): white #ffffff page, #2a2a2a ink, #595959 summaries, #111111 strong text, a blue #166dfc pill Subscribe CTA (hover #1366b3) and #e7f0fe CTA container. Postoni 700 headlines at 26px, ITC Franklin 300/700 for summaries and UI; 9999px pills, 0.1-alpha outlines.

the-watch.name: FS 60P by 60fps
the-watch.description: Monochrome single-product site for the FS 60P automatic watch by 60fps: Nekst uppercase display at 311px, Inter micro body at 10.67px, canvas #ebebeb fading to black #0a0a0a, near-zero chrome and radii of 4px, 5px and a full circle.

the1.name: The 1
the1.description: The 1 (the1.co.th), Thailand's loyalty-points app site — near-black canvas (#0a0a0a) with off-white text (#f5f5f5), a single signal red (#dd1a22) on 3.56px-radius download buttons, the proprietary the_one_official family in Light, Regular and Bold, and phone-mockup storytelling in a Thai-first, app-download-led layout.

thelinestudio-com.name: THE LINE Studio
thelinestudio-com.description: Animation studio in London with a loud, oversized-type look: DenimWeb in weights 300 to 500 from 8.9px captions to 155.6px headings with negative tracking, off-white #f8f8f8 and #dddee2 canvas, near-black #0b0b0b ink, signal red #ff391e and zero radii.

theme-ui.name: Theme UI
theme-ui.description: Theme UI documentation home: white canvas, black ink, primary #3333ee, secondary #111199 and accent #660099, system-ui headings at weight 800 (32px sections), black 56px buttons with 6px radius, flat #f6f6f6 code panels and a node-graph illustration.

thermo-fisher.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific
thermo-fisher.description: Thailand storefront of Thermo Fisher Scientific: Helvetica Neue at light 100 weight 50px hero and 16px body, white canvas, charcoal ink #222222, brand red #e71316 for primary buttons, link blue #0071d0, 3 to 4px radii and a single soft card shadow.

theverge.name: The Verge
theverge.description: The Verge's homepage is a tech-news magazine in a white canvas with near-black #131313 headlines, grey #4a4a4a serif body copy, one electric violet #5200ff for actions and bylines, and a 90px Manuka condensed 900 headline set against FK Roman and PolySans.

things.name: Things
things.description: Cultured Code's Things site sets everything in the system UI font (ui-sans-serif, 20.25px/26.325px body, 36px/700 section titles) in #303336 and #44474b on a cool #f2f5f7 page with #ffffff panels, #5c9cf5 blue text links that gain a 20% blue fill on hover, 18px-radius platform cards and soft two-layer shadows.

thitikorn.name: Thitikorn
thitikorn.description: Thai consumer-finance site in Prompt: white #ffffff page, #6e6e6e body copy, lime #5dc100 navigation and headings, #008452 green footer with #ffffffcc text, #025454 deep teal accent, circular badges only and no shadows.

thoresen-thai-agencies-public-company-li.name: Thoresen Thai Agencies (TTA)
thoresen-thai-agencies-public-company-li.description: Investor-facing home page of Thoresen Thai Agencies (TTA Group), Thailand: Manrope with Kanit fallback at 16px weight 500 body, 32px uppercase hero, white canvas, grey ink #464646, corporate blue #125bb2 with a green gradient brand field, 16px card radius and soft deep shadows.

thorgal.name: Thorgal
thorgal.description: Official French-language site of the Thorgal comic saga: Artifex Hand CF uppercase display at 75.2px and Mulish navigation at 10.5px, page-body canvas #efeeed, near-black ink #22201d, sand gold #b8a88a, a 3.5px-radius dark Découvrir button and a #1a1a1a menu panel.

thumbtack.name: Thumbtack
thumbtack.description: Thumbtack's home-services marketplace homepage pairs the Rise typeface (weights 400 and 700, variable up to 900) with a deep navy pill CTA (#07344a), a measured cyan accent (#009fd9), white and #fafafa surfaces, 16px-radius photo cards and a 48px display headline at -0.96px tracking, all on the Thumbprint design system's --tp- CSS variables.

tiffany-and-co.name: Tiffany & Co.
tiffany-and-co.description: Tiffany & Co. (tiffany.com, US storefront): white #ffffff canvas with black #000000 ink, a Tiffany Blue #81d8d0 announcement band, a light-champagne #fbf9f7 footer and champagne #f4f0ea square (0px) uppercase buttons. Sterling SSM serif headings (28px/500 hero, 32px/325 section) over Santral Book sans body at 13–16px; focus and hover use the accessible teal #009cad.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.description: TikTok logged-out feed: a white #ffffff shell around a portrait video, TikTokFont type at 12-17px (15px/500 labels, 14px body), black #000000 navigation and one hot pink-red #fe2c55 pill button 32px tall with a #ea284e hover.

tilda.name: Tilda
tilda.description: Tilda's site uses its own open-licensed variable Tilda Sans at weight 300 for most text (16px/24.8px body, 72–78px light headlines) and 600 for the 46px hero, black #000000 ink on white with #efefef illustration panels, square 0px-radius #fa8669 coral buttons (hover #ff7a5a), and line-art illustrations in coral #ffa282.

tinybird.name: Tinybird
tinybird.description: Tinybird's site is a terminal-styled dark page: #0a0a0a canvas, white Roboto 64px/72px headlines at -1.28px, Roboto Mono for buttons and labels, a square-cornered (0px) neon-green #27f795 CTA with #0a0a0a text that hovers to #008060 with white text, and #151515 cards outlined in 1px #353535 at 4px radius.

tiparos.name: ทิพรส (Tiparos)
tiparos.description: Tiparos fish-sauce brand site by Tang Sang Hah Co., Ltd. - a white page under a solid red (#e22626) header band, navy (#1e3d7c) headings, yellow (#ffdd00) accent, set entirely in the Kanit family (SemiBold 28px h1, Regular 18px body) with 5px/10px/pill radii.

tisco.name: TISCO Bank
tisco.description: Thai bank TISCO's English home page: TISCO_AD typeface at 16px body and 26px headings, brand blue #1369b0 used for ink, headings and the 36px-high e-Service button (6px radius), white and #fafafa canvas, charcoal footer #212121 and hairline #dee2e6 table rules.

titangate-equity.name: TitanGate Equity
titangate-equity.description: Dark, invitation-only private-markets site: black canvas with white Fellix display at 87.04px and 32px body, PP Supply Sans mono-style uppercase labels at 12px with 3.2px tracking, a translucent white button (#ffffff1a, 2.4px radius) and ghosted greys #606060 and #202020.

tldraw.name: tldraw
tldraw.description: tldraw (tldraw.com), "very good free whiteboard": an app-first page on a #f9fafb canvas with #fcfcfc floating panels, Inter 500–700 UI labels at 12px/19.2px in #1c1c1c, a #3182ed selection blue for the Sign in to share button and active tool, 9px–11px panel radii, layered tl-shadow-2 panel shadows and a 12-colour shape palette.

tnn.name: TNN Thailand
tnn.description: Thai news channel TNN's home page: True family Thai typefaces (Bold, Medium) at 21 to 22px body and 40px headings, white canvas, charcoal ink #333333, TNN orange #ec5f27, ticker and card surfaces in #f5f5f5, with pill 100px and 8px radii and a black mourning band.

todoist.name: Todoist
todoist.description: Todoist's marketing home: warm near-white #fefdfc canvas with peach #fff6f0 panels, Todoist red #e34432 Start for free buttons (hover #cf3520) with 15px and 8px corners, warm-black #25221e text at 66% alpha for body, Graphik 600 headlines at 55px over Inter 500 body at 20.5px, soft #25221e-tinted shadows.

together-ai.name: Together AI
together-ai.description: Together AI's marketing site sets "The Future" (a Futura-inspired geometric sans) at 56.8889px/500 on a pale-blue-to-white canvas, with black #000000 uppercase mono buttons, a deep navy #010120 research band, and lilac, cyan and magenta accents lifted from its own CSS variables.

tohome.name: Tohome.com
tohome.description: Thai online IT and gadget retailer (tohome.com): indigo #241f61 and #282467 header and buttons, white and #f8fafc canvas, red #dc2626 flash-sale and #e11d48 price accents, Anuphan typeface up to weight 900, 16px cards and pill inputs.

tokio-marine-thailand.name: Tokio Marine Thailand
tokio-marine-thailand.description: Thailand English page of Tokio Marine insurance: Lato (Regular, Medium, Semibold) at 16px body and 48px hero, white canvas, deep teal ink #022b39, primary button #00546c and secondary #33abba as 1000px pills, 16px cards with a 0.1 alpha shadow and pastel category chips.

tonson.name: Tonson Group
tonson.description: Monochrome Bangkok investment-company site in Nord and Questrial: black #000000 header, charcoal #111111 sections, white #ffffff content, #b3b3b3 grey accent, 93px uppercase headlines, 60px-radius pill buttons and photography-led color.

top-news.name: TOP NEWS
top-news.description: Thai online news outlet TOP NEWS: Kanit headings at 32px weight 500 and Sarabun body at 14px, white canvas with near-black ink #1b1b1b, a saturated blue headline band #1068b2, grey top bar, black footer and rounded 5px, 25px and 50px chips for LIVE and read-all links.

tops.name: Tops Online
tops.description: Thai grocery delivery storefront Tops Online (English): IBM Plex-style ibmregular and ibmsemibold at 16px body and 28px headings, white canvas on a #e3e4e3 page, ink #121212, Tops red-orange #ff3d1c buttons and a #f70405 header strip, 6px to 12px radii, gold Tops Prime Plus card.

totalenergies.name: TotalEnergies
totalenergies.description: TotalEnergies corporate site: white and pale blue-grey canvas, slate ink #374649, signature red #e70000 on outlined pill buttons (80px radius), Nunito headlines over Roboto body, 20px-radius photo cards and a Bootstrap-derived CSS base.

toyota.name: Toyota
toyota.description: Toyota USA homepage system: white #ffffff canvas with #000000 text, the brand red #e10a1d (measured link colour, matching the logo in the capture), tcomMed 48px display headlines, white pill buttons over full-bleed vehicle photography, and muted olive-grey #969688 vehicle cards with 8px to 50px radii.

tpc-power.name: TPC Power Holding
tpc-power.description: TPC Power Holding (tpcpower.co.th), a Thai holding company for biomass and other renewable power plants, uses a white canvas #ffffff, gold #c39831 and #bb8e25 headings and pills, lime #a3b808 secondary buttons, grey #666666 body text and a #313131 footer, all in Prompt with 30px/500 headings and 30px-radius pills.

tpi-polene-power.name: TPI Polene Power
tpi-polene-power.description: TPI Polene Power Public Company Limited Thai homepage (tpipolenepower.co.th/index.php/th/): Athiti typeface at weight 300 and 16px body, 46px/600 centered hero title in slate #2f3f54, #f7f7f7 canvas, ink #090e1d, navy #19283f footer, amber #f6bf1f link hover, a saturated blue header band and square corners throughout.

trainline.name: Trainline
trainline.description: Trainline (US English site): Trainline green #00a88f with deep navy #160078 headlines, charcoal ink #192325, TLCircular 700 display type, 4px-radius buttons, an 8px-radius floating search card with a 16px shadow and a partner-brand navy band.

traveloka-thailand.name: Traveloka Thailand
traveloka-thailand.description: Traveloka Thailand (en-th) travel marketplace: white canvas, charcoal ink #434343, Traveloka blue #0a9af2 buttons, orange #f96d01 prices, Godwit typeface at 600 weight, 10px-radius deal cards with a soft 4px 10px shadow and 999px pill filter chips.

trawelt.name: Trawelt
trawelt.description: Trawelt, a Salesforce consultancy for travel and hospitality: black canvas with white text, mint #d3ffc3 navigation and CTA, forest green #2d9b4c ticket cards and footer, Labour Grotesk 400 with Reckless Neue 250 serif accents and 10px/15px radii.

trek-bicycles.name: Trek Bicycles
trek-bicycles.description: Trek Bikes US storefront: photo-led hero and category grid on white, black #000000 text, white 8px-radius uppercase Roboto 500 buttons over imagery, #1a1a1a header and #2b2b2b footer, Avalon-Bold headlines at 34.29px and 10px-radius image tiles.

trello.name: Trello
trello.description: Trello's marketing home (an Atlassian product): white #ffffff and #f4f5f7 grey bands, Atlassian blue #0065ff buttons (#0747a6 hover) and a full-width blue section, #091e42 navy text, #172b4d navy footer, Charlie Display 500 headlines at 48px/60px over Charlie Text 20px/30px body, square 0px header CTA and 4.8px form corners.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.description: Tremor is an open-source React and Tailwind CSS kit for charts and dashboards; its site and components use Geist Sans, a white canvas, near-black #101828 headlines, a #2b7fff blue primary, 6px-radius controls with #d1d5dc borders, and soft layered card shadows.

tresmares-capital.name: Tresmares Capital
tresmares-capital.description: Tresmares Capital, a pan-European private equity and financing firm: white canvas, charcoal ink #2b2b2b, PP Neue Montreal 500 with a 149.34px tightly tracked hero, red #e41613 PP Fragment Serif statistics, square corners, hairline #d5d5d5 boxes and no shadows.

trevor-noah.name: Trevor Noah
trevor-noah.description: Trevor Noah official site: deep navy #1d2440 canvas, cream #f9fcf4 text and Get Tickets pill, pink #ff9bb4 accent, Die Grotesk C/D at 89.74px headlines, clip-path pill buttons and fluid clamp() type.

triggerdev.name: Trigger.dev
triggerdev.description: Trigger.dev's site is a dark developer page on charcoal #121317 with dimmed #878c99 body text, Satoshi-Variable 60px/600 headlines, Geist UI text and Geist Mono code, a square-cornered apple-green #a8ff53 CTA with #121317 label, 4px controls, 6px cards and #1c1e21 hairline borders.

trionn-2.name: TRIONN
trionn-2.description: TRIONN, an independent digital studio: near-black #0c0c0c canvas with #d8d8d8 text, familjen display at 80px with -4.8px tracking, neueHaas body, martianMono uppercase links, a white pill LET'S TALK button and 6.4px-radius dark cards with no shadows.

tripcom.name: Trip.com
tripcom.description: Trip.com US home page: Trip Geom 400/500/700 throughout, 40px bold white hero headline, #121826 ink on #ffffff with #f5f7fa footer, Trip blue #2c61fe buttons with 4px corners (hover #2953d6), 48px search button, 8px-radius cards with soft navy shadows, #fcc8d0 coupon borders, #2346ff app-promo band and #c74401 badges.

truckn-roll-r.name: Truck'N Roll
truckn-roll-r.description: Truck'N Roll entertainment logistics: #131313 near-black canvas with #fefefe text, electric violet #4e37ff accent, National 2 Condensed 900 uppercase headlines at 200px, Helvetica Now Display body and a 12-column grid with 8px and 14px radii.

true-corporation.name: True Corporation (True-dtac)
true-corporation.description: True Corporation Thai home page (true.th, True-dtac): white and #f9f9fc canvas, True red #e00000 pill buttons with 100px radius, slate ink #303c46, BetterTogether typeface, 24px-radius cards with a soft blue-grey shadow and a 60px-radius search field.

true-digital.name: True Digital Group
true-digital.description: True Digital Group (English site): white canvas, gray #6b7280 body text, True red #ca0008 for emphasis words and numerals, Satoshi with IBM Plex Sans Thai fallback, white pill LEARN MORE buttons with a blue and pink glow shadow and 8px-radius bordered cards.

true-spark.name: TrueVisions NOW
true-spark.description: TrueVisions NOW (truevisions.co.th, operator site measured for True Spark): near-black #0f0f0f pages with white text, magenta #e31d93 header and #f341b4 pill CTAs, Better Together typeface, 20px-radius poster tiles and 12px-radius white buttons.

truemoney.name: TrueMoney (ทรูมันนี่)
truemoney.description: TrueMoney Thailand home page: white canvas (#ffffff) with navy ink (#0e162c), a single orange accent (#ff5a00) used for pill-shaped outlined buttons (9999px radius, 48px high), peach cards (#ffede2, 24px radius) and the graphikth Thai/Latin typeface at 400 and 600 weights.

truus.name: Truus
truus.description: Truus, an Amsterdam advertising agency: warm off-white canvas (#f0ebe6) against pure black, lowercase Epilogue 900 headlines with tight negative tracking (-2.56px at 85.33px), DM Sans 400 body at 17.78px, Lora italic accents, and bright pops of blue #4b69f0, berry #a0325a, lilac #f0befa and orange #f5693c.

tsmc.name: TSMC
tsmc.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company home page: Roboto in 400 and 500 on white (#ffffff) and light grey (#f2f2f2), charcoal text (#333333), a slate band (#3c4854), and a single crimson accent (#b32a2a) for the job-search button and LEARN MORE links, with 100px pill outlines and 5px radii.

ttb.name: ttb bank (TMBThanachart Bank)
ttb.description: TMBThanachart Bank (ttb) English home page: navy #002d63 and #0d2d5e chrome, a full-bleed orange hero (#f68b1f, the stylesheet's --btn-primary), white pill-shaped search buttons, the proprietary ttb display face at 68.864px weight 600 and Ekachon for text, with 24px card radii.

tukcom.name: Tukcom
tukcom.description: Tukcom is the Thai IT and family shopping-mall brand; its site pairs a full-bleed aerial mall photograph with Montserrat 800 white 40px headlines, Open Sans 14px body, a white header with #2ea3f2 navigation, a 79px-radius outlined More Info button and black and #222222 footer fields.

tumblr.name: Tumblr
tumblr.description: Tumblr's logged-out explore dashboard — a navy #001935 chrome around white #ffffff post cards, Favorit / Favorit Modern type at 16px/24px, a #00b8ff pill Sign up button with black text, a black #000000 pill on the #7c5cff sign-up banner, 8px card corners and 9999px pills.

tune-protect.name: Tune Protect Thailand
tune-protect.description: Tune Protect Thailand (ทูน ประกันภัย) Thai homepage: Noto Sans Thai at 16px weight 500 with slate ink (#495057), pure red (#ff0000) accents and a red announcement banner, six outline-icon product tiles at 6px radius with layered Material-style shadows, and promotion cards with text-only action rows.

turborepo.name: Turborepo
turborepo.description: Turborepo (turborepo.dev) is a Vercel Geist-system page: off-white #fafafa canvas, GeistSans 64px/450 headline tracked to -3.84px, #4d4d4d 14px body, a near-black #171717 pill 'Get started' button with a white pill 'Read the docs' partner, white 8px-radius cards with #e6e6e6 hairlines, GeistMono terminal snippets and a red-to-blue gradient speedometer.

turkish-airlines.name: Turkish Airlines
turkish-airlines.description: Turkish Airlines' Thailand-English home page: white #ffffff canvas, deep navy #101a2a footer and #232b38 dark bands, signature red #e81932 'Search flights' button (hover #ff3545) with 4px corners, #f4f5f8 grey booking fields 66px tall, and every word in museoSans from 38px/500 headlines down to 11px/700 header links.

turn-io.name: Turn.io
turn-io.description: Turn.io home page: a deep forest-green hero (#0a3922) with mint headline (#d2f2e3), a white canvas with pastel feature cards (#e0f6fb, #e4f7ee, 16px radius), a coral pill button (#ff643b, 50px radius, white DM Sans 600 at 18px) and DM Sans throughout, from 80px display to 16px body.

turso.name: Turso
turso.description: Turso (turso.tech) is a dark Bunker #0d1318 / #0f1317 page with a single accent, Turso Aqua #4ff8d2: aqua pill CTAs (9999px, 12px 24px, 44px) with black labels hovering to #88ffe4, Inter 60px/800 headlines at -1.5px tracking, 50%-white #ffffff80 body text, #283945 hairlines and 12–16px-radius code and diagram cards.

tv-thunder.name: TV Thunder
tv-thunder.description: TV Thunder (บริษัท ทีวี ธันเดอร์ จำกัด (มหาชน)) home page: white canvas with charcoal text (#333333), a green footer (#126a3c) and green nav hover (#2fc142), uppercase Mitr section titles at 32px and DBHeavent body at 22px, with every element rendering square (0px radius).

twenty.name: Twenty
twenty.description: Twenty.com home: light grey #f4f4f4 and white #ffffff grounds with #1c1c1c ink and dark #1c1c1c panels, Aleo 300 serif headlines (60px/66px, -1.2px) mixed with Host Grotesk, Azeret Mono 12px uppercase labels and buttons, square #1c1c1c 'GET STARTED' buttons, 4px-radius cards and an indigo #4a38f5 hover accent.

twilio.name: Twilio
twilio.description: Twilio home page (twilio.com/en-us): a deep navy canvas (#000d25, cards #191f36), white Whitney SSm headlines at 56px weight 700 with -1.68px tracking, an electric blue pill button (#1866ee, 50px radius, hover #0e3e92) and a signature red (#ef223a), with a white header and 20px card radii.

twitch.name: Twitch
twitch.description: Twitch.tv logged-out browse page: light #efeff1 / #f7f7f8 canvas, #0e0e10 ink, Twitch Purple #9147ff pill Sign Up button (hover #772ce8), #5c16c5 link purple, Roobert 18px/500 headings over Inter 14px body, 4px-radius thumbnails, translucent grey #adadb838 tag pills and a #451093 join banner.

twks-1.name: twks
twks-1.description: twks, an independent creative agency in Geneva: a stark black-on-white page (#ffffff, #000000, grey #8c8c8c) set entirely in GT Standard, with a 52.8px weight-600 statement headline at -0.528px tracking, 20px body, hairline rules, and every element rendering with square corners (0px).

typeform.name: Typeform
typeform.description: Typeform's home page is a dark aubergine #2a222b canvas with off-white #faf9fb text, a 64px Tobias serif display headline at -1px tracking, Twklausanne sans for body (20px/24px) and UI, light #faf9fb buttons with #2a222b labels and 12px radius, lilac purple accents (#a25fba, #eccffa) with soft purple glows, and 24px-radius cards on a pale #faf9fb section.

tyson-foods.name: Tyson Foods
tyson-foods.description: Tyson Foods corporate home page: warm off-white sections (#fbf9f4, #f3ede0) with slate-grey text (#4a5157), a burgundy primary (#7f091c) on square 3px-bordered uppercase buttons, Sentinel serif headlines at 40px weight 300, Proxima Nova body at 16px, and a brand red (#c8102e) for links and hover.

u-tapao-international-airport.name: U-Tapao Rayong-Pattaya International Airport
u-tapao-international-airport.description: U-Tapao Rayong-Pattaya International Airport website: white canvas (#ffffff) with charcoal text (#222222), deep navy chrome (#010c44 and #000c46), a sky-blue accent (#38a2d2) for heading underlines, Prompt in 300 to 600 weights, and radii from 4px to 30px.

u-x-machina.name: U x Machina
u-x-machina.description: U x Machina, a digital experience studio: a warm cream canvas (#fbf3eb) with dark brown ink (#2e2626), white type over a red-to-orange gradient hero, PP Neue Montreal at 400 and 500 (64.08px display, 24px body, 12px uppercase labels) with Instrument Serif italic accents, and 6px and pill radii.

uber.name: Uber
uber.description: Uber's consumer site is a black-canvas (#000000) page with white (#ffffff) Uber Move type, a 52px/700 headline, white 8px-radius primary buttons, light-grey pill secondary buttons (#efefef) and #292929 cards, built on the Base design system's custom-property tokens.

uber-eats.name: Uber Eats
uber-eats.description: Uber Eats home page measured live: a pure white canvas (#ffffff) with black (#000000) text and black buttons, set in Uber's proprietary UberMove (700, 52px h1) and UberMoveText (500, 16px body), with an 8px-radius search button, 9999px pill header buttons and a warm photographic hero.

ubs.name: UBS
ubs.description: UBS United States home page measured live: white and warm-grey (#f4f3ee, #f9f9f7) surfaces, near-black #1c1c1c light-weight Frutiger text (300, 48.0048px h1), a single UBS red #e60000 for the Client logins and Find out how buttons, and a tight 2px corner radius throughout.

uc-berkeley.name: University of California, Berkeley
uc-berkeley.description: UC Berkeley home page measured live: white canvas with #262626 Inter text, Berkeley Blue #002676 buttons, links, headlines and footer, California Gold #fdb515 as a full-width promotional band and nav hover colour, Inter at weights 400 to 900, and 9px-radius buttons with a 28px search field.

udemy.name: Udemy
udemy.description: Udemy's marketplace UI as shipped on udemy.com — the proprietary Udemy Sans at weights 300/400/500/700 on a white canvas, deep slate ink #2a2b3f, a single vivid purple #6d28d2 for every action (hover #892de1), 8px-radius buttons at 40px and 48px heights, 1000px pill search field, 16px-radius course cards with a #e9eaf2 hairline, teal "Bestseller" tags and a #202230 footer. Colors are authored in oklch as --color-* primitives and --applied-* semantic roles.

ufm.name: UFM Fuji Super
ufm.description: UFM Fuji Super, a Bangkok Japanese-style supermarket whose tagline is Thai Smiles Japanese Styles, pairs a warm cream canvas (#fef8eb) with a tomato-red main color (#e84e40), a leaf green accent (#88c640), Kalam handwriting headings at 46px and Poppins body text with Noto Sans Thai fallback.

ui-kitten.name: UI Kitten
ui-kitten.description: UI Kitten docs home: Docusaurus page with an orange #ff6721 hero, ink #1c1e21 system-font headings at 48px weight 700, pale #ebedf0 buttons with 6.4px radius, #f6f7f8 code box and a #303846 navy footer; documents an Eva-based React Native library.

uizard.name: Uizard
uizard.description: Uizard's uizard.io marketing site (now branded 'miro | LABS'): a black #000000 canvas with a violet glow, near-white #f5f5f5 Satoshi text at weight 480, ClashGrotesk 72px headlines, brand Blue #1e90ff for the Sign up CTA, lavender #a881fe for AI actions, 16px-radius dark cards with #2e2e2e borders, and 8px-radius buttons.

ulta-beauty.name: Ulta Beauty
ulta-beauty.description: Ulta Beauty home page measured live: white canvas with warm greys (#f8f5f2, #eae5e1) and black #000000 Circular text at light weight 300, black pill buttons with 100px radius and 40px height, a magenta #cc0058 price accent, 8px card radius, and saturated pink and orange promotional bands.

umami.name: Umami
umami.description: Umami's open-source analytics site: a #fafafa page with white 6px-radius cards and #e5e5e5 borders, Inter throughout (72px/700 headline at -1.8px tracking, 18px/28px grey #838383 body), #202020 and #0a0a0a ink, and a single blue #2b7fff for buttons with 8.4px corners, tracked eyebrows and charts.

under-armour.name: Under Armour
under-armour.description: Under Armour US home page measured live: near-black #1d1d1d header and text on white, grey #f0f0f0 footer, NeuePlakUA in 800-weight uppercase at 64px with 2px tracking for hero headlines, white pill buttons (44px, 9999px radius) over photography, and a #00834b green for promo notes.

unesco-stolen-objects-museum.name: UNESCO Virtual Museum of Stolen Cultural Objects
unesco-stolen-objects-museum.description: UNESCO Virtual Museum of Stolen Cultural Objects (museum.unesco.org), measured as its entry screen: a pale cloud-photograph canvas (#ece2db), dark brown #442d26 text, a salmon-pink #cb8d79 title line, Unbounded 40px display type with -2px tracking, Inter 16px body, and a pill-shaped Visit now button.

unhcr.name: UNHCR
unhcr.description: UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency (unhcr.org): white #ffffff and light grey #f5f5f5 bands, black #000000 text, UN blue #0072bc for navigation, hero and help actions, a yellow #faeb00 DONATE button with #212529 label, charcoal #343a40/#333333 emergency and footer bands. ProximaNova 400/700 — 42px hero, 32px section titles, 18px/25.2px body — with 4px button and 8px card radii.

unicef.name: UNICEF
unicef.description: UNICEF.org: a UNICEF cyan (#00aeef) header and footer around a white (#ffffff) and light-grey (#f1f1f1) page, Noto Sans throughout with a 48px/64px bold hero headline set white on a #111111 highlight strip, #111111 ink, 5px-radius elevated buttons (cyan with dark text, hover #008bbf; white with orange #d14808 Donate text; 3px outlined), and white 5px-radius story cards with Material-style shadows.

unilever.name: Unilever
unilever.description: Unilever Global (unilever.com) pairs its proprietary UnileverDesire typeface with Unilever Sky blue #0066cc for headings and buttons, Earth #f6f7f0 and white bands, Stone #4d4b46 body text, Night #133062, half-pill buttons (0 32px 32px 0) and 16px cards with sweeping 64px corner curves.

uninet-thailand.name: UniNet
uninet-thailand.description: UniNet Thailand (uni.net.th) home page measured live: Mitr Thai typeface at 16 to 44.5px, white canvas with #000000 text, orange #e1690f pill buttons (100px radius, 50px tall) with #05080f labels, a #05080f dark ThaiLIS band with #dddddd text, and a #f2f2f2 footer.

unisight-cdp.name: UniSight
unisight-cdp.description: UniSight CDP (unisight.asia) home page measured live: IBM Plex Sans Thai in regular, semi-bold and bold at up to 68px, black #000000 pill buttons (50px radius, 42px tall), a LINE-green #06c755 add-friend button, mint #2beaa4 cards with 24px radius, and a mint-to-blue gradient call-to-action band on white.

united-airlines-g.name: United Airlines
united-airlines-g.description: United Airlines' united.com booking site: white #ffffff canvas over a sky photograph, pale #f7f7f7 bands, black #000000 text, a vivid #1414d2 'United blue' for pill CTAs (30px radius) and links, hover darkening to #0d0d8f, 10px-radius inputs and cards, and the proprietary Neue Plak for United faces in Text Regular, Text SemiBold and Bold cuts.

united-carriers.name: United Carriers
united-carriers.description: United Carriers home page measured live: a black hero fading to white, near-black #111111 text, BT Steinhart uppercase 700 headlines at 71.1111px and BT Steinhart Mono button labels, Helvetica Neue 500 body at 20.7407px, square-cornered white buttons and 9999px-radius outlined pills.

united-information-highway-uih.name: United Information Highway (UIH)
united-information-highway-uih.description: United Information Highway (UIH) home page measured live: IBM Plex Sans Thai at weight 300 for 40px headlines and Looped at 400 for 16px body, white canvas with #f6f6fb cards, UIH blue #204882 pill buttons (40px radius, 53px tall) and soft grey #858585 body text, with a translucent #ffffffcc floating navigation bar.

united-nations.name: United Nations
united-nations.description: United Nations English home page (un.org/en) measured live: light grey #f2f2f2 canvas with #454545 Roboto text, Roboto Condensed 700 headlines at 32px with -0.77px tracking, a deep blue #0a5a82 button with square corners, UN blue #009edb outline on the DONATE button, and pale blue #eaf3fb and #e4effb panels.

unitedhealth-group.name: UnitedHealth Group
unitedhealth-group.description: UnitedHealth Group home page measured live: white canvas with warm #faf8f2 panels, OptumSans 700 headlines (44px, 0.44px tracking), a bright blue #0066f5 pill call-to-action (999px radius, 48px tall), navy #002677 statistic text, dark #323334 footer and 12 to 15px rounded image panels.

units.name: Units
units.description: Units (units.gr) is a Greek student-housing brand whose site is a bento grid of saturated, rounded color cards on a warm #f4e9e1 canvas, set in Bunch 850 display type at 64px and Aeonik Pro 14px body, with pill buttons at 33.33px radius and black ink on every colored tile.

unity.name: Unity
unity.description: Unity's site runs on a black (#000000) canvas with #141414 cards, white Inter body type and a geometric nohemi 500 display face (120px hero, 48px section heads, tight negative tracking). Actions are pill-shaped: a cobalt #3a5bc7 uppercase CTA with 3.6px tracking, #3358d4 'Get started' and #262626 nav pills at 32px; cards use 8px radius, pricing cards 16px on a light #f5f5f5 page.

universal-music-group.name: Universal Music Group
universal-music-group.description: Universal Music Group (universalmusic.com) presents its artist roster as a dark, full-bleed photographic carousel on a #222222 canvas, with light-weight uppercase Lato names in sky blue #2ab3e2, Glegoo serif navigation on a #000000 bar, square corners throughout and a 40px dark search input.

unkey.name: Unkey
unkey.description: Unkey's site pairs a near-black #040406 canvas with articulat-cf display type (64px/72px, weight 400), Inter UI text, JetBrains Mono labels, square white #ffffff buttons with #040406 labels that hover to #e3e4e9, 1px #2e3038 grid rules, a lime #def135 text highlight and a pale-blue gradient band.

unocss.name: UnoCSS
unocss.description: UnoCSS is an on-demand atomic CSS engine; its VitePress docs site uses the system UI sans stack, #3c3c43 ink on a #f6f6f7 and white canvas, a #00a98e teal brand with a #009ff7 gradient partner, and pill buttons with 20px radius and 12px-radius feature cards.

unreal-engine.name: Unreal Engine
unreal-engine.description: Epic Games' Unreal Engine site unrealengine.com measured live — a dark #101014 page with #18181c and #202024 elevated surfaces and 5%-white glass cards (24px radius), 65%-white #ffffffa6 body text, electric blue #26bbff buttons with #101014 labels (8px radius, #72d3ff hover), Inter Tight 700 headlines at 40px and Inter body at 16px/26.4px, built on an 'eds' CSS token set.

unseen-studio-2025-wrapped.name: Unseen Studio Year in Review 2025
unseen-studio-2025-wrapped.description: Unseen Studio's Year in Review 2025 microsite (2025.unseen.co) is a near-black #111111 scroll story with gold #e8b900 New Icon Script display type at 74.07px, bracketed uppercase DM Mono labels at 11.85px, Neue Montreal navigation, 7.41px image corners and per-client chapter colors.

unsplash.name: Unsplash
unsplash.description: Unsplash's photo-first interface is a strict monochrome system: white #ffffff canvas, Black #111111 ink and fills, Grey #767676 for secondary links and quiet controls, rendered in the platform's own UI sans stack (ui-sans-serif, system-ui) with a 40px/700 wordmark headline, 15px/500 body, 8px button radius and 32px compact buttons, so the masonry grid of photographs carries all of the colour.

untitled-ui.name: Untitled UI
untitled-ui.description: Marketing site for the Untitled UI Figma kit and React library: white canvas, mid-gray #525252 text, one violet #7f56d9 primary, Inter at 400 and 600, 44px headings, 8px button radius and soft ring-and-lift shadows.

untold-1.name: Untold
untold-1.description: Untold (untold.site) is a communications ecosystem whose site pairs a cream #fcfcf4 canvas and #232428 ink with signal-orange #ff5623 square buttons, enormous lowercase Geometric415Lite headlines at 120px to 168px with negative tracking, and rounded-pill and tilted-photo collage details.

uob-thailand.name: UOB Thailand
uob-thailand.description: UOB Thailand (uob.co.th personal banking, in Thai) uses a white canvas, #005eb8 UOB blue for the header, headings and footer, #0084ff for 5px-radius action buttons, Noto Sans Thai Light 36px headings, 16px Regular body and white 10px-radius promotion cards with a soft 15px shadow.

up-up.name: The Up&Up Group
up-up.description: The Up&Up Group (theupandupgroup.com), a South African creative group, sets giant 130.857px uppercase headlines that mix Inter 500 with ivypresto-display serif on a white canvas with #343434 ink, one copper-orange #f2623a accent, #f5f5f5 sections, 4px corners and hairline #c1c1c1 rules.

ups.name: UPS
ups.description: UPS (ups.com) runs a white, utility-first homepage set entirely in Roboto (400 headings at 48px/40px/32px, 16px/24px body, 500 for buttons and links), with UPS Gold (#ffc400) pill buttons 46px tall at a 40px radius that lighten to #ffd64c and gain a layered shadow on hover, near-black text #121212, link blue #0662bb, 16px-radius cards on warm off-white #fcfaf8, a #f2f1ef utility bar and a UPS brown (#351c15) footer.

upstash.name: Upstash
upstash.description: Upstash's serverless-data site: a #f5f5f5 canvas with white panels, deep-green #022c22 ink, an emerald #00bc7d primary button with 12px corners, Inter Tight 128px/700 display headlines over Inter body text, JetBrains Mono code on #09090b panels, and mint #04785714 cards rounded at 16px.

urban-jurgensen.name: Urban Jürgensen
urban-jurgensen.description: Urban Jürgensen (urbanjurgensen.com), a Swiss watchmaker founded in 1773, uses a #600b1a burgundy entry screen, a #f9f5ef paper page with a tiled paper texture, uppercase uj serif display type at 64px with 1.92px tracking, wea sans at 14px, hairline #c7c4bf outlined buttons and square corners.

usa-gov.name: USAGov
usa-gov.description: USA.gov (USAGov), the U.S. government's official guide to services, built with the U.S. Web Design System: Source Sans Pro Web body text at 18.08px/27.12px in #1b1b1b on #ffffff, Merriweather Web 700 headlines at 31.2px, navy #112f4e 4px-radius buttons that invert to white with a #0081a1 border on hover, #1a4480 links, a cyan #00bde3 search button and a pale #d2ebf1 topic grid of white cards with 2px #0081a1 borders.

usavionix.name: USAvionix
usavionix.description: USAvionix (usavionix.com) presents jet-drone ISR and defense systems on a #000000 canvas with Geist 600 headings (50px, -1.5px tracking), Geist Mono uppercase 13px labels, translucent #ffffff40 pill buttons, cyan #7aebff accents and white text at 80% opacity.

usva.name: usva
usva.description: usva (usva.build) design system site: a deep violet-black #0a0613 canvas, muted lavender #8b85a8 ink and a #a78bfa violet accent, set in Fira Sans 800 at 177.32px with -7.0928px tracking, glass-pill buttons with 16px radii and layered fog shadows.

uswds-cfpb.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
uswds-cfpb.description: The CFPB site (consumerfinance.gov) is built on the bureau's open-source CFPB Design System: a white canvas (#ffffff) with pale gray bands (#f7f8f9), near-black ink (#101820), Pacific blue (#0072ce) for links and the standard button, and the CFPB green (#20aa3f) reserved for the thick rules under the header and above the footer. Type is Source Sans 3 Variable at 16px/22px body and 34px/42.5px semibold display, with a restrained 4px radius.

utopia-tokyo.name: Utopia Tokyo
utopia-tokyo.description: Utopia Tokyo (utopiatokyo.com), a masks-and-future-Tokyo web experience, uses a #14171f ink-navy canvas with #ff1919 signal red display type, #ebe5ce cream text, PPMori 600 headlines at 175.36px, Zpix pixel-font labels, ghosted #647d9633 buttons and strictly square 0px corners.

utrecht.name: Gemeente Utrecht
utrecht.description: Gemeente Utrecht's municipal site (www.utrecht.nl) is a civic service portal in Noto Sans Variable: a flat #cc0000 Utrecht red for the search button and footer, a #24578f blue for service tiles, square 0px buttons, 24px/600 panel headings, a #262626 main navigation bar, and brick-street photography.

v0.name: v0
v0.description: v0 by Vercel uses a #fafafa canvas with white #ffffff cards on 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) rings, GeistSans 600 headings with tight tracking (32px/40px at -1.28px; 48px/56px at -2.88px), a 16px/24px system-stack body in #666666, #171717 ink, and 32px-tall #171717 buttons with 8px radius beside pill chips.

va-gov.name: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA.gov)
va-gov.description: VA.gov homepage built on the VA Design System: deep navy #162e51 chrome, USWDS-style blue #005ea2 primary with 4px-radius 40px buttons, Bitter slab-serif headings at 40px and Source Sans Pro 16.96px body on white, flat color-band sections.

vacheron-constantin.name: Vacheron Constantin
vacheron-constantin.description: Vacheron Constantin (vacheron-constantin.com, international English home) is a quiet luxury watch site on a #f8f0e5 cream canvas with #412c17 brown ink, Prelo serif headings at 40px, Sohne sans body at 13px, uppercase letterspaced 12px links with hairline underlines and no rounded corners.

val-town.name: Val Town
val-town.description: Val Town's home page sets Sprig Sans at weight 400 (48px/57.6px hero, -1.2px) in pure #000000 on white, with a sky-blue #00bcff 'Sign Up' button (12px radius, #052f4a text), slate-bordered #f8fafc chips, #00598a links and a warm #f8f4f2 prompt card — framed by hand-drawn isometric city illustrations.

valentino.name: Valentino
valentino.description: Valentino homepage measured at www.valentino.com/en-us: a white canvas (#ffffff) with black text (#000000), a Times New Roman display line at 24px, DINPro 12px interface text with 0.5px tracking, square corners, and translucent charcoal (#25252599) overlay buttons on photography.

valve.name: Valve Corporation
valve.description: Valve Corporation (valvesoftware.com) presents its careers-style home in pure #000000 black with #f74843 red apercu 900 headings (70px department links, 38px intro) over ultra-light 200-weight white 22px body copy, a red footer panel and zero rounded corners.

van-cleef-and-arpels.name: Van Cleef & Arpels
van-cleef-and-arpels.description: Van Cleef & Arpels (vancleefarpels.com, US English home) is a white and #f5f5f5 high-jewelry site with Janson Text serif headings at 45px, Maison Neue Book body at 16px, uppercase 13px labels with 1.5px tracking, black ink, hairline #dddddd rules and no button fills.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.description: Vanguard's corporate portal page (investor.vanguard.com/corporate-portal): FF Mark in 400-900 weights, a single crimson #c20029 hero panel on white #ffffff, near-black #000000 text, dark red #96151d hover accent, square corners, no shadows, 17px/24px body and 34px/900 headings.

vanilla-extract.name: Vanilla Extract
vanilla-extract.description: Vanilla Extract's docs site pairs Shrikhand italic display headlines (52px) with DM Sans headings, on mint #cbfbf1 and sky-blue #dff2fe sections cut by slanted edges, a dark #101828 pill button with a 28px radius, and code panels set in a monospace face.

vant.name: Youzan (有赞)
vant.description: Youzan (有赞) home page, a Chinese retail-SaaS marketing site on a white canvas (#ffffff) with near-black ink (#323233 body, #1d1d1f headings), a single bright blue action color (#3370ff) on pill buttons (26px radius, 52px tall), a system font stack (-apple-system with PingFang SC fallbacks) at 400/600 weights, and 16px rounded white cards over a pale blue hero wash.

vast.name: Vast
vast.description: Vast (vastspace.com): space-station maker styled as an engineering firm: Owners 500 display at 76px/65.36px, Owners Text body, Phonic labels, meteorite-black #2a2c2f on warm-white #fdfcf4, moon-rock #b3aba3 bands, single solar-orange #ff5623 accent, square 0px corners, no visible shadows.

vaulk.name: Vaulk
vaulk.description: Vaulk (vaulk.com/en-GB): modular CBRN shelters in UHPC, shown through a dark #0c0c0c ground, Telegraf 500 white type at 48px/57.6px, thin white wireframe drawings, one alert-orange #f4682b accent, light #eceeed form surfaces and nearly square 1.78px corners.

vectr.name: Vectr
vectr.description: Vectr (vectrfl.com): field-crew activation brand in Roboto 400/500 with 96px/86.4px display at -5.76px tracking, navy #050419 on off-white #fcfcfc, sky-blue #d0e1eb ground, 156px pill buttons 48px tall, cobalt symbol, no shadows.

venmo.name: Venmo
venmo.description: Venmo home page (venmo.com), measured — white #ffffff canvas with Venmo blue #4bb4ff and Stash purple #3f34ee feature bands, black #000000 pill buttons (1000px radius) with white text, #f5f5f7 grey pills hovering to #e1e1e3, Venmo Sans 60.29px/700 headlines with tight negative tracking, 14px/400 body, 32px-radius cards.

vercel.name: Vercel
vercel.description: Vercel marketing homepage: a #fafafa near-white canvas with near-black #171717 headlines and pill buttons, set entirely in Geist Sans (400-500 weight, tight negative tracking from -0.96px to -3.84px) with Geist Mono for code. Cards are 6px-radius surfaces outlined by a hairline shadow ring rather than a fill or a drop shadow.

verizon.name: Verizon
verizon.description: Verizon consumer home page: Verizon red #ee001e hero and 2px outlined 24px-radius cards on white #ffffff, electric yellow #f8ff3c 44px pill buttons with red labels, 128px/700 Verizon-NHG-DS display type, yellow circular price stickers and glossy 3D objects.

vero-new-york.name: Vero
vero-new-york.description: Vero (verostudio.com): luxury fine-art wedding-dress sculpture studio with a cinematic film hero over warm beige #f3f0ed, near-black #181615 text, Louize Display serif capitals with Beausite Classic 500 sans, 2px corners, no shadows, very sparse editorial layout.

vestas.name: Vestas
vestas.description: Vestas (vestas.com/en): wind-energy manufacturer styled in VestasSans weight 200 headlines (56px/50px) in Vestas blue #005aff on white and #e3e5e8 gray bands, navy #1f3144 text and footer, full-bleed turbine photography, circled-arrow links and 50% circles, no shadows.

vibrant.name: Vibrant
vibrant.description: Lively, colorful design with bold playful typography, warm accents, and dynamic visual energy.

vibrant-wellness.name: Vibrant Wellness
vibrant-wellness.description: Vibrant Wellness interactive experience (vibrant.noomoagency.com, built by Noomo Agency): pastel lavender #d9cffb hero with a glossy 3D bust, PlusJakarta Sans 16px body and 80px headline, Ubuntu Mono caps toggles, ink #282f3c, blue #0774c4 labels, glass white pills and circles.

villa-market.name: Villa Market
villa-market.description: Villa Market's online grocery storefront (shop.villamarket.com) — a light-grey canvas (#eeeeee) with white product cards, a Villa red (#c72027) for the recommended strip, prices and badges, a deep navy (#2c2a74) navigation bar and headings, green cart buttons (#178841), and the system UI sans-serif stack at weights 400 to 800.

vimeo.name: Vimeo
vimeo.description: Vimeo's home page alternates Vimeo White (#fafcfd) and Vimeo Black (#141a20) bands, with Vimeo Blue #17d5ff on 12px-radius 48px buttons with dark text, ABC Repro 500 headlines at 72px with -3.6px tracking, #4c5864 body text, 16px-radius video cards and a lime #d6e96d announcement bar.

vintage.name: Vintage
vintage.description: 1950s-1990s nostalgia with skeuomorphic touches, grainy textures, retro color palettes, and pixel-style typography.

virgin-atlantic.name: Virgin Atlantic
virgin-atlantic.description: Virgin Atlantic's 'Tailwind' digital design system as shipped on virginatlantic.com — Gotham served only at light weights (300/325/350), Virgin red #da0530 for every filled CTA (hover #b1062b, active #9a0728), near-black ink #030c16 on white, 4px-radius rectangular buttons and inputs 48px tall, a full-width red booking band, Upper Class purple #4f145b, a #111921 footer, and a semantic token set named --color-{background|text|icon|border}-{intent}-{variant}-{state}.

viriyah.name: Viriyah Insurance
viriyah.description: Viriyah Insurance (viriyah.co.th/en): Thai insurer in royal blue #1434a2 and gold #fcaf17 on white, DBSathornMedium 48px/500 headings with DBSathornX 18px body, flush 80px square header tabs, 20px and 4px radius cards with soft shadows, photography-led split blocks.

visa.name: Visa
visa.description: Visa.com (en-US) marketing site — white canvas, near-black ink (#1a1a1a), the Visa Blue family (#1434cb primary, #0d2181 hover, #d9dffb tint) against a deep navy (#020f27) band, and one proprietary Dialect typeface at regular weight, with a 64px hero at -1.2px tracking, 1000px-radius pill buttons and photography-led three-up cards.

vite.name: Vite
vite.description: Vite (vite.dev) is a near-black #16171d page built on VoidZero's VitePress theme: APK Protocol display type (60px/500, -3px tracking), Inter body at 16px/26px in 70%-white #ffffffb2, KH Teka Mono uppercase labels, a white #ffffff 8px-radius 'Get Started' button, Vite violet #b39aff hover accents, #3b3440 hairlines and deep purple #370a7f glows and banners.

vitra.name: Vitra
vitra.description: Vitra's US online shop (vitra.com/en-us) is a white, gallery-like system set in the bespoke Lineto-refined corporate Futura served as vitraFutura and vitraFuturaV2: 50px/400 hero titles over full-bleed photography, 40px/44px section heads in #101010, 17px/500 #333333 navigation that turns signal red #d43e42 on hover, ghost CTAs drawn as 1px rules above and below the label, #333333 5px-radius Buy buttons that darken to #101010, #f7f7f7 newsletter band and 0px photo corners.

vmware-clarity.name: VMware by Broadcom
vmware-clarity.description: The VMware by Broadcom homepage: Metropolis in thin 300 weight at 50px for headlines and 16px body in grey #565656, a deep-navy hero (#1b1d36), one corporate blue (#005c8a) for uppercase 14px buttons with 3px corners and for card titles, white cards with a soft blue-tinted 14px shadow, and isometric parallelogram illustrations in blue, teal, green and purple.

vocom-international-telecommunication.name: Vocom International Telecommunication
vocom-international-telecommunication.description: Vocom International Telecommunication (vocom.com): telecom wholesaler home page with a data-center photo hero, VOCOM wordmark in white Lato 700 70.6667px on an indigo #20124d label, mint #9dcfc4 services field, three-column square photo tiles, no shadows or buttons.

vodafone.name: Vodafone
vodafone.description: Vodafone Group corporate homepage: red #e60000 pill buttons (60px radius, 800-weight 15.3967px labels) over full-bleed photography and a deep red gradient, with white and #25282b ink, and all type in the Vodafone family loaded in weights 300 to 800, with uppercase 115.435px headlines at -1px tracking.

vogue.name: Vogue
vogue.description: Vogue's US home page vogue.com measured live — a white #ffffff editorial grid with black #000000 type and square black SUBSCRIBE NOW buttons, #636363 bylines, a #f8f8f8 promo strip and a black footer, set almost entirely in Vogue Avant Garde (32px/600 lead headline, 22px uppercase section heads with +1.6px tracking, 13px/600 buttons with +1.1px) plus Adobe Garamond Pro for serif accents.

voice-tv.name: Voice TV
voice-tv.description: Voice TV (voicetv.co.th): Thai news portal in Dindan Mai type, a white 94px header with uppercase 16px/700 links, orange #f66604 tag and red #dd2027 LIVE outline, three-column story cards on #f4f4f4 gray with #eeeeee and #333333 panels, square #e6e6e6 button, tiny 4px radii.

voku-studiotm.name: Voku.Studio™
voku-studiotm.description: Voku.Studio™ is a Madrid creative studio working with AI; its site is an off-white #fffdfc canvas with near-black #0a0a0a text, a 10.6666px Archivo interface layer, an 80px custom vokufont wordmark, zero border radius and a fanned arc of project thumbnails.

volkswagen.name: Volkswagen
volkswagen.description: Volkswagen's US home (vw.com) pairs a warm #f6f5f2 canvas and #1b2236 midnight ink with the proprietary vw-head and vw-text families, 100px pill buttons 44px tall, 12px and 8px image corners, and full-bleed vehicle hero photography on black.

voltagent.name: VoltAgent
voltagent.description: VoltAgent marketing site: a near-black #050507 page with #101010 panels, emerald #10b981 and mint #2fd6a1 accents, warm grey #8a8380 body copy, Inter for body and a system-ui stack for 60px headlines at -0.65px tracking. Outlined buttons with 6px radius, 8px bordered cards, and code and product windows replace imagery.

volvo-cars.name: Volvo Cars
volvo-cars.description: Volvo Car USA's home page: white #ffffff and #fafafa surfaces, black #000000 headings and #5e5e5e secondary text, black and white 9999px pill buttons 48px tall, sand #f7f3f0 model bands, a single blue accent #0b2ded, and one typeface, Volvo Centum, from 12px/0.24px disclaimers to a 320px 'For Life.' footer statement.

vox.name: Vox
vox.description: Vox is an explanatory news site built on a white #ffffff page with #131313 text, a loud #fff200 yellow masthead and Sign Up button, balto sans headlines, harriet serif deck copy at 14px, Roboto Mono 12px kickers, and near-square 1px to 2px corners.

vp-infotech-visperhost.name: VisperHost
vp-infotech-visperhost.description: VisperHost (VP InfoTech Co., Ltd.) is a Thai VPS and hosting provider whose site runs entirely in Kanit: white #ffffff canvas, #0059e8 electric-blue pill buttons 39px tall, a #273647 slate stats band, #242424 footer and 10px rounded white service cards.

vtex-styleguide.name: VTEX
vtex-styleguide.description: The VTEX commerce-suite marketing site (vtex.com/en-us): VTEXTrust type at 60px/700 with negative tracking, deep navy ink #142032, Rebel Pink #f71963 for buttons and highlights, a pale blue-white canvas #f5f9ff, 16px button radius and translucent frosted cards over a pink-to-cyan gradient.

vue-ds.name: Vue Design System
vue-ds.description: Vue Design System's landing page sets a deep navy faceted hero with a five-tile red-to-gold VUEDS wordmark above a white features grid, in light-weight (300) Fira type at 56px, a #1070d1 blue Download button with 3px corners and a soft 57.6px shadow, and gray #6e6e6e body copy.

vuetify.name: Vuetify
vuetify.description: Vuetify, the Material Design component framework for Vue: default theme primary #1867c0 on white, Roboto at 57px/700 for hero headlines and 14px/500 buttons, 36px-high buttons with 4px radius (44px and 8px for hero CTAs), two-layer Material shadows, and a dark surface of #212121.

waabi.name: Waabi
waabi.description: Waabi, the autonomous trucking and robotaxi company, uses a white #ffffff canvas with #191818 near-black text, a #ff2c6b pink action color on 48px pill buttons, a 150px Zagma serif hero with -6.4px tracking, NeueHaas UI text, and 12px rounded photo tiles.

wacoal-thailand.name: Wacoal Thailand (Thai Wacoal Public Company Limited)
wacoal-thailand.description: Wacoal Thailand's shop: Prompt typeface on a white canvas, near-black (#1c1c1c) uppercase VIEW ALL buttons, a sale-price red (#e32c2b), 8px product cards and full-bleed lifestyle photography with a pink-and-cream campaign palette.

wai-wai.name: Wai Wai (Thai Preserved Food Factory)
wai-wai.description: The Thai-language corporate site of Wai Wai (ไวไว), Thai Preserved Food Factory Company Limited — a warm greige canvas (#f0ebe9) holding white news cards, a deep green footer band (#3a5b4f) carrying product-pack tiles, Prompt at weights 300 and 400 for Thai text, Helvetica Neue for Latin links, and #337ab7 blue for every link.

walgreens.name: Walgreens
walgreens.description: Walgreens' home page sets Inter UI text in charcoal #413d3c on white with a #62002e wine promotional ground, Tiempos Headline serif display at 36px, crimson #a32a33 brand action color, 8px rounded white promo buttons and 45px pill Clip buttons.

walmart.name: Walmart
walmart.description: Walmart's US home page uses EverydaySans on a #ffffff canvas over a #f1f1f1 page ground with #2e2f32 text, a #0053e2 blue brand fill for the header and deal tiles, #2a8703 green prices, #ffc220 spark yellow, 8px rounded tiles and 9999px pill search.

walrus.name: Walrus
walrus.description: Walrus, the data platform for AI, is a black #000000 site with warm off-white #faf8f5 text and panels, Ratch headlines at 72px, Google Sans Flex body at weight 350, uppercase Google Sans Code mono links, #53575a outlined 26px pill buttons and 6px cards.

warm-editorial.name: Warm Editorial
warm-editorial.description: A serif-led magazine aesthetic. Terracotta accent on warm off-white paper —

warm-fuzzy.name: Warm & Fuzzy
warm-fuzzy.description: Warm & Fuzzy, a self-described feel-good creative company, runs a black #000000 site of white SuisseIntl type with tight negative tracking, 132px uppercase section titles, a showreel hero, #190bb6 cobalt, #f7dd47 yellow and #e74a27 orange blocks, and circular 50% thumbnails.

warp.name: Warp
