warp.description: Warp homepage: a white and #fbfdfd canvas with ink #1a1522, electric indigo #2a1eff accents, and a yellow #eef17c demo button, set almost entirely in Azeret Mono at 54px/-2px headlines. Uppercase 12px buttons with 4px radius, blueprint-style framed figures, and dotted data-grid illustrations.

watershed.name: Watershed
watershed.description: Watershed (watershed.com), the enterprise sustainability AI platform: a white #ffffff and pale cobalt #f5f8ff canvas, deep navy #041330 bands, and Cobalt #265cff as the single action colour (hover #1246e0). Type is Messina Sans (served as messinaSans) in weight 500 with tight tracking - 72px/72px hero at -2.88px - body 20px/30px in slate #666c80, plus GeistMono 14px eyebrows and P22 Mackinac (mackinacPro) serif quotes. Corners are nearly square: 2px buttons and inputs, 44-47px tall controls.

watson.name: Watson
watson.description: Watson is a Los Angeles creative studio whose site is pure black #000000 type on an off-white #fefefe canvas: a 284.877px stacked WATSON wordmark in the ca face with -12.8195px tracking, serif statements, 17.3056px ba body text and zero border radius.

waymo.name: Waymo
waymo.description: Waymo, the autonomous ride-hail service, sets GT-Walsheim with tight negative tracking on white #ffffff and deep #050f1e navy-black, with a #006fee blue 40px pill CTA, an electric #0077ff accent for statistics, a #00e89d mint, and large 16px to 40px rounded panels.

web-awesome.name: Web Awesome
web-awesome.description: Web Awesome is an open source web-component library; its own site uses cera-round-pro headings at 52px/600, system sans body at 16px, a burnt-orange brand #cb4b27 on 6px-radius buttons, near-white #f1f2f3 bands and a #1b1d26 ink, while the docs default theme ships a blue #0071ec brand.

webflow.name: Webflow
webflow.description: Webflow homepage: white canvas with near-black #080808 ink, a single saturated blue #146ef5 (hover #0055d4) for 4px-radius buttons, and WF Visual Sans Variable at weight 600 for 74.8571px headlines with -0.748571px tracking; dark product screenshots and customer logo walls carry the imagery.

weights-and-biases.name: Weights & Biases
weights-and-biases.description: Weights & Biases (wandb.ai/site), the AI developer platform now part of CoreWeave: charcoal #1a1c1f and #282a2f surfaces, white Source Serif 4 headlines at 72px/600, Source Sans 3 20px/30px body, teal #00afc2 links and a #10bfcc-to-#0097ab gradient CTA at 8px radius, gold #ffcc33 accents and uppercase 0.96px-tracked buttons.

welcome-ui.name: Welcome to the Jungle
welcome-ui.description: Welcome to the Jungle's homepage runs on its own Welcome UI system: a saturated #ffcd00 yellow hero canvas with black ink, a #f6f3ef warm page body, 48px weight-900 headlines in the custom welcome-font at -2% tracking, Work Sans 16px body and 8px-radius buttons 42px tall.

wembi.name: Wembi
wembi.description: Wembi, an industrial IoT digital-twin company, uses a warm #ede8e8 canvas with black HaasUnicaSH type, a #c0dfe9 pale-blue stage, a #beff8b lime accent with a lime display wordmark in the ductile face, an 86.6667px headline and tab-shaped N° buttons with 6.67px top corners.

west-elm.name: West Elm
west-elm.description: West Elm's storefront is a white (#ffffff) editorial canvas with near-black #212121 ink, Commercial Type's Sanomat serif at weight 300 for display (48px/60px hero with 0.96px tracking, 28px section titles) and Grilli Type's GT Eesti Text at weights 300 and 375 for everything else, with tracked uppercase labels. Actions are square-cornered (0px radius) #212121 rectangles with white uppercase 14px text and 1.4px tracking, a white twin on photography, and a #f4f4f4 footer.

wework.name: WeWork
wework.description: WeWork (wework.com) runs a black-and-white editorial system: white #ffffff page, #000000 ink with #444444 secondary text, a custom webfont served as "Serif" at weight 400 for every headline (56px/61.6px hero, 36px/40px sections, 24px/32px card titles), Apercu 400/600 for UI and body (16px/25.888px, the 1.618 golden-ratio line height), and a soft periwinkle brand blue #678fff for 8px-radius CTAs that hover to #3b5bbe with white text; cards are 12px-radius with a 1px #e6e6e6 border and a 20px grey glow.

what-the-duck.name: What The Duck
what-the-duck.description: Dark record-label site for What The Duck (Thailand): black #000000 canvas, white text, amber #fcb93d accent on nav and pill buttons, Lulo Clean bold headings with 3.6px tracking, Avenir light body at 15px, square art tiles and 9999px pill buttons.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: WhatsApp's site sits on a warm cream canvas (#fcf5eb) with deep #111b21 bands and a mint #e6ffda strip; WhatsApp green #25d366 fills 50px-radius pill buttons with dark #1c1e21 text and a 1px outline, and WhatsApp Sans Var headlines run large and light at 80px/400.

whimsical.name: Whimsical
whimsical.description: Whimsical (whimsical.com), "the whiteboard for product builders": Agrandir 700 headlines at 64px and 96px with slight negative tracking, Manrope 16px UI and body text, a #250835 deep-plum 12px-radius Get started free button with a soft plum shadow, a #f7f7f8 page, and huge 120px–160px-radius panels filled with grainy pastel sunset gradients.

white-desert.name: White Desert
white-desert.description: Luxury Antarctic expedition site: full-bleed ice film under a 227.555px uppercase Oswald headline, Cardinal Classic Long serif titles, Inter Tight UI at 12.4444px, navy #1f2a44 text on white, orange #ff7e15 hover accent and 2px-radius translucent nav buttons.

white-house.name: The White House
white-house.description: Official US presidential website: deep navy #0d132d and white with a burgundy #8b1a1a pill accent, Instrument Serif statements at 30px, Instrument Sans body at 14px, wide uppercase Nord navigation with 1.8px tracking, full-bleed photographic tiles.

who.name: World Health Organization (WHO)
who.description: WHO public site: navy #00205c Noto Sans bold on white and #f6f7f9 grey, 50px hero headline on a translucent navy plate, 18px card titles, square-cornered 40px buttons, 4px-radius cards and a #0c2b64 footer; documentary photography, no shadows.

whole-foods.name: Whole Foods Market
whole-foods.description: Whole Foods Market online store: single brand green #004e36 on white and warm #f8f7f5, Corda Std serif headlines at 70px, Circular Pro 16px body, 2px-radius green buttons with #006f46 hover, pill search field and overlapping white promo cards on food photography.

whoop.name: WHOOP
whoop.description: WHOOP's wearable storefront — stark black #000000 and white #ffffff sections, full-bleed athletic photography and video, a single proxima-nova family with huge light-weight headlines (120px/400, line-height 96px, -3.6px tracking) and tight negative tracking everywhere, uppercase bold CTA labels with 10% letter-spacing on 16px-radius buttons in electric accent #4a53ff, black or white, 24px-radius membership cards with soft radial gradients, and a black footer with #999999 links.

wieden-kennedy.name: Wieden+Kennedy
wieden-kennedy.description: Wieden+Kennedy agency site: black and white bands, Univers LT Std Light (weight 300) at 68px display and 45px statements, grey #6c757d captions, full-bleed campaign imagery with +OFFICE tags, circular 50% controls and no shadows or filled buttons.

wikipedia.name: Wikipedia
wikipedia.description: The wikipedia.org portal is a white, centred, text-first page built on Wikimedia's Codex tokens — the system sans stack (-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Inter, Helvetica, Arial) at 13–16px, a Linux Libertine serif h1 at 32px/700, progressive blue #3366cc links and search button (hover #3056a9), #202122 base text with #54595d subtle text, #f8f9fa interactive-subtle fills, #a2a9b1 borders and a 2px base radius.

wild-week-athens.name: Wild Week – Athens (2026)
wild-week-athens.description: Event page for Wild Week Athens 2026: bento tile mosaic on #cbcbcb and #dcdbd5 greys, one saturated blue #0755bb for all text, Albertus Nova Light 18px uppercase titles with 0.72px tracking, 10px body, 4px and 8px radii and classical plaster relief imagery.

wildy-riftian-portfolio.name: Wildy Riftian
wildy-riftian-portfolio.description: Portfolio of Wildy Riftian: black, #171717 and #f5f5f5 bands with one electric yellow #ffe430 card, Lock Serif Light display at 80px, uppercase JetBrains Mono 12px and 14px interface text, 6px radii and a faint upward shadow.

wimbledon.name: Wimbledon
wimbledon.description: The Championships, Wimbledon official site (wimbledon.com): white #ffffff canvas, #121619 ink, Wimbledon green #006633 for links and actions, deep green #0b2917 header and bands, purple #540082 Caslon eyebrows, cool grey #f2f4f8 layers. Gotham uppercase headings (40px/700, 32px/700 with tight negative tracking), Gotham 16px/24px body, 8px card radius.

windsurf.name: Devin Desktop
windsurf.description: Devin Desktop (devin.ai/desktop, where windsurf.com now redirects; the page calls it 'the new name for Windsurf') uses NB International Pro at weight 400 (64px/-1.92px display), #191919 ink on a #fcfcfc canvas, black #000000 pill and #363636 2px-radius download buttons, GeistMono uppercase labels in accent blue #317cff, and white 12px-radius product cards.

wired.name: WIRED
wired.description: WIRED is a technology-news front page built from black, white and pale gray: WiredDisplay headlines at 64px with -0.5px tracking, Breve Text body at 16px, uppercase WIRED Mono labels, square-cornered black buttons (0px radius, #000000) and #f3f3f3 ad bands, with all color supplied by photography and illustration.

wise.name: Wise
wise.description: Wise pairs a bright green (#9fe870) hero field with forest-green (#163300) ink and pill buttons, setting display type in the proprietary Wise Sans at weight 900 (86.86px) and everything else in Inter 600, with round-cornered cards (10-36px radii) and almost no shadows.

wisesight.name: Wisesight
wisesight.description: Wisesight (Thai social data analytics) design system: Kanit headlines at 86px weight 500, light Sarabun body, white canvas, near-black navy #101820 pill buttons, maroon #850219 accent and 12px cards.

wix.name: Wix
wix.description: Wix.com's home page is a bright white #ffffff canvas with black #000000 Wix Madefor Display headlines (73.3334px/400, -1.46667px tracking), Madefor Text body at 16px/24px, a blue #166aea 'Start for free' pill (42px radius, hover #2d83ff), black 50px-radius 'Get Started' pills, butter-yellow #fff1ac and sage #d2e4c7 color washes, and a glowing pill search field.

wmca.name: West Midlands Combined Authority
wmca.description: The WMCA public site (wmca.org.uk) is a civic-service design built on the shipped wmcads stylesheet: a warm near-white canvas (#fcfcfc), charcoal ink (#231f20), Furnace-style orange (#c05701) for the hero panel, buttons and icons, and a teal-blue (#007da8) for underlined headline links. DM Sans 700 sets headings (46px display), Noto Sans Display sets body at 16px/24px, corners are a restrained 5px, and the header and footer sit on charcoal.

wolff-olins.name: Wolff Olins
wolff-olins.description: Global brand consultancy site: white and black with grey text ramp and one acid yellow #fff84b footer, Untitled Serif statement at 64px with -1.76px tracking, Monument Grotesk 20px and 16px interface text, full-bleed project carousel and pill-shaped controls.

wolverine-worldwide.name: Wolverine Worldwide
wolverine-worldwide.description: Wolverine World Wide corporate site: black, white and grey with ABC Diatype bold at 168px and -8.4px tracking, 33px statements, translucent #0000001a buttons, 12px radii, a rounded #010101 footer and outdoor lifestyle photography.

won-j-you-studios-2.name: Won J. You Studios
won-j-you-studios-2.description: Won J. You Studios: near-black design-mentorship portfolio (#0a0a0a body, #050505 rail) with coral #ef5143 uppercase avantt 800 headlines at 168.667px, cream #fee9ce navigation, orange #ffb261 connect tab, flat surfaces and zero shadows.

wonderflow.name: Wonderflow
wonderflow.description: Wonderflow marketing site for its agentic consumer-intelligence platform: system-ui sans at bold 700 with tight tracking (52.4442px display, 20px body), a single brand red #e00000 (hover #c10000) on 4px-radius buttons, slate text #444954 over white and #f8f9fa, and one near-black #1f2227 band. The look comes from the open-source Wanda design system's tokens.

wongnai.name: Wongnai
wongnai.description: Wongnai (wongnai.com), Thailand's restaurant and lifestyle review platform, renders a light-grey #edf0f2 page with white 8px-radius content blocks, Thai type in the self-hosted DB Heavent Now (400/500/700) over a Helvetica Neue base, a #0093e8 blue for search, tabs and links, a #3d4245 grey ink, small 8px cards with a soft rgba(0,0,0,0.08) shadow, and dark-red #880b0b rating badges.

wookco.name: Wookco
wookco.description: Wookco (sustainable travel booking) design system: Plus Jakarta Sans 48px headings with Inter body, white canvas, emerald #286648 primary, navy #1a263f ink and pills, coral #f5835b promos and 22px cards with a navy-tinted soft shadow.

wordpress.name: WordPress
wordpress.description: The WordPress.org homepage pairs EB Garamond display headlines at 70px with Inter body text at 16px, a single blueberry action color #3858e9 on 2px-radius rectangular buttons, light-grey #f6f6f6 bands, and a near-black #1e1e1e showcase section. Pill-shaped 9999px rounding appears only on small items; everything else is flat with hairline #d9d9d9 borders.

work-co.name: Work & Co
work-co.description: Work & Co (part of Accenture Song) runs a near-monochrome editorial system — pure #ffffff canvas, #000000 ink, and a single red signal in two shades (#ff3029 logo/top bar, #db2223 links). Headlines are Monotype's HelveticaNowDisplay at weight 500 with tight negative tracking (56px/56px/-1.12px h1), body copy is Adobe Garamond Pro (adobe-garamond-pro) at 20px/30px, the only filled button is a black 50px-radius pill (10px 25px, 47px tall), and everything else is hairline dividers (#dddddd) on a 12-column, 750/1100/1800px breakpoint grid with zero shadows and square imagery.

workday.name: Workday
workday.description: Workday's marketing site is a deep-navy canvas (#022043) set in Acid Grotesk at weights 400 to 800 (56px display, -2% tracking), with white text, a blue pill CTA (#0057ae, 24px radius) and gradient-washed AI storytelling; its Sana Canvas design system documents tokens on an 8px grid, Roboto and Sana Sans VF type, and a navy (#000080) pill button.

working-stiff-films.name: Working Stiff Films
working-stiff-films.description: Working Stiff Films: comedic commercial-production studio site with a cream #f0ecd9 and slate #282d35 palette, red #d93535 accent, Grand Bold uppercase display at 71.104px, PP Neue Montreal text, 5px corners and a toothy mascot illustration.

workloft.name: The Work Loft
workloft.description: The Work Loft (theworkloft.com), a coworking, meeting-room and private-office space in Silom, Bangkok. Raleway 700 headings, Avenir Light body at 15px, raspberry #e42c54 buttons and feature panels with 6px radius, charcoal #3c4444 text and footer, white canvas and a #fafafa section tint.

workos.name: WorkOS
workos.description: WorkOS's site sets Untitled Sans 500 headlines very tight (80px/84px at -5.6px) on white #ffffff and #f9f9fb sections with #29363d ink, uses a brand purple #6363f1 pill CTA (100px radius, hover #7777f3) and a glowing mint #23f0c3 pill on the deep navy #030527 developer band, with layered soft shadows on cards.

workpoint.name: Workpoint Entertainment
workpoint.description: Workpoint Entertainment: Thai TV and entertainment group site with navy #222963 and #10132d grounds, electric blue #3a6ad9 accent, white Outfit 700 uppercase hero at 138.366px, Sarabun for Thai, square outlined buttons and 4px card radius.

world-bank.name: World Bank Group
world-bank.description: World Bank Group: international development portal with navy #012740 feature bands, pale #e7edf3 sections, blue #0071bc and #004370 pill buttons at 32px radius, Open Sans 700 at 48px, 8px bordered stat cards and no shadows.

world-economic-forum.name: World Economic Forum
world-economic-forum.description: World Economic Forum: global institution portal with a #0065f2 blue hero, white AkkuratLLWeb 900 headlines at 40px, pill buttons, 12px-radius story cards, soft two-layer shadows and uppercase 14px tracked category labels.

world-internetwork.name: InternetThai
world-internetwork.description: InternetThai: Thai internet and hosting provider site with charcoal #333333 header and footer, grey #f3f3f3 service band, orange #e47b2a icons, Roboto and Kanit weight 400, 60px hero and 6px-radius service tiles with a soft grey shadow.

world-internetwork-corporation-otaro.name: OTARO
world-internetwork-corporation-otaro.description: OTARO: Thai telephony and hosting operator site with brand blue #2468b3, grey #f3f3f3 service band, charcoal #333333 footer, Roboto and Kanit weight 400, 55px hero title, outlined ghost button and 6px-radius soft-shadow service tiles.

wpp.name: WPP
wpp.description: WPP: global communications group site on a white canvas with navy #000050 text and controls, wppSans weight 300 uppercase display at 52px, 4px-radius buttons, a floating navy pill nav, warm #fafaf0 footer and image-led case tiles.

wwf.name: WWF
wwf.description: World Wildlife Fund (worldwildlife.org) pairs full-bleed wildlife photography with a warm off-white canvas (#fefcf9), deep ocean-blue bands (#0f3d57) and pale blue sections (#eef4fa); Open Sans throughout with 54px/700 condensed (font-stretch 75%) two-tone headlines, near-black #0f0f0f ink, terracotta Donate (#cb4328) and oxblood Gifts (#6f190b) pill buttons, and 4px-radius cards.

wyndham.name: Wyndham Hotels & Resorts
wyndham.description: Wyndham Hotels & Resorts: hotel-booking site (APAC deals page) with a #282828 header, Wyndham blue #0065ab square uppercase buttons, HCo Gotham SSm 300 body at 15px and 700 headings at 28px, white and #f4f4f4 bands, 0px radii and no shadows.

x-ai.name: SpaceXAI (x.ai)
x-ai.description: SpaceXAI (x.ai) is a warm-white developer-product site: near-black #0a0a0a pill buttons, the variable sans xVf at weight 450 with -0.6px tracking, GeistMono for code, #f9f8f6 cards at 16px radius, and ember-orange gradient art as the only saturated color.

xbox.name: Xbox
xbox.description: Xbox.com (Microsoft) runs a full-bleed, image-led storefront on a black #000000 canvas with white #ffffff Segoe UI type, square 0px-radius CTAs set in SegoeProBlack 15px/900 uppercase, a Game Pass lime #9bf00b button with dark-green #054b16 label on its evergreen pages, heritage Xbox green #107c10 as the --brandColorPrimary token, campaign takeovers that recolour CTAs (currently red #f00000), and a light-grey #f2f2f2 Microsoft footer in #616161 11px text.

xiaohongshu.name: Xiaohongshu
xiaohongshu.description: Lifestyle UGC social platform. Singular brand red, generous radius, content-first.

xiaomi.name: Xiaomi
xiaomi.description: Xiaomi Global (mi.com/global) — a white-and-#f7f7f7 product showroom set entirely in MiSans Latin, with #191919 ink, a #191919 footer, Xiaomi orange #ff6900 reserved for nav hover and focus rings, 12px-radius controls and 999px pill details around full-bleed product photography.

xox.name: XOX by makemepulse
xox.description: XOX by makemepulse: playful avatar-game microsite on bubblegum pink #ffbbff with navy #204a78 labels, magenta #ff4fff and #ff34ff accents, Bangers 80px lettering, hand-lettered button face, Poppins 16px text and white 32px-radius pills.

y-u-t-corporate.name: Y.U.T Corporate
y-u-t-corporate.description: Y.U.T Corporate: Thai enterprise IT and internet services site with brand blue #0087e2 navigation and buttons, Prompt typeface weights 300 to 700, 50px uppercase hero, 20px-radius feature cards and blue-tinted shadows in rgb(0, 78, 190).

yahoo-japan.name: LY Corporation
yahoo-japan.description: LY Corporation corporate site (lycorp.co.jp/en): a white canvas with near-black #2e2e2e ink and no saturated accent, set entirely in LINESeedJP (400 and 700) with 38px display headlines, 20px, 12px and 8px rounded image cards and a soft 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) shadow over candid photography.

yale-university.name: Yale University
yale-university.description: Yale University: flagship university site in Yale blue #00356b on white with charcoal #222222 footer, yale serif headings at 36px, Mallory sans body at 20px, 14px uppercase tracked buttons, interactive blue #286dc0 and square 0px corners throughout.

yamaha.name: Yamaha Music USA
yamaha.description: Yamaha Music United States (usa.yamaha.com) measured on the live site: white canvas #ffffff with Yamaha purple #48207b for brand and links, dark #222222 footer, GTAmerica 700 uppercase 83px hero headlines, Oswald 500 category labels, Helvetica Neue 14px UI text, and a single 8px radius. Photography-led product grid.

yamaha-motor.name: Yamaha Motorsports USA
yamaha-motor.description: Yamaha Motorsports USA (yamahamotorsports.com) measured on the live site: Yamaha blue #003087 square-cornered CTAs, a black #000000 and white #ffffff band rhythm, Bebas Neue Pro uppercase headlines at 38px and 45.6px, Montserrat 14.44px body, and full-bleed motorcycle photography.

yame-the-molazone.name: Molazone - Yamê Official Website
yame-the-molazone.description: Molazone, the official website of the artist Yamê (mola-zone.com), measured on the live site: near-black canvas #0b0b0c, pure white #ffffff text, the single typeface Kern at 700 uppercase in 10px, 12px and 16px sizes with 0.44px to 1.36px tracking, one 50px radius, and monochrome line-illustration artwork.

yayoi-thailand.name: ร้านอาหารญี่ปุ่นยาโยอิ (Yayoi Thailand)
yayoi-thailand.description: Yayoi Thailand restaurant and delivery site by MK Restaurant Group - white page under a #ffd500 yellow header, hot-pink (#f0609f) pill buttons with 80px radius and magenta (#ec008c) accents, set in db_helvethaica at 17.5px body and 35px bold headings.

ynab.name: YNAB
ynab.description: YNAB (You Need A Budget): a buttermilk #fef9ed page with a blurple #545bfe hero, midnight #1c1f58 ink and header, Wishfarm Semibold headlines (64px, -0.64px) over Figtree body, firefly-green #aee865 CTAs with 6px corners and #1c1f58 text that deepen to #93d53e, white 12px stat cards, and wavy green and blue section edges.

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.description: YouTube logged-out homepage in Thailand: a white #ffffff canvas with near-black #0f0f0f Roboto type (24px/900 heading, 14px/500 controls), an outlined 20px-radius Sign in pill in action blue #065fd4, a capsule search bar and brand red #ff0033 only in the logo.

yucca-packaging.name: Yucca Packaging
yucca-packaging.description: Yucca Packaging (yucca.co.za), a South African food and produce packaging supplier, measured on the live site: porcelain page #fffdf5 over oat #dfdac6 bands, charcoal #1d1d1b ink and buttons, deep forest green #12271d, the single typeface Magnetik at weights 200 and 300, and small 3.28px, 6.56px and 13.13px radii.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.description: Zapier is a warm paper-toned marketing site: cream canvas #fffefb, reddish near-black ink #201515, one orange (#ff4f00) with 4px-radius buttons, Degular Display 500 at 56px for the hero, Inter for UI and body, and a light Serrif serif for card titles.

zappos.name: Zappos
zappos.description: Zappos.com: Caslon Ionic serif section titles at 24px/28.8px weight 500 over a white canvas, Modern Gothic sans for everything else at 16px/21.6px, black #000000 ink and square-cornered uppercase buttons with 2px radii, a #ffe300 yellow app button, #ffb967 orange and #ffe336 yellow promo bands, pill-shaped color swatches and #d12015 sale prices.

zara.name: Zara
zara.description: Zara's storefront is a monochrome editorial frame around full-bleed fashion photography: Helvetica Now Text at weight 300 for almost every word (13px uppercase nav, 12px/18px body, 11px/16px uppercase product names, 10px micro copy), a Didot 32px campaign line, #000000 ink on a #ffffff canvas, square 0px buttons — black #000000 filled 32px tall with 2px 12px padding that hovers to #333333 — and a #0170e9 focus ring.

zed.name: Zed Industries
zed.description: The zed.dev home page as Zed Industries runs it — IBM Plex Serif headings at 25.6px/390 and iA Writer Quattro body at 14px on a warm #eee7e7 textured field with white #ffffff panels, Zed brand blue #1348dc and Delta red #bf3c27 Download buttons with a 4px radius and an inset bottom shadow, and a live-looking editor mock built from #dcdcdd, #fafafa and #f5f5f5 surfaces.

zendesk.name: Zendesk
zendesk.description: Zendesk's marketing site: Vanilla Sans in medium weight at a 68px display size, near-black ink (#11110d) on white and warm grey (#f5f5f2) surfaces, a lime #d1f470 call-to-action button with 16px corners, a deep forest green band (#203524) and a darker lime-green accent (#70a32a) used for emphasis words, with very round 40px content cards and full-bleed photographic heroes.

zentry.name: Zentry
zentry.description: Zentry (zentry.com), a Human-Agentic OS and token project, measured on the live site: electric violet canvas #5542ff, lavender-mist text #dfdff2, black #000000 bands, ZentryScreamer 900 uppercase headlines up to 160px with negative tracking, Roboto Mono for all small text, and 4px, 6.4px and 8px radii.

zeroz-brand-site.name: /zeroz Official Site (Otsuka Pharmaceutical)
zeroz-brand-site.description: The official site of /zeroz (ゼロズ), Otsuka Pharmaceutical's Active Inner Resource supplement (otsuka-air.jp), measured live: near-black canvas #111312, signature green #00a852, white text, HelveticaNowDisplay for English display and TazuganeGothic for Japanese body at 18px with 1.8px tracking, and square 0px corners.

zettajoule.name: ZettaJoule
zettajoule.description: ZettaJoule (zetta-joule.com), an advanced nuclear technology company, measured live: white and duck-egg #f1f5f8 canvas, grey-brown ink #524f4b, dark blue #3d5e86 primary, Geist at weight 250 up to 177.776px with negative tracking, Inter for body, a blue-to-peach hero and 3.56px radii.

zillow.name: Zillow
zillow.description: Zillow home page: Object Sans 900 60px hero headline over photography, Inter 400/700 for UI with #535364 body and #111116 headings on #ffffff, Zillow blue #0041d9 buttons with 12px corners (hover #0033ab), outlined blue 'Sign in' variants, 20px-radius white cards with #cdcdd3 borders, a #f7f7f7 band and #d03c0b listing badges.

zoom.name: Zoom
zoom.description: Zoom (www.zoom.com), the AI-first work platform, measured on the live home page: white canvas, navy ink #00053d, Zoom blue #0b5cff primary buttons with 12px radius, Newsreader serif headlines at 54px and 48px, Inter UI text at 14px and 16px, and a blue-to-violet gradient hero with rounded product-preview cards.

zoox.name: Zoox
zoox.description: Zoox (zoox.com), the autonomous robotaxi service, measured on the live site: pale mint-grey #d3e4df and white fields, near-black ink #0d1212, mint green #64d5b3 call-to-action fills with 12px uppercase labels, GT Standard type at 56px and 28px, and large 16px to 36px rounded photographic cards.
